FILE .codex-context/invariants.md SHA256 40213766a29c6708c0b5b7df4b995c6016a817e8b5e02af4e818237596e01893
1: # Contracts to preserve
2:
3: [Repository rules](../CLAUDE.md) are authoritative. The contracts below link
4: those requirements to inspected source and existing verification paths;
5: source inspection does not establish that tests currently pass.
6:
7: | Contract | Evidence and verification |
8: | --- | --- |
9: | Workspace routes enforce tenant access, return 404 across organizations, and require capabilities above the route floor. Actors come from the signed-in principal. Production refuses developer sign-in. | `apps/server/src/app.ts`, `auth/http.ts`, `auth/config.ts`; `apps/server/test/auth.test.ts`, `api.test.ts`. |
10: | Workspace mutations, the hash-chained audit record, and revision changes share a transaction. Await storage calls; keep network calls outside transactions. Events publish only after commit, and rollback discards them. | `VisuaService.mutate/log/emit` in `apps/server/src/services/visua.ts`; `Store.transaction/afterCommit` in `storage/store.ts`; `apps/server/test/storage.test.ts`. |
11: | Concurrent PostgreSQL writers serialize by workspace and reread state after obtaining the lock. Nested transactions use savepoints. | `apps/server/src/services/visua.ts`, `storage/store.ts`, `storage/postgres.ts`; PostgreSQL cases in `apps/server/test/storage.test.ts`. |
12: | Agent mutations go through `host.propose()`, followed by human approval or explicitly granted autonomy. Agents cannot verify requirements, issue audit or authorization decisions, or file plans/templates as evidence. | `packages/agents/src/host.ts`, `tools.ts`, `apps/server/src/services/visua.ts`; `packages/agents/test/tools.test.ts`, `apps/server/test/api.test.ts`. |
13: | Not-applicable decisions require a rationale; scope recomputation preserves `userExclusion`. | `effectiveScope`, `updateState`, and framework scope updates in `apps/server/src/services/visua.ts`; `apps/server/test/api.test.ts`. |
14: | Status precedence is not-applicable, override, at-risk, verified, implemented, in-progress, not-started. Verification needs a positive target met, `verifiedAt`, and accepted unexpired evidence. Scores depend on workspace revision and the current hour; uncommitted computed results must not enter the score cache. | `packages/core/src/status.ts`, `apps/server/src/services/visua.ts`; `packages/core/test/core.test.ts`, `apps/server/test/storage.test.ts`. |
15: | Requirement statements retain corpus citations. Preserve published node IDs and law codes. AI RMF statements use the PDF extraction, not alternate CPRT/Playbook wording. Official catalog counts change only with an intentional source update. | `packages/frameworks/src/ingest/`, `packages/core/src/ids.ts`; `packages/frameworks/test/frameworks.test.ts`, `pnpm corpus:verify`. |
16: | Threat catalogs are derived coverage views, never assessable frameworks. Published threat links retain authority/status and stay separate from requirement crosswalks. A mapping is never evidence. | `packages/frameworks/src/threat-links.ts`, `threat-paths.ts`, `apps/server/src/services/threats.ts`, `packages/core/src/crosswalk.ts`; framework, agent, and API tests. |
17: | Restricted corpus text and derived artifacts stay out of Git. Licensed text must pass through `modelText()` / `licensedTextToModel()` before reaching a model. Preserve open-license notices. | `.gitignore`, `corpus/README.md`, `packages/frameworks/data/NOTICE.md`, `packages/agents/src/mode.ts`, `tools.ts`; `packages/agents/test/licensing.test.ts`, licensing guard in `scripts/check.ts`. |
18: | DNS timeout/server failure is unknown, not proof of a missing SSO ownership record. Domain lapse blocks new admission without locking existing members out of their route. | `apps/server/src/auth/domain-recheck.ts`, `auth/service.ts`, `storage/identity.ts`; `domain-recheck.test.ts`, `sso-recheck.test.ts`, and the canonical SSO design. |
19: | Visual values come from `DESIGN.md` tokens. Pair status colors with labels/glyphs; reserve tertiary violet for agents and framework-ai copper for AI frameworks. Preserve accessible 2D navigation. | `CLAUDE.md`, `DESIGN.md`, `packages/design/scripts/build.ts`, `apps/web/src/scene/`; design lint, `apps/web/test/screen-labels.test.ts`, and `e2e/visua.spec.ts`. |
20:
21: Use [verification commands](verification.md) to select the appropriate suite.
22: For SSO changes, also read the
23: [domain recheck specification](../docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-27-sso-domain-recheck-design.md).

1: import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";

23: const ThreatsPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/ThreatsPage.tsx").then((m) => ({ default: m.ThreatsPage })));
24: const ReportsPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/ReportsPage.tsx").then((m) => ({ default: m.ReportsPage })));

27: const TrustPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/TrustPage.tsx").then((m) => ({ default: m.TrustPage })));

29:
30: function Landing() {
31:   const { data, isLoading } = useWorkspaces();
32:   const me = useMe();
33:   const navigate = useNavigate();
34:   const canCreate = !!me.data?.activeTenant?.capabilities.includes("workspace.configure");
35:   useEffect(() => {
36:     if (isLoading || !data) return;
37:     if (data.length) navigate(`/w/${data[0]!.workspace.slug}`, { replace: true });
38:     else if (canCreate) navigate("/onboarding", { replace: true });
39:   }, [data, isLoading, navigate, canCreate]);
40:   if (data && !data.length && !canCreate) {
41:     return (
42:       <div className="login">
43:         <div className="login__card panel">
44:           <h1 style={{ margin: 0 }}>No workspaces yet</h1>
45:           <p className="muted">{me.data?.activeTenant ? `${me.data.activeTenant.name} has no workspace you can see. An admin creates workspaces and invites people.` : "You are not a member of any organization yet. Ask an administrator to add you."}</p>
46:         </div>
47:       </div>
48:     );
49:   }
50:   return <div className="page muted">Loading Visua…</div>;
51: }
52:
53: /** Everything except sign-in and public trust centers needs a signed-in principal. */
54: function RequireSignIn({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
55:   const me = useMe();
56:   const qc = useQueryClient();
57:   const location = useLocation();
58:   useEffect(() => onUnauthorized(() => qc.setQueryData(meKey, null)), [qc]);
59:   if (me.isLoading) return <div className="page muted">Loading Visua…</div>;
60:   if (!me.data) return <Navigate to={`/login?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(location.pathname + location.search)}`} replace />;
61:   return <>{children}</>;
62: }
63:
64: const Fallback = () => <div className="page muted">Loading…</div>;
65:
66: export function App() {
67:   return (
68:     <BrowserRouter>
69:       <Suspense fallback={<Fallback />}>
70:         <Routes>
71:           <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
72:           <Route path="/trust/:slug" element={<TrustPage />} />
73:           <Route path="/" element={<RequireSignIn><Landing /></RequireSignIn>} />
74:           <Route path="/onboarding" element={<RequireSignIn><OnboardingPage /></RequireSignIn>} />
75:           <Route path="/w/:ws" element={<RequireSignIn><Shell /></RequireSignIn>}>
76:             <Route index element={<HomePage />} />
77:             <Route path="observatory" element={<ObservatoryPage />} />
78:             <Route path="observatory/:fw" element={<ObservatoryPage />} />
79:             <Route path="plan" element={<PlanPage />} />
80:             <Route path="evidence" element={<EvidencePage />} />
81:             <Route path="agents" element={<AgentsPage />} />
82:             <Route path="agents/:runId" element={<AgentsPage />} />
83:             <Route path="policies" element={<PoliciesPage />} />
84:             <Route path="profile" element={<ProfilePage />} />
85:             <Route path="crosswalk" element={<CrosswalkPage />} />
86:             <Route path="soc2" element={<Soc2Page />} />
87:             <Route path="rmf" element={<RmfPage />} />
88:             <Route path="ai" element={<AiPage />} />
89:             <Route path="laws" element={<LawsPage />} />
90:             <Route path="threats" element={<ThreatsPage />} />
91:             <Route path="threats/:catalog" element={<ThreatsPage />} />
92:             <Route path="reports" element={<ReportsPage />} />
93:             <Route path="settings" element={<SettingsPage />} />
94:             <Route path="organization" element={<OrganizationPage />} />
95:           </Route>
96:           <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
97:         </Routes>
98:       </Suspense>
99:     </BrowserRouter>
100:   );
101: }

FILE apps/web/src/components/agents/Proposals.tsx SHA256 9f8466f7feb4847eea331483d23e6e631cafc7564e69d55cff02ac9843fc7b56
1: /** Proposal cards: agents propose, people dispose. */
2: import { Check, Eye, X } from "lucide-react";
3: import { useState } from "react";
4: import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
5: import { api } from "../../lib/api.ts";
6: import { useCan } from "../../lib/auth.ts";
7: import { truncate } from "../../lib/format.ts";
8: import { Markdown } from "../../lib/markdown.tsx";
9: import { useWsMutation } from "../../lib/queries.ts";
10: import type { Proposal } from "../../lib/types.ts";
11: import { AgentBadge, CitationBlock, CodeTag, Dialog, toast } from "../ui/index.tsx";
12:
13: const TYPE_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
14:   "set-level": "Assessment",
15:   "set-target": "Target",
16:   "set-applicability": "Scope",
17:   "create-task": "New task",
18:   "update-task": "Task update",
19:   "create-evidence": "Evidence",
20:   "review-evidence": "Evidence review",
21:   "create-policy": "Policy draft",
22:   "create-risk": "Risk",
23:   "set-rmf": "RMF settings",
24: };
25:
26: export function ProposalCard({ proposal, compact }: { proposal: Proposal; compact?: boolean }) {
27:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
28:   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
29:   const canDecide = useCan("work.approve");
30:   const decide = useWsMutation(ws, (decision: "approved" | "rejected") => api.post<Proposal>(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/proposals/${proposal.id}/decision`, { decision }));
31:   const act = (decision: "approved" | "rejected") =>
32:     decide.mutate(decision, {
33:       onSuccess: (p) => toast(p.status === "applied" ? `Applied: ${truncate(p.title, 60)}` : p.status === "rejected" ? "Proposal rejected" : `Could not apply: ${p.rationale.split("Apply failed:")[1] ?? ""}`, p.status === "failed" ? "error" : "info"),
34:       onError: (e) => toast((e as Error).message, "error"),
35:     });
36:   const pending = proposal.status === "pending";
37:   const body = typeof proposal.payload["body"] === "string" ? (proposal.payload["body"] as string) : undefined;
38:   const note = typeof proposal.payload["note"] === "string" ? (proposal.payload["note"] as string) : undefined;
39:   const checklist = Array.isArray(proposal.payload["checklist"]) ? (proposal.payload["checklist"] as string[]) : [];
40:   return (
41:     <div className="panel panel--raised" style={{ padding: 12, borderColor: pending ? "var(--color-tertiary-container)" : undefined }}>
42:       <div className="row" style={{ alignItems: "flex-start", gap: 10 }}>
43:         <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
44:           <div className="row" style={{ gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
45:             <AgentBadge label={TYPE_LABEL[proposal.type] ?? proposal.type} />
46:             <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
47:               confidence {proposal.confidence}
48:             </span>
49:             {!pending && (
50:               <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: proposal.status === "applied" ? "var(--color-status-implemented)" : proposal.status === "rejected" ? "var(--color-on-surface-muted)" : "var(--color-status-at-risk)" }}>
51:                 {proposal.status}
52:                 {proposal.decidedBy ? ` by ${proposal.decidedBy}` : ""}
53:               </span>
54:             )}
55:           </div>
56:           <div style={{ fontWeight: 500, marginTop: 6 }}>{proposal.title}</div>
57:           {!compact && <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13, marginTop: 4, whiteSpace: "pre-line" }}>{truncate(proposal.rationale, 320)}</div>}
58:           {proposal.nodeIds.length > 0 && (
59:             <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 4, marginTop: 8 }}>
60:               {proposal.nodeIds.slice(0, compact ? 4 : 12).map((id) => (
61:                 <CodeTag key={id} id={id} />
62:               ))}
63:               {proposal.nodeIds.length > (compact ? 4 : 12) ? <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>+{proposal.nodeIds.length - (compact ? 4 : 12)}</span> : null}
64:             </div>
65:           )}
66:         </div>
67:         <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
68:           {(body || note || checklist.length || proposal.citations.length) ? (
69:             <button className="btn btn--sm" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
70:               <Eye size={13} /> Review
71:             </button>
72:           ) : null}
73:           {pending && !canDecide && (
74:             <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }} title="Approvers, admins and owners decide proposals">
75:               Awaiting an approver
76:             </span>
77:           )}
78:           {pending && canDecide && (
79:             <>
80:               <button className="btn btn--agent btn--sm" onClick={() => act("approved")} disabled={decide.isPending}>
81:                 <Check size={13} /> Approve
82:               </button>
83:               <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" onClick={() => act("rejected")} disabled={decide.isPending}>
84:                 <X size={13} /> Reject
85:               </button>
86:             </>
87:           )}
88:         </div>
89:       </div>
90:       {open && (
91:         <Dialog
92:           wide
93:           title={proposal.title}
94:           onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
95:           footer={
96:             pending && canDecide ? (
97:               <>
98:                 <button className="btn" onClick={() => (act("rejected"), setOpen(false))}>
99:                   Reject
100:                 </button>
101:                 <button className="btn btn--agent" onClick={() => (act("approved"), setOpen(false))}>
102:                   Approve and apply
103:                 </button>
104:               </>
105:             ) : undefined
106:           }
107:         >
108:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
109:             <div className="muted" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-line" }}>{proposal.rationale}</div>
110:             {checklist.length > 0 && (
111:               <ol style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: 20, lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
112:                 {checklist.map((c) => (
113:                   <li key={c}>{c}</li>
114:                 ))}
115:               </ol>
116:             )}
117:             {proposal.citations.map((c, i) => (
118:               <CitationBlock key={i} citation={c} />
119:             ))}
120:             {body && (
121:               <div className="panel" style={{ maxHeight: "50vh", overflow: "auto" }}>
122:                 <Markdown text={body} />
123:               </div>
124:             )}
125:             {note && note.length > 80 && (
126:               <div className="panel" style={{ maxHeight: "50vh", overflow: "auto" }}>
127:                 <Markdown text={note} />
128:               </div>
129:             )}
130:           </div>
131:         </Dialog>
132:       )}
133:     </div>
134:   );
135: }

20: type Tab = "overview" | "tasks" | "evidence" | "mappings" | "history";
21:
22: export function Inspector({ nodeId, onClose }: { nodeId: string; onClose: () => void }) {
23:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
24:   const { data, isLoading } = useNodeDetail(ws, nodeId);
25:   const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("overview");
26:   if (isLoading || !data) {
27:     return (
28:       <aside className="inspector" aria-busy="true" data-hud>
29:         <div className="muted">Loading…</div>
30:       </aside>
31:     );
32:   }
33:   // Threat catalogs are not assessed: their nodes get the coverage inspector.
34:   if (data.threat) return <ThreatInspector data={data} onClose={onClose} />;
35:   const { node } = data;
36:   const status = data.status?.status ?? data.groupStatus ?? "not-started";
37:   return (
38:     <aside className="inspector" aria-label={`${node.code} details`} data-hud>
39:       <SheetGrabber />
40:       <header className="inspector__head">
41:         <div className="row" style={{ gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
42:           <FrameworkBadge frameworkId={node.frameworkId} />
43:           {data.ancestors.map((a) => (
44:             <CodeTag key={a.id} id={a.id} />
45:           ))}
46:           <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
47:           <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm btn--icon" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close inspector">
48:             <X size={14} />
49:           </button>
50:         </div>
51:         <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10, gap: 10, alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
52:           <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 600, color: "var(--color-primary)", lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
53:             {node.code}
54:           </span>
55:           <StatusChip status={status} />
56:         </div>
57:         {node.title && node.title !== node.code ? <h2 className="inspector__title">{node.title}</h2> : null}
58:       </header>
59:       <Tabs<Tab>
60:         value={tab}
61:         onChange={setTab}
62:         tabs={[
63:           { id: "overview", label: "Overview" },
64:           { id: "tasks", label: "Tasks", count: data.tasks.length },
65:           { id: "evidence", label: "Evidence", count: data.evidence.length },
66:           { id: "mappings", label: "Mappings", count: data.mappings.length },
67:           { id: "history", label: "History" },
68:         ]}
69:       />
70:       <div className="inspector__body">
71:         {tab === "overview" && <Overview data={data} />}
72:         {tab === "tasks" && <TasksTab data={data} />}
73:         {tab === "evidence" && <EvidenceTab data={data} />}
74:         {tab === "mappings" && <MappingsTab data={data} />}
75:         {tab === "history" && <HistoryTab data={data} />}
76:       </div>
77:       <AgentFooter data={data} />
78:     </aside>
79:   );
80: }
81:
82: function Overview({ data }: { data: NodeDetail }) {
83:   const { node } = data;
84:   const family = familyOf(node.frameworkId) as FrameworkFamily;
85:   const examples = node.examples ?? [];
86:   const pof = (node.attributes?.["pointsOfFocus"] as { title: string; text?: string }[] | undefined) ?? [];
87:   const objectives = (node.attributes?.["objectives"] as string[] | undefined) ?? [];
88:   const baselines = (node.attributes?.["baselines"] as string[] | undefined) ?? [];
89:   const rmf = node.frameworkId === "nist-rmf" ? (node.attributes as Record<string, unknown>) : undefined;
90:   const suggested = (node.attributes?.["suggestedActions"] as string[] | undefined) ?? [];
91:   const transparency = (node.attributes?.["transparency"] as string[] | undefined) ?? [];
92:   const about = node.attributes?.["about"] as string | undefined;
93:   const profileActions = (node.attributes?.["profileActions"] as ProfileAction[] | undefined) ?? [];
94:   const graph = useGraph(profileActions.length ? node.frameworkId : undefined);
95:   const riskTitle = (id: string) => graph.data?.profiles?.flatMap((p) => p.risks).find((r) => r.id === id)?.title ?? id;
96:   return (
97:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
98:       <p style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-line", lineHeight: 1.6 }}>{node.text}</p>
99:       {data.timing && (
100:         <div className="callout" role="note" style={{ fontSize: 12.5 }}>
101:           {data.timing.state === "upcoming"
102:             ? `○ Takes effect on ${data.timing.effective}. Until then it is prepared for, not counted in today's readiness.`
103:             : data.timing.state === "ended"
104:               ? `No longer in effect after ${data.timing.until}.`
105:               : `● In force since ${data.timing.effective}${data.timing.until ? `, until ${data.timing.until}` : ""}.`}
106:         </div>
107:       )}
108:       {data.source && (
109:         <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
110:           Source:{" "}
111:           {data.source.present ? (
112:             <a href={corpusFileUrl(data.source.path, data.source.page)} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
113:               {data.source.identifier ?? data.source.title}
114:               {data.source.page ? `, p. ${data.source.page}` : ""} <ExternalLink size={11} style={{ verticalAlign: -1 }} />
115:             </a>
116:           ) : (
117:             <span>{data.source.identifier ?? data.source.title}</span>
118:           )}
119:           {data.source.locator ? ` · ${data.source.locator}` : ""}
120:         </div>
121:       )}
122:       {data.contentNotice && node.attributes?.["licensed"] !== undefined && (
123:         <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11.5, fontStyle: "italic" }}>
124:           {data.contentNotice}
125:         </div>
126:       )}
127:       {node.assessable && data.state ? <Assessment data={data} family={family} /> : null}
128:       <OverlaySections data={data} />
129:       <ThreatsAddressed threats={data.threats ?? []} />
130:       {!node.assessable && data.score ? (
131:         <div className="panel panel--raised stack">
132:           <div className="row">
133:             <span className="eyebrow">Readiness</span>
134:             <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
135:             <span className="mono">{Math.round(data.score.readiness * 100)}%</span>
136:           </div>
137:           <StatusBar counts={data.score.counts} />
138:           <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
139:             {data.score.total} in scope · {data.score.gaps} gaps · evidence {Math.round(data.score.evidenceCoverage * 100)}%
140:           </span>
141:         </div>
142:       ) : null}
143:       {baselines.length > 0 && (
144:         <div className="row row--wrap">
145:           <span className="eyebrow">SP 800-53B baselines</span>
146:           {baselines.map((b) => (
147:             <span key={b} className="chip" style={{ cursor: "default" }}>
148:               {b.toUpperCase()}
149:             </span>
150:           ))}
151:         </div>
152:       )}
153:       {examples.length > 0 && (
154:         <section>
155:           <div className="eyebrow" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
156:             Official implementation examples
157:           </div>
158:           <ul style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: 18, lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
159:             {examples.map((e) => (
160:               <li key={e.code} style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
161:                 {e.text}
162:               </li>
163:             ))}
164:           </ul>
165:         </section>
166:       )}
167:       {pof.length > 0 && (
168:         <section>
169:           <div className="eyebrow" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
170:             Points of focus
171:           </div>
172:           <ul style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: 18, lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
173:             {pof.map((p) => (
174:               <li key={p.title} style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
175:                 <strong>{p.title}</strong>
176:                 {p.text ? ` — ${p.text}` : ""}
177:               </li>
178:             ))}
179:           </ul>
180:         </section>
181:       )}
182:       {suggested.length > 0 && (
183:         <section>
184:           <div className="eyebrow" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
185:             Suggested actions (AI RMF Playbook)
186:           </div>
187:           <ul style={{ margin: 0, paddingLeft: 18, lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
188:             {suggested.map((a) => (
189:               <li key={a} style={{ marginBottom: 6, whiteSpace: "pre-line" }}>
190:                 {a}
191:               </li>
192:             ))}
193:           </ul>
194:         </section>
195:       )}
196:       {transparency.length > 0 && (
197:         <details>
198:           <summary className="eyebrow" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
199:             Transparency and documentation ({transparency.length})
200:           </summary>
201:           <ul style={{ margin: "8px 0 0", paddingLeft: 18, lineHeight: 1.5, fontSize: 13 }}>
202:             {transparency.map((t) => (
203:               <li key={t}>{t}</li>
204:             ))}
205:           </ul>
206:         </details>
207:       )}
208:       {about && (
209:         <details>
210:           <summary className="eyebrow" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
211:             About this outcome (AI RMF Playbook)
212:           </summary>
213:           <p className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 1.6, fontSize: 13, whiteSpace: "pre-line" }}>
214:             {about}
215:           </p>
216:         </details>
217:       )}
218:       {profileActions.length > 0 && (
219:         <details>
220:           <summary className="eyebrow" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
221:             Generative AI Profile actions — NIST AI 600-1 ({profileActions.length})
222:           </summary>
223:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
224:             {profileActions.map((a) => (
225:               <div key={a.id} style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
226:                 <span className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-framework-ai)", marginRight: 6 }}>
227:                   {a.id}
228:                 </span>
229:                 {a.text}
230:                 {a.risks.length > 0 && (
231:                   <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 4, marginTop: 4 }}>
232:                     {a.risks.map((r) => (
233:                       <span key={r} className="chip" style={{ cursor: "default", fontSize: 11 }}>
234:                         {riskTitle(r)}
235:                       </span>
236:                     ))}
237:                   </div>
238:                 )}
239:               </div>
240:             ))}
241:           </div>
242:         </details>
243:       )}
244:       {rmf && (
245:         <section className="stack">
246:           <div className="eyebrow">Task details (SP 800-37 Rev. 2)</div>
247:           <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
248:             <strong style={{ color: "var(--color-on-surface)" }}>Outcome:</strong> {String(rmf["outcome"] ?? "")}
249:           </div>
250:           <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
251:             <strong style={{ color: "var(--color-on-surface)" }}>Primary responsibility:</strong> {((rmf["primaryResponsibility"] as string[]) ?? []).join("; ")}
252:           </div>
253:           <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
254:             <strong style={{ color: "var(--color-on-surface)" }}>Expected outputs:</strong> {((rmf["expectedOutputs"] as string[]) ?? []).join("; ")}
255:           </div>
256:         </section>
257:       )}
258:       {objectives.length > 0 && (
259:         <details>
260:           <summary className="eyebrow" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
261:             SP 800-53A assessment objectives ({objectives.length})
262:           </summary>
263:           <ul style={{ margin: "8px 0 0", paddingLeft: 18, lineHeight: 1.5, fontSize: 13 }}>
264:             {objectives.map((o) => (
265:               <li key={o}>{o}</li>
266:             ))}
267:           </ul>
268:         </details>
269:       )}
270:       {node.guidance && (
271:         <details>
272:           <summary className="eyebrow" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
273:             Discussion
274:           </summary>
275:           <p className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 1.6, fontSize: 13 }}>
276:             {node.guidance}
277:           </p>
278:         </details>
279:       )}
280:       {data.children.length > 0 && (
281:         <section>
282:           <div className="eyebrow" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
283:             Contains
284:           </div>
285:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
286:             {data.children.slice(0, 60).map((c) => (
287:               <div key={c.id} className="row" style={{ alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
288:                 <CodeTag id={c.id} />
289:                 <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
290:                   {truncate(c.title || c.text, 110)}
291:                 </span>
292:               </div>
293:             ))}
294:           </div>
295:         </section>
296:       )}
297:     </div>
298:   );
299: }
300:
301: function Assessment({ data, family }: { data: NodeDetail; family: FrameworkFamily }) {
302:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
303:   const meta = useMeta();
304:   const state = data.state!;
305:   const scale = meta.data?.levelScales[family];
306:   const [naOpen, setNaOpen] = useState(false);
307:   const [rationale, setRationale] = useState(state.applicabilityRationale ?? "");
308:   const update = useWsMutation(ws, (patch: Record<string, unknown>) => api.patch(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/requirements/${encodeURIComponent(data.node.id)}`, patch));
309:   const set = (patch: Record<string, unknown>) =>
310:     update.mutate(patch, {
311:       onError: (e) => toast((e as Error).message, "error"),
312:     });
313:   const levels = scale?.levels ?? [0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((l) => ({ level: l, label: levelLabel(family, l), description: "" }));
314:   const canWrite = useCan("work.write");
315:   // Scope and verification are review decisions (approvers and above).
316:   const canDecide = useCan("work.approve");
317:   return (
318:     <fieldset disabled={!canWrite} className="panel panel--raised stack" style={{ gap: 12, margin: 0, minWidth: 0 }} aria-label="Assessment">
319:       <div className="row">
320:         <span className="eyebrow">{scale?.name ?? "Implementation level"}</span>
321:         <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
322:         <LevelPips current={state.current} target={state.target} />
323:       </div>
324:       <LevelRow label="Current" value={state.current} levels={levels} onChange={(v) => set({ current: v })} disabled={!state.applicable} />
325:       <LevelRow label="Target" value={state.target} levels={levels} onChange={(v) => set({ target: v })} disabled={!state.applicable} />
326:       {data.status?.reasons.length ? <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{data.status.reasons.join(" · ")}</div> : null}
327:       <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
328:         <label className="field" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}>
329:           <span className="label">Priority</span>
330:           <select className="select" value={state.priority} onChange={(e) => set({ priority: e.target.value })}>
331:             {["critical", "high", "medium", "low"].map((p) => (
332:               <option key={p} value={p}>
333:                 {p}
334:               </option>
335:             ))}
336:           </select>
337:         </label>
338:         <label className="field" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}>
339:           <span className="label">Owner</span>
340:           <input className="input" defaultValue={state.owner ?? ""} placeholder="Unassigned" onBlur={(e) => e.target.value !== (state.owner ?? "") && set({ owner: e.target.value })} />
341:         </label>
342:       </div>
343:       <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
344:         {state.applicable ? (
345:           canDecide && (
346:             <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" onClick={() => setNaOpen(true)}>
347:               Mark not applicable…
348:             </button>
349:           )
350:         ) : (
351:           <>
352:             <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, flex: 1, minWidth: 180 }}>
353:               {state.userExclusion ? "Not applicable" : "Out of scope"}: {state.applicabilityRationale}
354:               {!state.userExclusion && <> · <Link to={programPath(ws, data.node.frameworkId)}>change the scope</Link></>}
355:             </span>
356:             {state.userExclusion && canDecide && (
357:               <button className="btn btn--sm" onClick={() => set({ applicable: true })}>
358:                 Bring into scope
359:               </button>
360:             )}
361:           </>
362:         )}
363:         <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
364:         {canDecide && state.applicable && state.current >= state.target && !state.verifiedAt && (
365:           <button className="btn btn--sm" onClick={() => set({ verifiedAt: new Date().toISOString() })} title="Record that an assessor verified the implementation and its evidence">
366:             Mark verified
367:           </button>
368:         )}
369:       </div>
370:       {naOpen && (
371:         <Dialog
372:           title={`Mark ${data.node.code} not applicable`}
373:           onClose={() => setNaOpen(false)}
374:           footer={
375:             <>
376:               <button className="btn" onClick={() => setNaOpen(false)}>
377:                 Cancel
378:               </button>
379:               <button
380:                 className="btn btn--primary"
381:                 disabled={rationale.trim().length < 12}
382:                 onClick={() => {
383:                   set({ applicable: false, applicabilityRationale: rationale.trim() });
384:                   setNaOpen(false);
385:                 }}
386:               >
387:                 Record decision
388:               </button>
389:             </>
390:           }
391:         >
392:           <div className="field">
393:             <label htmlFor="na-rationale">Rationale (visible to auditors)</label>
394:             <textarea id="na-rationale" className="textarea" value={rationale} onChange={(e) => setRationale(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. No on-premises facilities; physical controls are inherited from the cloud provider." />
395:             <span className="field__hint">Scoping decisions are first-class, reviewable artifacts in Visua — a written justification is required.</span>
396:           </div>
397:         </Dialog>
398:       )}
399:     </fieldset>
400:   );
401: }
402:
403: function LevelRow({ label, value, levels, onChange, disabled }: { label: string; value: number; levels: { level: number; label: string; description: string }[]; onChange: (v: number) => void; disabled?: boolean }) {
404:   return (
405:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
406:       <div className="row">
407:         <span style={{ width: 56, fontSize: 12 }} className="muted">
408:           {label}
409:         </span>
410:         <div className="segmented" role="radiogroup" aria-label={`${label} level`} style={{ flex: 1, justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
411:           {levels.map((l) => (
412:             <button key={l.level} role="radio" aria-checked={value === l.level} aria-pressed={value === l.level} disabled={disabled} onClick={() => onChange(l.level)} title={`${l.label}: ${l.description}`} style={{ flex: 1 }}>
413:               {l.level}
414:             </button>
415:           ))}
416:         </div>
417:       </div>
418:       <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginLeft: 64 }}>
419:         {levels.find((l) => l.level === value)?.label}
420:       </span>
421:     </div>
422:   );
423: }
424:
425: function TasksTab({ data }: { data: NodeDetail }) {
426:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
427:   const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
428:   const create = useWsMutation(ws, (t: string) => api.post(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/tasks`, { title: t, requirementIds: [data.node.id], kind: "procedure" }));
429:   const run = useRunAgent();
430:   return (
431:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
432:       {data.tasks.length === 0 && <Empty title="No tasks yet">Plan work with an agent or add one below.</Empty>}
433:       {data.tasks.map((t) => (
434:         <div key={t.id} className="panel panel--raised" style={{ padding: 12 }}>
435:           <div className="row" style={{ alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
436:             <ListChecks size={15} style={{ marginTop: 2, color: "var(--color-on-surface-muted)" }} />
437:             <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
438:               <div style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{t.title}</div>
439:               <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
440:                 {TASK_STATUS_LABEL[t.status]} · {t.priority} · due {shortDate(t.dueDate)} · {t.checklist.filter((c) => c.done).length}/{t.checklist.length} steps
441:                 {t.origin === "agent" ? " · " : ""}
442:                 {t.origin === "agent" ? <AgentBadge label="agent" /> : null}
443:               </div>
444:             </div>
445:             {t.status !== "done" && (
446:               <button className="btn btn--agent btn--sm" onClick={() => run("task-executor", `Execute task: ${t.title}`, { taskId: t.id })} title="Let an agent carry this task as far as software can (with your approval)">
447:                 <Bot size={13} /> Execute
448:               </button>
449:             )}
450:           </div>
451:         </div>
452:       ))}
453:       <form
454:         className="row"
455:         onSubmit={(e) => {
456:           e.preventDefault();
457:           if (title.trim()) create.mutate(title.trim(), { onSuccess: () => setTitle("") });
458:         }}
459:       >
460:         <input className="input" placeholder="Add a task for this requirement…" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} />
461:         <button className="btn btn--icon" aria-label="Add task" disabled={!title.trim()}>
462:           <Plus size={15} />
463:         </button>
464:       </form>
465:     </div>
466:   );
467: }
468:
469: function EvidenceTab({ data }: { data: NodeDetail }) {
470:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
471:   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
472:   const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
473:   const [content, setContent] = useState("");
474:   const [kind, setKind] = useState("document");
475:   const add = useWsMutation(ws, () => api.post(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/evidence`, { title, content, kind, requirementIds: [data.node.id] }));
476:   return (
477:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
478:       {data.evidence.length === 0 && <Empty title="No evidence yet">Evidence must show what is actually in place — configuration exports, logs, records or signed attestations.</Empty>}
479:       {data.evidence.map((e) => (
480:         <div key={e.id} className="panel panel--raised" style={{ padding: 12 }}>
481:           <div className="row" style={{ alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
482:             <FileText size={15} style={{ marginTop: 2, color: "var(--color-on-surface-muted)" }} />
483:             <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
484:               <div style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{e.title}</div>
485:               <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
486:                 {e.kind} · {e.source === "connector" ? "API-automated" : e.source === "agent" ? "agent-assisted" : "manual"} · {e.status}
487:                 {e.validUntil ? ` · valid until ${shortDate(e.validUntil)}` : ""}
488:               </div>
489:               {e.sha256 && (
490:                 <div className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 11, marginTop: 4 }} title="SHA-256 content hash (provenance)">
491:                   sha256 {e.sha256.slice(0, 16)}…
492:                 </div>
493:               )}
494:             </div>
495:           </div>
496:         </div>
497:       ))}
498:       <button className="btn" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
499:         <Plus size={14} /> Add evidence
500:       </button>
501:       {open && (
502:         <Dialog
503:           title={`Add evidence for ${data.node.code}`}
504:           onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
505:           footer={
506:             <>
507:               <button className="btn" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
508:                 Cancel
509:               </button>
510:               <button className="btn btn--primary" disabled={!title.trim()} onClick={() => add.mutate(undefined, { onSuccess: () => (setOpen(false), setTitle(""), setContent(""), toast("Evidence added — it awaits review")) })}>
511:                 Add for review
512:               </button>
513:             </>
514:           }
515:         >
516:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>

520:             </div>

532:             </div>

536:     </div>

539:
540: function MappingsTab({ data }: { data: NodeDetail }) {
541:   const navigate = useNavigate();
542:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
543:   const grouped = useMemo(() => {
544:     const m = new Map<string, NodeDetail["mappings"]>();
545:     for (const x of data.mappings) m.set(x.framework, [...(m.get(x.framework) ?? []), x]);
546:     return [...m.entries()];
547:   }, [data.mappings]);
548:   if (!data.mappings.length) return <Empty title="No authoritative mappings">No crosswalk in the local corpus maps this requirement yet.</Empty>;
549:   return (

559:               {list.length} · {list[0]?.authority}
560:             </span>
561:           </div>
562:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
563:             {list.map((m) => (
564:               <div key={m.id} className="row" style={{ alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
565:                 <CodeTag id={m.id} onNavigate={(id) => navigate(`/w/${ws}/observatory/${fw}?select=${encodeURIComponent(id)}`)} />
566:                 <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13, flex: 1 }}>
567:                   {truncate(m.title ? `${m.title}: ${m.text}` : m.text, 110)}
568:                 </span>
569:                 <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }} title="Current / target level">
570:                   {m.applicable === false ? "N/A" : m.current !== undefined ? `${m.current}/${m.target}` : ""}
571:                 </span>
572:               </div>
573:             ))}
574:           </div>
575:         </section>
576:       ))}
577:     </div>
578:   );
579: }

581: function HistoryTab({ data }: { data: NodeDetail }) {

608: export function useRunAgent() {
609:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
610:   const navigate = useNavigate();
611:   return async (agent: string, goal: string, input: Record<string, unknown>, opts: { stay?: boolean } = {}) => {
612:     try {
613:       await api.post(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/runs`, { agent, goal, input });
614:       toast(`${agent} started — watch it work in the scene or in Agents.`, "agent");
615:       if (!opts.stay) void navigate;
616:     } catch (e) {
617:       toast((e as Error).message, "error");
618:     }
619:   };
620: }

629:   return (

636:           <Sparkles size={13} /> Assess
637:         </button>
638:         <button className="btn btn--sm" onClick={() => run("planner", `Plan the work to reach target for ${label}`, input)}>
639:           Plan
640:         </button>

642:           Draft policy
643:         </button>

645:           Explain

648:       <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11, marginTop: 8 }}>
649:         Agents propose; you approve in <strong>Agents</strong>. {STATUS_LABEL[data.status?.status ?? "not-started"]} · {badgeOf(node.frameworkId)}
650:       </div>

FILE apps/web/src/components/inspector/Threats.tsx SHA256 4ff97f7dc32f5827e1fd49d737832c7c40d1b25375f525868ca11ddf968a53f6
1: /**
2:  * Threat inspector sections. A threat (ATLAS technique, OWASP entry, NIST AI 100-2
3:  * attack) is never assessed: the inspector shows what its publishers link it to,
4:  * with each link's status, and how far the workspace has implemented those
5:  * requirements. A requirement's inspector lists the threats it helps address.
6:  */
7: import { ExternalLink, Info, X } from "lucide-react";
8: import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
9: import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
10: import { corpusFileUrl } from "../../lib/api.ts";
11: import { truncate } from "../../lib/format.ts";
12: import { badgeOf, isThreatCatalog } from "../../lib/frameworks.ts";
13: import type { BriefNode, CoverageView, ExternalReference, LinkStatus, LinkView, NodeDetail, ThreatAddressed, ThreatPathView, ThreatRequirement } from "../../lib/types.ts";
14: import { CoverageBar, CoverageChip, CoverageLegend, LinkStatusBadge, ThreatLinkFilter } from "../threats/Coverage.tsx";
15: import { FrameworkBadge, LevelPips, Progress, SheetGrabber, StatusChip, Tabs } from "../ui/index.tsx";
16:
17: const enc = encodeURIComponent;
18:
19: /** Where a node lives in the app: requirements in the Observatory, threats on the Threats page. */
20: export function nodeHref(ws: string, framework: string, id: string, threat: boolean) {
21:   return threat ? `/w/${ws}/threats/${framework}?select=${enc(id)}` : `/w/${ws}/observatory/${framework}?select=${enc(id)}`;
22: }
23:
24: /**
25:  * ATLAS descriptions are Markdown with links to other ATLAS objects ("/techniques/AML.T0051.000")
26:  * and to outside pages. Render those links (in-app for ATLAS objects), everything else as text.
27:  */
28: function ThreatText({ ws, text }: { ws: string; text: string }) {
29:   const parts: React.ReactNode[] = [];
30:   const re = /\[([^\]]+)\]\(\s*([^)\s]+)\s*\)/g;
31:   let last = 0;
32:   let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
33:   while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
34:     if (m.index > last) parts.push(text.slice(last, m.index));
35:     const [, label, href] = m;
36:     const atlas = /^\/?(?:techniques|mitigations|tactics)\/(AML\.[A-Z]+\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\/?$/.exec(href!);
37:     if (atlas) {
38:       parts.push(
39:         <Link key={m.index} to={nodeHref(ws, "mitre-atlas", `mitre-atlas:${atlas[1]}`, true)}>
40:           {label}
41:         </Link>,
42:       );
43:     } else if (/^https?:\/\//.test(href!)) {
44:       parts.push(
45:         <a key={m.index} href={href} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">
46:           {label}
47:         </a>,
48:       );
49:     } else parts.push(label);
50:     last = m.index + m[0].length;
51:   }
52:   if (last < text.length) parts.push(text.slice(last));
53:   return <p style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-line", lineHeight: 1.6 }}>{parts}</p>;
54: }
55: const isThreat = isThreatCatalog;
56:
57: function LinkLine({ link }: { link: LinkView }) {
58:   return (
59:     <span className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 12 }}>
60:       <span className="muted">{link.label}</span>
61:       <LinkStatusBadge status={link.status} />
62:       <span className="muted" title={`${link.citation.documentId}${link.citation.locator ? ` · ${link.citation.locator}` : ""}${link.citation.page ? `, p. ${link.citation.page}` : ""}`}>
63:         {truncate(link.authority, 56)}
64:       </span>
65:     </span>
66:   );
67: }
68:
69: function PathLine({ ws, path }: { ws: string; path: ThreatPathView }) {
70:   const how = path.kind === "mitigation" ? "through mitigation" : path.kind === "edition" ? "through the same entry in the other edition" : "linked directly";
71:   return (
72:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 3, paddingLeft: 10, borderLeft: "2px solid var(--color-outline)" }}>
73:       <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 12 }}>
74:         <span className="muted">{how}</span>
75:         {path.via && (
76:           <Link to={nodeHref(ws, path.via.framework, path.via.id, true)} className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-primary)" }} title={path.via.title}>
77:             {path.via.code}
78:           </Link>
79:         )}
80:         {path.via && <span className="muted">{truncate(path.via.title, 40)}</span>}
81:         {path.group && <span className="muted">· via group {path.group}</span>}
82:       </div>
83:       {path.links.map((l, i) => (
84:         <div key={i} className="stack" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
85:           <LinkLine link={l} />
86:           {l.note && (
87:             <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
88:               “{truncate(l.note, 260)}”
89:             </div>
90:           )}
91:         </div>
92:       ))}
93:     </div>
94:   );
95: }
96:
97: function RequirementRow({ ws, r }: { ws: string; r: ThreatRequirement }) {
98:   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
99:   return (
100:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6, padding: "6px 0", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--color-outline)" }}>
101:       <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8, alignItems: "center" }}>
102:         <FrameworkBadge frameworkId={r.framework} />
103:         <Link to={nodeHref(ws, r.framework, r.id, false)} className="mono xw-code" title={`Open ${r.code} in the Observatory`}>
104:           {r.code}
105:         </Link>
106:         <span className="xw-title" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }} title={r.title}>
107:           {r.title}
108:         </span>
109:         {!r.enabled ? (
110:           <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
111:             not followed
112:           </span>
113:         ) : r.applicable === false ? (
114:           <StatusChip status="not-applicable" />
115:         ) : r.status ? (
116:           <StatusChip status={r.status} />
117:         ) : null}
118:       </div>
119:       <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
120:         {r.enabled && r.applicable !== false && r.current !== undefined && r.target !== undefined ? <LevelPips current={r.current} target={r.target} /> : null}
121:         {r.best && <LinkStatusBadge status={r.best} />}
122:         <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
123:         <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} aria-expanded={open}>
124:           {open ? "Hide" : "Why linked"} ({r.paths.length})
125:         </button>
126:       </div>
127:       {open && (
128:         <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
129:           {r.paths.map((p, i) => (
130:             <PathLine key={i} ws={ws} path={p} />
131:           ))}
132:         </div>
133:       )}
134:     </div>
135:   );
136: }
137:
138: const STATUS_ORDER: Record<LinkStatus, number> = { final: 3, draft: 2, unreviewed: 1, superseded: 0 };
139:
140: interface Route {
141:   key: string;
142:   kind: ThreatPathView["kind"];
143:   via?: BriefNode;
144:   group?: string;
145:   requirements: ThreatRequirement[];
146: }
147: interface Publication {
148:   publication: string;
149:   status: LinkStatus;
150:   view?: CoverageView;
151:   routes: Route[];
152:   requirements: number;
153: }
154:
155: /**
156:  * Linked requirements as coverage counts them: by the publication that links them
157:  * (the last link of each path), then by route — directly, through an ATLAS mitigation,
158:  * through the other edition's entry, or through a group such as an AI RMF category.
159:  */
160: function byPublication(requirements: ThreatRequirement[], views: CoverageView[]): Publication[] {
161:   const pubs = new Map<string, { status: LinkStatus; routes: Map<string, Route>; ids: Set<string> }>();
162:   for (const r of requirements) {
163:     for (const p of r.paths) {
164:       const publication = p.links[p.links.length - 1]!.authority;
165:       const pub = pubs.get(publication) ?? { status: p.status, routes: new Map(), ids: new Set() };
166:       if (STATUS_ORDER[p.status] < STATUS_ORDER[pub.status]) pub.status = p.status;
167:       const key = p.via ? `via:${p.via.id}` : p.group ? `group:${p.group}` : "direct";
168:       const route = pub.routes.get(key) ?? { key, kind: p.kind, ...(p.via ? { via: p.via } : {}), ...(p.group ? { group: p.group } : {}), requirements: [] };
169:       if (!route.requirements.includes(r)) route.requirements.push(r);
170:       pub.routes.set(key, route);
171:       pub.ids.add(r.id);
172:       pubs.set(publication, pub);
173:     }
174:   }
175:   return [...pubs.entries()]
176:     .map(([publication, p]) => ({
177:       publication,
178:       status: p.status,
179:       view: views.find((v) => v.publication === publication),
180:       routes: [...p.routes.values()].sort((a, b) => (a.key === "direct" ? -1 : b.key === "direct" ? 1 : b.requirements.length - a.requirements.length)),
181:       requirements: p.ids.size,
182:     }))
183:     .sort((a, b) => STATUS_ORDER[b.status] - STATUS_ORDER[a.status] || b.requirements - a.requirements);
184: }
185:
186: function RouteGroup({ ws, route }: { ws: string; route: Route }) {
187:   const [limit, setLimit] = useState(8);
188:   const rows = [...route.requirements].sort((a, b) => a.framework.localeCompare(b.framework) || a.code.localeCompare(b.code, undefined, { numeric: true }));
189:   return (
190:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
191:       <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 12, marginTop: 6 }}>
192:         <span className="muted">
193:           {route.kind === "mitigation" ? "Through mitigation" : route.kind === "edition" ? "Through the same entry in the other edition" : route.group ? "Through the group" : "Linked directly"}
194:         </span>
195:         {route.via && (
196:           <Link to={nodeHref(ws, route.via.framework, route.via.id, true)} className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-primary)" }} title={route.via.title}>
197:             {route.via.code}
198:           </Link>
199:         )}
200:         {route.via && <span className="muted">{truncate(route.via.title, 44)}</span>}
201:         {route.group && <span className="mono">{route.group}</span>}
202:         <span className="muted">· {rows.length}</span>
203:       </div>
204:       {rows.slice(0, limit).map((r) => (
205:         <RequirementRow key={r.id} ws={ws} r={r} />
206:       ))}
207:       {rows.length > limit && (
208:         <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" style={{ alignSelf: "flex-start" }} onClick={() => setLimit(rows.length)}>
209:           Show {rows.length - limit} more
210:         </button>
211:       )}
212:     </div>
213:   );
214: }

299: type ThreatTab = "overview" | "requirements" | "related";
300:
301: export function ThreatInspector({ data, onClose }: { data: NodeDetail; onClose: () => void }) {
302:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
303:   const [tab, setTab] = useState<ThreatTab>("overview");
304:   const { node } = data;
305:   const threat = data.threat!;
306:   const a = (node.attributes ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
307:   const prevention = (a["preventionStrategies"] as { label: string; title?: string; text: string; page?: number }[] | undefined) ?? [];
308:   const intro = (a["preventionIntro"] as string[] | undefined) ?? [];
309:   const lineage = [a["previousEdition"], a["nextEdition"]].filter(Boolean) as { key: string; nodeId: string; basis?: string }[];
310:   const tactics = (a["tactics"] as string[] | undefined) ?? [];
311:   const c = threat.coverage;
312:   return (
313:     <aside className="inspector" aria-label={`${node.code} details`} data-hud>
314:       <SheetGrabber />
315:       <header className="inspector__head">
316:         <div className="row" style={{ gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
317:           <FrameworkBadge frameworkId={node.frameworkId} />
318:           {data.ancestors.map((x) => (
319:             <span key={x.id} className="code" title={x.title}>
320:               {x.code}
321:             </span>
322:           ))}
323:           <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
324:           <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm btn--icon" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close inspector">
325:             <X size={14} />
326:           </button>
327:         </div>
328:         <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10, gap: 10, alignItems: "flex-start", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
329:           <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 600, color: "var(--color-primary)", lineHeight: 1.2 }}>
330:             {String(a["key"] ?? node.code)}
331:           </span>
332:           <CoverageChip coverage={c} />
333:         </div>
334:         <h2 className="inspector__title">{node.title}</h2>
335:       </header>
336:       <Tabs<ThreatTab>
337:         value={tab}
338:         onChange={setTab}
339:         tabs={[
340:           { id: "overview" as ThreatTab, label: "Overview" },
341:           ...(threat.group ? [] : [{ id: "requirements" as ThreatTab, label: "Linked requirements", count: threat.requirements.length }]),
342:           { id: "related" as ThreatTab, label: "Related threats", count: threat.related.length },
343:         ]}
344:       />
345:       <div className="inspector__body">
346:         {tab === "overview" && (
347:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
348:             <ThreatText ws={ws} text={node.text} />
349:             {data.source && (
350:               <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
351:                 Source:{" "}
352:                 {data.source.present ? (
353:                   <a href={corpusFileUrl(data.source.path, data.source.page)} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
354:                     {data.source.identifier ?? data.source.title}
355:                     {data.source.page ? `, p. ${data.source.page}` : ""} <ExternalLink size={11} style={{ verticalAlign: -1 }} />
356:                   </a>
357:                 ) : (
358:                   <span>{data.source.identifier ?? data.source.title}</span>
359:                 )}
360:                 {data.source.locator ? ` · ${data.source.locator}` : ""}
361:               </div>
362:             )}
363:             <div className="panel panel--raised stack" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
364:               <div className="row">
365:                 <span className="eyebrow">Coverage</span>
366:                 <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
367:                 {c.level !== null ? <LevelPips current={c.level} target={4} /> : null}
368:               </div>
369:               {threat.group && (
370:                 <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
371:                   <CoverageBar byState={threat.group.byState} />
372:                   <CoverageLegend byState={threat.group.byState} />
373:                 </div>
374:               )}
375:               <div style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
376:                 {threat.group
377:                   ? `${threat.group.units} ${threat.group.units === 1 ? "threat" : "threats"} in this group; coverage pooled from each one's linked requirements.`
378:                   : c.state === "unmapped"
379:                   ? "No publisher links this threat to a requirement at the chosen link status."
380:                   : c.state === "out-of-scope"
381:                     ? `${c.linked} linked requirement${c.linked === 1 ? "" : "s"}, all in frameworks this workspace does not follow (${c.frameworks.map(badgeOf).join(", ")}).`
382:                     : `${c.met} of ${c.inScope} linked requirement${c.inScope === 1 ? "" : "s"} in scope ${c.met === 1 ? "is" : "are"} at target · ${Math.round(c.progress * 100)}% of the way, each publication counted once${c.atRisk ? ` · ${c.atRisk} at risk` : ""}.`}
383:               </div>
384:               {c.best && (
385:                 <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 12 }}>
386:                   <span className="muted">Strongest link</span>
387:                   <LinkStatusBadge status={c.best} />
388:                 </div>
389:               )}
390:               <ThreatLinkFilter />
391:               <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11.5 }}>
392:                 Derived from the requirements linked to this threat, not an assessment of it. Coverage is not a guarantee of protection.
393:               </div>
394:             </div>
395:             {tactics.length > 0 && (
396:               <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
397:                 <span className="eyebrow">Tactics</span>
398:                 {tactics.map((t) => (
399:                   <span key={t} className="chip" style={{ cursor: "default" }}>
400:                     {t.split(":")[1]}
401:                   </span>
402:                 ))}
403:                 {a["maturity"] ? <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>· maturity: {String(a["maturity"])}</span> : null}
404:               </div>
405:             )}
406:             {lineage.length > 0 && (
407:               <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 12.5 }}>
408:                 <span className="eyebrow">Other edition</span>
409:                 {lineage.map((l) => (
410:                   <Link key={l.nodeId} to={nodeHref(ws, node.frameworkId, l.nodeId, true)} className="mono" title={l.basis}>
411:                     {l.key}
412:                   </Link>
413:                 ))}
414:               </div>
415:             )}
416:             {prevention.length > 0 && (
417:               <details open>
418:                 <summary className="eyebrow" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
419:                   Prevention and mitigation strategies ({prevention.length})
420:                 </summary>
421:                 {intro.map((p) => (
422:                   <p key={p} className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.55 }}>
423:                     {p}
424:                   </p>
425:                 ))}
426:                 <ol style={{ margin: "8px 0 0", paddingLeft: 20, lineHeight: 1.55, fontSize: 13 }}>
427:                   {prevention.map((p) => (
428:                     <li key={`${p.label}-${p.text.slice(0, 20)}`} style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
429:                       {p.title ? <strong>{p.title}. </strong> : null}
430:                       {p.text}
431:                     </li>
432:                   ))}
433:                 </ol>
434:               </details>
435:             )}
436:             {data.children.length > 0 && (
437:               <section>
438:                 <div className="eyebrow" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
439:                   {node.kind === "tactic" ? "Techniques" : node.kind === "technique" ? "Sub-techniques" : "Contains"} ({data.children.length})
440:                 </div>
441:                 <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
442:                   {data.children.slice(0, 80).map((ch) => (
443:                     <div key={ch.id} className="row" style={{ gap: 8, fontSize: 12.5 }}>
444:                       <Link to={nodeHref(ws, node.frameworkId, ch.id, true)} className="mono xw-code">
445:                         {ch.code}
446:                       </Link>
447:                       <span className="xw-title">{ch.title}</span>
448:                     </div>
449:                   ))}
450:                 </div>
451:               </section>
452:             )}
453:             <ExternalRefs refs={threat.externalRefs} />
454:             {data.contentNotice && (
455:               <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11.5, fontStyle: "italic" }}>
456:                 {data.contentNotice}
457:               </div>
458:             )}
459:           </div>
460:         )}
461:         {tab === "requirements" && (
462:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 14 }}>
463:             <ThreatLinkFilter />
464:             <div className="callout" role="note">
465:               <Info size={14} /> A link says a publisher considers the requirement relevant to this threat. Implementing it is not proof of protection.
466:             </div>
467:             {!threat.requirements.length ? <div className="muted">No linked requirement at the chosen link status.</div> : <LinkedRequirements ws={ws} requirements={threat.requirements} views={threat.coverage.views} />}
468:           </div>
469:         )}
470:         {tab === "related" && (
471:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
472:             {!threat.related.length && <div className="muted">No published link to another threat catalog.</div>}
473:             {threat.related.map((r, i) => (
474:               <div key={`${r.id}-${i}`} className="stack" style={{ gap: 3, paddingBottom: 8, borderBottom: "1px solid var(--color-outline)" }}>
475:                 <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
476:                   <FrameworkBadge frameworkId={r.framework} />
477:                   <Link to={nodeHref(ws, r.framework, r.id, isThreat(r.framework))} className="mono xw-code">
478:                     {r.code}
479:                   </Link>
480:                   <span className="xw-title" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
481:                     {r.title}
482:                   </span>
483:                 </div>
484:                 <LinkLine link={r} />
485:                 {r.note && (
486:                   <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
487:                     “{truncate(r.note, 300)}”
488:                   </div>
489:                 )}
490:               </div>
491:             ))}
492:           </div>
493:         )}
494:       </div>
495:     </aside>
496:   );
497: }
