499: /** Requirement inspector section: the threats this requirement helps address. */
500: export function ThreatsAddressed({ threats }: { threats: ThreatAddressed[] }) {
501:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
502:   const [limit, setLimit] = useState(12);
503:   if (!threats.length) return null;
504:   const direct = threats.filter((t) => t.paths.some((p) => p.kind === "direct")).length;
505:   return (
506:     <details>
507:       <summary className="eyebrow" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
508:         Threats this helps address ({threats.length})
509:       </summary>
510:       <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, margin: "6px 0 8px" }}>
511:         {direct} linked directly, {threats.length - direct} through an ATLAS mitigation or another edition. Published links, labeled by status.
512:       </div>
513:       <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
514:         {threats.slice(0, limit).map((t) => {
515:           const via = t.paths.find((p) => p.via)?.via;
516:           return (
517:             <div key={t.id} className="row" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 12.5 }}>
518:               <FrameworkBadge frameworkId={t.framework} />
519:               <Link to={nodeHref(ws, t.framework, t.id, true)} className="mono xw-code">
520:                 {t.code}
521:               </Link>
522:               <span className="xw-title" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }} title={via ? `${t.title} (via ${via.code} ${via.title})` : t.title}>
523:                 {t.title}
524:                 {via && !t.paths.some((p) => p.kind === "direct") ? <span className="muted"> · via {via.code}</span> : null}
525:               </span>
526:               <LinkStatusBadge status={t.best} />
527:             </div>
528:           );
529:         })}
530:       </div>
531:       {threats.length > limit && (
532:         <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" style={{ marginTop: 6 }} onClick={() => setLimit(limit + 40)}>
533:           Show {Math.min(40, threats.length - limit)} more
534:         </button>
535:       )}
536:     </details>
537:   );
538: }

FILE apps/web/src/components/laws/Timeline.tsx SHA256 2f953a4b3ea6010bd8d2e30cfd98c673968a80f6d3c9321a3c7000e1f59e438f
1: /**
2:  * When state-law obligations take effect. One column per month with effective dates:
3:  * its height is the number of obligations that take effect then, filled when they are
4:  * in force and outlined when they are still to come; a dashed line marks today. Only
5:  * the next wave and the largest month carry a label: every month shows its laws on
6:  * hover and keyboard focus, and the list view gives every date in words.
7:  *
8:  * The SVG is drawn at its real width in pixels, so its text stays at the type scale.
9:  */
10: import { useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
11: import { Segmented } from "../ui/index.tsx";
12:
13: export interface TimelineEntry {
14:   date: string;
15:   lawCode: string;
16:   lawId: string;
17:   label: string;
18:   obligations: number;
19:   past: boolean;
20: }
21:
22: interface Month {
23:   month: string;
24:   /** Dates before the window fold into its first month. */
25:   earlier: boolean;
26:   laws: { code: string; title: string; obligations: number; date: string; past: boolean }[];
27:   obligations: number;
28:   past: boolean;
29: }
30:
31: const t = (d: string) => new Date(`${d.length === 7 ? `${d}-01` : d}T00:00:00Z`).getTime();
32: const DAY = 86_400_000;
33:
34: /** The width of an element, followed as it resizes (a callback ref, so a remounted element is followed too). */
35: function useWidth() {
36:   const [el, setEl] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null);
37:   const [width, setWidth] = useState(0);
38:   useLayoutEffect(() => {
39:     if (!el) return;
40:     const measure = () => setWidth(el.clientWidth);
41:     measure();
42:     const ro = new ResizeObserver(measure);
43:     ro.observe(el);
44:     return () => ro.disconnect();
45:   }, [el]);
46:   return [setEl, width] as const;
47: }
48:
49: export function LawTimeline({ timeline, today }: { timeline: TimelineEntry[]; today: string }) {
50:   const [view, setView] = useState<"chart" | "list">("chart");
51:   const [ref, width] = useWidth();
52:   const [hover, setHover] = useState<string | null>(null);
53:
54:   const months = useMemo(() => {
55:     const windowStart = new Date(t(today) - 2 * 365 * DAY).toISOString().slice(0, 7);
56:     const by = new Map<string, Month>();
57:     for (const p of timeline) {
58:       const earlier = p.date.slice(0, 7) < windowStart;
59:       const month = earlier ? windowStart : p.date.slice(0, 7);
60:       const m = by.get(month) ?? { month, earlier: false, laws: [], obligations: 0, past: true };
61:       m.laws.push({ code: p.lawCode, title: p.label, obligations: p.obligations, date: p.date, past: p.past });
62:       m.obligations += p.obligations;
63:       m.past = m.past && p.past;
64:       m.earlier = m.earlier || earlier;
65:       by.set(month, m);
66:     }
67:     return [...by.values()].sort((a, b) => a.month.localeCompare(b.month));
68:   }, [timeline, today]);
69:   if (!months.length) return null;
70:
71:   // Scales: time across, obligations up. Room for labels above, the axis below.
72:   const W = Math.max(width, 280);
73:   const pad = 16;
74:   const top = 34;
75:   const base = 104;
76:   const H = base + 26;
77:   const min = t(months[0]!.month) - 45 * DAY;
78:   const max = Math.max(t(months.at(-1)!.month), t(today)) + 75 * DAY;
79:   const x = (d: string) => pad + ((t(d) - min) / (max - min)) * (W - 2 * pad);
80:   const most = Math.max(...months.map((m) => m.obligations));
81:   const h = (n: number) => 6 + (n / most) * (base - top - 6);
82:   const band = Math.max(8, Math.min(16, ((W - 2 * pad) / ((max - min) / (30 * DAY))) * 0.7));
83:   const years: number[] = [];
84:   for (let y = new Date(min).getUTCFullYear(); y <= new Date(max).getUTCFullYear(); y++) if (t(`${y}-01-01`) > min && t(`${y}-01-01`) < max) years.push(y);
85:   const label = (m: Month) => `${m.earlier ? "≤ " : ""}${m.month} · ${m.laws.length === 1 ? m.laws[0]!.code : `${new Set(m.laws.map((l) => l.code)).size} laws`}`;
86:
87:   // Selective direct labels: the next wave to come, then the largest month already in force, if they do not collide.
88:   const next = months.find((m) => !m.past && m.month >= today.slice(0, 7));
89:   const largest = [...months].filter((m) => m.past).sort((a, b) => b.obligations - a.obligations)[0];
90:   const labeled: { m: Month; x: number; anchor: "start" | "end"; text: string }[] = [];
91:   for (const m of [next, largest]) {
92:     if (!m || labeled.some((l) => l.m === m)) continue;
93:     const text = m === next ? `Next: ${label(m)}` : label(m);
94:     const px = x(m.month);
95:     const w = text.length * 6.7;
96:     const anchor = px + w > W - pad ? "end" : "start";
97:     const [a, b] = anchor === "start" ? [px - 2, px + w] : [px - w, px + 2];
98:     if (labeled.some((l) => (l.anchor === "start" ? l.x < b && a < l.x + l.text.length * 6.7 : l.x - l.text.length * 6.7 < b && a < l.x))) continue;
99:     labeled.push({ m, x: px, anchor, text });
100:   }
101:   const focus = months.find((m) => m.month === hover);
102:
103:   return (
104:     <div className="panel">
105:       <div className="panel__head">
106:         <h2>When obligations take effect</h2>
107:         <span className="spacer" />
108:         <Segmented
109:           label="Timeline view"
110:           value={view}
111:           onChange={(v) => setView(v)}
112:           options={[
113:             { id: "chart", label: "Chart" },
114:             { id: "list", label: "List" },
115:           ]}
116:         />
117:       </div>
118:       {view === "chart" ? (
119:         <>
120:           <div className="row row--wrap law-timeline__legend" aria-hidden>
121:             <span className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
122:               <svg width="10" height="12">
123:                 <rect x="1" y="1" width="8" height="11" rx="2" fill="var(--color-framework-law)" />
124:               </svg>
125:               In force
126:             </span>
127:             <span className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
128:               <svg width="10" height="12">
129:                 <rect x="1.75" y="1.75" width="6.5" height="9.5" rx="2" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="var(--color-framework-law)" strokeWidth="1.5" />
130:               </svg>
131:               Upcoming
132:             </span>
133:             <span className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
134:               <svg width="10" height="12">
135:                 <line x1="5" x2="5" y1="0" y2="12" stroke="var(--color-primary)" strokeDasharray="3 2" />
136:               </svg>
137:               Today, {today}
138:             </span>
139:             <span className="muted">Height: obligations taking effect that month</span>
140:           </div>
141:           <div ref={ref} className="law-timeline" onPointerLeave={() => setHover(null)}>
142:             {width > 0 && (
143:               <svg width={W} height={H} role="list" aria-label="Effective-date timeline of the tracked laws">
144:                 <line x1={pad} x2={W - pad} y1={base} y2={base} stroke="var(--color-outline-strong)" strokeWidth={1} />
145:                 {years.map((y) => (
146:                   <g key={y} aria-hidden>
147:                     <line x1={x(`${y}-01-01`)} x2={x(`${y}-01-01`)} y1={base} y2={base + 5} stroke="var(--color-outline-strong)" />
148:                     <text x={x(`${y}-01-01`) + 3} y={base + 18} fill="var(--color-on-surface-muted)" fontSize={11}>
149:                       {y}
150:                     </text>
151:                   </g>
152:                 ))}
153:                 <line x1={x(today)} x2={x(today)} y1={top - 12} y2={base + 5} stroke="var(--color-primary)" strokeDasharray="3 3" aria-hidden />
154:                 {months.map((m) => {
155:                   const px = x(m.month);
156:                   const bh = h(m.obligations);
157:                   const text = `${m.earlier ? `${m.month} or earlier` : m.month}: ${m.laws.map((l) => l.code).join(", ")} — ${m.obligations} obligation${m.obligations === 1 ? "" : "s"} ${m.past ? "in force" : "take effect"}`;
158:                   return (
159:                     <g
160:                       key={m.month}
161:                       role="listitem"
162:                       tabIndex={0}
163:                       aria-label={text}
164:                       className={`law-timeline__month ${hover === m.month ? "is-active" : ""}`}
165:                       onPointerEnter={() => setHover(m.month)}
166:                       onFocus={() => setHover(m.month)}
167:                       onBlur={() => setHover(null)}
168:                     >
169:                       {/* The hit area is the whole column band, not just the bar. */}
170:                       <rect x={px - Math.max(12, band / 2 + 4)} y={top - 12} width={Math.max(24, band + 8)} height={base - top + 18} fill="transparent" />
171:                       <path
172:                         d={`M${px - band / 2},${base} v${-(bh - 4)} q0,-4 4,-4 h${band - 8} q4,0 4,4 v${bh - 4} z`}
173:                         fill={m.past ? "var(--color-framework-law)" : "var(--color-surface)"}
174:                         stroke={m.past ? "none" : "var(--color-framework-law)"}
175:                         strokeWidth={m.past ? 0 : 1.5}
176:                       />
177:                     </g>
178:                   );
179:                 })}
180:                 {labeled.map((l) => (
181:                   <g key={l.m.month} aria-hidden>
182:                     <line x1={l.x} x2={l.x} y1={base - h(l.m.obligations) - 3} y2={top - 8} stroke="var(--color-outline-strong)" />
183:                     <text x={l.anchor === "start" ? l.x + 4 : l.x - 4} y={top - 12} textAnchor={l.anchor} fill="var(--color-on-surface)" stroke="var(--color-surface)" strokeWidth={4} paintOrder="stroke" fontSize={11} fontFamily="var(--font-code-sm-family)">
184:                       {l.text}
185:                     </text>
186:                   </g>
187:                 ))}
188:               </svg>
189:             )}
190:             {focus && (
191:               <div className="tooltip law-timeline__tip" role="status" style={{ left: Math.min(Math.max(8, x(focus.month) - 140), W - 288), top: 4 }}>
192:                 <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
193:                   <strong className="mono">{focus.obligations}</strong>
194:                   <span className="muted">
195:                     obligation{focus.obligations === 1 ? "" : "s"} {focus.past ? "in force since" : "take effect"} {focus.earlier ? `${focus.month} or earlier` : focus.month}
196:                   </span>
197:                 </div>
198:                 <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 2, marginTop: 6 }}>
199:                   {focus.laws.slice(0, 8).map((l) => (
200:                     <div key={`${l.code}-${l.date}`} className="row" style={{ gap: 8, fontSize: 12 }}>
201:                       <span className="mono" style={{ minWidth: 26, textAlign: "right" }}>
202:                         {l.obligations}
203:                       </span>
204:                       <span className="mono muted">{l.code}</span>
205:                       <span className="muted">{l.date}</span>
206:                     </div>
207:                   ))}
208:                   {focus.laws.length > 8 && <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>and {focus.laws.length - 8} more</div>}
209:                 </div>
210:               </div>
211:             )}
212:           </div>
213:         </>
214:       ) : (
215:         <table className="table table--timeline" aria-label="Effective dates of the tracked laws">
216:           <thead>
217:             <tr>
218:               <th style={{ width: 110 }}>Date</th>
219:               <th>Law</th>
220:               <th style={{ width: 110 }}>Obligations</th>
221:               <th style={{ width: 120 }}>Status</th>
222:             </tr>
223:           </thead>
224:           <tbody>
225:             {[...timeline]
226:               .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || a.lawCode.localeCompare(b.lawCode))
227:               .map((p) => (
228:                 <tr key={`${p.lawCode}-${p.date}`}>
229:                   <td className="mono">{p.date}</td>
230:                   <td>
231:                     <span className="mono">{p.lawCode}</span> <span className="muted">{p.label}</span>
232:                   </td>
233:                   <td className="mono">{p.obligations}</td>
234:                   <td>{p.past ? "● In force" : "○ Upcoming"}</td>
235:                 </tr>
236:               ))}
237:           </tbody>
238:         </table>
239:       )}
240:     </div>
241:   );
242: }

FILE apps/web/src/components/overlays/OverlayPanels.tsx SHA256 0448b216d8e9f9f3fe0a8da5ec314f7df99e73bb3312285408c435084fb349b4
1: /**
2:  * Overlay panels: the NIST Cyber AI Profile (a CSF 2.0 community profile) on
3:  * the AI governance page, and the COSAiS control overlay on the RMF page.
4:  * Both are NIST drafts; the panels say so and never present them as
5:  * requirements.
6:  */
7: import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
8: import { ShieldAlert, Telescope } from "lucide-react";
9: import { useState } from "react";
10: import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
11: import type { OverlayAdoption, Status } from "@visua/core";
12: import { api } from "../../lib/api.ts";
13: import { useCan } from "../../lib/auth.ts";
14: import { keys } from "../../lib/queries.ts";
15: import { useUi } from "../../state/ui.ts";
16: import { PriorityChip } from "../inspector/Overlays.tsx";
17: import { Progress, StatusChip, toast } from "../ui/index.tsx";
18:
19: export const CYBER_AI_PROFILE = "nist-ir-8596-iprd";
20: export const COSAIS = "nist-cosais-predictive-ai";
21:
22: interface OverlayMeta {
23:   id: string;
24:   shortName: string;
25:   identifier: string;
26:   title: string;
27:   status: string;
28:   notice: { text: string; citation: { page?: number } };
29:   landingPage?: string;
30:   published?: string;
31:   scope?: { useCases?: { id: string; text: string }[]; lifecyclePhases?: string[] };
32: }
33: interface Unit {
34:   nodeId: string;
35:   code: string;
36:   title: string;
37:   applicable: boolean | null;
38:   current: number | null;
39:   target: number | null;
40:   status: Status | null;
41: }
42: interface ProfileSummary {
43:   overlay: OverlayMeta;
44:   enabled: boolean;
45:   adoption: OverlayAdoption | null;
46:   lenses: { id: string; short: string; title: string; description: string; selected: boolean; byPriority: { level: number; label: string; count: number; readiness: number; gaps: number }[] }[];
47:   high: { count: number; readiness: number; gaps: number; inScope: number };
48:   gaps: Unit[];
49:   raisable: number;
50: }
51: interface ControlSummary {
52:   overlay: OverlayMeta;
53:   enabled: boolean;
54:   adoption: OverlayAdoption | null;
55:   controls: (Unit & { annotated: boolean; proposedAdditional: boolean; lifecyclePhases: string[]; addedByOverlay: boolean; tailoredByPerson: "add" | "remove" | null })[];
56:   readiness: number;
57:   gaps: number;
58:   inScope: number;
59: }
60:
61: const enc = encodeURIComponent;
62: const useSummary = <T,>(ws: string, id: string) => useQuery({ queryKey: [...keys.workspace(ws), "overlay", id], queryFn: () => api.get<T>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws)}/overlays/${id}`) });
63:
64: function DraftBadge({ overlay }: { overlay: OverlayMeta }) {
65:   return (
66:     <span className="role-badge" title={overlay.notice.text}>
67:       <ShieldAlert size={11} aria-hidden /> {overlay.status}
68:     </span>
69:   );
70: }
71:
72: function useOverlayAction(ws: string) {
73:   const qc = useQueryClient();
74:   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
75:   return {
76:     busy,
77:     run: async (fn: () => Promise<unknown>, message: string) => {
78:       setBusy(true);
79:       try {
80:         await fn();
81:         toast(message);
82:         await qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["ws", ws] });
83:       } catch (err) {
84:         toast((err as Error).message, "error");
85:       } finally {
86:         setBusy(false);
87:       }
88:     },
89:   };
90: }
91:
92: export function CyberAiProfilePanel({ ws }: { ws: string }) {
93:   const summary = useSummary<ProfileSummary>(ws, CYBER_AI_PROFILE);
94:   const canConfigure = useCan("workspace.configure");
95:   const canApprove = useCan("work.approve");
96:   const action = useOverlayAction(ws);
97:   const navigate = useNavigate();
98:   const setLens = useUi((s) => s.setLens);
99:   const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<string[] | null>(null);
100:   const data = summary.data;
101:   if (!data) return null;
102:   const selected = chosen ?? data.adoption?.lenses ?? data.lenses.map((l) => l.id);
103:   const toggle = (id: string) => setChosen(selected.includes(id) ? selected.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...selected, id]);
104:   const adopt = () => action.run(() => api.put(`/workspaces/${enc(ws)}/overlays/${CYBER_AI_PROFILE}`, { lenses: selected }), data.adoption ? "Focus areas updated" : "Cyber AI Profile adopted");
105:   return (
106:     <section className="panel stack" style={{ gap: 14 }} aria-labelledby="cyber-ai-title">
107:       <div className="panel__head" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
108:         <h2 id="cyber-ai-title">NIST Cyber AI Profile</h2>
109:         <DraftBadge overlay={data.overlay} />
110:         <span className="spacer" />
111:         <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
112:           {data.overlay.identifier}
113:           {data.overlay.published ? ` · ${data.overlay.published}` : ""}
114:         </span>
115:       </div>
116:       <p className="muted" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 13 }}>
117:         A CSF 2.0 Community Profile: NIST proposes a priority for each of the 106 CSF subcategories in three focus areas, with considerations and example references
118:         (MITRE ATLAS, OWASP). It works on your CSF 2.0 assessment — nothing is assessed twice. {data.overlay.notice.text}
119:       </p>
120:       {!data.enabled && <p className="muted">Enable NIST CSF 2.0 to use the Cyber AI Profile.</p>}
121:       <div className="grid grid--3">
122:         {data.lenses.map((l) => {
123:           const on = selected.includes(l.id);
124:           return (
125:             <div key={l.id} className="panel panel--raised stack" style={{ gap: 8, borderColor: on ? "var(--color-framework-ai)" : undefined }}>
126:               <label className="row" style={{ gap: 8, cursor: canConfigure ? "pointer" : "default" }}>
127:                 <input type="checkbox" checked={on} disabled={!canConfigure} onChange={() => toggle(l.id)} aria-label={`Follow the ${l.short} focus area`} />
128:                 <strong>{l.short}</strong>
129:                 <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
130:                   {l.title}
131:                 </span>
132:               </label>
133:               <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, margin: 0 }} title={l.description}>
134:                 {l.description.length > 170 ? `${l.description.slice(0, 169)}…` : l.description}
135:               </p>
136:               {l.byPriority.map((p) => (
137:                 <div key={p.level} className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
138:                   <span style={{ width: 118 }}>
139:                     <PriorityChip level={p.level} label={p.label} />
140:                   </span>
141:                   <span className="mono" style={{ width: 28, textAlign: "right" }}>
142:                     {p.count}
143:                   </span>
144:                   <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
145:                     <Progress value={p.readiness} color="var(--color-framework-ai)" />
146:                   </div>
147:                   <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 12, width: 38, textAlign: "right" }}>
148:                     {Math.round(p.readiness * 100)}%
149:                   </span>
150:                 </div>
151:               ))}
152:             </div>
153:           );
154:         })}
155:       </div>
156:       <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
157:         {canConfigure && (
158:           <button className="btn btn--primary" disabled={action.busy || !selected.length || !data.enabled} onClick={() => void adopt()}>
159:             {data.adoption ? "Update focus areas" : "Adopt for these focus areas"}
160:           </button>
161:         )}
162:         {canConfigure && data.adoption && (
163:           <button className="btn btn--quiet" disabled={action.busy} onClick={() => void action.run(() => api.del(`/workspaces/${enc(ws)}/overlays/${CYBER_AI_PROFILE}`), "Stopped following the Cyber AI Profile")}>
164:             Stop following
165:           </button>
166:         )}
167:         {canApprove && data.adoption && data.raisable > 0 && (
168:           <button
169:             className="btn"
170:             disabled={action.busy}
171:             title="Raise CSF priorities to the profile's proposed priorities for the focus areas you follow (never lowers one)"
172:             onClick={() => void action.run(() => api.post(`/workspaces/${enc(ws)}/overlays/${CYBER_AI_PROFILE}/apply-priorities`), "CSF priorities raised to the profile's High priorities")}
173:           >
174:             Raise {data.raisable} CSF priorit{data.raisable === 1 ? "y" : "ies"}
175:           </button>
176:         )}
177:         <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
178:         <button
179:           className="btn btn--quiet"
180:           onClick={() => {
181:             setLens("overlay");
182:             navigate(`/w/${ws}/observatory/nist-csf-2.0`);
183:           }}
184:         >
185:           <Telescope size={14} aria-hidden /> AI overlay lens in 3D
186:         </button>
187:       </div>
188:       <div>
189:         <h3 className="section-title" style={{ margin: "0 0 8px" }}>
190:           High-priority gaps ({data.high.gaps} of {data.high.count} High subcategories below target)
191:         </h3>
192:         {data.gaps.length ? (
193:           <table className="table">
194:             <thead>
195:               <tr>
196:                 <th>Subcategory</th>
197:                 <th style={{ width: 110 }}>Current → target</th>
198:                 <th style={{ width: 140 }}>Status</th>
199:               </tr>
200:             </thead>
201:             <tbody>
202:               {data.gaps.map((g) => (
203:                 <tr key={g.nodeId}>
204:                   <td>
205:                     <Link to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/nist-csf-2.0?select=${enc(g.nodeId)}`} style={{ color: "inherit" }}>
206:                       <span className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-primary)" }}>
207:                         {g.code}
208:                       </span>{" "}
209:                       <span className="muted">{g.title}</span>
210:                     </Link>
211:                   </td>
212:                   <td className="mono">
213:                     {g.current} → {g.target}
214:                   </td>
215:                   <td>{g.status && <StatusChip status={g.status} />}</td>
216:                 </tr>
217:               ))}
218:             </tbody>
219:           </table>
220:         ) : (
221:           <p className="muted" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
222:             No High-priority subcategory is below target for the focus areas you follow.
223:           </p>
224:         )}
225:       </div>
226:     </section>
227:   );
228: }
229:
230: export function CosaisPanel({ ws }: { ws: string }) {
231:   const summary = useSummary<ControlSummary>(ws, COSAIS);
232:   const canConfigure = useCan("workspace.configure");
233:   const action = useOverlayAction(ws);
234:   const [showAll, setShowAll] = useState(false);
235:   const data = summary.data;
236:   if (!data) return null;
237:   const added = data.controls.filter((c) => c.addedByOverlay).length;
238:   const rows = showAll ? data.controls : data.controls.filter((c) => c.annotated);
239:   return (
240:     <section className="panel stack" style={{ gap: 12 }} aria-labelledby="cosais-title">
241:       <div className="panel__head" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
242:         <h2 id="cosais-title">AI control overlay · COSAiS</h2>
243:         <DraftBadge overlay={data.overlay} />
244:         <span className="spacer" />
245:         <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
246:           {data.overlay.identifier}
247:         </span>
248:       </div>
249:       <p className="muted" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 13 }}>
250:         NIST's SP 800-53 Control Overlays for Securing AI Systems. This annotated outline covers using and fine-tuning predictive AI:{" "}
251:         {data.controls.length} controls, {data.controls.filter((c) => c.annotated).length} of them annotated with AI lifecycle phases and tailoring. {data.overlay.notice.text}
252:       </p>
253:       <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
254:         <span>
255:           <span className="mono">{data.inScope}</span> <span className="muted">of {data.controls.length} in scope</span>
256:         </span>
257:         <span>
258:           <span className="mono">{Math.round(data.readiness * 100)}%</span> <span className="muted">readiness</span>
259:         </span>
260:         <span>
261:           <span className="mono">{data.gaps}</span> <span className="muted">gaps</span>
262:         </span>
263:         {data.adoption && (
264:           <span className="muted">
265:             Adopted — {added} control{added === 1 ? "" : "s"} brought into scope by the overlay
266:           </span>
267:         )}
268:         <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
269:         {canConfigure && data.enabled && !data.adoption && (
270:           <button className="btn btn--primary" disabled={action.busy} onClick={() => void action.run(() => api.put(`/workspaces/${enc(ws)}/overlays/${COSAIS}`, {}), "COSAiS overlay adopted: its controls are in scope")}>
271:             Adopt the overlay
272:           </button>
273:         )}
274:         {canConfigure && data.adoption && (
275:           <button className="btn btn--quiet" disabled={action.busy} onClick={() => void action.run(() => api.del(`/workspaces/${enc(ws)}/overlays/${COSAIS}`), "COSAiS overlay dropped")}>
276:             Drop the overlay
277:           </button>
278:         )}
279:       </div>
280:       <table className="table table--cosais">
281:         <thead>
282:           <tr>
283:             <th>Control</th>
284:             <th>AI lifecycle phases</th>
285:             <th style={{ width: "20%" }}>Scope</th>
286:             <th style={{ width: "22%" }}>Status</th>
287:           </tr>
288:         </thead>
289:         <tbody>
290:           {rows.map((c) => (
291:             <tr key={c.nodeId}>
292:               <td>
293:                 <Link to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/nist-sp-800-53-r5?select=${enc(c.nodeId)}`} style={{ color: "inherit" }}>
294:                   <span className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-primary)" }}>
295:                     {c.code}
296:                   </span>{" "}
297:                   <span className="muted">{c.title}</span>
298:                 </Link>
299:               </td>
300:               <td className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
301:                 {c.lifecyclePhases.join(", ") || "—"}
302:               </td>
303:               <td style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{c.applicable ? (c.addedByOverlay ? "In scope (overlay)" : "In scope") : c.tailoredByPerson === "remove" ? "Tailored out by you" : "Not in scope"}</td>
304:               <td>{c.status && <StatusChip status={c.status} />}</td>
305:             </tr>
306:           ))}
307:         </tbody>
308:       </table>
309:       <div>
310:         <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" onClick={() => setShowAll(!showAll)}>
311:           {showAll ? "Show the annotated controls only" : `Show all ${data.controls.length} controls`}
312:         </button>
313:       </div>
314:     </section>
315:   );
316: }

FILE apps/web/src/components/shell/Shell.tsx SHA256 20fd5612b4ec10cab4b81ca1d1ddc9e1a171ba2ce1618e8376255c0d86aac2f3
1: /** App shell: labeled sidebar, top bar, command palette, toasts, live events. */
2: import {
3:   Activity,
4:   BookCheck,
5:   BrainCircuit,
6:   Bot,
7:   Building2,
8:   Check,
9:   LogOut,
10:   Menu,
11:   Users,
12:   X,
13:   ClipboardList,
14:   FileText,
15:   GitCompareArrows,
16:   LayoutDashboard,
17:   Network,
18:   Radar,
19:   Scale,
20:   Search,
21:   Settings,
22:   ShieldCheck,
23:   Sparkles,
24:   Telescope,
25:   Waypoints,
26: } from "lucide-react";
27: import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
28: import { Link, NavLink, Outlet, useLocation, useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
29: import { api, setCsrfToken } from "../../lib/api.ts";
30: import { ROLE_NAMES, useMe, useResetSession } from "../../lib/auth.ts";
31: import { initials } from "../../pages/LoginPage.tsx";
32: import { useWorkspaceEvents } from "../../lib/events.ts";
33: import { truncate } from "../../lib/format.ts";
34: import { allFrameworks, threatCatalogs } from "../../lib/frameworks.ts";
35: import { useMeta, useSearch, useWorkspace, useWorkspaces } from "../../lib/queries.ts";
36: import { useAgentActivity } from "../../state/agentActivity.ts";
37: import { useUi } from "../../state/ui.ts";
38: import { AgentBadge, FrameworkBadge, Logo, toast, Toasts } from "../ui/index.tsx";
39:
40: function RailItem({ to, icon, label, badge, end }: { to: string; icon: ReactNode; label: string; badge?: number; end?: boolean }) {
41:   return (

43:       {icon}

45:       <span className="rail__label" aria-hidden>
46:         {label}
47:       </span>
48:       {badge ? <span className="rail__badge">{badge > 99 ? "99+" : badge}</span> : null}
49:     </NavLink>

92: function AgentPulse({ ws }: { ws: string }) {
93:   const running = useAgentActivity((s) => s.running);
94:   const last = useAgentActivity((s) => s.steps[s.steps.length - 1]);
95:   const count = Object.keys(running).length;
96:   const navigate = useNavigate();
97:   if (!count && !last) return null;
98:   return (
99:     <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm topbar__pulse" onClick={() => navigate(`/w/${ws}/agents`)} title="Agent activity" style={{ maxWidth: 360 }}>
100:       <span className={count ? "pulse" : ""} style={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: 99, background: count ? "var(--color-tertiary)" : "var(--color-outline-strong)" }} />
101:       <span className="muted" style={{ overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis" }}>
102:         {count ? `${count} agent run${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} · ` : ""}
103:         {last ? truncate(last.step.title, 48) : ""}
104:       </span>
105:     </button>
106:   );
107: }

109: const methodLabel = (m: string) => (m === "dev" ? "developer sign-in" : m === "token" ? "an API token" : m === "oidc:platform" ? "single sign-on" : "your organization's SSO");

111: function AccountMenu({ ws }: { ws: string }) {
112:   const me = useMe();
113:   const summary = useWorkspace(ws);
114:   const reset = useResetSession();
115:   const navigate = useNavigate();
116:   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
117:   const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
118:   useEffect(() => {
119:     if (!open) return;
120:     const onDown = (e: MouseEvent) => !ref.current?.contains(e.target as Node) && setOpen(false);
121:     const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && setOpen(false);
122:     window.addEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
123:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
124:     return () => {
125:       window.removeEventListener("mousedown", onDown);
126:       window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
127:     };
128:   }, [open]);
129:   if (!me.data) return null;
130:   const { user, organizations, activeTenant, method } = me.data;
131:   const signOut = async () => {
132:     await api.post("/auth/logout").catch(() => undefined);
133:     setCsrfToken(undefined);
134:     await reset();
135:     navigate("/login", { replace: true });
136:   };
137:   const switchTo = async (tenantId: string) => {
138:     try {
139:       await api.post("/auth/tenant", { tenantId });
140:       setOpen(false);
141:       await reset();
142:       navigate("/", { replace: true });
143:     } catch (err) {
144:       toast((err as Error).message, "error");
145:     }
146:   };
147:   const tenantName = organizations.find((o) => o.id === summary.data?.workspace.tenantId)?.name;
148:   return (
149:     <div className="account" ref={ref}>
150:       <button className="account__button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} aria-label={`Account menu for ${user.name}`}>
151:         <span className="account__avatar" aria-hidden>
152:           {initials(user.name)}
153:         </span>
154:         <span className="account__name">{tenantName ?? user.name}</span>
155:       </button>
156:       {open && (
157:         <div className="account__menu" role="menu" aria-label="Account">
158:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 2, padding: "4px 8px 8px" }}>
159:             <strong>{user.name}</strong>
160:             {user.email && <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{user.email}</span>}
161:             <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>Signed in with {methodLabel(method)}</span>
162:           </div>
163:           <div className="eyebrow" style={{ padding: "4px 8px" }}>
164:             Organizations
165:           </div>
166:           {organizations.map((o) => (
167:             <button key={o.id} role="menuitemradio" aria-checked={o.id === activeTenant?.id} className="account__item" onClick={() => (o.id === activeTenant?.id ? setOpen(false) : void switchTo(o.id))}>
168:               <Building2 size={14} aria-hidden />
169:               <span style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis" }}>{o.name}</span>
170:               <span className="role-badge">{ROLE_NAMES[o.role]}</span>
171:               {o.id === activeTenant?.id ? <Check size={14} aria-label="Active" /> : <span style={{ width: 14 }} />}
172:             </button>
173:           ))}
174:           <Link role="menuitem" to={`/w/${ws}/organization`} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
175:             <Users size={14} aria-hidden /> Members, SSO and API tokens
176:           </Link>
177:           <button role="menuitem" className="account__item" onClick={() => void signOut()}>
178:             <LogOut size={14} aria-hidden /> Sign out
179:           </button>
180:         </div>
181:       )}
182:     </div>
183:   );

186: function TopBar({ ws }: { ws: string }) {
187:   const { data } = useWorkspace(ws);
188:   const { data: all } = useWorkspaces();
189:   const meta = useMeta();
190:   const openPalette = useUi((s) => s.openPalette);
191:   const navigate = useNavigate();
192:   const role = data?.access?.role;
193:   const readOnly = !!data?.access && !data.access.capabilities.includes("work.write");
194:   const canCreate = !!data?.access?.capabilities.includes("workspace.configure");
195:   const navOpen = useUi((s) => s.navOpen);
196:   const setNav = useUi((s) => s.setNav);
197:   return (
198:     <header className="topbar">
199:       <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--icon topbar__menu" aria-label={navOpen ? "Close menu" : "Open menu"} aria-expanded={navOpen} aria-controls="primary-nav" onClick={() => setNav(!navOpen)}>

201:       </button>

204:           className="select topbar__ws"
205:           aria-label="Workspace"
206:           value={data?.workspace.slug ?? ws}
207:           onChange={(e) => (e.target.value === "__new" ? navigate("/onboarding") : navigate(`/w/${e.target.value}`))}
208:         >
209:           {data && !(all ?? []).some((w) => w.workspace.id === data.workspace.id) && <option value={data.workspace.slug}>{data.workspace.name}</option>}
210:           {(all ?? []).map((w) => (
211:             <option key={w.workspace.id} value={w.workspace.slug}>
212:               {w.workspace.name}
213:             </option>
214:           ))}
215:           {canCreate && <option value="__new">+ New workspace…</option>}
216:         </select>
217:         <span className="row topbar__frameworks" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
218:           {data?.frameworks.map((f) => <FrameworkBadge key={f.id} frameworkId={f.id} />)}
219:         </span>
220:       </div>
221:       <button className="topbar__search" onClick={() => openPalette()} aria-label="Search or ask the copilot">
222:         <Search size={15} />
223:         <span className="topbar__search-text">Search requirements or ask the copilot…</span>
224:         <span className="kbd">⌘K</span>
225:       </button>
226:       <AgentPulse ws={ws} />
227:       <span className="badge-agent topbar__agents" title={meta.data?.ai.mode === "claude" ? `Agents run on ${meta.data.ai.model}` : "Agents run deterministic offline playbooks. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server to enable Claude."}>
228:         <Sparkles size={11} />
229:         {meta.data?.ai.mode === "claude" ? meta.data.ai.model : "offline agents"}
230:       </span>
231:       {role && (
232:         <span className="role-badge" title={readOnly ? "Your role can view this workspace but not change it" : `Your role in this organization`}>
233:           {ROLE_NAMES[role]}
234:           {readOnly ? " · read-only" : ""}
235:         </span>
236:       )}
237:       <AccountMenu ws={ws} />
238:     </header>
239:   );
240: }

242: // ------------------------------------------------------------------ command palette
243:
244: interface PaletteItem {
245:   key: string;
246:   group: string;
247:   label: ReactNode;
248:   hint?: string;
249:   run: () => void;
250: }
251:
252: function CommandPalette({ ws }: { ws: string }) {
253:   const open = useUi((s) => s.paletteOpen);
254:   const initial = useUi((s) => s.paletteQuery);
255:   const close = useUi((s) => s.closePalette);
256:   const focus = useUi((s) => s.focus);
257:   const navigate = useNavigate();
258:   const [q, setQ] = useState(initial);
259:   const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
260:   const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
261:   const search = useSearch(q);
262:
263:   useEffect(() => {
264:     if (open) {
265:       setQ(initial);
266:       setActive(0);
267:       setTimeout(() => input.current?.focus(), 10);
268:     }
269:   }, [open, initial]);
270:
271:   const ask = async (agent: string, goal: string, input: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => {
272:     close();
273:     try {
274:       await api.post(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/runs`, { agent, goal, input });
275:       toast(`${agent === "copilot" ? "Copilot" : agent} is working on it — follow along in Agents.`, "agent");
276:       navigate(`/w/${ws}/agents`);
277:     } catch (err) {
278:       toast((err as Error).message, "error");
279:     }
280:   };
281:
282:   const items = useMemo<PaletteItem[]>(() => {
283:     const out: PaletteItem[] = [];
284:     const text = q.trim();
285:     if (text.length > 2) {
286:       out.push({ key: "ask", group: "Copilot", label: <span>Ask the copilot: “{truncate(text, 70)}”</span>, hint: "↵", run: () => void ask("copilot", text) });
287:     }
288:     for (const n of search.data?.nodes ?? []) {
289:       out.push({
290:         key: n.id,
291:         group: "Requirements",
292:         label: (
293:           <span className="row" style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
294:             <FrameworkBadge frameworkId={n.framework} />
295:             <span className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-primary)" }}>
296:               {n.code}
297:             </span>
298:             <span className="muted">{truncate(n.title || n.text, 80)}</span>
299:           </span>
300:         ),
301:         run: () => {
302:           close();
303:           navigate(`/w/${ws}/observatory/${n.framework}`);
304:           setTimeout(() => focus([n.id]), 60);
305:         },
306:       });
307:     }
308:     for (const p of (search.data?.passages ?? []).slice(0, 3)) {
309:       out.push({
310:         key: `${p.documentId}-${p.page}-${p.quote.slice(0, 10)}`,
311:         group: "Official corpus",
312:         label: (
313:           <span className="stack" style={{ gap: 2, minWidth: 0 }}>
314:             <span className="muted">{truncate(p.quote, 110)}</span>
315:             <span style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
316:               {truncate(p.documentTitle, 70)}
317:               {p.page ? `, p. ${p.page}` : ""}
318:             </span>
319:           </span>
320:         ),
321:         run: () => void ask("copilot", text || p.quote),
322:       });
323:     }
324:     const base = `/w/${ws}`;
325:     const nav: [string, string][] = [
326:       ["Overview", base],
327:       ...allFrameworks().map((f): [string, string] => [`Observatory — ${f.shortName}${f.family === "threat" ? " coverage in 3D" : ""}`, `${base}/observatory/${f.id}`]),
328:       ["Plan & tasks", `${base}/plan`],
329:       ["Evidence & monitoring", `${base}/evidence`],
330:       ["Agents & approvals", `${base}/agents`],
331:       ["Policies", `${base}/policies`],
332:       ["CSF profile & tiers", `${base}/profile`],
333:       ["Crosswalk nexus", `${base}/crosswalk`],
334:       ["SOC 2 program", `${base}/soc2`],
335:       ["RMF program", `${base}/rmf`],
336:       ["AI governance (AI RMF)", `${base}/ai`],
337:       ["State AI laws", `${base}/laws`],
338:       ...threatCatalogs().map((f): [string, string] => [`AI threats — ${f.name}`, `${base}/threats/${f.id}`]),
339:       ["Reports & trust center", `${base}/reports`],
340:       ["New workspace", "/onboarding"],
341:     ];
342:     for (const [label, to] of nav) {
343:       if (text && !label.toLowerCase().includes(text.toLowerCase())) continue;
344:       out.push({ key: to, group: "Go to", label, run: () => (close(), navigate(to)) });
345:     }
346:     const agents: [string, string, string][] = [
347:       ["planner", "Plan the next sprint of work for our largest gaps", "Planner"],
348:       ["assessor", "Assess our current implementation levels from evidence", "Assessor"],
349:       ["evidence-collector", "Run monitoring checks and find missing evidence", "Evidence Collector"],
350:       ["auditor-prep", "Prepare an audit readiness brief", "Audit Prep"],
351:       ["crosswalk-analyst", "Project our CSF progress onto other frameworks", "Crosswalk Analyst"],
352:     ];
353:     for (const [agent, goal, name] of agents) {
354:       if (text && !`${name} ${goal}`.toLowerCase().includes(text.toLowerCase())) continue;
355:       out.push({ key: `agent-${agent}`, group: "Run an agent", label: <span className="row"><AgentBadge label={name} /> {goal}</span>, run: () => void ask(agent, goal) });
356:     }
357:     return out;
358:     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
359:   }, [q, search.data, ws]);
360:
361:   if (!open) return null;
362:   const onKey = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
363:     if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
364:       e.preventDefault();
365:       setActive((a) => Math.min(items.length - 1, a + 1));
366:     } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
367:       e.preventDefault();
368:       setActive((a) => Math.max(0, a - 1));
369:     } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
370:       e.preventDefault();
371:       items[active]?.run();
372:     } else if (e.key === "Escape") close();
373:   };
374:   let lastGroup = "";
375:   return (
376:     <div className="overlay" onMouseDown={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && close()}>
377:       <div className="palette" role="dialog" aria-label="Command palette">
378:         <input
379:           ref={input}
380:           className="palette__input"
381:           placeholder="Search GV.OC-01, CC6.1, AC-2… or ask anything"
382:           value={q}
383:           onChange={(e) => {
384:             setQ(e.target.value);
385:             setActive(0);
386:           }}
387:           onKeyDown={onKey}
388:           aria-activedescendant={items[active]?.key}
389:         />
390:         <div className="palette__list" role="listbox">
391:           {items.map((item, i) => {
392:             const header = item.group !== lastGroup ? <div className="palette__group eyebrow">{item.group}</div> : null;
393:             lastGroup = item.group;
394:             return (
395:               <div key={item.key}>
396:                 {header}
397:                 <button id={item.key} role="option" aria-selected={i === active} className="palette__item" onMouseEnter={() => setActive(i)} onClick={() => item.run()}>
398:                   {item.label}
399:                   {item.hint ? <span className="kbd">{item.hint}</span> : null}
400:                 </button>
401:               </div>
402:             );
403:           })}
404:           {!items.length && <div className="muted" style={{ padding: 16 }}>No results.</div>}
405:         </div>
406:       </div>
407:     </div>
408:   );
409: }
410:
411: export function Shell() {
412:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
413:   const { data, error } = useWorkspace(ws);
414:   // Framework families, names and pages come from /api/meta: pages render once it has loaded.
415:   const meta = useMeta();
416:   const openPalette = useUi((s) => s.openPalette);
417:   const navOpen = useUi((s) => s.navOpen);
418:   const setNav = useUi((s) => s.setNav);
419:   const navigate = useNavigate();
420:   const location = useLocation();
421:   useWorkspaceEvents(data?.workspace.id);
422:
423:   // The menu closes when a destination is chosen, on Escape, and when the window grows past it.
424:   useEffect(() => setNav(false), [location.pathname, setNav]);
425:   useEffect(() => {
426:     if (!navOpen) return;
427:     const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && setNav(false);
428:     const wide = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 1025px)");
429:     const onWide = () => wide.matches && setNav(false);
430:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
431:     wide.addEventListener("change", onWide);
432:     return () => {
433:       window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
434:       wide.removeEventListener("change", onWide);
435:     };
436:   }, [navOpen, setNav]);
437:
438:   useEffect(() => {
439:     const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
440:       if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "k") {
441:         e.preventDefault();
442:         openPalette();
443:       }
444:     };
445:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
446:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
447:   }, [openPalette]);
448:
449:   useEffect(() => {
450:     if (error) navigate("/");
451:   }, [error, navigate]);
452:
453:   if (!meta.data) return <div className="page muted">{meta.error ? `Visua could not load: ${(meta.error as Error).message}` : "Loading Visua…"}</div>;
454:   return (
455:     <div className={`shell ${navOpen ? "shell--nav-open" : ""}`}>
456:       <NavRail ws={ws} approvals={data?.approvals ?? 0} />
457:       {navOpen && <div className="shell__backdrop" onClick={() => setNav(false)} aria-hidden />}
458:       <TopBar ws={ws} />
459:       <main className="main" id="main">
460:         <Outlet />
461:       </main>
462:       <CommandPalette ws={ws} />
463:       <Toasts />
464:     </div>
465:   );
466: }

FILE apps/web/src/components/threats/Coverage.tsx SHA256 f94c0bebe228e59182f2dd122bf7f3267e2fb7c856086b96a3045e018cf97e53
1: /**
2:  * Coverage atoms for threat views. Coverage is derived from the requirements
3:  * linked to a threat; it reuses the status palette and glyphs (never color
4:  * alone) and adds one state of its own: no published link.
5:  */
6: import type { Status } from "@visua/core";
7: import type { CoverageState, LinkStatus, MinStatus, ThreatCoverage } from "../../lib/types.ts";
8: import { useUi } from "../../state/ui.ts";
9: import { Segmented, StatusGlyph } from "../ui/index.tsx";
10:
11: export const COVERAGE_ORDER: CoverageState[] = ["covered", "partial", "open", "out-of-scope", "unmapped"];
12:
13: export const COVERAGE_LABEL: Record<CoverageState, string> = {
14:   covered: "Covered",
15:   partial: "Partly covered",
16:   open: "Open",
17:   "out-of-scope": "Not in your frameworks",
18:   unmapped: "No published link",
19: };
20:
21: export const COVERAGE_HELP: Record<CoverageState, string> = {
22:   covered: "Every linked requirement in scope is at its target.",
23:   partial: "Linked requirements are partly implemented.",
24:   open: "Linked requirements exist in your frameworks, but none is implemented yet.",
25:   "out-of-scope": "Linked requirements belong to frameworks this workspace does not follow.",
26:   unmapped: "No publisher links this threat to a requirement at the chosen link status.",
27: };
28:
29: /** The status each coverage state borrows its color and glyph from. */
30: export const COVERAGE_STATUS: Record<CoverageState, Status | null> = {
31:   covered: "implemented",
32:   partial: "in-progress",
33:   open: "not-started",
34:   "out-of-scope": "not-applicable",
35:   unmapped: null,
36: };
37:
38: export const coverageColor = (state: CoverageState) => (COVERAGE_STATUS[state] ? `var(--color-status-${COVERAGE_STATUS[state]})` : "var(--color-outline-strong)");
39:
40: export function CoverageGlyph({ state, size = 12 }: { state: CoverageState; size?: number }) {
41:   const status = COVERAGE_STATUS[state];
42:   if (status) return <StatusGlyph status={status} size={size} />;
43:   return (
44:     <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 12 12" aria-hidden className="status__glyph">
45:       <circle cx="6" cy="6" r="4.2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.4" strokeDasharray="1.6 1.8" />
46:     </svg>
47:   );
48: }
49:
50: export function CoverageChip({ coverage, state }: { coverage?: ThreatCoverage; state?: CoverageState }) {
51:   const s = coverage?.state ?? state ?? "unmapped";
52:   const status = COVERAGE_STATUS[s];
53:   const title = coverage && coverage.inScope ? `${COVERAGE_HELP[s]} ${coverage.met} of ${coverage.inScope} linked requirements at target.` : COVERAGE_HELP[s];
54:   return (
55:     <span className={`status ${status ? `status--${status}` : "status--unmapped"}`} title={title}>
56:       <CoverageGlyph state={s} />
57:       {COVERAGE_LABEL[s]}
58:       {coverage && coverage.inScope > 0 && s !== "covered" ? <span className="mono" style={{ opacity: 0.8 }}>{Math.round(coverage.progress * 100)}%</span> : null}
59:     </span>
60:   );
61: }
62:
63: /** Stacked distribution of coverage states with 2px gaps and a text alternative. */
64: export function CoverageBar({ byState, height = 8 }: { byState: Record<CoverageState, number>; height?: number }) {
65:   const present = COVERAGE_ORDER.filter((k) => byState[k]);
66:   const label = present.map((k) => `${COVERAGE_LABEL[k]} ${byState[k]}`).join(", ");
67:   return (
68:     <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 2, height }} role="img" aria-label={label} title={label}>
69:       {present.map((k, i) => (
70:         <span
71:           key={k}
72:           style={{
73:             flexGrow: byState[k],
74:             flexBasis: 0,
75:             minWidth: 3,
76:             background: k === "unmapped" ? "transparent" : coverageColor(k),
77:             boxShadow: k === "unmapped" ? "inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-outline-strong)" : undefined,
78:             borderRadius: `${i === 0 ? 4 : 0}px ${i === present.length - 1 ? 4 : 0}px ${i === present.length - 1 ? 4 : 0}px ${i === 0 ? 4 : 0}px`,
79:           }}
80:         />
81:       ))}
82:     </div>
83:   );
84: }
85:
86: export function CoverageLegend({ byState }: { byState?: Record<CoverageState, number> }) {
87:   return (
88:     <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 12, fontSize: 12 }}>
89:       {COVERAGE_ORDER.map((k) => (
90:         <span key={k} className="row" style={{ gap: 5, color: k === "unmapped" ? "var(--color-on-surface-muted)" : coverageColor(k) }} title={COVERAGE_HELP[k]}>
91:           <CoverageGlyph state={k} />
92:           <span style={{ color: "var(--color-on-surface)" }}>
93:             {COVERAGE_LABEL[k]}
94:             {byState ? <span className="mono muted"> {byState[k]}</span> : null}
95:           </span>
96:         </span>
97:       ))}
98:     </div>
99:   );
100: }
101:
102: export const LINK_STATUS_LABEL: Record<LinkStatus, string> = { final: "Final", draft: "Draft", unreviewed: "Unreviewed", superseded: "Superseded" };
103: export const LINK_STATUS_HELP: Record<LinkStatus, string> = {
104:   final: "Published in a final catalog or standard (MITRE, OWASP, NIST).",
105:   draft: "From a NIST draft (Cyber AI Profile, COSAiS outline): may change before final publication.",
106:   unreviewed: "From OWASP's community crosswalk, which names no reviewer: treat as a lead.",
107:   superseded: "From an older edition of the catalog.",
108: };
109:
110: /** Link status is provenance, not implementation status: neutral ink, told apart by border and label. */
111: export function LinkStatusBadge({ status }: { status: LinkStatus }) {
112:   return (
113:     <span className={`link-status link-status--${status}`} title={LINK_STATUS_HELP[status]}>
114:       {LINK_STATUS_LABEL[status]}
115:     </span>
116:   );
117: }
118:
119: const MIN_OPTIONS: { id: MinStatus; label: string }[] = [
120:   { id: "unreviewed", label: "All published links" },
121:   { id: "draft", label: "Final and draft" },
122:   { id: "final", label: "Final only" },
123: ];
124:
125: /** Which links count toward coverage, shared by the Threats page, the threat Observatory and the Nexus ring. */
126: export function ThreatLinkFilter() {
127:   const min = useUi((s) => s.threatMin);
128:   const set = useUi((s) => s.setThreatMin);
129:   return <Segmented<MinStatus> label="Links counted toward coverage" options={MIN_OPTIONS} value={min} onChange={set} />;
130: }

252: export function Dialog({ title, onClose, children, wide, footer }: { title: string; onClose: () => void; children: ReactNode; wide?: boolean; footer?: ReactNode }) {
253:   useEffect(() => {
254:     const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && onClose();
255:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
256:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
257:   }, [onClose]);
258:   return (

261:         <div className="row" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>

265:           <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
266:           <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close">
267:             Esc
268:           </button>
269:         </div>
270:         {children}
271:         {footer ? <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: "flex-end", marginTop: 20, gap: 8 }}>{footer}</div> : null}
272:       </div>
273:     </div>
274:   );
275: }

301: // ------------------------------------------------------------------ toasts
302:
303: interface Toast {
304:   id: number;
305:   text: string;
306:   kind: "info" | "error" | "agent";
307: }
308: interface ToastState {
309:   toasts: Toast[];
310:   push: (text: string, kind?: Toast["kind"]) => void;
311:   dismiss: (id: number) => void;
312: }
313: let toastSeq = 0;
314: export const useToasts = create<ToastState>((set) => ({
315:   toasts: [],
316:   push: (text, kind = "info") => {
317:     const id = ++toastSeq;
318:     set((s) => ({ toasts: [...s.toasts.slice(-3), { id, text, kind }] }));
319:     setTimeout(() => set((s) => ({ toasts: s.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== id) })), kind === "error" ? 7000 : 4200);
320:   },
321:   dismiss: (id) => set((s) => ({ toasts: s.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== id) })),
322: }));
323: export const toast = (text: string, kind?: Toast["kind"]) => useToasts.getState().push(text, kind);
324:
325: export function Toasts() {
326:   const toasts = useToasts((s) => s.toasts);
327:   const dismiss = useToasts((s) => s.dismiss);
328:   return (
329:     <div className="toasts" role="status" aria-live="polite">
330:       {toasts.map((t) => (
331:         <div key={t.id} className={`toast ${t.kind === "error" ? "toast--error" : t.kind === "agent" ? "toast--agent" : ""}`}>
332:           {t.kind === "agent" ? <AgentBadge /> : null}
333:           <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{t.text}</span>
334:           <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" onClick={() => dismiss(t.id)} aria-label="Dismiss">
335:             ✕
336:           </button>
337:         </div>
338:       ))}
339:     </div>
340:   );
341: }
342:
343: export function frameworkLabel(id: string) {
344:   return badgeOf(frameworkOf(id));
345: }

347: export { pct };
