349: /** The Visua mark: a V with the terracotta agent core and a verified arc. */
350: export function Logo({ size = 30 }: { size?: number }) {
351:   return (
352:     <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-label="Visua" role="img">
353:       <path d="M14 18 L32 48 L50 18" fill="none" stroke="var(--color-primary)" strokeWidth="5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
354:       <circle cx="32" cy="27" r="5" fill="var(--color-tertiary)" />
355:       <path d="M20 18 A 16 16 0 0 1 44 18" fill="none" stroke="var(--color-status-verified)" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" opacity=".85" />
356:     </svg>
357:   );
358: }

FILE apps/web/src/lib/api.ts SHA256 5417d89f1332af444345e26c618fe693ac41faa84723df4b42c559532b9bb512
1: /** Minimal typed API client: same-origin session cookie, CSRF header on writes, sign-in prompt on 401. */
2: export class ApiError extends Error {
3:   readonly status: number;
4:   constructor(status: number, message: string) {
5:     super(message);
6:     this.status = status;
7:   }
8: }
9:
10: let csrfToken = "";
11: /** The session's CSRF token (from /api/auth/me); sent with every state-changing request. */
12: export const setCsrfToken = (token: string | undefined) => {
13:   csrfToken = token ?? "";
14: };
15:
16: const unauthorizedListeners = new Set<() => void>();
17: /** Called when the server says the session is gone (expired, signed out elsewhere). */
18: export const onUnauthorized = (fn: () => void) => {
19:   unauthorizedListeners.add(fn);
20:   return () => void unauthorizedListeners.delete(fn);
21: };
22:
23: async function request<T>(method: string, path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
24:   const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
25:   if (body !== undefined) headers["content-type"] = "application/json";
26:   if (method !== "GET" && csrfToken) headers["x-visua-csrf"] = csrfToken;
27:   const res = await fetch(`/api${path}`, { method, headers, body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined, credentials: "same-origin" });
28:   const text = await res.text();
29:   let data: unknown;
30:   try {
31:     data = text ? (JSON.parse(text) as unknown) : undefined;
32:   } catch {
33:     data = undefined;
34:   }
35:   if (!res.ok) {
36:     if (res.status === 401 && !path.startsWith("/auth/")) for (const fn of unauthorizedListeners) fn();
37:     const message = (data as { error?: string } | undefined)?.error ?? `${res.status} ${res.statusText}`;
38:     throw new ApiError(res.status, message);
39:   }
40:   return data as T;
41: }
42:
43: export const api = {
44:   get: <T>(path: string) => request<T>("GET", path),
45:   post: <T>(path: string, body?: unknown) => request<T>("POST", path, body ?? {}),
46:   patch: <T>(path: string, body: unknown) => request<T>("PATCH", path, body),
47:   put: <T>(path: string, body: unknown) => request<T>("PUT", path, body),
48:   del: <T>(path: string) => request<T>("DELETE", path),
49: };
50:
51: export const corpusFileUrl = (path: string, page?: number) => `/api/corpus/file/${path.split("/").map(encodeURIComponent).join("/")}${page ? `#page=${page}` : ""}`;
52: export const exportUrl = (ws: string, kind: string) => `/api/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/exports/${kind}`;

FILE apps/web/src/lib/auth.ts SHA256 c00f8f4dc512401fcd40d13d15b79494de06eaf9b2720bcccbea65d5ac772a36
1: /** Who is signed in, what they may do, and the sign-in configuration. */
2: import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
3: import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
4: import type { Capability, Role } from "@visua/core";
5: import { api, ApiError, setCsrfToken } from "./api.ts";
6: import { useWorkspace } from "./queries.ts";
7:
8: export interface Me {
9:   authMode: "dev" | "oidc";
10:   principal: "user" | "token";
11:   user: { id: string; email: string; name: string };
12:   method: string;
13:   csrf?: string;
14:   tenantScope: string | null;
15:   activeTenant: { id: string; slug: string; name: string; role: Role; capabilities: Capability[]; settings: { requireSso?: boolean } } | null;
16:   organizations: { id: string; slug: string; name: string; role: Role }[];
17: }
18:
19: export interface AuthConfig {
20:   mode: "dev" | "oidc";
21:   platform: { name: string } | null;
22:   sso: boolean;
23:   personas: { email: string; name: string; organizations: { name: string; role: Role }[] }[];
24: }
25:
26: export const meKey = ["auth", "me"] as const;
27:
28: async function fetchMe(): Promise<Me | null> {
29:   try {
30:     const me = await api.get<Me | null>("/auth/me");
31:     setCsrfToken(me?.csrf);
32:     return me;
33:   } catch (err) {
34:     if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 401) {
35:       setCsrfToken(undefined);
36:       return null;
37:     }
38:     throw err;
39:   }
40: }
41:
42: /** The signed-in principal, or null when signed out. */
43: export function useMe() {
44:   return useQuery({ queryKey: meKey, queryFn: fetchMe, staleTime: 60_000, retry: false });
45: }
46:
47: export const useAuthConfig = () => useQuery({ queryKey: ["auth", "config"], queryFn: () => api.get<AuthConfig>("/auth/config"), staleTime: Infinity });
48:
49: /** Forget everything cached for the previous principal and load the new one. */
50: export function useResetSession() {
51:   const qc = useQueryClient();
52:   return async () => {
53:     qc.removeQueries({ predicate: (q) => q.queryKey[0] !== "auth" });
54:     await qc.fetchQuery({ queryKey: meKey, queryFn: fetchMe, staleTime: 0 });
55:   };
56: }
57:
58: /**
59:  * Whether the signed-in principal may do something in the current workspace
60:  * (its organization's role), or in the active organization outside one.
61:  * The server enforces the same rule; this only shapes the interface.
62:  */
63: export function useCan(capability: Capability): boolean {
64:   const { ws } = useParams();
65:   const summary = useWorkspace(ws);
66:   const me = useMe();
67:   if (ws) return !!summary.data?.access?.capabilities.includes(capability);
68:   return !!me.data?.activeTenant?.capabilities.includes(capability);
69: }
70:
71: export const ROLE_NAMES: Record<Role, string> = {
72:   owner: "Owner",
73:   admin: "Admin",
74:   approver: "Approver",
75:   contributor: "Contributor",
76:   auditor: "Auditor",
77:   viewer: "Viewer",
78: };

FILE apps/web/src/lib/events.ts SHA256 8e98cd76f3391907d21a22f5e513d8fd227a98f6ce41b8c1fbdbc0bad590422d
1: /** Live workspace events over SSE → cache invalidation + live agent activity. */
2: import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
3: import { useEffect } from "react";
4: import { useAgentActivity } from "../state/agentActivity.ts";
5: import { keys } from "./queries.ts";
6: import type { AgentStep } from "@visua/core";
7: import type { VisuaEvent } from "./types.ts";
8:
9: export function useWorkspaceEvents(ws: string | undefined): void {
10:   const qc = useQueryClient();
11:   useEffect(() => {
12:     if (!ws) return;
13:     const source = new EventSource(`/api/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/events`);
14:     const pending = new Set<string>();
15:     let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
16:     const invalidate = (...groups: string[]) => {
17:       for (const g of groups) pending.add(g);
18:       if (timer) return;
19:       timer = setTimeout(() => {
20:         timer = undefined;
21:         const groups = [...pending];
22:         pending.clear();
23:         for (const g of groups) {
24:           if (g === "all") void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["ws", ws] });
25:           else void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["ws", ws, g] });
26:         }
27:         void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.workspace(ws), exact: true });
28:         void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.workspaces });
29:       }, 250);
30:     };
31:     source.addEventListener("visua", (msg) => {
32:       const event = JSON.parse((msg as MessageEvent<string>).data) as VisuaEvent;
33:       const activity = useAgentActivity.getState();
34:       switch (event.type) {
35:         case "agent.step": {
36:           const { runId, agent, step } = event.data as { runId: string; agent: string; step: AgentStep };
37:           activity.pushStep(runId, agent, step);
38:           invalidate("run");
39:           break;
40:         }
41:         case "agent.run.created":
42:         case "agent.run.updated": {
43:           const run = event.data as { id: string; status: string; agent: string };
44:           activity.setRunStatus(run.id, run.agent, run.status);
45:           invalidate("runs", "run", "proposals");
46:           break;
47:         }
48:         case "proposal.created":
49:         case "proposal.updated":
50:           invalidate("proposals", "run", "node");
51:           break;
52:         case "state.updated":
53:           invalidate("state", "node");
54:           break;
55:         case "task.created":
56:         case "task.updated":
57:         case "task.deleted":
58:           invalidate("tasks", "state", "node");
59:           break;
60:         case "evidence.created":
61:         case "evidence.updated":
62:           invalidate("evidence", "state", "node");
63:           break;
64:         case "policy.created":
65:         case "policy.updated":
66:           invalidate("policies");
67:           break;
68:         case "risk.updated":
69:           invalidate("risks");
70:           break;
71:         case "check.completed":
72:           invalidate("checks", "connectors", "state", "node", "evidence");
73:           break;
74:         case "activity":
75:           invalidate("activity", "audit");
76:           break;
77:         case "workspace.updated":
78:           invalidate("all");
79:           break;
80:       }
81:     });
82:     return () => {
83:       if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
84:       source.close();
85:     };
86:   }, [ws, qc]);
87: }

FILE apps/web/src/lib/format.ts SHA256 d13b0e3084f3f9448de41f44193fcc8e35ad92d1aee9cb29b3bad74bc28922db
1: import type { Status } from "@visua/core";
2:
3: export const STATUS_LABEL: Record<Status, string> = {
4:   "not-started": "Not started",
5:   "in-progress": "In progress",
6:   implemented: "Implemented",
7:   verified: "Verified",
8:   "at-risk": "At risk",
9:   "not-applicable": "Not applicable",
10: };
11:
12: export const pct = (v: number | undefined, digits = 0) => `${((v ?? 0) * 100).toFixed(digits)}%`;
13:
14: export function codeOf(id: string): string {
15:   const i = id.lastIndexOf(":");
16:   return i === -1 ? id : id.slice(i + 1);
17: }
18: export function frameworkOf(id: string): string {
19:   const i = id.lastIndexOf(":");
20:   return i === -1 ? "" : id.slice(0, i);
21: }
22:
23: export function relativeTime(iso: string | undefined, now = Date.now()): string {
24:   if (!iso) return "—";
25:   const diff = new Date(iso).getTime() - now;
26:   const abs = Math.abs(diff);
27:   const units: [number, Intl.RelativeTimeFormatUnit][] = [
28:     [60_000, "second"],
29:     [3_600_000, "minute"],
30:     [86_400_000, "hour"],
31:     [2_592_000_000, "day"],
32:     [31_536_000_000, "month"],
33:     [Infinity, "year"],
34:   ];
35:   const fmt = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat("en", { numeric: "auto" });
36:   let prev = 1000;
37:   for (const [limit, unit] of units) {
38:     if (abs < limit) return fmt.format(Math.round(diff / prev), unit);
39:     prev = limit;
40:   }
41:   return iso.slice(0, 10);
42: }
43:
44: export const shortDate = (iso: string | undefined) =>
45:   iso ? new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("en", { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: new Date(iso).getFullYear() !== new Date().getFullYear() ? "numeric" : undefined }) : "—";
46:
47: export function truncate(text: string, n: number): string {
48:   const t = text.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
49:   return t.length > n ? `${t.slice(0, n - 1)}…` : t;
50: }
51:
52: export const TASK_STATUS_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
53:   backlog: "Backlog",
54:   todo: "To do",
55:   "in-progress": "In progress",
56:   "in-review": "In review",
57:   done: "Done",
58:   blocked: "Blocked",
59: };

FILE apps/web/src/lib/frameworks.ts SHA256 579fc9bb442c3c923066463ef61882fb7856fbb71c6cf128d94daa76629c6828
1: /**
2:  * Framework metadata in the web app comes from /api/meta: each framework's family,
3:  * names and compact badge label, in the server's presentation order. This module
4:  * also holds the one map from a framework to its program page. The shell renders
5:  * its pages only once the metadata has loaded, so these lookups are always filled.
6:  */
7: import type { FrameworkDescriptor, FrameworkFamily } from "@visua/core";
8:
9: export type Family = FrameworkFamily;
10: export type FrameworkMeta = FrameworkDescriptor & { units?: number };
11:
12: let ordered: FrameworkMeta[] = [];
13: let byId = new Map<string, FrameworkMeta>();
14:
15: /** Called with /api/meta's frameworks. */
16: export function registerFrameworks(list: FrameworkMeta[]): void {
17:   ordered = list;
18:   byId = new Map(list.map((f) => [f.id, f]));
19: }
20:
21: export const frameworkMeta = (id: string): FrameworkMeta | undefined => byId.get(id);
22:
23: /** Every framework and threat catalog, in presentation order. */
24: export const allFrameworks = (): readonly FrameworkMeta[] => ordered;
25:
26: /** Threat catalogs (MITRE ATLAS, the OWASP Top 10s, NIST AI 100-2): viewed, never assessed. */
27: export const threatCatalogs = (): FrameworkMeta[] => ordered.filter((f) => f.family === "threat");
28:
29: export const familyOf = (frameworkId: string): Family | undefined => byId.get(frameworkId)?.family;
30:
31: export const isThreatCatalog = (frameworkId: string): boolean => familyOf(frameworkId) === "threat";
32:
33: /** Compact label for badges and dense views ("SOC 2", "ATLAS"). */
34: export const badgeOf = (frameworkId: string): string => {
35:   const f = byId.get(frameworkId);
36:   return f?.badge ?? f?.shortName ?? frameworkId;
37: };
38:
39: /** Where each family's program lives. */
40: const PROGRAM_PAGE: Record<Family, string> = {
41:   csf: "profile",
42:   soc2: "soc2",
43:   rmf: "rmf",
44:   ai: "ai",
45:   law: "laws",
46:   threat: "threats",
47: };
48:
49: /** The program page of a framework (a threat catalog opens its own view on the threats page). */
50: export function programPath(ws: string, frameworkId: string): string {
51:   const family = familyOf(frameworkId);
52:   if (!family) return `/w/${ws}/observatory/${frameworkId}`;
53:   return family === "threat" ? `/w/${ws}/threats/${frameworkId}` : `/w/${ws}/${PROGRAM_PAGE[family]}`;
54: }

FILE apps/web/src/lib/markdown.tsx SHA256 960bc1d1f55a28135c5a3b5c3c4f0744856a39e63386db40584e5b2d7ef18fce
1: /**
2:  * Minimal, safe Markdown → React renderer (no HTML injection): headings,
3:  * paragraphs, lists, tables, blockquotes, bold, italic, inline code, links.
4:  * Enough for agent summaries, policies and reports.
5:  */
6: import { Fragment, type ReactNode } from "react";
7:
8: function inline(text: string, key = 0): ReactNode[] {
9:   const out: ReactNode[] = [];
10:   const re = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|\*[^*\s][^*]*\*|`[^`]+`|\[[^\]]+\]\([^)\s]+\))/g;
11:   let last = 0;
12:   let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
13:   let i = 0;
14:   while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
15:     if (m.index > last) out.push(text.slice(last, m.index));
16:     const token = m[0];
17:     const k = `${key}-${i++}`;
18:     if (token.startsWith("**")) out.push(<strong key={k}>{inline(token.slice(2, -2), i)}</strong>);
19:     else if (token.startsWith("`")) out.push(<code key={k}>{token.slice(1, -1)}</code>);
20:     else if (token.startsWith("[")) {
21:       const mm = /^\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)\s]+)\)$/.exec(token)!;
22:       const href = mm[2]!;
23:       const safe = /^(https?:|\/|#)/.test(href) ? href : "#";
24:       out.push(
25:         <a key={k} href={safe} target={safe.startsWith("http") ? "_blank" : undefined} rel="noreferrer">
26:           {mm[1]}
27:         </a>,
28:       );
29:     } else out.push(<em key={k}>{inline(token.slice(1, -1), i)}</em>);
30:     last = m.index + token.length;
31:   }
32:   if (last < text.length) out.push(text.slice(last));
33:   return out;
34: }
35:
36: function splitRow(line: string): string[] {
37:   return line
38:     .trim()
39:     .replace(/^\|/, "")
40:     .replace(/\|$/, "")
41:     .split("|")
42:     .map((c) => c.trim());
43: }
44:
45: export function Markdown({ text, className }: { text: string; className?: string }) {
46:   const lines = text.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").split("\n");
47:   const blocks: ReactNode[] = [];
48:   let i = 0;
49:   let key = 0;
50:   while (i < lines.length) {
51:     const line = lines[i]!;
52:     if (!line.trim()) {
53:       i++;
54:       continue;
55:     }
56:     const heading = /^(#{1,4})\s+(.*)$/.exec(line);
57:     if (heading) {
58:       const level = heading[1]!.length;
59:       const content = inline(heading[2]!, key);
60:       blocks.push(level === 1 ? <h1 key={key++}>{content}</h1> : level === 2 ? <h2 key={key++}>{content}</h2> : <h3 key={key++}>{content}</h3>);
61:       i++;
62:       continue;
63:     }
64:     if (/^\|.*\|\s*$/.test(line) && i + 1 < lines.length && /^\|?\s*:?-{2,}/.test(lines[i + 1]!)) {
65:       const head = splitRow(line);
66:       i += 2;
67:       const rows: string[][] = [];
68:       while (i < lines.length && /^\|.*\|\s*$/.test(lines[i]!)) rows.push(splitRow(lines[i++]!));
69:       blocks.push(
70:         <div key={key++} style={{ overflowX: "auto" }}>
71:           <table>
72:             <thead>
73:               <tr>{head.map((h, hi) => <th key={hi}>{inline(h, hi)}</th>)}</tr>
74:             </thead>
75:             <tbody>
76:               {rows.map((r, ri) => (
77:                 <tr key={ri}>{r.map((c, ci) => <td key={ci}>{inline(c, ci)}</td>)}</tr>
78:               ))}
79:             </tbody>
80:           </table>
81:         </div>,
82:       );
83:       continue;
84:     }
85:     if (/^>\s?/.test(line)) {
86:       const quote: string[] = [];
87:       while (i < lines.length && /^>\s?/.test(lines[i]!)) quote.push(lines[i++]!.replace(/^>\s?/, ""));
88:       blocks.push(<blockquote key={key++}>{quote.map((q, qi) => <Fragment key={qi}>{inline(q, qi)}{qi < quote.length - 1 ? <br /> : null}</Fragment>)}</blockquote>);
89:       continue;
90:     }
91:     if (/^\s*[-*]\s+/.test(line)) {
92:       const items: string[] = [];
93:       while (i < lines.length && /^\s*[-*]\s+/.test(lines[i]!)) items.push(lines[i++]!.replace(/^\s*[-*]\s+/, ""));
94:       blocks.push(<ul key={key++}>{items.map((it, ii) => <li key={ii}>{inline(it, ii)}</li>)}</ul>);
95:       continue;
96:     }
97:     if (/^\s*\d+\.\s+/.test(line)) {
98:       const items: string[] = [];
99:       while (i < lines.length && /^\s*\d+\.\s+/.test(lines[i]!)) items.push(lines[i++]!.replace(/^\s*\d+\.\s+/, ""));
100:       blocks.push(<ol key={key++}>{items.map((it, ii) => <li key={ii}>{inline(it, ii)}</li>)}</ol>);
101:       continue;
102:     }
103:     const para: string[] = [];
104:     while (i < lines.length && lines[i]!.trim() && !/^(#{1,4}\s|>|\s*[-*]\s|\s*\d+\.\s|\|)/.test(lines[i]!)) para.push(lines[i++]!);
105:     if (!para.length) para.push(lines[i++]!);
106:     blocks.push(<p key={key++}>{inline(para.join(" "), key)}</p>);
107:   }
108:   return <div className={`markdown ${className ?? ""}`}>{blocks}</div>;
109: }

FILE apps/web/src/lib/media.ts SHA256 d75f1cf8966b24a502f4665ac435905f4c49989d51840875fa974ecd8f41a328
1: /** Responsive helpers shared by pages: one place for the breakpoints the CSS uses. */
2: import { useEffect, useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";
3:
4: /** Single-column layouts below this width (px): two-pane pages stack, master-detail pages show one pane. */
5: export const NARROW = "(max-width: 900px)";
6: /** Phones: touch screens smaller than 768px, where the Observatory opens on its 2D outline (DESIGN.md › Layout). */
7: export const PHONE = "(max-width: 767px) and (pointer: coarse)";
8:
9: export function useMediaQuery(query: string): boolean {
10:   const [matches, setMatches] = useState(() => typeof window !== "undefined" && window.matchMedia(query).matches);
11:   useEffect(() => {
12:     const mq = window.matchMedia(query);
13:     const on = () => setMatches(mq.matches);
14:     on();
15:     mq.addEventListener("change", on);
16:     return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", on);
17:   }, [query]);
18:   return matches;
19: }
20:
21: /** Two columns in the given proportions, stacking into one below 900px (`.split` in global.css). */
22: export function split(left: number, right: number): CSSProperties {
23:   return { ["--split" as string]: `minmax(0, ${left}fr) minmax(0, ${right}fr)` } as CSSProperties;
24: }

FILE apps/web/src/lib/queries.ts SHA256 f3ee9a4564ab9a2a4f0951323469de91040c6e5049833d1e77cd46688a383589
1: /** React Query hooks — server state. SSE events invalidate these keys (see events.ts). */
2: import { keepPreviousData, useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
3: import { useUi } from "../state/ui.ts";
4: import { api } from "./api.ts";
5: import { frameworkOf } from "./format.ts";
6: import { familyOf, registerFrameworks } from "./frameworks.ts";
7: import type {
8:   ActivityEvent,
9:   CheckResult,
10:   Connector,
11:   Evidence,
12:   FrameworkStateBundle,
13:   LeanGraph,
14:   Meta,
15:   NodeDetail,
16:   Policy,
17:   Proposal,
18:   Risk,
19:   RunWithProposals,
20:   SearchResult,
21:   Task,
22:   WorkspaceSummary,
23: } from "./types.ts";
24:
25: export const keys = {
26:   meta: ["meta"] as const,
27:   workspaces: ["workspaces"] as const,
28:   workspace: (ws: string) => ["ws", ws] as const,
29:   graph: (fw: string) => ["graph", fw] as const,
30:   state: (ws: string, fw: string) => ["ws", ws, "state", fw] as const,
31:   node: (ws: string, id: string) => ["ws", ws, "node", id] as const,
32:   tasks: (ws: string) => ["ws", ws, "tasks"] as const,
33:   evidence: (ws: string) => ["ws", ws, "evidence"] as const,
34:   policies: (ws: string) => ["ws", ws, "policies"] as const,
35:   risks: (ws: string) => ["ws", ws, "risks"] as const,
36:   connectors: (ws: string) => ["ws", ws, "connectors"] as const,
37:   checks: (ws: string) => ["ws", ws, "checks"] as const,
38:   runs: (ws: string) => ["ws", ws, "runs"] as const,
39:   run: (ws: string, id: string) => ["ws", ws, "run", id] as const,
40:   proposals: (ws: string) => ["ws", ws, "proposals"] as const,
41:   activity: (ws: string) => ["ws", ws, "activity"] as const,
42:   audit: (ws: string) => ["ws", ws, "audit"] as const,
43:   search: (q: string) => ["search", q] as const,
44: };
45:
46: const enc = encodeURIComponent;
47:
48: export const useMeta = () =>
49:   useQuery({
50:     queryKey: keys.meta,
51:     queryFn: async () => {
52:       const meta = await api.get<Meta>("/meta");
53:       registerFrameworks(meta.frameworks);
54:       return meta;
55:     },
56:     staleTime: Infinity,
57:   });
58: export const useWorkspaces = () => useQuery({ queryKey: keys.workspaces, queryFn: () => api.get<WorkspaceSummary[]>("/workspaces") });
59: export const useWorkspace = (ws: string | undefined) =>
60:   useQuery({ queryKey: keys.workspace(ws ?? ""), queryFn: () => api.get<WorkspaceSummary>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}`), enabled: !!ws });
61: export const useGraph = (fw: string | undefined) =>
62:   useQuery({ queryKey: keys.graph(fw ?? ""), queryFn: () => api.get<LeanGraph>(`/frameworks/${enc(fw!)}`), enabled: !!fw, staleTime: Infinity });
63: export const useFrameworkState = (ws: string | undefined, fw: string | undefined) => {
64:   // Threat catalogs carry derived coverage, counted down to the chosen link status.
65:   const min = useUi((s) => s.threatMin);
66:   const threat = !!fw && familyOf(fw) === "threat";
67:   return useQuery({
68:     queryKey: threat ? [...keys.state(ws ?? "", fw ?? ""), min] : keys.state(ws ?? "", fw ?? ""),
69:     queryFn: () => api.get<FrameworkStateBundle>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}/frameworks/${enc(fw!)}/state${threat ? `?min=${min}` : ""}`),
70:     enabled: !!ws && !!fw,
71:     placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
72:   });
73: };
74: export const useNodeDetail = (ws: string | undefined, id: string | undefined) => {
75:   const min = useUi((s) => s.threatMin);
76:   const threat = !!id && familyOf(frameworkOf(id)) === "threat";
77:   return useQuery({
78:     queryKey: threat ? [...keys.node(ws ?? "", id ?? ""), min] : keys.node(ws ?? "", id ?? ""),
79:     queryFn: () => api.get<NodeDetail>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}/requirements/${enc(id!)}${threat ? `?min=${min}` : ""}`),
80:     enabled: !!ws && !!id,
81:     // Changing the link filter refetches the same node: keep showing it (and the open tab) meanwhile.
82:     placeholderData: (prev) => (prev?.node.id === id ? prev : undefined),
83:   });
84: };
85: export const useTasks = (ws: string | undefined) => useQuery({ queryKey: keys.tasks(ws ?? ""), queryFn: () => api.get<Task[]>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}/tasks`), enabled: !!ws });
86: export const useEvidence = (ws: string | undefined) => useQuery({ queryKey: keys.evidence(ws ?? ""), queryFn: () => api.get<Evidence[]>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}/evidence`), enabled: !!ws });
87: export const usePolicies = (ws: string | undefined) => useQuery({ queryKey: keys.policies(ws ?? ""), queryFn: () => api.get<Policy[]>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}/policies`), enabled: !!ws });
88: export const useRisks = (ws: string | undefined) => useQuery({ queryKey: keys.risks(ws ?? ""), queryFn: () => api.get<Risk[]>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}/risks`), enabled: !!ws });
89: export const useConnectors = (ws: string | undefined) => useQuery({ queryKey: keys.connectors(ws ?? ""), queryFn: () => api.get<Connector[]>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}/connectors`), enabled: !!ws });
90: export const useChecks = (ws: string | undefined) => useQuery({ queryKey: keys.checks(ws ?? ""), queryFn: () => api.get<CheckResult[]>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}/checks`), enabled: !!ws });
91: export const useRuns = (ws: string | undefined) => useQuery({ queryKey: keys.runs(ws ?? ""), queryFn: () => api.get<RunWithProposals[]>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}/runs`), enabled: !!ws });
92: export const useRun = (ws: string | undefined, id: string | undefined) =>
93:   useQuery({ queryKey: keys.run(ws ?? "", id ?? ""), queryFn: () => api.get<RunWithProposals>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}/runs/${enc(id!)}`), enabled: !!ws && !!id });
94: export const useProposals = (ws: string | undefined, status?: string) =>
95:   useQuery({ queryKey: [...keys.proposals(ws ?? ""), status ?? "all"], queryFn: () => api.get<Proposal[]>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}/proposals${status ? `?status=${status}` : ""}`), enabled: !!ws });
96: export const useActivity = (ws: string | undefined, limit = 100) =>
97:   useQuery({ queryKey: [...keys.activity(ws ?? ""), limit], queryFn: () => api.get<ActivityEvent[]>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}/activity?limit=${limit}`), enabled: !!ws });
98: export const useAuditVerification = (ws: string | undefined) =>
99:   useQuery({ queryKey: keys.audit(ws ?? ""), queryFn: () => api.get<{ valid: boolean; events: number; brokenAt?: number; head?: string }>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws!)}/activity/verify`), enabled: !!ws });
100: export const useSearch = (q: string) =>
101:   useQuery({ queryKey: keys.search(q), queryFn: () => api.get<SearchResult>(`/search?q=${enc(q)}`), enabled: q.trim().length >= 2, placeholderData: keepPreviousData });
102:
103: /** Generic mutation that refreshes the whole workspace on success. */
104: export function useWsMutation<TVars, TResult = unknown>(ws: string | undefined, fn: (vars: TVars) => Promise<TResult>) {
105:   const qc = useQueryClient();
106:   return useMutation({
107:     mutationFn: fn,
108:     onSuccess: () => {
109:       void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["ws", ws ?? ""] });
110:       void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.workspaces });
111:     },
112:   });
113: }

FILE apps/web/src/main.tsx SHA256 65a95f6c3e2754408f37e00cc86da8e16545c7178251b41e4563d1dac46a3769
1: import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
2: import { StrictMode } from "react";
3: import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
4: import { App } from "./App.tsx";
5: import "./styles/global.css";
6:
7: const queryClient = new QueryClient({
8:   defaultOptions: { queries: { staleTime: 15_000, refetchOnWindowFocus: false, retry: 1 } },
9: });

11: createRoot(document.getElementById("root")!).render(
12:   <StrictMode>
13:     <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
14:       <App />
15:     </QueryClientProvider>
16:   </StrictMode>,
17: );

FILE apps/web/src/pages/AgentsPage.tsx SHA256 f9361ee21a90b62fa81a3957b6d50e2533eb4ca6f275be82e030f87220a36b33
1: /**
2:  * Agents: glass-box flight recorders, the approvals inbox and the launcher.
3:  */
4: import { AlertTriangle, ArrowLeft, BookOpen, Brain, CheckCheck, Compass, MessageSquare, Play, Square, Wrench } from "lucide-react";
5: import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
6: import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
7: import type { AgentStep } from "@visua/core";
8: import { ProposalCard } from "../components/agents/Proposals.tsx";
9: import { AgentBadge, CitationBlock, CodeTag, Empty, toast } from "../components/ui/index.tsx";
10: import { api } from "../lib/api.ts";
11: import { useCan } from "../lib/auth.ts";
12: import { relativeTime, truncate } from "../lib/format.ts";
13: import { Markdown } from "../lib/markdown.tsx";
14: import { NARROW, useMediaQuery } from "../lib/media.ts";
15: import { useMeta, useProposals, useRun, useRuns, useWorkspace, useWsMutation } from "../lib/queries.ts";
16: import type { RunWithProposals } from "../lib/types.ts";
17: import { useUi } from "../state/ui.ts";
18:
19: const STEP_ICON: Record<AgentStep["type"], React.ReactNode> = {
20:   plan: <Compass size={14} />,
21:   thought: <Brain size={14} />,
22:   "tool-call": <Wrench size={14} />,
23:   "tool-result": <Wrench size={14} />,
24:   citation: <BookOpen size={14} />,
25:   proposal: <CheckCheck size={14} />,
26:   message: <MessageSquare size={14} />,
27:   ui: <Compass size={14} />,
28:   error: <AlertTriangle size={14} />,
29: };
30:
31: function RunStatus({ status }: { status: string }) {
32:   const color =
33:     status === "completed" ? "var(--color-status-implemented)" : status === "failed" ? "var(--color-status-at-risk)" : status === "awaiting-approval" ? "var(--color-tertiary)" : status === "cancelled" ? "var(--color-on-surface-muted)" : "var(--color-status-in-progress)";
34:   return (
35:     <span className="row mono" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 11, color }}>
36:       <span className={status === "running" || status === "queued" ? "pulse" : ""} style={{ width: 7, height: 7, borderRadius: 99, background: color }} />
37:       {status}
38:     </span>
39:   );
40: }
41:
42: function StepView({ step }: { step: AgentStep }) {
43:   const focus = useUi((s) => s.focus);
44:   const navigate = useNavigate();
45:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
46:   const tool = step.type === "tool-call" || step.type === "tool-result";
47:   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
48:   return (
49:     <li className="flight__step">
50:       <span className={`flight__dot flight__dot--${step.type}`}>{STEP_ICON[step.type]}</span>
51:       <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
52:         <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
53:           <span className="eyebrow" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>
54:             {step.type}
55:           </span>
56:           <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 10.5 }}>
57:             {new Date(step.at).toLocaleTimeString()}
58:           </span>
59:         </div>
60:         <div className={tool ? "agent-step agent-step--tool" : step.type === "error" ? "toast toast--error" : "agent-step"} style={{ marginTop: 4, cursor: step.data || step.detail ? "pointer" : undefined }} onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>
61:           <div style={{ fontWeight: tool ? 500 : 500 }}>{step.title}</div>
62:           {open && step.detail && step.type !== "message" && <div style={{ marginTop: 6, whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", opacity: 0.9 }}>{step.detail}</div>}
63:           {open && step.data !== undefined && (
64:             <pre className="mono" style={{ marginTop: 8, whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", fontSize: 11, maxHeight: 260, overflow: "auto" }}>
65:               {JSON.stringify(step.data, null, 2).slice(0, 4000)}
66:             </pre>
67:           )}
68:         </div>
69:         {step.type === "message" && step.detail && (
70:           <div className="panel" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
71:             <Markdown text={step.detail} />
72:           </div>
73:         )}
74:         {step.citations?.length ? (
75:           <div className="stack" style={{ marginTop: 8, gap: 6 }}>
76:             {step.citations.slice(0, 3).map((c, i) => (
77:               <CitationBlock key={i} citation={c} />
78:             ))}
79:           </div>
80:         ) : null}
81:         {step.nodeIds?.length ? (
82:           <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 4, marginTop: 6 }}>
83:             {step.nodeIds.slice(0, 10).map((id) => (
84:               <CodeTag
85:                 key={id}
86:                 id={id}
87:                 onNavigate={(nid) => {
88:                   navigate(`/w/${ws}/observatory/${nid.slice(0, nid.lastIndexOf(":"))}?select=${encodeURIComponent(nid)}`);
89:                   focus([nid]);
90:                 }}
91:               />
92:             ))}
93:           </div>
94:         ) : null}
95:       </div>
96:     </li>
97:   );
98: }
99:
100: function FlightRecorder({ runId }: { runId: string }) {
101:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
102:   const { data: run } = useRun(ws, runId);
103:   const cancel = useWsMutation(ws, () => api.post(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/runs/${runId}/cancel`));
104:   const approveAll = useWsMutation(ws, () => api.post(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/runs/${runId}/approve-all`));
105:   const canDecide = useCan("work.approve");
106:   if (!run) return <div className="muted">Loading run…</div>;
107:   const pending = run.proposals.filter((p) => p.status === "pending");
108:   const duration = run.startedAt && run.finishedAt ? Math.max(0, (new Date(run.finishedAt).getTime() - new Date(run.startedAt).getTime()) / 1000) : undefined;
109:   return (
110:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
111:       <div className="panel">
112:         <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ alignItems: "flex-start", gap: 12 }}>
113:           <div style={{ flex: "1 1 260px", minWidth: 0 }}>
114:             <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
115:               <AgentBadge label={run.agent} />
116:               <RunStatus status={run.status} />
117:               <span className="muted mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
118:                 {run.mode === "claude" ? run.model : "offline playbook"}
119:                 {duration !== undefined ? ` · ${duration.toFixed(1)}s` : ""}
120:                 {run.usage ? ` · ${run.usage.inputTokens.toLocaleString()} in / ${run.usage.outputTokens.toLocaleString()} out tokens` : ""}
121:               </span>
122:             </div>
123:             <h2 className="section-title" style={{ marginTop: 10, marginBottom: 0 }}>
124:               {run.goal}
125:             </h2>
126:           </div>
127:           {(run.status === "running" || run.status === "queued") && (
128:             <button className="btn btn--sm" onClick={() => cancel.mutate(undefined)}>
129:               <Square size={12} /> Stop
130:             </button>
131:           )}
132:           {pending.length > 1 && canDecide && (
133:             <button className="btn btn--agent btn--sm" onClick={() => approveAll.mutate(undefined, { onSuccess: () => toast(`Approved ${pending.length} proposals`) })}>
134:               <CheckCheck size={13} /> Approve all {pending.length}
135:             </button>
136:           )}
137:         </div>
138:         {run.error && <div className="toast toast--error" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>{run.error}</div>}
139:       </div>
140:       {run.proposals.length > 0 && (
141:         <section>
142:           <div className="eyebrow" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
143:             Proposals ({pending.length} pending of {run.proposals.length})
144:           </div>
145:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
146:             {run.proposals.map((p) => (
147:               <ProposalCard key={p.id} proposal={p} />
148:             ))}
149:           </div>
150:         </section>
151:       )}
152:       <section>
153:         <div className="eyebrow" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
154:           Flight recorder · {run.steps.length} steps
155:         </div>
156:         <ol className="flight">
157:           {run.steps.map((s) => (
158:             <StepView key={s.id} step={s} />
159:           ))}
160:         </ol>
161:       </section>
162:     </div>
163:   );
164: }
165:
166: const PRESETS: Record<string, string> = {
167:   copilot: "What are our largest gaps and what should we do first?",
168:   assessor: "Assess our current implementation levels from evidence and monitoring",
169:   planner: "Plan the next sprint of work for our highest-priority gaps",
170:   "policy-author": "Draft the policy that governs our weakest category",
171:   "evidence-collector": "Run monitoring checks and find implemented requirements without evidence",
172:   "crosswalk-analyst": "Project our CSF progress onto our other frameworks",
173:   "auditor-prep": "Prepare an audit readiness brief with blocking items",
174:   "task-executor": "Execute the selected task",
175: };
176:
177: function Launcher() {
178:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
179:   const meta = useMeta();
180:   const workspace = useWorkspace(ws);
181:   const navigate = useNavigate();
182:   const [agent, setAgent] = useState("copilot");
183:   const [goal, setGoal] = useState(PRESETS["copilot"]!);
184:   const [framework, setFramework] = useState("");
185:   const start = useWsMutation(ws, () => api.post<RunWithProposals>(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/runs`, { agent, goal, input: framework ? { framework } : {} }));
186:   const canWrite = useCan("work.write");
187:   if (!canWrite) return null;
188:   return (
189:     <div className="panel">
190:       <div className="panel__head">
191:         <h2>Launch an agent</h2>
192:         <span className="spacer" />
193:         <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
194:           {meta.data?.ai.mode === "claude" ? `Claude · ${meta.data.ai.model}` : "Offline playbooks"}
195:         </span>
196:       </div>
197:       <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
198:         <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
199:           {(meta.data?.agents ?? []).filter((a) => a.kind !== "task-executor").map((a) => (
200:             <button
201:               key={a.kind}
202:               className="chip"
203:               aria-pressed={agent === a.kind}
204:               title={a.tagline}
205:               onClick={() => {
206:                 setAgent(a.kind);
207:                 setGoal(PRESETS[a.kind] ?? "");
208:               }}
209:             >
210:               {a.name}
211:             </button>
212:           ))}
213:         </div>
214:         <textarea className="textarea" style={{ minHeight: 70 }} value={goal} onChange={(e) => setGoal(e.target.value)} aria-label="Goal" />
215:         <div className="row">
216:           <select className="select" style={{ maxWidth: 220 }} value={framework} onChange={(e) => setFramework(e.target.value)} aria-label="Framework scope">
217:             <option value="">All enabled frameworks</option>
218:             {workspace.data?.frameworks.map((f) => (
219:               <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
220:                 {f.shortName}
221:               </option>
222:             ))}
223:           </select>
224:           <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
225:           <button
226:             className="btn btn--agent"
227:             disabled={!goal.trim() || start.isPending}
228:             onClick={() =>
229:               start.mutate(undefined, {
230:                 onSuccess: (run) => navigate(`/w/${ws}/agents/${run.id}`),
231:                 onError: (e) => toast((e as Error).message, "error"),
232:               })
233:             }
234:           >
235:             <Play size={14} /> Run {meta.data?.agents.find((a) => a.kind === agent)?.name ?? agent}
236:           </button>
237:         </div>
238:       </div>
239:     </div>
240:   );
241: }
242:
243: export function AgentsPage() {
244:   const { ws = "", runId } = useParams();
245:   const navigate = useNavigate();
246:   const runs = useRuns(ws);
247:   const pending = useProposals(ws, "pending");
248:   const selected = runId ?? runs.data?.[0]?.id;
249:   const [tab, setTab] = useState<"runs" | "inbox">("runs");
250:   // Narrow screens show one pane at a time: the list, or the run someone opened.
251:   const narrow = useMediaQuery(NARROW);
252:   useEffect(() => {
253:     if (!narrow && !runId && runs.data?.[0]) navigate(`/w/${ws}/agents/${runs.data[0].id}`, { replace: true });
254:   }, [narrow, runId, runs.data, navigate, ws]);
255:   const inbox = useMemo(() => pending.data ?? [], [pending.data]);
256:   return (
257:     <div className="page master-detail" data-pane={runId ? "detail" : "list"} style={{ ["--master" as string]: "420px" }}>
258:       <aside className="stack master-detail__master">
259:         <div>
260:           <h1 style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-headline-lg-family)", fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 600 }}>Agents</h1>
261:           <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13, marginTop: 4 }}>
262:             Every run is recorded step by step. Agents propose; you decide. Nothing changes your compliance state without approval unless you grant autonomy in Settings.
263:           </p>
264:         </div>
265:         <Launcher />
266:         <div className="tabs" role="tablist" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
267:           <button role="tab" aria-selected={tab === "runs"} onClick={() => setTab("runs")}>
268:             Runs <span className="count">{runs.data?.length ?? 0}</span>
269:           </button>
270:           <button role="tab" aria-selected={tab === "inbox"} onClick={() => setTab("inbox")}>
271:             Approvals inbox <span className="count">{inbox.length}</span>
272:           </button>
273:         </div>
274:         {tab === "runs" && (
275:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
276:             {(runs.data ?? []).map((r) => (
277:               <button key={r.id} className={`runrow ${selected === r.id ? "is-selected" : ""}`} onClick={() => navigate(`/w/${ws}/agents/${r.id}`)}>
278:                 <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
279:                   <AgentBadge label={r.agent} />
280:                   <RunStatus status={r.status} />
281:                   <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
282:                   <span className="muted mono" style={{ fontSize: 10.5 }}>
283:                     {relativeTime(r.createdAt)}
284:                   </span>
285:                 </div>
286:                 <div style={{ marginTop: 6, textAlign: "left" }}>{truncate(r.goal, 110)}</div>
287:               </button>
288:             ))}
289:             {!runs.data?.length && <Empty title="No runs yet">Launch an agent above.</Empty>}
290:           </div>
291:         )}
292:         {tab === "inbox" && (
293:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
294:             {inbox.map((p) => (
295:               <ProposalCard key={p.id} proposal={p} compact />
296:             ))}
297:             {!inbox.length && <Empty title="Inbox zero">No proposals are waiting for a decision.</Empty>}
298:           </div>
299:         )}
300:       </aside>
301:       <section className="master-detail__detail">
302:         <Link to={`/w/${ws}/agents`} className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm master-detail__back">
303:           <ArrowLeft size={14} aria-hidden /> All runs and approvals
304:         </Link>
305:         {selected ? <FlightRecorder runId={selected} /> : <Empty title="Select a run" />}
306:       </section>
307:     </div>
308:   );
309: }

FILE apps/web/src/pages/AiPage.tsx SHA256 b1a30810b03c85ee0a221fdda2f6161b9ccc1092ef579274d454172cf9664393
1: /**
2:  * AI governance program (NIST AI RMF 1.0 + the NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile):

58: function SystemDialog({ ws, initial, onClose }: { ws: string; initial: Draft; onClose: () => void }) {
59:   const [d, setD] = useState<Draft>(initial);
60:   const save = useWsMutation(ws, (v: Draft) => {
61:     const { id, ...body } = v;
62:     const clean = { ...body, provider: body.provider || undefined, owner: body.owner || undefined, humanOversight: body.humanOversight || undefined };
63:     return id ? api.patch(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/ai/systems/${id}`, clean) : api.post(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/ai/systems`, clean);
64:   });
65:   const valid = d.name.trim() && d.purpose.trim();
66:   return (
67:     <Dialog
68:       wide
69:       title={d.id ? `Edit ${initial.name}` : "Add an AI system to the inventory"}
70:       onClose={onClose}
71:       footer={
72:         <>
73:           <button className="btn" onClick={onClose}>
74:             Cancel
75:           </button>
76:           <button
77:             className="btn btn--primary"
78:             disabled={!valid}
79:             onClick={() => save.mutate(d, { onSuccess: () => (toast(d.id ? "AI system updated" : "AI system added to the inventory"), onClose()), onError: (e) => toast((e as Error).message, "error") })}
80:           >
81:             {d.id ? "Save" : "Add system"}
82:           </button>
83:         </>
84:       }
85:     >
86:       <div className="grid grid--2" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
87:         <div className="field">
88:           <label>Name</label>
89:           <input className="input" value={d.name} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, name: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. Clinical note summarizer" />
90:         </div>
91:         <div className="field">
92:           <label>Model, API or platform (value chain)</label>
93:           <input className="input" value={d.provider ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, provider: e.target.value })} placeholder="e.g. third-party LLM API, in-house gradient boosting" />
94:         </div>
95:         <div className="field" style={{ gridColumn: "1 / -1" }}>
96:           <label>Intended purpose and context of use</label>
97:           <textarea className="input" rows={3} value={d.purpose} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, purpose: e.target.value })} placeholder="What it does, for whom, where its outputs are used, and what it must not be used for" />
98:         </div>
99:         <div className="field">
100:           <label>Our role</label>
101:           <select className="select" value={d.role} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, role: e.target.value as AiSystem["role"] })}>
102:             {ROLES.map(([v, l]) => (
103:               <option key={v} value={v}>
104:                 {l}
105:               </option>
106:             ))}
107:           </select>
108:         </div>
109:         <div className="field">
110:           <label>Lifecycle stage</label>
111:           <select className="select" value={d.lifecycle} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, lifecycle: e.target.value as AiSystem["lifecycle"] })}>
112:             {LIFECYCLE.map(([v, l]) => (
113:               <option key={v} value={v}>
114:                 {l}
115:               </option>
116:             ))}
117:           </select>
118:         </div>
119:         <div className="field">
120:           <label>Risk tier (your organization's own tiering)</label>
121:           <select className="select" value={d.riskTier} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, riskTier: e.target.value as AiSystem["riskTier"] })}>
122:             {(["low", "moderate", "high"] as const).map((t) => (
123:               <option key={t} value={t}>
124:                 {TIER_LABEL[t]}
125:               </option>
126:             ))}
127:           </select>
128:         </div>
129:         <div className="field">
130:           <label>Accountable owner</label>
131:           <input className="input" value={d.owner ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, owner: e.target.value })} />
132:         </div>
133:         <label className="row" style={{ gap: 8, gridColumn: "1 / -1", fontSize: 13 }}>
134:           <input type="checkbox" checked={d.generative} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, generative: e.target.checked })} />
135:           Generative AI (produces text, images, audio, code or other content) — applies the NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile
136:         </label>
137:         <div className="field" style={{ gridColumn: "1 / -1" }}>
138:           <span className="label">Data it processes</span>
139:           <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
140:             {DATA_TYPES.map(([v, l]) => (
141:               <button key={v} className="chip" aria-pressed={d.dataTypes.includes(v)} onClick={() => setD({ ...d, dataTypes: d.dataTypes.includes(v) ? d.dataTypes.filter((x) => x !== v) : [...d.dataTypes, v] })}>
142:                 {l}
143:               </button>
144:             ))}
145:           </div>
146:         </div>
147:         <div className="field" style={{ gridColumn: "1 / -1" }}>
148:           <label>Human oversight</label>
149:           <input className="input" value={d.humanOversight ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setD({ ...d, humanOversight: e.target.value })} placeholder="Who reviews or can override outputs, and when" />
150:         </div>
151:       </div>
152:     </Dialog>
153:   );
154: }

156: function Inventory({ ws, systems }: { ws: string; systems: AiSystem[] }) {
157:   const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Draft | null>(null);
158:   const remove = useWsMutation(ws, (id: string) => api.del(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/ai/systems/${id}`));
159:   return (
160:     <div className="panel">
161:       <div className="panel__head">
162:         <BrainCircuit size={16} />
163:         <h2>AI system inventory</h2>
164:         <span className="spacer" />
165:         <button className="btn btn--sm" onClick={() => setEditing(EMPTY)}>
166:           <Plus size={13} /> Add system
167:         </button>
168:       </div>
169:       {systems.length ? (
170:         <table className="table table--systems">
171:           <thead>
172:             <tr>
173:               <th>System</th>
174:               <th>Role · stage</th>
175:               <th>Risk tier</th>
176:               <th>Owner</th>
177:               <th />
178:             </tr>
179:           </thead>
180:           <tbody>
181:             {systems.map((s) => (
182:               <tr key={s.id}>
183:                 <td>
184:                   <div style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>
185:                     {s.name}
186:                     {s.generative && (
187:                       <span className="chip" style={{ cursor: "default", marginLeft: 8, fontSize: 11 }}>
188:                         <Sparkles size={11} /> Generative
189:                       </span>
190:                     )}
191:                   </div>
192:                   <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
193:                     {truncate(s.purpose, 120)}
194:                     {s.provider ? ` · ${s.provider}` : ""}
195:                   </div>
196:                 </td>
197:                 <td className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12.5 }}>
198:                   {ROLES.find(([v]) => v === s.role)?.[1].split(" (")[0]} · {LIFECYCLE.find(([v]) => v === s.lifecycle)?.[1]}
199:                 </td>
200:                 <td style={{ fontSize: 12.5 }}>{TIER_LABEL[s.riskTier]}</td>
201:                 <td className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12.5 }}>
202:                   {s.owner ?? "—"}
203:                 </td>
204:                 <td style={{ whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
205:                   <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm btn--icon" aria-label={`Edit ${s.name}`} onClick={() => setEditing({ ...s })}>
206:                     <Pencil size={13} />
207:                   </button>
208:                   <button
209:                     className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm btn--icon"
210:                     aria-label={`Remove ${s.name}`}
211:                     onClick={() => window.confirm(`Remove ${s.name} from the inventory? The removal is recorded in the audit trail.`) && remove.mutate(s.id)}
212:                   >
213:                     <Trash2 size={13} />
214:                   </button>
215:                 </td>
216:               </tr>
217:             ))}
218:           </tbody>
219:         </table>
220:       ) : (
221:         <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
222:           No AI systems inventoried yet. Start here: AI risk management is scoped by the systems you develop or deploy, their purpose and their context of use.
223:         </p>
224:       )}
225:       {editing && <SystemDialog ws={ws} initial={editing} onClose={() => setEditing(null)} />}
226:     </div>
227:   );
228: }

230: export function AiPage() {
231:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
232:   const meta = useMeta();
233:   const workspace = useWorkspace(ws);
234:   const run = useRunAgent();
235:   const loaded = meta.data?.frameworks.some((f) => f.id === AI_RMF);
236:   const { data, error } = useQuery({ queryKey: ["ws", ws, "ai"], queryFn: () => api.get<AiOverview>(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/ai`), enabled: !!loaded });
237:   const enable = useWsMutation(ws, () => api.put(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/frameworks/${AI_RMF}`, { enabled: true }));
238:
239:   if (!meta.data || !workspace.data) return <div className="page muted">Loading…</div>;
240:   if (!loaded) {
241:     return (
242:       <div className="page">
243:         <Empty title="The NIST AI RMF is not ingested">
244:           <p style={{ margin: "8px 0 0" }}>
245:             Add the official corpus to <code className="mono">corpus/nist-ai-rmf/</code> and run <code className="mono">pnpm ingest</code>.
246:           </p>
247:         </Empty>
248:       </div>
249:     );
250:   }
251:   if (error) return <div className="page muted">Could not load AI governance: {(error as Error).message}</div>;
252:   if (!data) return <div className="page muted">Loading…</div>;
253:   if (!data.enabled) {
254:     return (
255:       <div className="page">
256:         <Empty title="AI governance is not enabled for this workspace">
257:           <p style={{ margin: "8px 0 12px" }}>
258:             Enable the NIST AI Risk Management Framework to inventory your AI systems and work through its four functions — GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE and MANAGE — with the Generative AI Profile for generative systems.
259:           </p>
260:           <button className="btn btn--primary" onClick={() => enable.mutate(undefined)}>
261:             Enable NIST AI RMF
262:           </button>
263:         </Empty>
264:       </div>
265:     );
266:   }
267:   const genAi = data.genAi;
268:   return (
269:     <div className="page">
270:       <header className="page__header">
271:         <div>
272:           <div className="eyebrow">AI governance · {data.framework.name}</div>
273:           <h1>AI RMF readiness · {Math.round(data.readiness * 100)}%</h1>
274:           <p>
275:             {data.systems.length} AI system{data.systems.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} inventoried · {data.total} outcomes · {data.gaps} gaps
276:             {genAi?.active ? ` · Generative AI Profile applies (${genAi.generativeSystems.join(", ")})` : ""}. The AI RMF is voluntary and outcome-based; Visua tracks progress, it does not certify conformity.
277:           </p>
278:         </div>
279:         <div className="page__actions">
280:           <button className="btn btn--agent" onClick={() => run("planner", "Plan AI RMF work for our largest AI governance gaps", { framework: AI_RMF }, { stay: true })}>
281:             <Sparkles size={14} /> Plan with agent
282:           </button>
283:           <a className="btn" href={exportUrl(ws, "ai-rmf-profile.csv")}>
284:             AI RMF profile (CSV)
285:           </a>
286:           <Link className="btn btn--primary" to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${AI_RMF}`}>
287:             <Telescope size={14} /> Outcomes in 3D
288:           </Link>
289:         </div>
290:       </header>
291:       <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
292:         <Inventory ws={ws} systems={data.systems} />
293:         <div className="grid grid--4">
294:           {data.functions.map((f) => (
295:             <Link key={f.id} to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${AI_RMF}?select=${encodeURIComponent(f.id)}`} className="panel" style={{ color: "inherit" }}>
296:               <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
297:                 <span className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-framework-ai)" }}>
298:                   {f.code}
299:                 </span>
300:                 <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
301:                 <StatusChip status={f.status} />
302:               </div>
303:               <div className="metric__value" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
304:                 {Math.round(f.readiness * 100)}
305:                 <small>%</small>
306:               </div>
307:               <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{f.counts && <StatusBar counts={f.counts} height={6} />}</div>
308:               <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginTop: 6 }}>
309:                 {f.total} outcomes · {f.gaps} gaps
310:               </div>
311:             </Link>
312:           ))}
313:         </div>
314:         {genAi && (
315:           <div className="panel">
316:             <div className="panel__head">
317:               <h2>{genAi.title}</h2>
318:               <span className="spacer" />
319:               <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
320:                 {genAi.active ? "Applies: at least one inventoried system is generative" : "Not yet applicable: no generative system in the inventory"}
321:               </span>
322:             </div>
323:             <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 12 }}>
324:               Each GAI risk is addressed by Generative AI Profile actions attached to AI RMF outcomes. Readiness here is the progress of those outcomes toward their targets — a lead indicator, not a risk rating.
325:             </p>
326:             <table className="table table--gai">
327:               <thead>
328:                 <tr>
329:                   <th>GAI risk</th>
330:                   <th style={{ width: 90 }}>Actions</th>
331:                   <th style={{ width: 90 }}>Outcomes</th>
332:                   <th style={{ width: "32%" }}>Outcome readiness</th>
333:                   <th style={{ width: 70 }}>Gaps</th>
334:                 </tr>
335:               </thead>
336:               <tbody>
337:                 {genAi.risks.map((r) => (
338:                   <tr key={r.id} title={r.description}>
339:                     <td>
340:                       <Link to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${AI_RMF}?select=${encodeURIComponent(r.outcomes[0] ?? "")}`} style={{ color: "inherit" }}>
341:                         {r.title}
342:                       </Link>
343:                       <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11.5 }}>
344:                         {truncate(r.description, 140)}
345:                         {r.citation.page ? ` (NIST AI 600-1, p. ${r.citation.page})` : ""}
346:                       </div>
347:                     </td>
348:                     <td className="mono">{r.actions}</td>
349:                     <td className="mono">{r.outcomes.length}</td>
350:                     <td>
351:                       <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
352:                         <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
353:                           <Progress value={r.readiness} color="var(--color-framework-ai)" />
354:                         </div>
355:                         <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 12, width: 38, textAlign: "right" }}>
356:                           {Math.round(r.readiness * 100)}%
357:                         </span>
358:                       </div>
359:                     </td>
360:                     <td className="mono">{r.gaps}</td>
361:                   </tr>
362:                 ))}
363:               </tbody>
364:             </table>
365:           </div>
366:         )}
367:         <CyberAiProfilePanel ws={ws} />
368:         {data.framework.contentNotice && <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{data.framework.contentNotice}</p>}
369:       </div>
370:     </div>
371:   );
372: }

1: /**
2:  * Crosswalk: the 3D Nexus of authoritative mappings between frameworks, with a
3:  * keyboard-accessible group list and unit-level mapping rows. A mapping means
4:  * two requirements address related intent — it is never evidence.
5:  */

8: import { Suspense, useMemo, useState } from "react";
9: import { Link, useParams, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
10: import type { Status } from "@visua/core";
11: import { useRunAgent } from "../components/inspector/Inspector.tsx";
12: import { CoverageBar, CoverageLegend, LINK_STATUS_HELP, LINK_STATUS_LABEL, LinkStatusBadge, ThreatLinkFilter } from "../components/threats/Coverage.tsx";
13: import { Empty, FrameworkBadge, StatusChip } from "../components/ui/index.tsx";
14: import { api } from "../lib/api.ts";
15: import { truncate } from "../lib/format.ts";
16: import { badgeOf } from "../lib/frameworks.ts";
17: import { useWorkspace } from "../lib/queries.ts";
18: import type { LinkStatus, ThreatRing } from "../lib/types.ts";

22: interface Side {
23:   id: string;
24:   code: string;
25:   title: string;
26:   framework: string;
27:   group: string | null;

42: const AUTHORITY_NOTES: Record<string, string> = {
43:   "NIST OLIR": "NIST's Online Informative References program — official, NIST-reviewed crosswalks.",
44:   AICPA: "AICPA's published mapping workbook (local licensed copy).",
45:   "AICPA + NIST OLIR (composed)": "AICPA's TSC → CSF v1.1 mapping carried to CSF 2.0 through NIST's official v1.1 → v2.0 crosswalk. Indirect: treat as a lead, not a match.",
46: };

48: function authorityNote(a: string): string {
49:   return AUTHORITY_NOTES[a] ?? (a.startsWith("Visua editorial") ? "Visua's editorial reading of the RMF task descriptions — flagged as editorial, not an official crosswalk." : a);
50: }

52: function Dot({ fw }: { fw: string }) {
53:   return <span aria-hidden style={{ display: "inline-block", width: 9, height: 9, borderRadius: 99, background: frameworkColor(fw) ?? "var(--color-outline)", flexShrink: 0 }} />;
54: }

56: function GroupDetail({ ws, data, groupId, onClose }: { ws: string; data: NexusData; groupId: string; onClose: () => void }) {
57:   const run = useRunAgent();
58:   const fw = data.frameworks.find((f) => f.groups.some((g) => g.id === groupId))!;
59:   const group = fw.groups.find((g) => g.id === groupId)!;
60:   const [limit, setLimit] = useState(80);
61:   const rows = useQuery({ queryKey: ["ws", ws, "crosswalk-rows", groupId], queryFn: () => api.get<Row[]>(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/crosswalk/rows?group=${encodeURIComponent(groupId)}&limit=3000`) });
62:   const byFramework = useMemo(() => {
63:     const m = new Map<string, Row[]>();
64:     for (const r of rows.data ?? []) {
65:       const other = r.source.group === groupId ? r.target : r.source;
66:       m.set(other.framework, [...(m.get(other.framework) ?? []), r]);
67:     }
68:     return m;
69:   }, [rows.data, groupId]);
70:   const name = (id: string) => data.frameworks.find((f) => f.id === id)?.shortName ?? id;
71:   let shown = 0;
72:   return (
73:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
74:       <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8, alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
75:         <Dot fw={fw.id} />
76:         <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
77:           <div className="eyebrow">{fw.shortName}</div>
78:           <h2 style={{ fontSize: 17, margin: "2px 0" }}>
79:             <span className="mono">{group.code}</span> {group.title}
80:           </h2>
81:           <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12.5 }}>
82:             {group.units} units{group.readiness !== null ? ` · ${Math.round(group.readiness * 100)}% ready` : fw.enabled ? "" : " · framework not enabled"} · {rows.data?.length ?? "…"} mappings
83:           </div>
84:         </div>
85:         <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--icon btn--sm" aria-label="Close" onClick={onClose}>
86:           <X size={14} />
87:         </button>
88:       </div>
89:       <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
90:         {[...byFramework.entries()].map(([other, list]) => (
91:           <span key={other} className="chip" style={{ cursor: "default" }}>
92:             <Dot fw={other} /> {name(other)} · {list.length}
93:           </span>
94:         ))}
95:       </div>
96:       <div className="callout" role="note">
97:         <Info size={14} /> A mapping says two requirements address related intent. It is not evidence: each requirement still needs its own implementation and proof.
98:       </div>
99:       {fw.enabled && (
100:         <button className="btn btn--agent btn--sm" style={{ alignSelf: "flex-start" }} onClick={() => run("crosswalk-analyst", `Project mapped progress onto ${fw.shortName}`, { framework: fw.id }, { stay: true })}>
101:           <Sparkles size={13} /> Project mapped progress onto {fw.shortName}
102:         </button>
103:       )}
104:       {rows.isLoading && <div className="muted">Loading mappings…</div>}
105:       {[...byFramework.entries()].map(([other, list]) => (
106:         <div key={other}>
107:           <div className="row" style={{ gap: 6, margin: "6px 0" }}>
108:             <Dot fw={other} />
109:             <strong style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>{name(other)}</strong>
110:             <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
111:               {list[0] ? truncate(list[0].authority, 60) : ""}
112:             </span>
113:           </div>
114:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
115:             {list.map((r, i) => {
116:               if (shown >= limit) return null;
117:               shown++;
118:               const mine = r.source.group === groupId ? r.source : r.target;
119:               const theirs = r.source.group === groupId ? r.target : r.source;
120:               return (
121:                 <div key={`${r.setId}-${i}`} className="xw-row" title={`${r.relationship} · ${r.authority} (${r.documentId})`}>
122:                   <Link to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${mine.framework}?select=${encodeURIComponent(mine.id)}`} className="mono xw-code">
123:                     {mine.code}
124:                   </Link>
125:                   <span className="muted" aria-hidden>
126:                     ↔
127:                   </span>
128:                   <Link to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${theirs.framework}?select=${encodeURIComponent(theirs.id)}`} className="mono xw-code">
129:                     {theirs.code}
130:                   </Link>
131:                   <span className="xw-title">{truncate(theirs.title, 70)}</span>
132:                   <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 10.5 }}>
133:                     {r.relationship}
134:                   </span>
135:                   {theirs.status ? <StatusChip status={theirs.status} /> : <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>not tracked</span>}
136:                 </div>
137:               );
138:             })}
139:           </div>
140:         </div>
141:       ))}
142:       {(rows.data?.length ?? 0) > limit && (
143:         <button className="btn btn--sm" onClick={() => setLimit(limit + 200)}>
144:           Show more ({(rows.data?.length ?? 0) - limit} remaining)
145:         </button>
146:       )}
147:     </div>
148:   );
149: }

151: function ThreatGroupDetail({ ws, data, groupId, onClose }: { ws: string; data: NexusData; groupId: string; onClose: () => void }) {
152:   const catalog = data.threats!.catalogs.find((c) => c.groups.some((g) => g.id === groupId))!;
153:   const group = catalog.groups.find((g) => g.id === groupId)!;
154:   const groups = new Map(data.frameworks.flatMap((f) => f.groups.map((g) => [g.id, { f, g }] as const)));
155:   const links = data.threats!.bundles.filter((b) => b.a === groupId).sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
156:   const byFramework = new Map<string, typeof links>();
157:   for (const l of links) {
158:     const fw = groups.get(l.b)?.f.id ?? l.b.slice(0, l.b.indexOf(":"));
159:     byFramework.set(fw, [...(byFramework.get(fw) ?? []), l]);
160:   }
161:   return (
162:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
163:       <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8, alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
164:         <FrameworkBadge frameworkId={catalog.id} />
165:         <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
166:           <div className="eyebrow">{catalog.shortName} · threat ring</div>
167:           <h2 style={{ fontSize: 17, margin: "2px 0" }}>
168:             <span className="mono">{group.code}</span> {group.title}
169:           </h2>
170:           <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12.5 }}>
171:             {group.units} {group.units === 1 ? "threat" : "threats"}
172:             {group.readiness !== null ? ` · ${Math.round(group.readiness * 100)}% covered` : ""} · linked to {links.length} requirement groups
173:           </div>
174:         </div>
175:         <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--icon btn--sm" aria-label="Close" onClick={onClose}>
176:           <X size={14} />
177:         </button>
178:       </div>
179:       <CoverageBar byState={group.byState} />
180:       <CoverageLegend byState={group.byState} />
181:       <ThreatLinkFilter />
182:       <div className="callout" role="note">
183:         <Info size={14} /> Arcs bundle the published links from these threats to requirement groups. Coverage is derived from those requirements: it is never an assessment of the threat.
184:       </div>
185:       <Link className="btn btn--sm" style={{ alignSelf: "flex-start" }} to={`/w/${ws}/threats/${catalog.id}?select=${encodeURIComponent(groupId)}`}>
186:         Open in threat view
187:       </Link>
188:       {[...byFramework.entries()].map(([fw, list]) => (
189:         <div key={fw} className="stack" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
190:           <div className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
191:             <Dot fw={fw} />
192:             <strong style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>{badgeOf(fw)}</strong>
193:           </div>
194:           {list.map((l) => {
195:             const target = groups.get(l.b);
196:             return (
197:               <div key={l.b} className="xw-row" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: "auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto auto" }}>
198:                 <Link to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${fw}?select=${encodeURIComponent(l.b)}`} className="mono xw-code">
199:                   {target?.g.code ?? l.b}
200:                 </Link>
201:                 <span className="xw-title">{truncate(target?.g.title ?? "", 60)}</span>
202:                 <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
203:                   {l.count}
204:                 </span>
205:                 <LinkStatusBadge status={l.best} />
206:                 {target?.g.status ? <StatusChip status={target.g.status} /> : <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>not tracked</span>}
207:               </div>
208:             );
209:           })}
210:         </div>
211:       ))}
212:     </div>
213:   );
214: }
