216: function Overview({ data, onSelect }: { data: NexusData; onSelect: (id: string) => void }) {
217:   const [q, setQ] = useState("");
218:   const total = data.sets.reduce((s, x) => s + x.count, 0);
219:   const needle = q.trim().toLowerCase();
220:   return (
221:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 14 }}>
222:       <div>
223:         <div className="eyebrow">Crosswalk Nexus</div>
224:         <h2 style={{ fontSize: 17, margin: "2px 0 6px" }}>Do the work once, see where it counts</h2>
225:         <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
226:           {total.toLocaleString()} unit-level mappings from {data.sets.length} sets connect {data.frameworks.length} frameworks. Pillars are requirement groups (height = number of units, color = status); overview arcs group mappings by framework (width = count). Select a pillar to trace its group-level connections.
227:         </p>
228:       </div>
229:       <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
230:         {data.sets.map((s) => (
231:           <div key={s.id} className="row" style={{ gap: 8, alignItems: "flex-start", fontSize: 12.5 }}>
232:             <span style={{ display: "flex", gap: 3, paddingTop: 4 }}>
233:               <Dot fw={s.source} />
234:               <Dot fw={s.target} />
235:             </span>
236:             <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
237:               <div>{s.title}</div>
238:               <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11.5 }}>
239:                 {authorityNote(s.authority)}
240:               </div>
241:             </div>
242:             <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
243:               {s.count.toLocaleString()}
244:             </span>
245:           </div>
246:         ))}
247:       </div>
248:       <div className="callout" role="note">
249:         <Info size={14} /> Mapping ≠ evidence. Visua uses mappings to suggest where existing work may help — as proposals you approve — never to mark a requirement met.
250:       </div>
251:       <div>
252:         <input className="input" placeholder="Find a group (e.g. PR.AA, CC6, AC)…" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} aria-label="Find a requirement group" />
253:         <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 2, marginTop: 8, maxHeight: 360, overflow: "auto" }} role="list" aria-label="Requirement groups">
254:           {data.frameworks.flatMap((f) =>
255:             f.groups
256:               .filter((g) => !needle || g.code.toLowerCase().includes(needle) || g.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle))
257:               .map((g) => (
258:                 <button key={g.id} role="listitem" className="xw-group" onClick={() => onSelect(g.id)}>
259:                   <Dot fw={f.id} />
260:                   <span className="mono" style={{ width: 64 }}>
261:                     {g.code}
262:                   </span>
263:                   <span style={{ flex: 1, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{g.title}</span>
264:                   {g.status && <StatusChip status={g.status} />}
265:                 </button>
266:               )),
267:           )}
268:           {(data.threats?.catalogs ?? []).flatMap((c) =>
269:             c.groups
270:               .filter((g) => !needle || g.code.toLowerCase().includes(needle) || g.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle))
271:               .map((g) => (
272:                 <button key={g.id} role="listitem" className="xw-group" onClick={() => onSelect(g.id)}>
273:                   <FrameworkBadge frameworkId={c.id} />
274:                   <span className="mono" style={{ width: 64, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis" }}>
275:                     {g.code}
276:                   </span>
277:                   <span style={{ flex: 1, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{g.title}</span>
278:                   <span style={{ width: 90 }}>
279:                     <CoverageBar byState={g.byState} height={6} />
280:                   </span>
281:                 </button>
282:               )),
283:           )}
284:         </div>
285:       </div>
286:       {data.threats && (
287:         <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
288:           <div className="eyebrow">Threat ring</div>
289:           <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12.5, margin: 0 }}>
290:             The inner ring holds MITRE ATLAS tactics, the OWASP LLM and Agentic Top 10 entries and NIST AI 100-2 objectives. Their arcs bundle published links to requirement groups; pillar
291:             color is coverage derived from those requirements.
292:           </p>
293:           <ThreatLinkFilter />
294:         </div>
295:       )}
296:     </div>
297:   );
298: }
299:
300: export function CrosswalkPage() {
301:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
302:   const workspace = useWorkspace(ws);
303:   const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
304:   const selected = params.get("group");
305:   const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<string | null>(null);
306:   const [hidden, setHidden] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
307:   const [showThreats, setShowThreats] = useState(true);
308:   const min = useUi((s) => s.threatMin);
309:   const { data, error } = useQuery({ queryKey: ["ws", ws, "crosswalk"], queryFn: () => api.get<NexusData>(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/crosswalk`) });
310:   const ring = useQuery({ queryKey: ["ws", ws, "crosswalk-threats", min], queryFn: () => api.get<ThreatRing>(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/crosswalk/threats?min=${min}`), placeholderData: keepPreviousData });
311:   const view = useMemo<NexusData | null>(() => {
312:     if (!data) return null;
313:     const frameworks = data.frameworks.filter((f) => !hidden.has(f.id));
314:     const visible = new Set(frameworks.flatMap((f) => f.groups.map((g) => g.id)));
315:     const threats = showThreats && ring.data ? { ...ring.data, bundles: ring.data.bundles.filter((b) => visible.has(b.b)) } : undefined;
316:     return { ...data, frameworks, bundles: data.bundles.filter((b) => visible.has(b.a) && visible.has(b.b)), threats };
317:   }, [data, hidden, ring.data, showThreats]);
318:   const isThreatGroup = (id: string | null) => !!id && !!view?.threats?.catalogs.some((c) => c.groups.some((g) => g.id === id));
319:   const select = (id: string | null) => {
320:     const next = new URLSearchParams(params);
321:     if (id) next.set("group", id);
322:     else next.delete("group");
323:     setParams(next, { replace: true });
324:   };
325:   const hoveredInfo = hovered && view ? [...view.frameworks, ...(view.threats?.catalogs ?? []).map((c) => ({ id: c.id, shortName: c.shortName, groups: c.groups }))].flatMap((f) => f.groups.map((g) => ({ f, g }))).find((x) => x.g.id === hovered) : null;
326:   const known = (id: string | null) => !!id && (view?.frameworks.some((f) => f.groups.some((g) => g.id === id)) || isThreatGroup(id));
327:   // A threat pillar under the pointer: its coverage by state and its strongest published link.
328:   const hoveredThreat = useMemo(() => {
329:     const g = hovered ? view?.threats?.catalogs.flatMap((c) => c.groups).find((x) => x.id === hovered) : undefined;
330:     if (!g) return null;
331:     const links = (view?.threats?.bundles ?? []).filter((b) => b.a === g.id);
332:     const rank: Record<LinkStatus, number> = { final: 3, draft: 2, unreviewed: 1, superseded: 0 };
333:     const best = links.reduce<LinkStatus | null>((w, b) => (w === null || rank[b.best] > rank[w] ? b.best : w), null);
334:     return { byState: g.byState, best, groups: new Set(links.map((b) => b.b)).size };
335:   }, [hovered, view]);
336:
337:   if (error) return <div className="page muted">Could not load the crosswalk: {(error as Error).message}</div>;
338:   if (!view || !workspace.data) return <div className="page muted">Loading the Nexus…</div>;
339:   if (!view.frameworks.length) return <div className="page"><Empty title="No frameworks to show" /></div>;
340:   return (
341:     <div className="observatory has-inspector nexus" data-stage-root>
342:       <div className="observatory__canvas" data-stage>
343:         <Suspense fallback={null}>
344:           <NexusCanvas data={view} selected={known(selected) ? selected : null} onSelect={select} hovered={hovered} onHover={setHovered} />
345:         </Suspense>
346:         <div className="hud hud--tl" data-hud>
347:           <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8, fontWeight: 600 }}>
348:             <GitCompareArrows size={15} /> Crosswalk Nexus
349:           </div>
350:           <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6, marginTop: 8 }}>
351:             {data!.frameworks.map((f) => (
352:               <button
353:                 key={f.id}
354:                 className="chip"
355:                 aria-pressed={!hidden.has(f.id)}
356:                 onClick={() => {
357:                   const next = new Set(hidden);
358:                   if (next.has(f.id)) next.delete(f.id);
359:                   else if (data!.frameworks.length - next.size > 2) next.add(f.id);
360:                   setHidden(next);
361:                 }}
362:               >
363:                 <Dot fw={f.id} /> {f.shortName}
364:               </button>
365:             ))}
366:             {ring.data && ring.data.catalogs.length > 0 && (
367:               <button className="chip" aria-pressed={showThreats} onClick={() => setShowThreats(!showThreats)} title="Inner ring: AI threat catalogs linked to requirement groups">
368:                 <span aria-hidden style={{ display: "inline-block", width: 9, height: 9, borderRadius: 99, boxShadow: "inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--color-on-surface-muted)" }} /> Threat ring
369:               </button>
370:             )}
371:           </div>
372:           <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginTop: 8 }}>
373:             {selected || hovered ? "Group connections · width shows mapping count" : "Framework connections · select a pillar to explore"}
374:           </div>
375:           {showThreats && ring.data && ring.data.catalogs.length > 0 && (
376:             <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 12, marginTop: 8, fontSize: 11.5 }} role="group" aria-label="Threat link status on arcs">
377:               <span className="muted">Threat links</span>
378:               {(["final", "draft", "unreviewed", "superseded"] as const).map((st) => (
379:                 <span key={st} className="row" style={{ gap: 5 }} title={LINK_STATUS_HELP[st]}>
380:                   <svg width="22" height="6" aria-hidden>
381:                     <line x1="1" y1="3" x2="21" y2="3" stroke="var(--color-on-surface-muted)" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray={st === "final" ? undefined : st === "draft" ? "6 3" : st === "unreviewed" ? "1 3" : "1 7"} />
382:                   </svg>
383:                   {LINK_STATUS_LABEL[st]}
384:                 </span>
385:               ))}
386:             </div>
387:           )}
388:         </div>
389:         {hoveredInfo && (
390:           <div className="hud hud--bl" role="status" data-hud style={{ maxWidth: 360 }}>
391:             <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
392:               <Dot fw={hoveredInfo.f.id} />
393:               <strong className="mono">{hoveredInfo.g.code}</strong>
394:               <span>{hoveredInfo.g.title}</span>
395:             </div>
396:             <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginTop: 4 }}>
397:               {hoveredInfo.f.shortName} · {hoveredInfo.g.units} {isThreatGroup(hovered) ? "threats" : "units"}
398:               {hoveredInfo.g.readiness !== null ? ` · ${Math.round(hoveredInfo.g.readiness * 100)}% ${isThreatGroup(hovered) ? "covered" : "ready"}` : ""} ·{" "}
399:               {[...view.bundles, ...(view.threats?.bundles ?? [])].filter((b) => b.a === hovered || b.b === hovered).reduce((s, b) => s + b.count, 0)} {isThreatGroup(hovered) ? "links" : "mappings"}
400:             </div>
401:             {hoveredThreat && (
402:               <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6, marginTop: 8 }}>
403:                 <CoverageBar byState={hoveredThreat.byState} height={6} />
404:                 <CoverageLegend byState={hoveredThreat.byState} />
405:                 {hoveredThreat.best && (
406:                   <div className="row" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 12 }}>
407:                     <span className="muted">Strongest link</span>
408:                     <LinkStatusBadge status={hoveredThreat.best} /> <span className="muted">· {hoveredThreat.groups} requirement group(s)</span>
409:                   </div>
410:                 )}
411:               </div>
412:             )}
413:           </div>
414:         )}
415:       </div>
416:       <aside className="inspector" aria-label="Crosswalk details" data-hud>
417:         <div className="inspector__body">
418:           {selected && isThreatGroup(selected) ? (
419:             <ThreatGroupDetail ws={ws} data={view} groupId={selected} onClose={() => select(null)} />
420:           ) : selected && view.frameworks.some((f) => f.groups.some((g) => g.id === selected)) ? (
421:             <GroupDetail ws={ws} data={view} groupId={selected} onClose={() => select(null)} />
422:           ) : (
423:             <Overview data={view} onSelect={select} />
424:           )}
425:         </div>
426:       </aside>
427:     </div>
428:   );
429: }

FILE apps/web/src/pages/EvidencePage.tsx SHA256 84ed14ecddfd305312c5d991b65e325e107abd406c9d81f089862ba40693edf6
1: /** Evidence & monitoring: provenance-first evidence ledger, connectors and checks. */
2: import { Check, Plug, Play, Plus, ShieldCheck, X } from "lucide-react";
3: import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
4: import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
5: import { useRunAgent } from "../components/inspector/Inspector.tsx";
6: import { CodeTag, Dialog, Empty, Metric, Segmented, toast } from "../components/ui/index.tsx";
7: import { api } from "../lib/api.ts";
8: import { useCan } from "../lib/auth.ts";
9: import { relativeTime, shortDate, truncate } from "../lib/format.ts";
10: import { useChecks, useConnectors, useEvidence, useMeta, useWsMutation } from "../lib/queries.ts";
11: import type { CheckResult, Evidence } from "../lib/types.ts";
12: import { split } from "../lib/media.ts";
13:
14: const OUTCOME_COLOR: Record<CheckResult["outcome"], string> = {
15:   pass: "var(--color-status-implemented)",
16:   warn: "var(--color-status-in-progress)",
17:   fail: "var(--color-status-at-risk)",
18:   error: "var(--color-status-at-risk)",
19: };
20:
21: function provenance(e: Evidence): { label: string; title: string } {
22:   if (e.source === "connector") return { label: "API-automated", title: "Collected by a monitoring connector; the raw observation and its SHA-256 hash are stored." };
23:   if (e.source === "agent") return { label: "Agent-assisted", title: "Proposed by an agent and approved by a person." };
24:   if (e.source === "upload") return { label: "Uploaded", title: "Uploaded by a person; content hash recorded." };
25:   return { label: "Manual", title: "Recorded manually." };
26: }
27:
28: function freshness(e: Evidence): { label: string; color: string } {
29:   if (e.status === "rejected") return { label: "rejected", color: "var(--color-on-surface-muted)" };
30:   if (e.status === "pending-review") return { label: "pending review", color: "var(--color-tertiary)" };
31:   if (!e.validUntil) return { label: "no expiry", color: "var(--color-status-verified)" };
32:   const days = (new Date(e.validUntil).getTime() - Date.now()) / 86_400_000;
33:   if (days < 0) return { label: `expired ${shortDate(e.validUntil)}`, color: "var(--color-status-at-risk)" };
34:   if (days < 30) return { label: `expires ${relativeTime(e.validUntil)}`, color: "var(--color-status-in-progress)" };
35:   return { label: `valid to ${shortDate(e.validUntil)}`, color: "var(--color-status-verified)" };
36: }
37:
38: function AddConnector({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
39:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
40:   const meta = useMeta();
41:   const kinds = meta.data?.connectorKinds ?? [];
42:   const [kind, setKind] = useState(kinds[0]?.kind ?? "web-posture");
43:   const [name, setName] = useState("");
44:   const [config, setConfig] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
45:   const def = kinds.find((k) => k.kind === kind);
46:   const create = useWsMutation(ws, () => api.post(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/connectors`, { kind, name: name || undefined, config }));
47:   return (
48:     <Dialog
49:       title="Add a monitoring connector"
50:       onClose={onClose}
51:       footer={
52:         <>
53:           <button className="btn" onClick={onClose}>
54:             Cancel
55:           </button>
56:           <button className="btn btn--primary" onClick={() => create.mutate(undefined, { onSuccess: () => (toast("Connector added"), onClose()), onError: (e) => toast((e as Error).message, "error") })}>
57:             Add connector
58:           </button>
59:         </>
60:       }
61:     >
62:       <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
63:         <div className="field">
64:           <label>Connector</label>
65:           <select className="select" value={kind} onChange={(e) => setKind(e.target.value)}>
66:             {kinds.map((k) => (
67:               <option key={k.kind} value={k.kind}>
68:                 {k.name}
69:               </option>
70:             ))}
71:           </select>
72:           <span className="field__hint">{def?.description}</span>
73:         </div>
74:         <div className="field">
75:           <label>Display name</label>
76:           <input className="input" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder={def?.name} />
77:         </div>
78:         {def?.configFields.map((f) => (
79:           <div key={f.key} className="field">
80:             <label>{f.label}</label>
81:             <input className="input" placeholder={f.placeholder} value={config[f.key] ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setConfig({ ...config, [f.key]: e.target.value })} />
82:           </div>
83:         ))}
84:         <span className="field__hint">Automation depth: API-automated. Every check stores its raw observation, timestamp and a SHA-256 hash.</span>
85:       </div>
86:     </Dialog>
87:   );
88: }
89:
90: export function EvidencePage() {
91:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
92:   const { data: evidence = [] } = useEvidence(ws);
93:   const { data: connectors = [] } = useConnectors(ws);
94:   const { data: checks = [] } = useChecks(ws);
95:   const run = useRunAgent();
96:   const [filter, setFilter] = useState<"all" | "pending" | "expiring" | "connector">("all");
97:   const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
98:   const [viewing, setViewing] = useState<Evidence | null>(null);
99:   const review = useWsMutation(ws, (v: { id: string; decision: "accepted" | "rejected" }) => api.patch(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/evidence/${v.id}`, { decision: v.decision }));
100:   const canReview = useCan("work.approve");
101:   const runConnector = useWsMutation(ws, (id: string) => api.post<CheckResult[]>(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/connectors/${id}/run`));
102:   const list = useMemo(() => {
103:     const now = Date.now();
104:     return evidence
105:       .filter((e) => {
106:         if (filter === "pending") return e.status === "pending-review";
107:         if (filter === "connector") return e.source === "connector";
108:         if (filter === "expiring") return !!e.validUntil && new Date(e.validUntil).getTime() - now < 30 * 86_400_000;
109:         return true;
110:       })
111:       .sort((a, b) => b.collectedAt.localeCompare(a.collectedAt));
112:   }, [evidence, filter]);
113:   const latestChecks = useMemo(() => {
114:     const seen = new Set<string>();
115:     return checks.filter((c) => {
116:       const key = `${c.connectorId}|${c.checkId}`;
117:       if (seen.has(key)) return false;
118:       seen.add(key);
119:       return true;
120:     });
121:   }, [checks]);
122:   const accepted = evidence.filter((e) => e.status === "accepted").length;
123:   const expired = evidence.filter((e) => e.validUntil && new Date(e.validUntil).getTime() < Date.now()).length;
124:   return (
125:     <div className="page">
126:       <header className="page__header">
127:         <div>
128:           <div className="eyebrow">Evidence & monitoring</div>
129:           <h1>Evidence ledger</h1>
130:           <p>Evidence must show what is actually in place. Every item records where it came from, when, who reviewed it, and a content hash. Agents cannot file plans or drafts as evidence.</p>
131:         </div>
132:         <div className="page__actions">
133:           <button className="btn btn--agent" onClick={() => run("evidence-collector", "Run monitoring checks and find implemented requirements without evidence", {})}>
134:             Collect with agent
135:           </button>
136:           <button className="btn" onClick={() => setAdding(true)}>
137:             <Plug size={14} /> Add connector
138:           </button>
139:         </div>
140:       </header>
141:       <div className="grid grid--4" style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
142:         <Metric label="Evidence items" value={evidence.length} sub={`${accepted} accepted`} />
143:         <Metric label="Awaiting review" value={evidence.filter((e) => e.status === "pending-review").length} />
144:         <Metric label="Expired" value={expired} sub="Expired evidence puts requirements at risk" />
145:         <Metric label="Connectors" value={connectors.length} sub={`${latestChecks.filter((c) => c.outcome === "pass").length}/${latestChecks.length} checks passing`} />
146:       </div>
147:       <div className="grid split" style={split(1.7, 1)}>
148:         <div className="panel" style={{ padding: 0, overflow: "hidden" }}>
149:           <div className="row" style={{ padding: 12, gap: 8 }}>
150:             <Segmented
151:               label="Filter evidence"
152:               value={filter}
153:               onChange={setFilter}
154:               options={[
155:                 { id: "all", label: "All" },
156:                 { id: "pending", label: "Pending review" },
157:                 { id: "expiring", label: "Expiring / expired" },
158:                 { id: "connector", label: "Automated" },
159:               ]}
160:             />
161:           </div>
162:           <div style={{ overflow: "auto", maxHeight: "calc(100vh - 360px)" }}>
163:             <table className="table table--evidence">
164:               <thead>
165:                 <tr>
166:                   <th>Evidence</th>
167:                   <th>Provenance</th>
168:                   <th>Requirements</th>
169:                   <th>Freshness</th>
170:                   <th />
171:                 </tr>
172:               </thead>
173:               <tbody>
174:                 {list.map((e) => {
175:                   const p = provenance(e);
176:                   const f = freshness(e);
177:                   return (
178:                     <tr key={e.id}>
179:                       <td style={{ maxWidth: 320 }}>
180:                         <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" style={{ padding: 0, height: "auto", color: "var(--color-on-surface)", textAlign: "left", whiteSpace: "normal" }} onClick={() => setViewing(e)}>
181:                           {truncate(e.title, 90)}
182:                         </button>
183:                         <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11.5 }}>
184:                           {e.kind} · collected {relativeTime(e.collectedAt)}
185:                         </div>
186:                       </td>
187:                       <td>
188:                         <span className="chip" style={{ cursor: "help" }} title={p.title}>
189:                           {p.label}
190:                         </span>
191:                         {e.sha256 && (
192:                           <div className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 10.5, marginTop: 4 }} title={e.sha256}>
193:                             sha256 {e.sha256.slice(0, 12)}…
194:                           </div>
195:                         )}
196:                       </td>
197:                       <td>
198:                         <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
199:                           {e.requirementIds.slice(0, 4).map((id) => (
200:                             <CodeTag key={id} id={id} />
201:                           ))}
202:                           {e.requirementIds.length > 4 ? <span className="muted">+{e.requirementIds.length - 4}</span> : null}
203:                         </div>
204:                       </td>
205:                       <td style={{ color: f.color, fontSize: 12.5, whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{f.label}</td>
206:                       <td style={{ whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
207:                         {e.status === "pending-review" && canReview && (
208:                           <>
209:                             <button className="btn btn--sm btn--icon" title="Accept" onClick={() => review.mutate({ id: e.id, decision: "accepted" })}>
210:                               <Check size={13} />
211:                             </button>{" "}
212:                             <button className="btn btn--sm btn--icon" title="Reject" onClick={() => review.mutate({ id: e.id, decision: "rejected" })}>
213:                               <X size={13} />
214:                             </button>
215:                           </>
216:                         )}
217:                       </td>
218:                     </tr>
219:                   );
220:                 })}
221:               </tbody>
222:             </table>
223:             {!list.length && (
224:               <div style={{ padding: 16 }}>
225:                 <Empty title="Nothing here" />
226:               </div>
227:             )}
228:           </div>
229:         </div>
230:         <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
231:           {connectors.map((c) => {
232:             const results = latestChecks.filter((r) => r.connectorId === c.id);
233:             return (
234:               <div key={c.id} className="panel">
235:                 <div className="panel__head">
236:                   <ShieldCheck size={16} />
237:                   <h3>{c.name}</h3>
238:                   <span className="spacer" />
239:                   <button
240:                     className="btn btn--sm"
241:                     disabled={runConnector.isPending}
242:                     onClick={() =>
243:                       runConnector.mutate(c.id, {
244:                         onSuccess: (r) => toast(`${c.name}: ${r.filter((x) => x.outcome === "pass").length}/${r.length} checks passing`),
245:                         onError: (e) => toast((e as Error).message, "error"),
246:                       })
247:                     }
248:                   >
249:                     <Play size={12} /> Run
250:                   </button>
251:                 </div>
252:                 <div className="muted wrap-anywhere" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 10 }}>
253:                   {c.kind} · {Object.values(c.config).map(String).join(" ")} · {c.lastRunAt ? `last run ${relativeTime(c.lastRunAt)}` : "never run"}
254:                 </div>
255:                 <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
256:                   {results.map((r) => (
257:                     <div key={r.id} className="row" style={{ alignItems: "flex-start", gap: 8, fontSize: 13 }}>
258:                       <span className="mono" style={{ color: OUTCOME_COLOR[r.outcome], width: 38, flexShrink: 0, fontSize: 11, textTransform: "uppercase" }}>
259:                         {r.outcome}
260:                       </span>
261:                       <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
262:                         <div>{r.title}</div>
263:                         <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
264:                           {truncate(r.detail, 140)}
265:                         </div>
266:                       </div>
267:                     </div>
268:                   ))}
269:                   {!results.length && <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>Run the connector to collect its first results.</div>}
270:                 </div>
271:               </div>
272:             );
273:           })}
274:           {!connectors.length && (
275:             <Empty title="No connectors yet">
276:               <button className="btn btn--sm" onClick={() => setAdding(true)} style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
277:                 <Plus size={13} /> Add a connector
278:               </button>
279:             </Empty>
280:           )}
281:         </div>
282:       </div>
283:       {adding && <AddConnector onClose={() => setAdding(false)} />}
284:       {viewing && (
285:         <Dialog wide title={viewing.title} onClose={() => setViewing(null)}>
286:           <dl className="kv" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
287:             <dt>Provenance</dt>
288:             <dd>
289:               {provenance(viewing).label} · {viewing.source}
290:               {viewing.connectorId ? ` · connector ${viewing.connectorId}` : ""}
291:             </dd>
292:             <dt>Status</dt>
293:             <dd>
294:               {viewing.status}
295:               {viewing.reviewedBy ? ` by ${viewing.reviewedBy} ${relativeTime(viewing.reviewedAt)}` : ""}
296:             </dd>
297:             <dt>Collected</dt>
298:             <dd>{new Date(viewing.collectedAt).toLocaleString()}</dd>
299:             <dt>Valid until</dt>
300:             <dd>{viewing.validUntil ? new Date(viewing.validUntil).toLocaleString() : "—"}</dd>
301:             <dt>SHA-256</dt>
302:             <dd className="mono" style={{ wordBreak: "break-all", fontSize: 12 }}>
303:               {viewing.sha256 ?? "—"}
304:             </dd>
305:           </dl>
306:           {viewing.content && <pre className="panel mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", fontSize: 12, maxHeight: 320, overflow: "auto" }}>{viewing.content}</pre>}
307:           {viewing.data && <pre className="panel mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "pre-wrap", fontSize: 11.5, maxHeight: 260, overflow: "auto", marginTop: 8 }}>{JSON.stringify(viewing.data, null, 2)}</pre>}
308:         </Dialog>
309:       )}
310:     </div>
311:   );
312: }

FILE apps/web/src/pages/HomePage.tsx SHA256 2c0352aeaea70c5f027e63b4c2e35a91d55a28476bb5d0ee9284b8e35a1b3067
1: /** Overview: where the program stands and what to do next. */
2: import { ArrowRight, Bot, ShieldCheck, Telescope } from "lucide-react";
3: import { useMemo } from "react";
4: import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
5: import type { Recommendation } from "@visua/core";
6: import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
7: import { useRunAgent } from "../components/inspector/Inspector.tsx";
8: import { AgentBadge, CodeTag, FrameworkBadge, Metric, StatusBar } from "../components/ui/index.tsx";
9: import { api } from "../lib/api.ts";
10: import { pct, relativeTime, truncate } from "../lib/format.ts";
11: import { frameworkMeta, programPath } from "../lib/frameworks.ts";
12: import { useActivity, useAuditVerification, useFrameworkState, useGraph, useProposals, useRuns, useWorkspace } from "../lib/queries.ts";
13: import { split } from "../lib/media.ts";
14:
15: const PRIORITY_WEIGHT = { critical: 4, high: 3, medium: 2, low: 1 } as const;
16:
17: function NextBestActions({ ws, frameworkId }: { ws: string; frameworkId: string }) {
18:   const graph = useGraph(frameworkId);
19:   const state = useFrameworkState(ws, frameworkId);
20:   const run = useRunAgent();
21:   const items = useMemo(() => {
22:     if (!graph.data || !state.data) return [];
23:     return graph.data.nodes
24:       .filter((n) => n.assessable)
25:       .map((n) => ({ n, u: state.data!.units[n.id] }))
26:       .filter((x) => x.u && x.u.applicable && x.u.target > x.u.current)
27:       .sort((a, b) => PRIORITY_WEIGHT[b.u!.priority] * (b.u!.target - b.u!.current) - PRIORITY_WEIGHT[a.u!.priority] * (a.u!.target - a.u!.current) || (a.u!.openTasks - b.u!.openTasks))
28:       .slice(0, 6);
29:   }, [graph.data, state.data]);
30:   return (
31:     <div className="panel home__actions-panel">
32:       <div className="panel__head">
33:         <div>
34:           <div className="eyebrow">Where to focus</div>
35:           <h2>Next best actions</h2>
36:         </div>
37:         <span className="spacer" />
38:         <button className="btn btn--agent btn--sm" onClick={() => run("planner", "Plan the next sprint of work for our highest-priority gaps", { framework: frameworkId })}>
39:           <Bot size={13} /> Plan with agent
40:         </button>
41:       </div>
42:       <div className="home__action-list">
43:         {items.map(({ n, u }) => (
44:           <div key={n.id} className="home__action-row">
45:             <CodeTag id={n.id} />
46:             <div className="home__action-copy">
47:               <div>{truncate(n.text, 140)}</div>
48:               <div className="muted home__action-meta">
49:                 {u!.priority} priority · level {u!.current} → {u!.target}
50:                 {u!.openTasks ? ` · ${u!.openTasks} open task(s)` : " · no task yet"}
51:               </div>
52:             </div>
53:             <Link className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" aria-label={`Open ${n.id} in the Observatory`} to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${frameworkId}?select=${encodeURIComponent(n.id)}`}>
54:               Open <ArrowRight size={13} />
55:             </Link>
56:           </div>
57:         ))}
58:         {!items.length && <div className="muted">Every in-scope requirement meets its target. Consider raising targets or adding a framework.</div>}
59:       </div>
60:     </div>
61:   );
62: }
63:
64: export function HomePage() {
65:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
66:   const { data } = useWorkspace(ws);
67:   const runs = useRuns(ws);
68:   const pending = useProposals(ws, "pending");
69:   const activity = useActivity(ws, 12);
70:   const audit = useAuditVerification(ws);
71:   const rec = useQuery({ queryKey: ["ws", ws, "recommendation"], queryFn: () => api.get<Recommendation>(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/recommendation`), enabled: !!ws });
72:   if (!data) {
73:     return (
74:       <div className="page home home__loading" aria-busy="true">
75:         <span className="sr-only">Loading workspace overview</span>
76:         <div className="skeleton skeleton--title" />
77:         <div className="grid grid--4">
78:           {Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => <div className="skeleton skeleton--metric" key={i} />)}
79:         </div>
80:         <div className="skeleton skeleton--content" />
81:       </div>
82:     );
83:   }
84:   const primary = data.frameworks[0];
85:   const p = data.workspace.profile;
86:   return (
87:     <div className="page home">
88:       <header className="page__header home__hero">

FILE apps/web/src/pages/LawsPage.tsx SHA256 8f098b4b0d0bbca812005241b0038de6d07bb7835ca86910929d11565d696fae
1: /**
2:  * U.S. state AI laws: which laws apply to the organization and in what role,
3:  * when their obligations take effect, and progress on the obligations in
4:  * scope. Obligation text is the statute's own; nothing here is legal advice.
5:  */
6: import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";

16:
17: const LAWS = "us-state-ai-laws";
18: const enc = encodeURIComponent;
19:
20: interface LawRole {
21:   role: string;
22:   obligations: number;
23:   definition?: string;
24: }
25: interface Law {
26:   id: string;
27:   lawId: string;
28:   code: string;
29:   title: string;
30:   citation: { documentId: string; locator?: string };
31:   summary: string;
32:   status: string;
33:   statusNote?: string;
34:   enacted?: string;
35:   effective?: string;
36:   sunset?: string;
37:   enforcement?: { authority?: string; penalties?: string; privateRight?: string };
38:   safeHarbors: { text: string; section: string; references?: string[]; note?: string }[];
39:   roles: LawRole[];
40:   applicability: { roles: string[]; note?: string; decidedAt: string; decidedBy: string } | null;
41:   obligations: number;
42:   inScope: number;
43:   /** In scope and in force today. */
44:   inForce: number;
45:   readiness: number;
46:   gaps: number;
47:   counts?: Record<Status, number>;
48:   status_: Status | null;
49:   upcoming: string | null;
50:   /** In scope but not in effect yet: prepared share, not counted in readiness. */
51:   upcomingInScope: { total: number; readiness: number; next: string | null };
52: }
53: interface LawsOverview {
54:   enabled: boolean;
55:   /** Obligations in force today and in scope. */
56:   readiness: number;
57:   gaps: number;
58:   total: number;
59:   upcoming: { total: number; readiness: number; gaps: number };
60:   obligations: number;
61:   laws: number;
62:   jurisdictions: { id: string; code: string; name: string; laws: Law[] }[];
63:   timeline: { date: string; lawCode: string; lawId: string; label: string; obligations: number; past: boolean }[];
64:   today: string;
65: }
66: interface Obligation {
67:   id: string;
68:   code: string;
69:   title: string;
70:   text: string;
71:   meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
72: }

74: const roleLabel = (r: string) => r.replace(/-/g, " ");
75:
76: function Obligations({ ws, law }: { ws: string; law: Law }) {
77:   const graph = useQuery({ queryKey: keys.graph(LAWS), queryFn: () => api.get<{ nodes: (Obligation & { parentId: string | null })[] }>(`/frameworks/${LAWS}`), staleTime: Infinity });
78:   const state = useQuery({
79:     queryKey: keys.state(ws, LAWS),
80:     queryFn: () => api.get<{ units: Record<string, { applicable: boolean; status: Status; current: number; target: number; upcoming?: string }> }>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws)}/frameworks/${LAWS}/state`),
81:   });
82:   const rows = (graph.data?.nodes ?? []).filter((n) => n.parentId === law.id);
83:   return (
84:     <table className="table table--obligations" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
85:       <thead>
86:         <tr>
87:           <th style={{ width: 150 }}>Obligation</th>
88:           <th>Summary</th>
89:           <th style={{ width: 150 }}>Applies to</th>
90:           <th style={{ width: 110 }}>Effective</th>
91:           <th style={{ width: 140 }}>Status</th>
92:         </tr>
93:       </thead>
94:       <tbody>
95:         {rows.map((o) => {
96:           const u = state.data?.units[o.id];
97:           const meta = o.meta ?? {};
98:           return (
99:             <tr key={o.id} title={o.text}>
100:               <td>
101:                 <Link to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${LAWS}?select=${enc(o.id)}`} className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-primary)" }}>
102:                   {o.code}
103:                 </Link>
104:               </td>
105:               <td>{o.title}</td>
106:               <td className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
107:                 {String(meta["role"] ?? "")}
108:               </td>
109:               <td className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
110:                 {String(meta["effective"] ?? law.effective ?? "—")}
111:               </td>
112:               <td>
113:                 {u ? (
114:                   <span className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
115:                     <StatusChip status={u.applicable ? u.status : "not-applicable"} />
116:                     {u.applicable && u.upcoming ? (
117:                       <span className="chip" style={{ cursor: "default", height: 22 }} title={`Takes effect ${u.upcoming}: not counted in today's readiness`}>
118:                         ○ upcoming
119:                       </span>
120:                     ) : null}
121:                   </span>
122:                 ) : null}
123:               </td>
124:             </tr>
125:           );
126:         })}
127:       </tbody>
128:     </table>
129:   );
130: }

132: /** Laws the organization has not decided on stay one line until opened. */
133: function LawRow({ ws, law }: { ws: string; law: Law }) {
134:   const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(!!law.applicability);
135:   if (expanded) return <LawCard ws={ws} law={law} onCollapse={law.applicability ? undefined : () => setExpanded(false)} />;
136:   return (
137:     <button type="button" className="panel row row--wrap law-row" style={{ gap: 8 }} onClick={() => setExpanded(true)} aria-expanded={false}>
138:       <ChevronRight size={14} aria-hidden className="muted" />
139:       <span className="badge-fw badge-fw--law">{law.code}</span>
140:       <strong style={{ textAlign: "left" }}>{law.title}</strong>
141:       <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
142:       <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
143:         {law.status}
144:         {law.effective ? ` · ${law.effective}` : ""} · {law.obligations} obligations · roles: {law.roles.map((r) => roleLabel(r.role)).join(", ") || "—"}
145:       </span>
146:       <span className="chip" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
147:         Not decided
148:       </span>
149:     </button>
150:   );
151: }

153: function LawCard({ ws, law, onCollapse }: { ws: string; law: Law; onCollapse?: () => void }) {
154:   const qc = useQueryClient();
155:   const canDecide = useCan("work.approve");
156:   const [roles, setRoles] = useState<string[] | null>(null);
157:   const [note, setNote] = useState<string | null>(null);
158:   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
159:   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
160:   const chosen = roles ?? law.applicability?.roles ?? [];
161:   const dirty = roles !== null || note !== null;
162:   const toggle = (r: string) => setRoles(chosen.includes(r) ? chosen.filter((x) => x !== r) : [...chosen, r]);
163:   const save = async () => {
164:     setBusy(true);
165:     try {
166:       await api.put(`/workspaces/${enc(ws)}/laws/${enc(law.lawId)}/applicability`, { roles: chosen, note: note ?? law.applicability?.note });
167:       toast(chosen.length ? `${law.code}: applicability recorded` : `${law.code} marked as not applying`);
168:       setRoles(null);
169:       setNote(null);
170:       await qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["ws", ws] });
171:     } catch (err) {
172:       toast((err as Error).message, "error");
173:     } finally {
174:       setBusy(false);
175:     }
176:   };
177:   const inForce = law.status.toLowerCase().startsWith("in force");
178:   const aiRmfHarbor = law.safeHarbors.some((h) => (h.references ?? []).some((r) => /AI 600-1|AI RMF|AI 100-1/i.test(r)) || /Risk Management Framework/i.test(h.text));
179:   return (
180:     <article className="panel stack" style={{ gap: 12 }} aria-labelledby={`law-${law.lawId}`}>
181:       <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
182:         {onCollapse && (
183:           <button type="button" className="btn btn--quiet btn--icon btn--sm" onClick={onCollapse} aria-label={`Collapse ${law.code}`} aria-expanded>
184:             <ChevronDown size={14} aria-hidden />
185:           </button>
186:         )}
187:         <span className="badge-fw badge-fw--law">{law.code}</span>
188:         <h3 id={`law-${law.lawId}`} style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 16 }}>
189:           {law.title}
190:         </h3>
191:         <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
192:         <span className="role-badge" title={law.statusNote}>
193:           <Gavel size={11} aria-hidden /> {law.status}
194:           {law.effective ? ` · ${inForce ? "since" : "from"} ${law.effective}` : ""}
195:           {law.sunset ? ` · sunsets ${law.sunset}` : ""}
196:         </span>
197:       </div>
198:       <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
199:         {law.citation.locator}
200:       </div>
201:       <fieldset disabled={!canDecide || busy} style={{ border: 0, padding: 0, margin: 0, minWidth: 0 }}>
202:         <legend className="eyebrow" style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
203:           Applies to us as
204:         </legend>
205:         <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
206:           {law.roles.map((r) => (
207:             <label key={r.role} className="chip" aria-pressed={chosen.includes(r.role)} title={r.definition ?? `${r.obligations} obligation(s) apply to this role`} style={{ cursor: canDecide ? "pointer" : "default" }}>
208:               <input type="checkbox" checked={chosen.includes(r.role)} onChange={() => toggle(r.role)} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} />
209:               {roleLabel(r.role)}
210:               <span className="muted" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
211:                 {r.obligations}
212:               </span>
213:             </label>
214:           ))}
215:         </div>
216:         <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
217:           <input className="input" style={{ flex: "1 1 260px" }} placeholder="Basis for this decision (e.g. which of our products or activities it covers, and where)" value={note ?? law.applicability?.note ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} aria-label={`Basis for ${law.code} applicability`} />
218:           {canDecide && (
219:             <button className="btn btn--primary" disabled={!dirty || busy} onClick={() => void save()}>
220:               {chosen.length ? "Record applicability" : "Record: does not apply"}
221:             </button>
222:           )}
223:         </div>
224:         {law.applicability && (
225:           <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11.5, marginTop: 4 }}>
226:             Decided {law.applicability.decidedAt.slice(0, 10)} by {law.applicability.decidedBy}
227:           </div>
228:         )}
229:       </fieldset>
230:       <div className="row row--wrap law-card__score" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
231:         <div style={{ minWidth: 150 }}>
232:           <span className="mono">{law.inForce}</span> <span className="muted">in force · {law.inScope} of {law.obligations} in scope</span>
233:         </div>
234:         <div style={{ flex: "1 1 160px" }}>{law.counts && law.inForce ? <StatusBar counts={law.counts} height={6} /> : <Progress value={0} />}</div>
235:         <span className="mono" style={{ width: 44, textAlign: "right" }} title="Readiness of the obligations in force today">
236:           {law.inForce ? `${Math.round(law.readiness * 100)}%` : "—"}
237:         </span>
238:         <span className="muted" style={{ width: 70 }}>
239:           {law.gaps} gaps
240:         </span>
241:         {law.status_ && law.inForce > 0 && <StatusChip status={law.status_} />}
242:       </div>
243:       {law.upcomingInScope.total > 0 ? (
244:         <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
245:           ○ {law.upcomingInScope.total} obligation{law.upcomingInScope.total === 1 ? "" : "s"} in scope take{law.upcomingInScope.total === 1 ? "s" : ""} effect from <strong>{law.upcomingInScope.next}</strong>: {Math.round(law.upcomingInScope.readiness * 100)}% prepared, not counted in today's readiness.
246:         </div>
247:       ) : law.upcoming ? (
248:         <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
249:           Next obligations take effect on <strong>{law.upcoming}</strong>.
250:         </div>
251:       ) : null}
252:       {law.safeHarbors.length > 0 && (
253:         <details>
254:           <summary className="eyebrow" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
255:             Safe harbors and defenses ({law.safeHarbors.length})
256:           </summary>
257:           <ul className="stack" style={{ gap: 8, paddingLeft: 18, marginTop: 8 }}>
258:             {law.safeHarbors.map((h) => (
259:               <li key={h.section} style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
260:                 <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 11.5 }}>
261:                   {h.section}
262:                 </span>{" "}
263:                 {h.text}
264:                 {h.note ? <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>{h.note}</div> : null}
265:               </li>
266:             ))}
267:           </ul>
268:           {aiRmfHarbor && (
269:             <p style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
270:               This law recognizes the NIST AI RMF or its Generative AI Profile. <Link to={`/w/${ws}/ai`}>See your AI RMF readiness →</Link>
271:             </p>
272:           )}
273:         </details>
274:       )}
275:       {law.enforcement && (law.enforcement.authority || law.enforcement.penalties) && (
276:         <details>
277:           <summary className="eyebrow" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
278:             Enforcement
279:           </summary>
280:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 13, marginTop: 8 }}>
281:             {law.enforcement.authority && <p style={{ margin: 0 }}>{law.enforcement.authority}</p>}
282:             {law.enforcement.penalties && <p className="muted" style={{ margin: 0 }}>{law.enforcement.penalties}</p>}
283:           </div>
284:         </details>
285:       )}
286:       <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
287:         <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} aria-expanded={open}>
288:           {open ? <ChevronDown size={14} aria-hidden /> : <ChevronRight size={14} aria-hidden />} {law.obligations} obligations
289:         </button>
290:         <Link className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${LAWS}?select=${enc(law.id)}`}>
291:           <Telescope size={14} aria-hidden /> In 3D
292:         </Link>
293:       </div>
294:       {open && <Obligations ws={ws} law={law} />}
295:     </article>
296:   );
297: }

299: export function LawsPage() {
300:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
301:   const qc = useQueryClient();
302:   const workspace = useWorkspace(ws);
303:   const canConfigure = useCan("workspace.configure");
304:   const enabled = !!workspace.data?.frameworks.some((f) => f.id === LAWS);
305:   const overview = useQuery({ queryKey: [...keys.workspace(ws), "laws"], queryFn: () => api.get<LawsOverview>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws)}/laws`), enabled: !!ws });
306:   const [filter, setFilter] = useState("");
307:   const data = overview.data;
308:   const jurisdictions = useMemo(
309:     () =>
310:       (data?.jurisdictions ?? [])
311:         .map((j) => ({ ...j, laws: j.laws.filter((l) => !filter || `${l.code} ${l.title} ${j.name}`.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase())) }))
312:         .filter((j) => j.laws.length),
313:     [data, filter],
314:   );
315:   if (overview.isError) return <div className="page muted">{(overview.error as Error).message}</div>;
316:   if (!data) return <div className="page muted">Loading…</div>;
317:   const enable = async () => {
318:     try {
319:       await api.put(`/workspaces/${enc(ws)}/frameworks/${LAWS}`, { enabled: true });
320:       toast("U.S. state AI laws enabled — record which laws apply to you");
321:       await qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["ws", ws] });
322:       await qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.workspaces });
323:     } catch (err) {
324:       toast((err as Error).message, "error");
325:     }
326:   };
327:   return (
328:     <div className="page">
329:       <header className="page__header">
330:         <div>
331:           <div className="eyebrow">AI laws · United States</div>
332:           <h1>
333:             State AI laws{enabled && data.total ? ` · ${Math.round(data.readiness * 100)}% of obligations in force` : ""}
334:           </h1>
335:           {enabled && data.upcoming.total > 0 && (
336:             <p className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
337:               ○ {data.upcoming.total} more obligation{data.upcoming.total === 1 ? "" : "s"} in scope take effect later: {Math.round(data.upcoming.readiness * 100)}% prepared.
338:             </p>
339:           )}
340:           <p>
341:             {data.laws} laws and regulations, {data.obligations} obligations quoted from the statutes and adopted regulations. Record the role you hold under each law —
342:             developer, deployer, employer, operator… as the law defines it — and Visua scopes its obligations. This is a tracking tool, not legal advice.
343:           </p>
344:         </div>
345:         <div className="page__actions">
346:           {!enabled && canConfigure && (
347:             <button className="btn btn--primary" onClick={() => void enable()}>
348:               <Scale size={14} aria-hidden /> Track state AI laws
349:             </button>
350:           )}
351:           {enabled && (
352:             <Link className="btn btn--primary" to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${LAWS}`}>
353:               <Telescope size={14} aria-hidden /> Obligations in 3D
354:             </Link>
355:           )}
356:         </div>
357:       </header>
358:       {!enabled && (
359:         <Empty title="Not tracked in this workspace">
360:           {canConfigure ? "Turn on tracking to record which laws apply and follow their obligations." : "Ask an admin to turn on tracking of U.S. state AI laws."}
361:         </Empty>
362:       )}
363:       <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
364:         <LawTimeline timeline={data.timeline} today={data.today} />
365:         <input className="input" placeholder="Filter laws (state, code, title)" value={filter} onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)} aria-label="Filter laws" style={{ maxWidth: 420 }} />
366:         {jurisdictions.map((j) => (
367:           <section key={j.id} className="stack" style={{ gap: 12 }} aria-labelledby={`j-${j.code}`}>
368:             <h2 id={`j-${j.code}`} className="section-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
369:               {j.name} <span className="muted">· {j.laws.length}</span>
370:             </h2>
371:             {j.laws.map((l) => (enabled ? <LawRow key={l.id} ws={ws} law={l} /> : <LawSummary key={l.id} law={l} />))}
372:           </section>
373:         ))}
374:         <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
375:           Sources: enrolled bills, codified statutes and adopted regulations from the state legislatures and agencies, stored in the local corpus with checksums. Titles, role
376:           labels and suggested evidence are Visua summaries. Laws change — check each law's status and dates, and consult counsel.
377:         </p>
378:       </div>
379:     </div>
380:   );
381: }
382:
383: function LawSummary({ law }: { law: Law }) {
384:   return (
385:     <div className="panel row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
386:       <span className="badge-fw badge-fw--law">{law.code}</span>
387:       <strong>{law.title}</strong>
388:       <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
389:       <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
390:         {law.status}
391:         {law.effective ? ` · ${law.effective}` : ""} · {law.obligations} obligations
392:       </span>
393:     </div>
394:   );
395: }

FILE apps/web/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx SHA256 93e347f2a3715b84ddd695cc4033ff29f7e1f0d2e3ce9d6adebc937f691f3dd8
1: /**
2:  * Sign-in. Organizations with their own identity provider are found from the
3:  * email domain; a platform identity provider may also be offered. Developer
4:  * mode (local use and demos only) adds one-click personas.
5:  */
6: import { ArrowRight, KeyRound, ShieldAlert, UserRound } from "lucide-react";
7: import { useState } from "react";
8: import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
9: import { Logo, Toasts } from "../components/ui/index.tsx";
10: import { api, ApiError, setCsrfToken } from "../lib/api.ts";
11: import { ROLE_NAMES, useAuthConfig, useResetSession, type Me } from "../lib/auth.ts";
12:
13: const safe = (to: string | null) => (to && to.startsWith("/") && !to.startsWith("//") ? to : "/");
14: const startUrl = (connection: string, returnTo: string) => `/api/auth/oidc/start?connection=${encodeURIComponent(connection)}&returnTo=${encodeURIComponent(returnTo)}`;
15:
16: export function LoginPage() {
17:   const [params] = useSearchParams();
18:   const returnTo = safe(params.get("returnTo"));
19:   const config = useAuthConfig();
20:   const reset = useResetSession();
21:   const navigate = useNavigate();
22:   const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
23:   const [devEmail, setDevEmail] = useState("");
24:   const [devName, setDevName] = useState("");
25:   const [error, setError] = useState(params.get("error") ?? "");
26:   const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
27:
28:   const continueWithSso = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
29:     e.preventDefault();
30:     setError("");
31:     setBusy(true);
32:     try {
33:       const found = await api.post<{ connection: string }>("/auth/sso/discover", { email });
34:       window.location.assign(startUrl(found.connection, returnTo));
35:     } catch (err) {
36:       setError(err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 404 ? "There is no single sign-on for this address. Ask your administrator how your organization signs in to Visua." : (err as Error).message);
37:       setBusy(false);
38:     }
39:   };
40:
41:   const devSignIn = async (address: string, name?: string) => {
42:     setError("");
43:     setBusy(true);
44:     try {
45:       const me = await api.post<Me>("/auth/dev/login", { email: address, name: name || undefined });
46:       setCsrfToken(me.csrf);
47:       await reset();
48:       navigate(returnTo, { replace: true });
49:     } catch (err) {
50:       setError((err as Error).message);
51:       setBusy(false);
52:     }
53:   };
54:
55:   const cfg = config.data;
56:   return (
57:     <div className="login">
58:       <main className="login__card panel" aria-labelledby="login-title">
59:         <div className="row" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
60:           <Logo size={40} />
61:           <div>
62:             <div className="eyebrow">Visua</div>
63:             <h1 id="login-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
64:               Sign in
65:             </h1>
66:           </div>
67:         </div>
68:         <p className="muted" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
69:           The spatial, AI-first compliance workspace. Your organization decides how you sign in and what you can do.
70:         </p>
71:
72:         {error && (
73:           <div className="login__error" role="alert">
74:             <ShieldAlert size={16} aria-hidden />
75:             <span>{error}</span>
76:           </div>
77:         )}
78:
79:         <form className="stack" style={{ gap: 10 }} onSubmit={continueWithSso}>
80:           <div className="field">
81:             <label htmlFor="login-email">Work email</label>
82:             <input id="login-email" className="input" type="email" autoComplete="email" required placeholder="you@company.com" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
83:           </div>
84:           <button className="btn btn--primary" type="submit" disabled={busy || !email.includes("@")}>
85:             <KeyRound size={15} aria-hidden /> Continue with single sign-on <ArrowRight size={15} aria-hidden />
86:           </button>
87:         </form>
88:
89:         {cfg?.platform && (
90:           <button className="btn" onClick={() => window.location.assign(startUrl("platform", returnTo))} disabled={busy}>
91:             Continue with {cfg.platform.name}
92:           </button>
93:         )}
94:
95:         {cfg?.mode === "dev" && (
96:           <section className="stack login__dev" aria-labelledby="dev-title" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
97:             <div>
98:               <h2 id="dev-title" className="section-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
99:                 Developer sign-in
100:               </h2>
101:               <p className="field__hint" style={{ margin: "4px 0 0" }}>
102:                 No password: for local use and demos only. Production servers run with <span className="mono">VISUA_AUTH_MODE=oidc</span>.
103:               </p>
104:             </div>
105:             {!!cfg.personas.length && (
106:               <ul className="login__personas" aria-label="Demo personas">
107:                 {cfg.personas.map((p) => (
108:                   <li key={p.email}>
109:                     <button className="login__persona" onClick={() => void devSignIn(p.email)} disabled={busy}>
110:                       <span className="login__avatar" aria-hidden>
111:                         {initials(p.name)}
112:                       </span>
113:                       <span className="stack" style={{ gap: 2, minWidth: 0, alignItems: "flex-start" }}>
114:                         <span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{p.name}</span>
115:                         <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
116:                           {p.organizations.map((o) => `${ROLE_NAMES[o.role]} · ${o.name}`).join(" — ")}
117:                         </span>
118:                       </span>
119:                     </button>
120:                   </li>
121:                 ))}
122:               </ul>
123:             )}
124:             <form
125:               className="row row--wrap"
126:               style={{ gap: 8, alignItems: "flex-end" }}
127:               onSubmit={(e) => {
128:                 e.preventDefault();
129:                 void devSignIn(devEmail, devName);
130:               }}
131:             >
132:               <div className="field" style={{ flex: "1 1 180px" }}>
133:                 <label htmlFor="dev-email">Email</label>
134:                 <input id="dev-email" className="input" type="email" required value={devEmail} onChange={(e) => setDevEmail(e.target.value)} placeholder="you@example.com" />
135:               </div>
136:               <div className="field" style={{ flex: "1 1 140px" }}>
137:                 <label htmlFor="dev-name">Name</label>
138:                 <input id="dev-name" className="input" value={devName} onChange={(e) => setDevName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Optional" />
139:               </div>
140:               <button className="btn" type="submit" disabled={busy || !devEmail.includes("@")}>
141:                 <UserRound size={15} aria-hidden /> Sign in
142:               </button>
143:             </form>
144:           </section>
145:         )}
146:       </main>
147:       <Toasts />
148:     </div>
149:   );
150: }
151:
152: export const initials = (name: string) =>
153:   name
154:     .split(/\s+/)
155:     .filter(Boolean)
156:     .slice(0, 2)
157:     .map((w) => w[0]!.toUpperCase())
158:     .join("") || "?";

FILE apps/web/src/pages/ObservatoryPage.tsx SHA256 bb049769ef69795cc0d2bb2ea747096c1ebf84c46192f4eae99ccaefa0382d3e
1: /**
2:  * Observatory: the 3D framework space + its keyboard-navigable 2D twin (outline)
3:  * + HUD (lens, view, legend, metrics) + inspector.
4:  */
5: import { Box, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, ChevronUp, Crosshair, ListTree, Search } from "lucide-react";
6: import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
7: import { useNavigate, useParams, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
8: import type { Status } from "@visua/core";
9: import { Inspector } from "../components/inspector/Inspector.tsx";
10: import { ThreatLinkFilter } from "../components/threats/Coverage.tsx";
11: import { StatusBar, StatusGlyph } from "../components/ui/index.tsx";
12: import { STATUS_LABEL, truncate } from "../lib/format.ts";
13: import { badgeOf, isThreatCatalog, threatCatalogs } from "../lib/frameworks.ts";
14: import { PHONE, useMediaQuery } from "../lib/media.ts";
15: import { useFrameworkState, useGraph, useWorkspace } from "../lib/queries.ts";
16: import type { FrameworkStateBundle, LeanNode } from "../lib/types.ts";
17: import { LENS_INFO, THREAT_LENS, THREAT_STATUS_LABEL, overlaySwatch } from "../scene/colors.ts";
18: import { computeLayout } from "../scene/layout.ts";
19: import { Observatory } from "../scene/Observatory.tsx";
20: import { useAgentActivity } from "../state/agentActivity.ts";
21: import { LENSES, useUi, type Lens } from "../state/ui.ts";
22:
23: function nodeStatus(state: FrameworkStateBundle | undefined, node: LeanNode): Status {
24:   if (!state) return "not-started";
25:   return node.assessable ? (state.units[node.id]?.status ?? "not-started") : (state.groups[node.id]?.status ?? "not-started");
26: }
27:
28: function Outline({ nodes, state, selectedId, onSelect, filter }: { nodes: LeanNode[]; state: FrameworkStateBundle | undefined; selectedId: string | null; onSelect: (id: string) => void; filter: string }) {
29:   const children = useMemo(() => {
30:     const m = new Map<string | null, LeanNode[]>();
31:     for (const n of nodes) m.set(n.parentId, [...(m.get(n.parentId) ?? []), n]);
32:     for (const l of m.values()) l.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
33:     return m;
34:   }, [nodes]);
35:   const byId = useMemo(() => new Map(nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n])), [nodes]);
36:   const [open, setOpen] = useState<Set<string>>(() => new Set());
37:   // Keep the selection's ancestors expanded.
38:   useEffect(() => {
39:     if (!selectedId) return;
40:     const next = new Set(open);
41:     let cur = byId.get(selectedId);
42:     while (cur?.parentId) {
43:       next.add(cur.parentId);
44:       cur = byId.get(cur.parentId);
45:     }
46:     if (next.size !== open.size) setOpen(next);
47:     document.getElementById(`outline-${CSS.escape(selectedId)}`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
48:     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
49:   }, [selectedId, byId]);
50:
51:   const q = filter.trim().toLowerCase();
52:   const matches = useMemo(() => {
53:     if (!q) return null;
54:     const hit = new Set<string>();
55:     for (const n of nodes) {
56:       if (n.code.toLowerCase().includes(q) || n.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || n.text.toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
57:         let cur: LeanNode | undefined = n;
58:         while (cur) {
59:           hit.add(cur.id);
60:           cur = cur.parentId ? byId.get(cur.parentId) : undefined;
61:         }
62:       }
63:     }
64:     return hit;
65:   }, [q, nodes, byId]);
66:
67:   const render = (parent: string | null, depth: number): React.ReactNode =>
68:     (children.get(parent) ?? [])
69:       .filter((n) => !matches || matches.has(n.id))
70:       .map((n) => {
71:         const kids = children.get(n.id) ?? [];
72:         const expanded = !!matches || open.has(n.id);
73:         const status = nodeStatus(state, n);
74:         const unit = state?.units[n.id];
75:         return (
76:           <li key={n.id} role="treeitem" aria-expanded={kids.length ? expanded : undefined} aria-selected={selectedId === n.id}>
77:             <div
78:               id={`outline-${n.id}`}
79:               className={`outline__row ${selectedId === n.id ? "is-selected" : ""}`}
80:               style={{ paddingLeft: 8 + depth * 14 }}
81:               onClick={() => onSelect(n.id)}
82:             >
83:               {kids.length ? (
84:                 <button
85:                   className="outline__toggle"
86:                   aria-label={expanded ? "Collapse" : "Expand"}
87:                   onClick={(e) => {
88:                     e.stopPropagation();
89:                     const next = new Set(open);
90:                     if (next.has(n.id)) next.delete(n.id);
91:                     else next.add(n.id);
92:                     setOpen(next);
93:                   }}
94:                 >
95:                   {expanded ? <ChevronDown size={13} /> : <ChevronRight size={13} />}
96:                 </button>
97:               ) : (
98:                 <span style={{ width: 18 }} />
99:               )}
100:               <span className={`status--${status}`} style={{ background: "transparent", display: "inline-flex" }} title={STATUS_LABEL[status]}>
101:                 <StatusGlyph status={status} size={11} />
102:               </span>
103:               <span className="mono outline__code">{n.code}</span>
104:               <span className="outline__text">{truncate(n.title && n.title !== n.code ? n.title : n.text, 70)}</span>
105:               {unit && unit.applicable ? (
106:                 <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 10.5 }} title="Current → target">
107:                   {unit.current}→{unit.target}
108:                 </span>
109:               ) : null}
110:             </div>
111:             {kids.length > 0 && expanded ? (
112:               <ul role="group" className="outline__list">
113:                 {render(n.id, depth + 1)}
114:               </ul>
115:             ) : null}
116:           </li>
117:         );
118:       });
119:   return (
120:     <ul role="tree" aria-label="Framework outline" className="outline__list">
121:       {render(null, 0)}
122:     </ul>
123:   );
124: }
125:
126: export function ObservatoryPage() {
127:   const { ws = "", fw: fwParam } = useParams();
128:   const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
129:   const navigate = useNavigate();
130:   const workspace = useWorkspace(ws);
131:   const enabled = workspace.data?.frameworks.map((f) => f.id) ?? [];
132:   const fw = fwParam ?? enabled[0] ?? "nist-csf-2.0";
133:   const graph = useGraph(fw);
134:   const state = useFrameworkState(workspace.data?.workspace.id, fw);
135:   const { selectedId, hoveredId, focusIds, focusSeq, lens, view, outlineOpen } = useUi();
136:   const ui = useUi();
137:   const running = useAgentActivity((s) => Object.keys(s.running).length > 0);
138:   const [filter, setFilter] = useState("");
139:   const [pointer, setPointer] = useState<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
140:   const legendOpen = useUi((s) => s.legendOpen);
141:   const phone = useMediaQuery(PHONE);
142:   const [threeD, setThreeD] = useState(false);
143:   const outlineView = phone && !threeD;
144:   const filterRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
145:
146:   const layout = useMemo(() => (graph.data ? computeLayout(graph.data.nodes, view) : undefined), [graph.data, view]);
147:   const byId = layout?.byId;
148:
149:   // Deep link: ?select=<nodeId>
150:   useEffect(() => {
151:     const sel = params.get("select");
152:     if (sel && byId?.has(sel)) {
153:       ui.select(sel);
154:       params.delete("select");
155:       setParams(params, { replace: true });
156:     }
157:     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
158:   }, [params, byId]);
159:
160:   // Clear selection when switching framework.
161:   useEffect(() => {
162:     if (selectedId && byId && !byId.has(selectedId)) ui.select(null);
163:     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
164:   }, [byId]);
165:
166:   const onHover = useCallback(
167:     (id: string | null, x?: number, y?: number) => {
168:       ui.hover(id);
169:       setPointer(id && x !== undefined && y !== undefined ? { x, y } : null);
170:     },
171:     [ui],
172:   );
173:
174:   // Keyboard map (DESIGN.md › Accessibility).
175:   useEffect(() => {
176:     const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
177:       const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
178:       if (target.closest("input, textarea, select, [contenteditable]") || useUi.getState().paletteOpen) return;
179:       if (!layout) return;
180:       const sel = useUi.getState().selectedId;
181:       const node = sel ? layout.byId.get(sel) : undefined;
182:       const siblings = node ? (layout.children.get(node.parentId) ?? []) : (layout.children.get(null) ?? []);
183:       const i = node ? siblings.findIndex((s) => s.id === node.id) : -1;
184:       switch (e.key) {
185:         case "ArrowRight":
186:         case "ArrowDown":
187:           e.preventDefault();
188:           ui.select(siblings[(i + 1) % siblings.length]?.id ?? null);
189:           break;
190:         case "ArrowLeft":
191:         case "ArrowUp":
192:           e.preventDefault();
193:           ui.select(siblings[(i - 1 + siblings.length) % siblings.length]?.id ?? null);
194:           break;
195:         case "Enter": {
196:           const first = node ? layout.children.get(node.id)?.[0] : layout.children.get(null)?.[0];
197:           if (first) ui.select(first.id);
198:           break;
199:         }
200:         case "Escape":
201:         case "Backspace":
202:           if (node) ui.select(node.parentId);
203:           break;
204:         case "f":
205:         case "F":
206:           ui.focus(sel ? [sel] : []);
207:           break;
208:         case "l":
209:         case "L":
210:           ui.cycleLens();
211:           break;
212:         case "/":
213:           e.preventDefault();
214:           filterRef.current?.focus();
215:           break;
216:       }
217:     };
218:     window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
219:     return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
220:   }, [layout, ui]);
221:
222:   const hovered = hoveredId && byId ? byId.get(hoveredId) : undefined;
223:   const hoveredUnit = hoveredId ? state.data?.units[hoveredId] : undefined;
224:   const hoveredGroup = hoveredId ? state.data?.groups[hoveredId] : undefined;
225:   // The overlay lens exists only where the framework has an overlay (CSF: Cyber AI Profile; SP 800-53: COSAiS).
226:   const overlay = state.data?.overlay ?? null;
227:   // Threat catalogs: coverage (status lens) and its gap only.
228:   // Threat catalogs open with coverage in place of status.
229:   const threat = isThreatCatalog(fw);
230:   const activeLens: Lens = threat ? (lens === "gap" ? "gap" : "status") : lens === "overlay" && !overlay ? "status" : lens;
231:   const lensInfo = threat
232:     ? THREAT_LENS[activeLens === "gap" ? "gap" : "status"]
233:     : activeLens === "overlay" && overlay
234:       ? {
235:           title: overlay.shortName,
236:           description: LENS_INFO.overlay.description,
237:           legend: [...overlay.levels.map((l) => ({ label: l.label, color: overlaySwatch(l.level) })), { label: "Not in the overlay", color: LENS_INFO.overlay.legend.at(-1)!.color }],
238:         }
239:       : LENS_INFO[activeLens];
240:   const breadcrumb: LeanNode[] = [];
241:   let cur = selectedId && byId ? byId.get(selectedId) : undefined;

247:   const lenses: Lens[] = threat ? ["status", "gap"] : LENSES.filter((l) => l !== "overlay" || overlay);

249:   const chips = threat ? threatCatalogs().map((c) => c.id) : [...enabled, ...(enabled.includes("nist-rmf") ? [] : ["nist-rmf"])];
250:   const chipLabel = (id: string) => (id === "nist-rmf" && !enabled.includes("nist-rmf") ? "RMF steps" : badgeOf(id));
251:   const outline = (

256:           <input ref={filterRef} className="input" style={{ minHeight: 30, height: 30 }} placeholder="Filter (press /)" value={filter} onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value)} aria-label="Filter outline" />
257:           {outlineView && (

265:             {[...chips, ...(threat ? [] : threatCatalogs().map((c) => c.id))].map((id) => (

274:     </aside>

276:
277:   // Phones open on the outline, the 3D scene one tap away (DESIGN.md › Layout).
278:   if (outlineView) {

283:       </div>

291:         {layout ? (

303:           />

306:             Preparing the Observatory…

309:
310:         {/* One bar: its two groups wrap onto two lines rather than overlap. */}

315:                 <ListTree size={15} />
316:               </button>

323:                 {chips.map((id) => (

325:                     {chipLabel(id)}

328:                 {!threat && (

330:                     Threats →
331:                   </button>
332:                 )}
333:               </span>
334:               <select className="select hud-select hud-select--frameworks" aria-label="Framework" value={fw} onChange={(e) => navigate(`/w/${ws}/observatory/${e.target.value}`)}>
335:                 {[...chips, ...(threat ? [] : threatCatalogs().map((c) => c.id))].map((id) => (
336:                   <option key={id} value={id}>
337:                     {chipLabel(id)}
338:                   </option>

344:                 {graph.data?.framework.shortName ?? badgeOf(fw)}
345:               </button>
346:               {breadcrumb.map((b) => (

350:                     {b.code}
351:                   </button>
352:                 </span>
353:               ))}
354:             </nav>
355:           </div>
356:
357:           <div className="hud hud-bar__group hud-bar__group--end" data-hud>
358:             <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6, justifyContent: "flex-end" }} role="group" aria-label="Lens">
359:               <span className="eyebrow" style={{ marginRight: 4 }}>
360:                 Lens
361:               </span>
362:               <span className="hud-chips row" style={{ gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap", justifyContent: "flex-end" }}>
363:                 {lenses.map((l) => (

365:                     {lensTitle(l)}

368:               </span>
369:               <select className="select hud-select" aria-label="Lens" value={activeLens} onChange={(e) => ui.setLens(e.target.value as Lens)}>
370:                 {lenses.map((l) => (

372:                     {lensTitle(l)}
373:                   </option>
374:                 ))}
375:               </select>

380:                   Constellation

382:                 <button aria-pressed={view === "terrain"} onClick={() => ui.setView("terrain")}>
383:                   Terrain
384:                 </button>
385:               </div>
386:               <button className="btn btn--sm" onClick={() => (ui.select(null), ui.focus([]))} title="Frame everything (F with nothing selected)">
387:                 <Crosshair size={13} /> Reset view

389:             </div>
390:           </div>
391:         </div>
392:
393:         <div className="hud-foot">
394:           <div className={`hud hud-legend ${legendOpen ? "is-open" : ""}`} data-hud>
395:             <button className="hud-legend__toggle" aria-expanded={legendOpen} onClick={() => ui.toggleLegend()}>
396:               <span className="eyebrow">{lensInfo.title} lens</span>

401:                   ))}
402:                 </span>
403:               )}
404:               {legendOpen ? <ChevronDown size={13} aria-hidden /> : <ChevronUp size={13} aria-hidden />}
405:             </button>
406:             {legendOpen && (
407:               <>
408:                 <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 4, marginTop: 6 }}>
409:                   {lensInfo.legend.map((item) => (
410:                     <div key={item.label} className="row" style={{ gap: 8, fontSize: 12 }}>
411:                       <span style={{ width: 10, height: 10, borderRadius: 2, background: item.color }} />
412:                       {item.label}
413:                     </div>
414:                   ))}
415:                 </div>
416:                 <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11, marginTop: 8, maxWidth: 230 }}>
417:                   {threat

419:                     : `Height = current level · outlined glass = target gap · ${view === "constellation" ? "outer arc" : "beacon ring"} = readiness · small dots: out of scope · ◆ task · ▲ evidence`}
420:                 </div>
421:               </>
422:             )}
423:           </div>
424:
425:           {state.data && (

430:                   <div className="metric__value hud-stats__value">
431:                     {Math.round(state.data.overall.readiness * 100)}
432:                     <small>%</small>
433:                   </div>
434:                 </div>
435:                 <div>
436:                   <div className="eyebrow">{threat ? "Not fully covered" : "Gaps"}</div>
437:                   <div className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 18 }}>

439:                   </div>
440:                 </div>
