443:                     <div className="eyebrow">In scope</div>
444:                     <div className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 18 }}>
445:                       {state.data.overall.total}
446:                     </div>
447:                   </div>
448:                 ) : (
449:                   <div>
450:                     <div className="eyebrow">Evidence</div>
451:                     <div className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 18 }}>
452:                       {Math.round(state.data.overall.evidenceCoverage * 100)}%
453:                     </div>
454:                   </div>
455:                 )}
456:               </div>
457:               {threat && (
458:                 <div style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
459:                   <ThreatLinkFilter />
460:                   <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11, marginTop: 6 }}>
461:                     Coverage derived from linked requirements, never assessed
462:                   </div>
463:                 </div>
464:               )}
465:               <div className="hud-stats__bar">
466:                 <StatusBar counts={state.data.overall.counts} />
467:               </div>
468:               <div className="muted hud-stats__keys">←→ siblings · Enter drill in · Esc up · F frame · L lens · / filter</div>
469:             </div>
470:           )}
471:         </div>
472:
473:         {hovered && pointer && (

475:             <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
476:               <span className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-primary)", fontWeight: 600 }}>
477:                 {hovered.code}
478:               </span>

480:             </div>

482:             {hoveredUnit && (

484:                 <span className={`status status--${hoveredUnit.status}`}>
485:                   <StatusGlyph status={hoveredUnit.status} />
486:                   {threat ? THREAT_STATUS_LABEL[hoveredUnit.status] : STATUS_LABEL[hoveredUnit.status]}

492:                 {hoveredUnit.openTasks ? <span className="muted">{hoveredUnit.openTasks} task(s)</span> : null}

498:                 {Math.round(hoveredGroup.readiness * 100)}% ready · {hoveredGroup.gaps} gaps · {hoveredGroup.total} in scope
499:               </div>
500:             )}
501:           </div>
502:         )}
503:       </section>
504:       {selectedId && byId?.has(selectedId) && <Inspector nodeId={selectedId} onClose={() => ui.select(null)} />}
505:     </div>
506:   );
507: }

1: /**
2:  * Onboarding: any niche, any maturity. Four short steps produce a tailored
3:  * framework path, targets and priorities — with the reasons shown.
4:  */
5: import { ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Check, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
6: import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";

8: import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
9: import { estimateTier, type OrganizationProfile, type Recommendation } from "@visua/core";
10: import { Toasts, toast } from "../components/ui/index.tsx";
11: import { api } from "../lib/api.ts";
12: import type { WorkspaceSummary } from "../lib/types.ts";
13: import { DATA_TYPES, DRIVERS, INDUSTRIES } from "./SettingsPage.tsx";
14:
15: const QUICK_CHECK = [
16:   "Leadership has approved a written information security policy that people follow",
17:   "Multi-factor authentication is enforced for every workforce account",
18:   "You keep an up-to-date inventory of hardware, software, cloud services and data",
19:   "An incident response plan exists and has been exercised in the last year",
20:   "Backups are protected and restores are tested",
21:   "Supplier and third-party security risks are assessed before and during engagements",
22:   "Security events are centrally logged, monitored and triaged",
23:   "Everyone completes security awareness training at least annually",
24: ];
25: const ANSWERS = ["Not at all", "Partially", "Mostly", "Fully, and reviewed"];
26:
27: export function OnboardingPage() {
28:   const navigate = useNavigate();
29:   const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
30:   const [name, setName] = useState("");
31:   const [profile, setProfile] = useState<OrganizationProfile>({
32:     industry: "saas",
33:     size: "11-50",
34:     dataTypes: ["pii"],
35:     drivers: ["enterprise-customers"],
36:     environments: ["cloud"],
37:     maturityTier: 1,
38:     guidance: "guided",
39:     securityTeamSize: 1,
40:   });
41:   const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<number[]>(() => QUICK_CHECK.map(() => -1));
42:   const [rec, setRec] = useState<Recommendation | null>(null);
43:   const [frameworks, setFrameworks] = useState<string[]>(["nist-csf-2.0"]);
44:   const [plan, setPlan] = useState(true);
45:   const [meta, setMeta] = useState<{ id: string }[]>([]);
46:
47:   useEffect(() => {
48:     void api.get<{ frameworks: { id: string }[] }>("/meta").then((m) => setMeta(m.frameworks));
49:   }, []);
50:
51:   const tier = estimateTier(answers.filter((a) => a >= 0));
52:   useEffect(() => {
53:     if (step !== 3) return;
54:     const p = { ...profile, maturityTier: tier };
55:     void api.post<Recommendation>("/recommend", p).then((r) => {
56:       setRec(r);
57:       setFrameworks(r.frameworks.filter((f) => f.availability === "available" && meta.some((m) => m.id === f.frameworkId)).slice(0, 2).map((f) => f.frameworkId));
58:     });
59:     // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
60:   }, [step]);
61:
62:   const create = useMutation({
63:     mutationFn: () => api.post<WorkspaceSummary>("/workspaces", { name, profile: { ...profile, maturityTier: tier }, frameworks, planInitialTasks: plan }),
64:     onSuccess: (ws) => navigate(`/w/${ws.workspace.slug}`),
65:     onError: (e) => toast((e as Error).message, "error"),
66:   });
67:
68:   const toggle = <T,>(list: T[], v: T) => (list.includes(v) ? list.filter((x) => x !== v) : [...list, v]);
69:   const steps = ["Organization", "Data & drivers", "Maturity", "Your path"];
70:   const canNext = step === 0 ? name.trim().length > 1 : step === 2 ? answers.every((a) => a >= 0) : true;
71:
72:   return (
73:     <div style={{ height: "100%", overflow: "auto" }}>
74:       <div style={{ maxWidth: 900, margin: "0 auto", padding: "48px 24px" }}>
75:         <div className="row" style={{ gap: 12, marginBottom: 28 }}>
76:           <svg width="34" height="34" viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden>
77:             <path d="M14 18 L32 48 L50 18" fill="none" stroke="var(--color-primary)" strokeWidth="5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
78:             <circle cx="32" cy="27" r="5" fill="var(--color-tertiary)" />
79:           </svg>
80:           <div>
81:             <div className="eyebrow">Welcome to Visua</div>
82:             <h1 style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-display-lg-family)", fontSize: 30, fontWeight: 600 }}>Set up your compliance observatory</h1>
83:           </div>
84:         </div>
85:         <ol className="row row--wrap" style={{ listStyle: "none", padding: 0, gap: 8, marginBottom: 24 }}>
86:           {steps.map((s, i) => (
87:             <li key={s} className="chip" aria-current={i === step ? "step" : undefined} aria-pressed={i === step} style={{ cursor: "default" }}>
88:               {i < step ? <Check size={12} /> : <span className="mono">{i + 1}</span>} {s}
89:             </li>
90:           ))}
91:         </ol>
92:
93:         <div className="panel" style={{ padding: 24 }}>
94:           {step === 0 && (
95:             <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
96:               <div className="field">
97:                 <label htmlFor="org">Organization name</label>
98:                 <input id="org" className="input" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Acme Corp" autoFocus />
99:               </div>
100:               <div className="field">
101:                 <span className="label">Industry</span>
102:                 <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
103:                   {INDUSTRIES.map(([v, l]) => (
104:                     <button key={v} className="chip" aria-pressed={profile.industry === v} onClick={() => setProfile({ ...profile, industry: v })}>
105:                       {l}
106:                     </button>
107:                   ))}
108:                 </div>
109:               </div>
110:               <div className="grid grid--3" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
111:                 <div className="field">
112:                   <label>People</label>
113:                   <select className="select" value={profile.size} onChange={(e) => setProfile({ ...profile, size: e.target.value as OrganizationProfile["size"] })}>
114:                     {["1-10", "11-50", "51-200", "201-1000", "1000+"].map((s) => (
115:                       <option key={s}>{s}</option>
116:                     ))}
117:                   </select>
118:                 </div>
119:                 <div className="field">
120:                   <label>Security team (people)</label>
121:                   <input className="input" type="number" min={0} value={profile.securityTeamSize} onChange={(e) => setProfile({ ...profile, securityTeamSize: Number(e.target.value) })} />
122:                 </div>
123:                 <div className="field">
124:                   <span className="label">Environments</span>
125:                   <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
126:                     {(["cloud", "on-prem", "hybrid", "ot"] as const).map((env) => (
127:                       <button key={env} className="chip" aria-pressed={profile.environments.includes(env)} onClick={() => setProfile({ ...profile, environments: toggle(profile.environments, env) })}>
128:                         {env === "ot" ? "OT / ICS" : env}
129:                       </button>
130:                     ))}
131:                   </div>
132:                 </div>
133:               </div>
134:             </div>
135:           )}
136:           {step === 1 && (
137:             <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 18 }}>
138:               <div className="field">
139:                 <span className="label">Which data do you handle?</span>
140:                 <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
141:                   {DATA_TYPES.map(([v, l]) => (
142:                     <button key={v} className="chip" aria-pressed={profile.dataTypes.includes(v)} onClick={() => setProfile({ ...profile, dataTypes: toggle(profile.dataTypes, v) })}>
143:                       {l}
144:                     </button>
145:                   ))}
146:                 </div>
147:               </div>
148:               <div className="field">
149:                 <span className="label">Why now?</span>
150:                 <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
151:                   {DRIVERS.map(([v, l]) => (
152:                     <button key={v} className="chip" aria-pressed={profile.drivers.includes(v)} onClick={() => setProfile({ ...profile, drivers: toggle(profile.drivers, v) })}>
153:                       {l}
154:                     </button>
155:                   ))}
156:                 </div>
157:               </div>
158:               <div className="field">
159:                 <span className="label">How much guidance do you want?</span>
160:                 <div className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
161:                   <button className="chip" aria-pressed={profile.guidance === "guided"} onClick={() => setProfile({ ...profile, guidance: "guided" })}>
162:                     Guided — I'm new to this
163:                   </button>
164:                   <button className="chip" aria-pressed={profile.guidance === "expert"} onClick={() => setProfile({ ...profile, guidance: "expert" })}>
165:                     Expert — keep it terse
166:                   </button>
167:                 </div>
168:               </div>
169:             </div>
170:           )}
171:           {step === 2 && (
172:             <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 14 }}>
173:               <p className="muted">A two-minute quick check. It estimates your starting CSF Tier so targets stay ambitious but reachable. You can take the full Tier assessment later.</p>
174:               {QUICK_CHECK.map((q, i) => (
175:                 <div key={q} className="stack" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
176:                   <div style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{q}</div>
177:                   <div className="segmented" role="radiogroup" aria-label={q}>
178:                     {ANSWERS.map((a, ai) => (
179:                       <button key={a} role="radio" aria-checked={answers[i] === ai} aria-pressed={answers[i] === ai} onClick={() => setAnswers(answers.map((x, xi) => (xi === i ? ai : x)))}>
180:                         {a}
181:                       </button>
182:                     ))}
183:                   </div>
184:                 </div>
185:               ))}
186:               {answers.every((a) => a >= 0) && (
187:                 <div className="panel panel--raised">
188:                   Estimated starting point: <strong>CSF Tier {tier}</strong> — {["Partial", "Risk Informed", "Repeatable", "Adaptive"][tier - 1]}.
189:                 </div>
190:               )}
191:             </div>
192:           )}
193:           {step === 3 && (
194:             <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
195:               {!rec && <div className="muted">Composing your path…</div>}
196:               {rec && (
197:                 <>
198:                   <p>
199:                     Visua recommends starting with <strong>NIST CSF 2.0</strong> as your program's foundation, with a default target of <strong>level {rec.defaultTarget}</strong> and <strong>level {rec.elevatedTarget}</strong> for high-priority outcomes.
200:                   </p>
201:                   <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
202:                     {rec.frameworks.map((f) => {
203:                       const available = f.availability === "available" && meta.some((m) => m.id === f.frameworkId);
204:                       const on = frameworks.includes(f.frameworkId);
205:                       return (
206:                         <label key={f.frameworkId} className="panel panel--raised row" style={{ gap: 12, alignItems: "flex-start", opacity: available ? 1 : 0.6, cursor: available ? "pointer" : "default" }}>
207:                           <input
208:                             type="checkbox"
209:                             disabled={!available || f.frameworkId === "nist-csf-2.0"}
210:                             checked={on}
211:                             onChange={() => setFrameworks(toggle(frameworks, f.frameworkId))}
212:                             style={{ marginTop: 3 }}
213:                           />
214:                           <div>
215:                             <strong>{f.name}</strong> {!available && <span className="chip" style={{ height: 20, cursor: "default" }}>roadmap</span>}
216:                             <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
217:                               {f.reason}
218:                             </div>
219:                           </div>
220:                         </label>
221:                       );
222:                     })}
223:                   </div>
224:                   <div>
225:                     <div className="eyebrow" style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
226:                       Focus first
227:                     </div>
228:                     <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
229:                       {rec.focus.map((c) => (
230:                         <span key={c} className="code" style={{ cursor: "default" }}>
231:                           {c}
232:                         </span>
233:                       ))}
234:                     </div>
235:                   </div>
236:                   <details>
237:                     <summary className="eyebrow" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
238:                       Why
239:                     </summary>
240:                     <ul className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 1.55, paddingLeft: 18 }}>
241:                       {rec.rationale.map((r) => (
242:                         <li key={r}>{r}</li>
243:                       ))}
244:                     </ul>
245:                   </details>
246:                   <label className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
247:                     <input type="checkbox" checked={plan} onChange={(e) => setPlan(e.target.checked)} /> Generate an initial action plan from NIST's official implementation examples
248:                   </label>
249:                 </>
250:               )}
251:             </div>
252:           )}
253:           <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
254:             {step > 0 && (
255:               <button className="btn" onClick={() => setStep(step - 1)}>
256:                 <ArrowLeft size={14} /> Back
257:               </button>
258:             )}
259:             <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
260:             {step < 3 ? (
261:               <button className="btn btn--primary" disabled={!canNext} onClick={() => setStep(step + 1)}>
262:                 Continue <ArrowRight size={14} />
263:               </button>
264:             ) : (
265:               <button className="btn btn--primary" disabled={!rec || create.isPending} onClick={() => create.mutate()}>
266:                 <Sparkles size={14} /> Create workspace
267:               </button>
268:             )}
269:           </div>
270:         </div>
271:       </div>
272:       <Toasts />
273:     </div>
274:   );
275: }

1: /**
2:  * Organization administration: members and roles, API tokens, single sign-on
3:  * connections, the SSO requirement and the organization's own audit trail.
4:  * Everything here is enforced by the server; the page only hides what the
5:  * signed-in role cannot do.
6:  */
7: import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
8: import { Copy, KeyRound, Plus, ShieldCheck, Trash2, UserPlus } from "lucide-react";
9: import { useState } from "react";
10: import { useNavigate, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
11: import { ROLES, ROLE_LABELS, can, roleRank, type ActivityEvent, type Role } from "@visua/core";
12: import { Empty, StatusChip, Tabs, toast } from "../components/ui/index.tsx";

18: interface Member {
19:   id: string;
20:   email: string;
21:   name: string;
22:   role: Role;
23:   memberSince: string;
24:   lastLoginAt?: string;
25: }
26: interface Token {
27:   id: string;
28:   name: string;
29:   role: Role;
30:   prefix: string;
31:   createdAt: string;
32:   expiresAt?: string;
33:   revokedAt?: string;
34:   lastUsedAt?: string;
35: }
36: interface Connection {
37:   id: string;
38:   name: string;
39:   issuer: string;
40:   clientId: string;
41:   hasClientSecret: boolean;
42:   domains: string[];
43:   /** Each domain's proof: only verified domains route sign-ins and admit people. */
44:   domainStatus: {
45:     domain: string;
46:     verified: boolean;
47:     standing: "pending" | "verified" | "failing" | "lapsed" | "not-proven";
48:     method?: "dns" | "grandfathered" | "trusted";
49:     verifiedAt?: string;
50:     failingSince?: string;
51:     lapsesAt?: string;
52:     lapsedAt?: string;
53:     takenOver: boolean;
54:     record?: { name: string; value: string };
55:   }[];
56:   jitProvisioning: boolean;
57:   defaultRole: Role;
58:   enabled: boolean;
59: }
60:
61: const PROOF: Record<string, string> = {
62:   dns: "Verified",
63:   grandfathered: "Verified before DNS checks",
64:   trusted: "Trusted (checks off)",
65: };
66: /** How often this installation looks proven domains up again (GET /sso). */
67: interface DomainRechecks {
68:   enabled: boolean;
69:   everyHours: number;
70: }
71: const every = (hours: number) => (hours === 24 ? "every day" : hours === 1 ? "every hour" : `every ${hours} hours`);
72: function DomainChip({ d, rechecks }: { d: Connection["domainStatus"][number]; rechecks?: DomainRechecks }) {
73:   // With re-checks off, a failing domain never lapses: no date to announce.
74:   if (d.standing === "failing") return <StatusChip status="at-risk" label={rechecks?.enabled === false ? "Record missing" : `Record missing · lapses ${shortDate(d.lapsesAt)}`} />;
75:   if (d.standing === "lapsed") return <StatusChip status="at-risk" label={d.takenOver ? "Held by another organization" : "Lapsed · admits no one new"} />;
76:   if (d.standing === "pending") return <StatusChip status="in-progress" label="Awaiting DNS proof" />;
77:   return <StatusChip status="verified" label={PROOF[d.method ?? "dns"]} />;
78: }
79: interface TenantInfo {
80:   id: string;
81:   name: string;
82:   slug: string;
83:   settings: { requireSso?: boolean };
84:   role: Role;

87: type Tab = "members" | "tokens" | "sso" | "audit";

89:
90: function RoleSelect({ value, onChange, max, label, exclude = [], compact }: { value: Role; onChange: (r: Role) => void; max: Role; label: string; exclude?: Role[]; compact?: boolean }) {
91:   return (
92:     <select className="select" aria-label={label} value={value} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value as Role)} style={compact ? { minHeight: 32, height: 32, padding: "0 8px", width: 160 } : { width: 160 }}>
93:       {ROLES.filter((r) => roleRank(r) <= roleRank(max) && !exclude.includes(r)).map((r) => (
94:         <option key={r} value={r} title={ROLE_LABELS[r].description}>
95:           {ROLE_NAMES[r]}
96:         </option>
97:       ))}
98:     </select>
99:   );
100: }

102: export function OrganizationPage() {
103:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
104:   const summary = useWorkspace(ws);
105:   const tenantId = summary.data?.workspace.tenantId;
106:   const qc = useQueryClient();
107:   const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("members");
108:   const tenant = useQuery({ queryKey: ["tenant", tenantId], queryFn: () => api.get<TenantInfo>(`/tenants/${tenantId}`), enabled: !!tenantId });
109:   const role = tenant.data?.role;
110:   const manage = can(role, "tenant.manage");
111:   const audit = can(role, "workspace.export");
112:   const refresh = () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["tenant", tenantId] });
113:
114:   if (!tenantId || !tenant.data) return <div className="page muted">Loading…</div>;
115:   const tabs: { id: Tab; label: string }[] = [{ id: "members", label: "Members" }];
116:   if (manage) tabs.push({ id: "tokens", label: "API tokens" }, { id: "sso", label: "Single sign-on" });
117:   if (audit) tabs.push({ id: "audit", label: "Audit trail" });
118:
119:   return (
120:     <div className="page">
121:       <header className="page__header">
122:         <div>
123:           <div className="eyebrow">Organization</div>
124:           <h1>{tenant.data.name}</h1>
125:           <p>
126:             Every workspace belongs to one organization. People see an organization's workspaces only through a membership, and what they can do follows their role.
127:             You are <strong>{ROLE_NAMES[tenant.data.role]}</strong>.
128:           </p>
129:         </div>
130:       </header>
131:       <Tabs tabs={tabs} value={tab} onChange={setTab} />
132:       <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
133:         {tab === "members" && <Members tenantId={tenantId} role={tenant.data.role} onChange={refresh} />}
134:         {tab === "tokens" && manage && <Tokens tenantId={tenantId} role={tenant.data.role} />}
135:         {tab === "sso" && manage && <Sso tenant={tenant.data} onChange={refresh} />}
136:         {tab === "audit" && audit && <Audit tenantId={tenantId} />}
137:       </div>
138:     </div>
139:   );
140: }

142: function Members({ tenantId, role, onChange }: { tenantId: string; role: Role; onChange: () => void }) {
143:   const qc = useQueryClient();
144:   const me = useMe();
145:   const manage = can(role, "tenant.manage");
146:   const members = useQuery({ queryKey: ["tenant", tenantId, "members"], queryFn: () => api.get<Member[]>(`/tenants/${tenantId}/members`) });
147:   const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
148:   const [name, setName] = useState("");
149:   const [newRole, setNewRole] = useState<Role>("contributor");
150:   const done = () => {
151:     void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["tenant", tenantId, "members"] });
152:     onChange();
153:   };
154:   const add = useMutation({
155:     mutationFn: () => api.post(`/tenants/${tenantId}/members`, { email, name: name || undefined, role: newRole }),
156:     onSuccess: () => {
157:       toast(`${email} added as ${ROLE_NAMES[newRole].toLowerCase()}`);
158:       setEmail("");
159:       setName("");
160:       done();
161:     },
162:     onError: (e: Error) => toast(e.message, "error"),
163:   });
164:   const setMemberRole = useMutation({
165:     mutationFn: (v: { id: string; role: Role }) => api.patch(`/tenants/${tenantId}/members/${v.id}`, { role: v.role }),
166:     onSuccess: done,
167:     onError: (e: Error) => toast(e.message, "error"),
168:   });
169:   const remove = useMutation({
170:     mutationFn: (id: string) => api.del(`/tenants/${tenantId}/members/${id}`),
171:     onSuccess: done,
172:     onError: (e: Error) => toast(e.message, "error"),
173:   });
174:   return (
175:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
176:       {manage && (
177:         <form
178:           className="panel row row--wrap"
179:           style={{ gap: 10, alignItems: "flex-end" }}
180:           onSubmit={(e) => {
181:             e.preventDefault();
182:             add.mutate();
183:           }}
184:         >
185:           <div className="field" style={{ flex: "2 1 220px" }}>
186:             <label htmlFor="member-email">Email</label>
187:             <input id="member-email" className="input" type="email" required value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} placeholder="colleague@company.com" />
188:           </div>
189:           <div className="field" style={{ flex: "1 1 160px" }}>
190:             <label htmlFor="member-name">Name</label>
191:             <input id="member-name" className="input" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Optional" />
192:           </div>
193:           <div className="field">
194:             <label>Role</label>
195:             <RoleSelect label="Role for the new member" value={newRole} onChange={setNewRole} max={role} />
196:           </div>
197:           <button className="btn btn--primary" type="submit" disabled={add.isPending || !email.includes("@")}>
198:             <UserPlus size={15} aria-hidden /> Add member
199:           </button>
200:           <p className="field__hint" style={{ flexBasis: "100%", margin: 0 }}>
201:             Members sign in through your SSO or the platform identity provider with this email address. {ROLE_LABELS[newRole].description}
202:           </p>
203:         </form>
204:       )}
205:       <div className="panel" style={{ padding: 0 }}>
206:         <table className="table table--members">
207:           <thead>
208:             <tr>
209:               <th>Member</th>
210:               <th>Role</th>
211:               <th>Member since</th>
212:               <th>Last sign-in</th>
213:               {manage && <th aria-label="Actions" />}
214:             </tr>
215:           </thead>
216:           <tbody>
217:             {(members.data ?? []).map((m) => {
218:               const self = m.id === me.data?.user.id;
219:               const editable = manage && !self && (m.role !== "owner" || role === "owner");
220:               return (
221:                 <tr key={m.id}>
222:                   <td>
223:                     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
224:                       <strong>
225:                         {m.name}
226:                         {self ? " (you)" : ""}
227:                       </strong>
228:                       <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
229:                         {m.email}
230:                       </span>
231:                     </div>
232:                   </td>
233:                   <td>{editable ? <RoleSelect compact label={`Role of ${m.email}`} value={m.role} onChange={(r) => setMemberRole.mutate({ id: m.id, role: r })} max={role} /> : <span className="role-badge">{ROLE_NAMES[m.role]}</span>}</td>
234:                   <td className="mono">{day(m.memberSince)}</td>
235:                   <td className="mono">{day(m.lastLoginAt)}</td>
236:                   {manage && (
237:                     <td style={{ textAlign: "right" }}>
238:                       {editable && (
239:                         <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm btn--icon" aria-label={`Remove ${m.email}`} title="Remove from organization" onClick={() => confirm(`Remove ${m.email} from this organization?`) && remove.mutate(m.id)}>
240:                           <Trash2 size={14} />
241:                         </button>
242:                       )}
243:                     </td>
244:                   )}
245:                 </tr>
246:               );
247:             })}
248:           </tbody>
249:         </table>
250:       </div>
251:       <NewOrganization />
252:     </div>
253:   );
254: }

256: function NewOrganization() {
257:   const me = useMe();
258:   const reset = useResetSession();
259:   const navigate = useNavigate();
260:   const [name, setName] = useState("");
261:   const create = useMutation({
262:     mutationFn: () => api.post<{ id: string }>("/tenants", { name }),
263:     onSuccess: async () => {
264:       toast(`Organization “${name}” created — you are its owner.`);
265:       await reset();
266:       navigate("/onboarding");
267:     },
268:     onError: (e: Error) => toast(e.message, "error"),
269:   });
270:   if (me.data?.principal !== "user" || me.data.tenantScope) return null;
271:   return (
272:     <form
273:       className="panel row row--wrap"
274:       style={{ gap: 10, alignItems: "flex-end" }}
275:       onSubmit={(e) => {
276:         e.preventDefault();
277:         create.mutate();
278:       }}
279:     >
280:       <div className="field" style={{ flex: "1 1 260px" }}>
281:         <label htmlFor="org-name">Start another organization</label>
282:         <input id="org-name" className="input" required value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. a client you advise" />
283:         <span className="field__hint">For consultants and groups: each organization's workspaces, members and SSO stay separate.</span>
284:       </div>
285:       <button className="btn" type="submit" disabled={!name.trim() || create.isPending}>
286:         <Plus size={15} aria-hidden /> Create organization
287:       </button>
288:     </form>
289:   );
290: }

292: function Tokens({ tenantId, role }: { tenantId: string; role: Role }) {
293:   const qc = useQueryClient();
294:   const tokens = useQuery({ queryKey: ["tenant", tenantId, "tokens"], queryFn: () => api.get<Token[]>(`/tenants/${tenantId}/tokens`) });
295:   const [name, setName] = useState("");
296:   const [tokenRole, setTokenRole] = useState<Role>("contributor");
297:   const [days, setDays] = useState(90);
298:   const [created, setCreated] = useState<{ name: string; token: string } | null>(null);
299:   const create = useMutation({
300:     mutationFn: () => api.post<Token & { token: string }>(`/tenants/${tenantId}/tokens`, { name, role: tokenRole, expiresInDays: days || undefined }),
301:     onSuccess: (t) => {
302:       setCreated({ name: t.name, token: t.token });
303:       setName("");
304:       void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["tenant", tenantId, "tokens"] });
305:     },
306:     onError: (e: Error) => toast(e.message, "error"),
307:   });
308:   const revoke = useMutation({
309:     mutationFn: (id: string) => api.del(`/tenants/${tenantId}/tokens/${id}`),
310:     onSuccess: () => void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["tenant", tenantId, "tokens"] }),
311:     onError: (e: Error) => toast(e.message, "error"),
312:   });
313:   const now = new Date().toISOString();
314:   return (
315:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
316:       <form
317:         className="panel row row--wrap"
318:         style={{ gap: 10, alignItems: "flex-end" }}
319:         onSubmit={(e) => {
320:           e.preventDefault();
321:           create.mutate();
322:         }}
323:       >
324:         <div className="field" style={{ flex: "2 1 220px" }}>
325:           <label htmlFor="token-name">Token name</label>
326:           <input id="token-name" className="input" required value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. CI evidence upload" />
327:         </div>
328:         <div className="field">
329:           <label>Role</label>
330:           <RoleSelect label="Token role" value={tokenRole} onChange={setTokenRole} max={role} exclude={["owner"]} />
331:         </div>
332:         <div className="field" style={{ width: 130 }}>
333:           <label htmlFor="token-days">Expires in (days)</label>
334:           <input id="token-days" className="input" type="number" min={1} max={730} value={days} onChange={(e) => setDays(Number(e.target.value))} />
335:         </div>
336:         <button className="btn btn--primary" type="submit" disabled={!name.trim() || create.isPending}>
337:           <KeyRound size={15} aria-hidden /> Create token
338:         </button>
339:         <p className="field__hint" style={{ flexBasis: "100%", margin: 0 }}>
340:           Tokens act in this organization only, with the role you choose, and every change they make is recorded under their name. Send them as <span className="mono">Authorization: Bearer …</span>.
341:         </p>
342:       </form>
343:       {created && (
344:         <div className="panel stack" role="status" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
345:           <strong>Copy “{created.name}” now — it will not be shown again.</strong>
346:           <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
347:             <code className="secret" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
348:               {created.token}
349:             </code>
350:             <button className="btn btn--sm" onClick={() => void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(created.token).then(() => toast("Token copied"))} aria-label="Copy token">
351:               <Copy size={14} />
352:             </button>
353:           </div>
354:         </div>
355:       )}
356:       <div className="panel" style={{ padding: 0 }}>
357:         {tokens.data?.length ? (
358:           <table className="table table--tokens">
359:             <thead>
360:               <tr>
361:                 <th>Token</th>
362:                 <th>Role</th>
363:                 <th>Created</th>
364:                 <th>Last used</th>
365:                 <th>Expires</th>
366:                 <th aria-label="Actions" />
367:               </tr>
368:             </thead>
369:             <tbody>
370:               {tokens.data.map((t) => {
371:                 const expired = !!t.expiresAt && t.expiresAt <= now;
372:                 return (
373:                   <tr key={t.id}>
374:                     <td>
375:                       <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 2 }}>
376:                         <strong>{t.name}</strong>
377:                         <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
378:                           {t.prefix}…
379:                         </span>
380:                       </div>
381:                     </td>
382:                     <td>
383:                       <span className="role-badge">{ROLE_NAMES[t.role]}</span>
384:                     </td>
385:                     <td className="mono">{day(t.createdAt)}</td>
386:                     <td className="mono">{day(t.lastUsedAt)}</td>
387:                     <td className="mono">{t.revokedAt ? `revoked ${day(t.revokedAt)}` : expired ? `expired ${day(t.expiresAt)}` : day(t.expiresAt)}</td>
388:                     <td style={{ textAlign: "right" }}>
389:                       {!t.revokedAt && !expired && (
390:                         <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" onClick={() => confirm(`Revoke “${t.name}”? Anything using it stops working immediately.`) && revoke.mutate(t.id)}>
391:                           Revoke
392:                         </button>
393:                       )}
394:                     </td>
395:                   </tr>
396:                 );
397:               })}
398:             </tbody>
399:           </table>
400:         ) : (
401:           <Empty title="No API tokens">Create one for CI pipelines, evidence uploads or integrations.</Empty>
402:         )}
403:       </div>
404:     </div>
405:   );
406: }
407:
408: const emptyConnection = { name: "", issuer: "", clientId: "", clientSecret: "", domains: "", jitProvisioning: false, defaultRole: "viewer" as Role };
409:
410: function Sso({ tenant, onChange }: { tenant: TenantInfo; onChange: () => void }) {
411:   const qc = useQueryClient();
412:   const sso = useQuery({ queryKey: ["tenant", tenant.id, "sso"], queryFn: () => api.get<{ redirectUri: string; domainRechecks: DomainRechecks; connections: Connection[] }>(`/tenants/${tenant.id}/sso`) });
413:   const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyConnection);
414:   const done = () => {
415:     void qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["tenant", tenant.id, "sso"] });
416:     onChange();
417:   };
418:   const save = useMutation({
419:     mutationFn: () =>
420:       api.post(`/tenants/${tenant.id}/sso`, {

663: function Audit({ tenantId }: { tenantId: string }) {
664:   const events = useQuery({ queryKey: ["tenant", tenantId, "activity"], queryFn: () => api.get<ActivityEvent[]>(`/tenants/${tenantId}/activity?limit=200`) });
665:   const verify = useQuery({ queryKey: ["tenant", tenantId, "verify"], queryFn: () => api.get<{ valid: boolean; events: number; head?: string }>(`/tenants/${tenantId}/activity/verify`) });
666:   return (
667:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
668:       {verify.data && (
669:         <div className="panel row" role="status" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
670:           <span className={`status status--${verify.data.valid ? "verified" : "at-risk"}`}>{verify.data.valid ? "✓ Chain intact" : "! Chain broken"}</span>
671:           <span className="muted">
672:             {verify.data.events} organization events, hash-chained like workspace audit trails
673:             {verify.data.head ? ` · head ${verify.data.head.slice(0, 12)}…` : ""}
674:           </span>
675:         </div>
676:       )}
677:       <div className="panel" style={{ padding: 0 }}>
678:         <table className="table">
679:           <thead>
680:             <tr>
681:               <th>When</th>
682:               <th>Who</th>
683:               <th>What</th>
684:             </tr>
685:           </thead>
686:           <tbody>
687:             {(events.data ?? []).map((e) => (
688:               <tr key={e.id}>
689:                 <td className="mono" style={{ whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
690:                   {e.at.slice(0, 16).replace("T", " ")}
691:                 </td>
692:                 <td>{e.actor}</td>
693:                 <td>{e.summary}</td>
694:               </tr>
695:             ))}
696:           </tbody>
697:         </table>
698:       </div>
699:     </div>
700:   );
701: }

29:       <div className="row" style={{ alignItems: "flex-start", gap: 8 }}>

33:       <div className="card__meta">

49: function TaskDialog({ task, onClose, saving = false }: { task: Task; onClose: () => void; saving?: boolean }) {

55:   const raise = useWsMutation(ws, (s: { nodeId: string; to: number }) => api.patch(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/requirements/${encodeURIComponent(s.nodeId)}`, { current: s.to }));

90:                 </label>

92:             </div>
93:           </div>
94:         </div>
95:         <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
96:           <dl className="kv">
97:             <dt>Status</dt>

99:               <select className="select" value={task.status} disabled={saving} onChange={(e) => setStatus(e.target.value as Task["status"])}>

102:                     {TASK_STATUS_LABEL[c]}

106:             </dd>

108:             <dd>{task.priority}</dd>
109:             <dt>Kind</dt>
110:             <dd>{task.kind}</dd>
111:             <dt>Dates</dt>
112:             <dd>
113:               {shortDate(task.startDate)} → {shortDate(task.dueDate)} {task.effortHours ? `· ${task.effortHours} h` : ""}
114:             </dd>

140: function Timeline({ tasks, onOpen }: { tasks: Task[]; onOpen: (t: Task) => void }) {
141:   const dated = tasks.filter((t) => t.startDate && t.dueDate).sort((a, b) => a.startDate!.localeCompare(b.startDate!));
142:   if (!dated.length) return <Empty title="No scheduled tasks" />;
143:   const min = new Date(dated[0]!.startDate!).getTime() - 3 * 86_400_000;
144:   const max = Math.max(...dated.map((t) => new Date(t.dueDate!).getTime())) + 5 * 86_400_000;
145:   const span = max - min;
146:   const today = Date.now();
147:   const x = (d: number) => `${((d - min) / span) * 100}%`;
148:   const months: { label: string; at: number }[] = [];
149:   const cursor = new Date(min);
150:   cursor.setDate(1);
151:   while (cursor.getTime() < max) {
152:     if (cursor.getTime() > min) months.push({ label: cursor.toLocaleDateString("en", { month: "short", year: "2-digit" }), at: cursor.getTime() });
153:     cursor.setMonth(cursor.getMonth() + 1);
154:   }
155:   return (
156:     <div className="panel" style={{ position: "relative", overflowX: "auto" }}>
157:       <div style={{ position: "relative", minWidth: 900 }}>
158:         <div style={{ position: "relative", height: 22, borderBottom: "1px solid var(--color-outline)", marginBottom: 8 }}>
159:           {months.map((m) => (
160:             <span key={m.at} className="eyebrow" style={{ position: "absolute", left: x(m.at) }}>
161:               {m.label}
162:             </span>
163:           ))}
164:         </div>
165:         {today > min && today < max && <div style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, bottom: 0, left: x(today), width: 2, background: "var(--color-primary)", opacity: 0.7 }} title="Today" />}
166:         {dated.map((t) => {
167:           const s = new Date(t.startDate!).getTime();
168:           const e = new Date(t.dueDate!).getTime() + 86_400_000;
169:           const late = t.status !== "done" && e < today;
170:           return (
171:             <div key={t.id} style={{ position: "relative", height: 30 }}>
172:               <button
173:                 onClick={() => onOpen(t)}
174:                 title={`${t.title} · ${TASK_STATUS_LABEL[t.status]}`}
175:                 style={{
176:                   position: "absolute",
177:                   left: x(s),
178:                   width: `max(${((e - s) / span) * 100}%, 6px)`,
179:                   top: 4,
180:                   height: 22,
181:                   borderRadius: 6,
182:                   border: `1px solid ${late ? "var(--color-status-at-risk)" : "var(--color-outline-strong)"}`,
183:                   background: t.status === "done" ? "var(--color-status-implemented-container)" : t.status === "in-progress" || t.status === "in-review" ? "var(--color-status-in-progress-container)" : "var(--color-surface-raised)",
184:                   color: "var(--color-on-surface)",
185:                   fontSize: 11.5,
186:                   textAlign: "left",
187:                   padding: "0 8px",
188:                   overflow: "hidden",
189:                   whiteSpace: "nowrap",
190:                   textOverflow: "ellipsis",
191:                   cursor: "pointer",
192:                 }}
193:               >
194:                 {t.title}
195:               </button>
196:             </div>
197:           );
198:         })}
199:       </div>
200:     </div>
201:   );
202: }

204: export function PlanPage() {
205:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
206:   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
207:   const { data: tasks = [] } = useTasks(ws);
208:   const workspace = useWorkspace(ws);
209:   const run = useRunAgent();
210:   const [view, setView] = useState<"board" | "timeline">("board");
211:   const [open, setOpen] = useState<Task | null>(null);
212:   const [over, setOver] = useState<string | null>(null);
213:   const [framework, setFramework] = useState("all");
214:   const [newTitle, setNewTitle] = useState("");
215:   const pendingMovesRef = useRef<Record<string, Task["status"]>>({});
216:   const [pendingMoves, setPendingMoves] = useState<Record<string, Task["status"]>>({});
217:   const clearPendingMove = (id: string) => {
218:     const next = { ...pendingMovesRef.current };
219:     delete next[id];
220:     pendingMovesRef.current = next;
221:     setPendingMoves(next);
222:   };
223:   const move = useMutation({
224:     mutationFn: (v: { id: string; status: Task["status"] }) => api.patch<{ task: Task }>(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/tasks/${v.id}`, { status: v.status }),
225:     onSuccess: ({ task }, { id }) => {
226:       queryClient.setQueryData<Task[]>(keys.tasks(ws), (current) => current?.map((item) => item.id === id ? task : item));
227:       void Promise.allSettled([
228:         queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["ws", ws] }),
229:         queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: keys.workspaces }),
230:       ]).then(() => clearPendingMove(id));
231:     },
232:     onError: (error, { id }) => {
233:       clearPendingMove(id);
234:       toast(`Could not move task: ${(error as Error).message}`, "error");
235:       void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["ws", ws] });
236:     },
237:   });
238:   const plan = useWsMutation(ws, (fw: string) => api.post<Task[]>(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/plan`, { framework: fw, maxTasks: 10 }));
239:   const create = useWsMutation(ws, (title: string) => api.post(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/tasks`, { title, status: "todo" }));
240:   const filtered = useMemo(() => (framework === "all" ? tasks : tasks.filter((t) => t.requirementIds.some((id) => frameworkOf(id) === framework))).map((task) => {
241:     const status = pendingMoves[task.id];
242:     return status ? { ...task, status } : task;
243:   }), [tasks, framework, pendingMoves]);
244:   const selectedTask = open ? tasks.find((t) => t.id === open.id) ?? open : null;
245:   const current = selectedTask ? { ...selectedTask, status: pendingMoves[selectedTask.id] ?? selectedTask.status } : null;
246:   const primary = workspace.data?.frameworks[0]?.id ?? "nist-csf-2.0";
247:   return (
248:     <div className="page">
249:       <header className="page__header">
250:         <div>
251:           <div className="eyebrow">Plan</div>
252:           <h1>Action plan</h1>
253:           <p>Tasks are grounded in official implementation examples, points of focus and assessment objectives. Drag cards between columns; open one to work its checklist or hand it to an agent.</p>
254:         </div>
255:         <div className="page__actions">
256:           <Segmented
257:             label="View"
258:             value={view}
259:             onChange={setView}
260:             options={[
261:               { id: "board", label: "Board" },
262:               { id: "timeline", label: "Timeline" },
263:             ]}
264:           />
265:           <button
266:             className="btn"
267:             disabled={plan.isPending}
268:             onClick={() =>
269:               plan.mutate(primary, {
270:                 onSuccess: (created) => toast(created.length ? `Planned ${created.length} task(s) from official guidance` : "Every gap already has an open task"),
271:                 onError: (error) => toast(`Could not generate plan: ${(error as Error).message}`, "error"),
272:               })
273:             }
274:           >
275:             <Wand2 size={14} /> {plan.isPending ? "Generating…" : "Generate plan"}
276:           </button>
277:           <button className="btn btn--agent" onClick={() => run("planner", "Plan the next sprint of work for our highest-priority gaps", { framework: primary })}>
278:             <Sparkles size={14} /> Plan with agent
279:           </button>
280:         </div>
281:       </header>
282:       <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ marginBottom: 16, gap: 8 }}>
283:         <select className="select" style={{ width: 220, maxWidth: "100%" }} value={framework} onChange={(e) => setFramework(e.target.value)} aria-label="Filter by framework">
284:           <option value="all">All frameworks</option>
285:           {workspace.data?.frameworks.map((f) => (
286:             <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
287:               {badgeOf(f.id)}
288:             </option>
289:           ))}
290:         </select>
291:         <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
292:           {filtered.length} task(s) · {filtered.filter((t) => t.status === "done").length} done
293:         </span>
294:         <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
295:         <form
296:           className="row"
297:           style={{ minWidth: 0, maxWidth: "100%" }}
298:           onSubmit={(e) => {
299:             e.preventDefault();
300:             if (newTitle.trim()) create.mutate(newTitle.trim(), {
301:               onSuccess: () => { setNewTitle(""); toast("Task added to To do"); },
302:               onError: (error) => toast(`Could not add task: ${(error as Error).message}`, "error"),
303:             });
304:           }}
305:         >
306:           <input className="input" style={{ width: 280, maxWidth: "100%", minWidth: 0 }} aria-label="Task title" placeholder="Quick add a task…" value={newTitle} onChange={(e) => setNewTitle(e.target.value)} />
307:           <button className="btn btn--icon" aria-label={create.isPending ? "Adding task" : "Add task"} disabled={create.isPending || !newTitle.trim()}>
308:             {create.isPending ? <span className="btn__spinner" aria-hidden /> : <Plus size={15} />}
309:           </button>
310:         </form>
311:       </div>
312:       {view === "board" ? (
313:         <div className="board">
314:           {COLUMNS.map((col) => {
315:             const items = filtered.filter((t) => t.status === col);
316:             return (
317:               <section
318:                 key={col}
319:                 className={`board__col ${over === col ? "is-over" : ""}`}
320:                 onDragOver={(e) => {
321:                   e.preventDefault();
322:                   setOver(col);
323:                 }}
324:                 onDragLeave={() => setOver(null)}
325:                 onDrop={(e) => {
326:                   const id = e.dataTransfer.getData("text/task");
327:                   setOver(null);
328:                   if (!id || tasks.find((task) => task.id === id)?.status === col) return;
329:                   if (pendingMovesRef.current[id]) {
330:                     toast("This task is still saving its previous move");
331:                     return;
332:                   }
333:                   const next = { ...pendingMovesRef.current, [id]: col };
334:                   pendingMovesRef.current = next;
335:                   setPendingMoves(next);
336:                   move.mutate({ id, status: col });
337:                 }}
338:                 aria-label={TASK_STATUS_LABEL[col]}
339:               >
340:                 <div className="board__head">
341:                   <span className="eyebrow">{TASK_STATUS_LABEL[col]}</span>
342:                   <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
343:                     {items.length}
344:                   </span>
345:                 </div>
346:                 {items.map((t) => (
347:                   <TaskCard key={t.id} task={t} saving={!!pendingMoves[t.id]} onOpen={() => setOpen(t)} />
348:                 ))}
349:               </section>
350:             );
351:           })}
352:         </div>
353:       ) : (
354:         <Timeline tasks={filtered} onOpen={setOpen} />
355:       )}
356:       {view === "board" && !filtered.length && (
357:         <div style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
358:           <Empty title="No tasks yet">
359:             Use <strong>Generate plan</strong> to turn your gaps into scheduled work, or ask the Planner agent. <Columns3 size={12} /> <CalendarRange size={12} />
360:           </Empty>
361:         </div>
362:       )}
363:       {current && <TaskDialog task={current} saving={!!pendingMoves[current.id]} onClose={() => setOpen(null)} />}
364:     </div>
365:   );
366: }

FILE apps/web/src/pages/PoliciesPage.tsx SHA256 d4450b3ff973339b4e6f397c6dd2c6677d14d6aa9566f8748ed4e234e34bc5e1
1: /** Policies: versioned lifecycle (draft → in review → approved → published), agent drafting. */
2: import { ArrowLeft, CheckCircle2, Edit3, FileText, Send, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
3: import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
4: import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
5: import { useRunAgent } from "../components/inspector/Inspector.tsx";
6: import { AgentBadge, CodeTag, Dialog, Empty, toast } from "../components/ui/index.tsx";
7: import { api } from "../lib/api.ts";
8: import { useCan } from "../lib/auth.ts";
9: import { relativeTime } from "../lib/format.ts";
10: import { Markdown } from "../lib/markdown.tsx";
11: import { useGraph, usePolicies, useWorkspace, useWsMutation } from "../lib/queries.ts";
12: import type { Policy } from "../lib/types.ts";
13:
14: const STATUS_COLOR: Record<Policy["status"], string> = {
15:   draft: "var(--color-on-surface-muted)",
16:   "in-review": "var(--color-tertiary)",
17:   approved: "var(--color-status-implemented)",
18:   published: "var(--color-status-verified)",
19:   retired: "var(--color-status-not-applicable)",
20: };
21:
22: function DraftDialog({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
23:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
24:   const workspace = useWorkspace(ws);
25:   const fw = workspace.data?.frameworks[0]?.id ?? "nist-csf-2.0";
26:   const graph = useGraph(fw);
27:   const run = useRunAgent();
28:   const groups = (graph.data?.nodes ?? []).filter((n) => !n.assessable && n.depth === 1);
29:   const [pick, setPick] = useState<string>("");
30:   useEffect(() => {
31:     if (!pick && groups[0]) setPick(groups[0].id);
32:   }, [groups, pick]);
33:   return (
34:     <Dialog
35:       title="Draft a policy with the Policy Author"
36:       onClose={onClose}
37:       footer={
38:         <>
39:           <button className="btn" onClick={onClose}>
40:             Cancel
41:           </button>
42:           <button className="btn btn--agent" disabled={!pick} onClick={() => (run("policy-author", "Draft the policy that governs the selected category", { nodeIds: [pick], framework: fw }), onClose())}>
43:             <Sparkles size={14} /> Draft policy
44:           </button>
45:         </>
46:       }
47:     >
48:       <div className="field">
49:         <label>Which area should the policy govern?</label>
50:         <select className="select" value={pick} onChange={(e) => setPick(e.target.value)}>
51:           {groups.map((g) => (
52:             <option key={g.id} value={g.id}>
53:               {g.code} — {g.title}
54:             </option>
55:           ))}
56:         </select>
57:         <span className="field__hint">The draft is composed from the official outcomes and implementation examples, tailored to your organization, with a requirements mapping across frameworks. You review and approve it.</span>
58:       </div>
59:     </Dialog>
60:   );
61: }
62:
63: export function PoliciesPage() {
64:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
65:   const { data: policies = [] } = usePolicies(ws);
66:   const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
67:   // Narrow screens show the list until a policy is opened (desktop shows both panes).
68:   const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);
69:   const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
70:   const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
71:   const [drafting, setDrafting] = useState(false);
72:   const policy = policies.find((p) => p.id === selected) ?? policies[0];
73:   const update = useWsMutation(ws, (patch: Partial<Policy>) => api.patch<Policy>(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/policies/${policy!.id}`, patch));
74:   useEffect(() => {
75:     setEditing(false);
76:   }, [policy?.id]);
77:   const canApprove = useCan("work.approve");
78:   const act = (patch: Partial<Policy>, msg: string) => update.mutate(patch, { onSuccess: () => toast(msg), onError: (e) => toast((e as Error).message, "error") });
79:   return (
80:     <div className="page master-detail" data-pane={opened ? "detail" : "list"} style={{ ["--master" as string]: "380px" }}>
81:       <aside className="stack master-detail__master">
82:         <div className="row">
83:           <h1 style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-headline-lg-family)", fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 600, flex: 1 }}>Policies</h1>
84:           <button className="btn btn--agent btn--sm" onClick={() => setDrafting(true)}>
85:             <Sparkles size={13} /> Draft
86:           </button>
87:         </div>
88:         <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
89:           Approved policies automatically become evidence for the requirements they govern, valid until their next review date.
90:         </p>
91:         {policies.map((p) => (
92:           <button key={p.id} className={`runrow ${policy?.id === p.id ? "is-selected" : ""}`} onClick={() => (setSelected(p.id), setOpened(true))}>
93:             <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
94:               <FileText size={14} />
95:               <strong style={{ flex: 1 }}>{p.title}</strong>
96:               <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: STATUS_COLOR[p.status] }}>
97:                 {p.status}
98:               </span>
99:             </div>
100:             <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginTop: 4 }}>
101:               v{p.version} · {p.requirementIds.length} requirement(s) · updated {relativeTime(p.updatedAt)} {p.origin === "agent" ? "· " : ""}
102:               {p.origin === "agent" ? <AgentBadge label="drafted by agent" /> : null}
103:             </div>
104:           </button>
105:         ))}
106:         {!policies.length && <Empty title="No policies yet">Ask the Policy Author to draft your first one.</Empty>}
107:       </aside>
108:       <section className="master-detail__detail">
109:         <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm master-detail__back" onClick={() => setOpened(false)}>
110:           <ArrowLeft size={14} aria-hidden /> All policies
111:         </button>
112:         {policy ? (
113:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16, maxWidth: 900 }}>
114:             <div className="row" style={{ alignItems: "flex-start", gap: 12 }}>
115:               <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
116:                 <div className="eyebrow">
117:                   Version {policy.version} · <span style={{ color: STATUS_COLOR[policy.status] }}>{policy.status}</span>
118:                   {policy.approvedBy ? ` · approved by ${policy.approvedBy} ${relativeTime(policy.approvedAt)}` : ""}
119:                 </div>
120:                 <h2 style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-headline-lg-family)", fontSize: 26, fontWeight: 600, marginTop: 6 }}>{policy.title}</h2>
121:               </div>
122:               {!editing && (
123:                 <button
124:                   className="btn"
125:                   onClick={() => {
126:                     setDraft(policy.body);
127:                     setEditing(true);
128:                   }}
129:                 >
130:                   <Edit3 size={14} /> Edit
131:                 </button>
132:               )}
133:               {policy.status === "draft" && (
134:                 <button className="btn" onClick={() => act({ status: "in-review" }, "Submitted for review")}>
135:                   <Send size={14} /> Submit for review
136:                 </button>
137:               )}
138:               {(policy.status === "draft" || policy.status === "in-review") && canApprove && (
139:                 <button className="btn btn--primary" onClick={() => act({ status: "approved" }, "Policy approved — recorded as evidence for its requirements")}>
140:                   <CheckCircle2 size={14} /> Approve
141:                 </button>
142:               )}
143:               {policy.status === "approved" && canApprove && (
144:                 <button className="btn btn--primary" onClick={() => act({ status: "published" }, "Policy published")}>
145:                   Publish
146:                 </button>
147:               )}
148:             </div>
149:             <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 4 }}>
150:               {policy.requirementIds.map((id) => (
151:                 <CodeTag key={id} id={id} />
152:               ))}
153:             </div>
154:             {editing ? (
155:               <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
156:                 <textarea className="textarea mono" style={{ minHeight: "55vh", fontSize: 13 }} value={draft} onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)} aria-label="Policy body (Markdown)" />
157:                 <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: "flex-end" }}>
158:                   <button className="btn" onClick={() => setEditing(false)}>
159:                     Cancel
160:                   </button>
161:                   <button
162:                     className="btn btn--primary"
163:                     onClick={() =>
164:                       update.mutate(
165:                         { body: draft },
166:                         {
167:                           onSuccess: (p) => {
168:                             setEditing(false);
169:                             toast(p.version > policy.version ? `Saved as v${p.version} — re-approval required` : "Saved");
170:                           },
171:                         },
172:                       )
173:                     }
174:                   >
175:                     Save
176:                   </button>
177:                 </div>
178:               </div>
179:             ) : (
180:               <div className="panel">
181:                 <Markdown text={policy.body} />
182:               </div>
183:             )}
184:           </div>
185:         ) : (
186:           <Empty title="Select a policy" />
187:         )}
188:       </section>
189:       {drafting && <DraftDialog onClose={() => setDrafting(false)} />}
190:     </div>
191:   );
192: }

FILE apps/web/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx SHA256 2192bcf2aac1a05d29e7acf1e47ff09b3a215398f1eff8ad0ffe81ffc292162d
1: /**
2:  * CSF 2.0 Organizational Profile & Tiers.
3:  * - Tier assessment with NIST's own statements (CSWP 29, Appendix B, Table 2).
4:  * - Current vs Target Profile per Category as a bullet chart (bar = current,
5:  *   tick = target, faint band = gap) with a numeric table twin.
6:  */
7: import { Download, ExternalLink } from "lucide-react";
8: import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
9: import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
10: import { StatusBar, StatusLegend, toast } from "../components/ui/index.tsx";
11: import { api, corpusFileUrl, exportUrl } from "../lib/api.ts";
12: import { useFrameworkState, useGraph, useMeta, useWorkspace, useWsMutation } from "../lib/queries.ts";
13: import type { LeanNode } from "../lib/types.ts";
14: import { split } from "../lib/media.ts";
15:
16: const FW = "nist-csf-2.0";
17:
18: interface Row {
19:   node: LeanNode;
20:   current: number;
21:   target: number;
22:   units: number;
23:   gaps: number;
24: }
25:
26: function BulletChart({ rows, functions }: { rows: Row[]; functions: LeanNode[] }) {
27:   const [hover, setHover] = useState<string | null>(null);
28:   const x = (v: number) => `${(v / 4) * 100}%`;
29:   return (
30:     <div className="panel" style={{ padding: 0 }}>
31:       <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ padding: "12px 16px", gap: "8px 16px", borderBottom: "1px solid var(--color-outline)" }}>
32:         <span className="eyebrow">Current vs target profile · mean implementation level by category (0–4)</span>
33:         <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
34:         <span className="row" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 12 }}>
35:           <span style={{ width: 14, height: 8, borderRadius: "0 4px 4px 0", background: "var(--color-framework-csf)" }} /> Current
36:         </span>
37:         <span className="row" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 12 }}>
38:           <span style={{ width: 2, height: 14, background: "var(--color-on-surface)" }} /> Target
39:         </span>
40:         <span className="row" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 12 }}>
41:           <span style={{ width: 14, height: 8, background: "var(--color-primary-container)" }} /> Gap
42:         </span>
43:       </div>
44:       <div role="table" aria-label="Current and target profile by category" style={{ padding: "8px 0 12px" }}>
45:         <div role="row" className="bullet__row bullet__row--head">
46:           <span role="columnheader" className="eyebrow">
47:             Category
48:           </span>
49:           <span role="columnheader" className="bullet__axis">
50:             {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((t) => (
51:               <span key={t} className="mono" style={{ left: x(t) }}>
52:                 {t}
53:               </span>
54:             ))}
55:           </span>
56:           <span role="columnheader" className="eyebrow" style={{ textAlign: "right" }}>
57:             Cur · Tgt · Gaps
58:           </span>
59:         </div>
60:         {functions.map((fn) => (
61:           <div key={fn.id}>
62:             <div className="bullet__group eyebrow">
63:               {fn.code} · {fn.title}
64:             </div>
65:             {rows
66:               .filter((r) => r.node.parentId === fn.id)
67:               .map((r) => (
68:                 <div
69:                   key={r.node.id}
70:                   role="row"
71:                   className={`bullet__row ${hover === r.node.id ? "is-hover" : ""}`}
72:                   tabIndex={0}
73:                   onMouseEnter={() => setHover(r.node.id)}
74:                   onMouseLeave={() => setHover(null)}
75:                   onFocus={() => setHover(r.node.id)}
76:                   onBlur={() => setHover(null)}
77:                   aria-label={`${r.node.code} ${r.node.title}: current ${r.current.toFixed(1)}, target ${r.target.toFixed(1)}, ${r.gaps} of ${r.units} outcomes below target`}
78:                 >
79:                   <span role="cell" style={{ minWidth: 0, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
80:                     <span className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-primary)", marginRight: 8 }}>
81:                       {r.node.code}
82:                     </span>
83:                     <span className="muted">{r.node.title}</span>
84:                   </span>
85:                   <span role="cell" className="bullet__track">
86:                     {[1, 2, 3].map((t) => (
87:                       <span key={t} className="bullet__grid" style={{ left: x(t) }} />
88:                     ))}
89:                     {r.target > r.current && <span className="bullet__gap" style={{ left: x(r.current), width: `calc(${x(r.target)} - ${x(r.current)})` }} />}
90:                     <span className="bullet__bar" style={{ width: x(r.current) }} />
91:                     <span className="bullet__target" style={{ left: x(r.target) }} />
92:                     {hover === r.node.id && (
93:                       // Opens toward the middle of the chart, so it never widens the page.
94:                       <span
95:                         className="tooltip"
96:                         style={{
97:                           position: "absolute",
98:                           bottom: "calc(100% + 6px)",
99:                           top: "auto",
100:                           width: "max-content",
101:                           maxWidth: "min(280px, 100%)",
102:                           whiteSpace: "normal",
103:                           ...(Math.max(r.current, r.target) > 2 ? { right: `calc(100% - ${x(Math.max(r.current, r.target))})`, left: "auto" } : { left: x(Math.max(r.current, r.target)) }),
104:                         }}
105:                       >
106:                         <strong className="mono">{r.current.toFixed(1)}</strong> current · <strong className="mono">{r.target.toFixed(1)}</strong> target · {r.gaps}/{r.units} below target
107:                       </span>
108:                     )}
109:                   </span>
110:                   <span role="cell" className="mono" style={{ textAlign: "right", fontSize: 12, fontVariantNumeric: "tabular-nums" }}>
111:                     {r.current.toFixed(1)} · {r.target.toFixed(1)} · <span style={{ color: r.gaps ? "var(--color-on-surface)" : "var(--color-on-surface-muted)" }}>{r.gaps}</span>
112:                   </span>
113:                 </div>
114:               ))}
115:           </div>
116:         ))}
117:       </div>
118:     </div>
119:   );
120: }

122: function TierAssessment() {
123:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
124:   const meta = useMeta();
125:   const workspace = useWorkspace(ws);
126:   const existing = workspace.data?.workspace.tierAssessment;
127:   const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, number>>(() => ({ ...(existing?.answers ?? {}) }));
128:   const [touched, setTouched] = useState(false);
129:   useEffect(() => {
130:     if (!touched && existing) setAnswers({ ...existing.answers });
131:   }, [existing, touched]);
132:   const save = useWsMutation(ws, () => api.post(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/tiers`, { answers }));
133:   const dims = meta.data?.tiers.dimensions ?? [];
134:   const names = meta.data?.tiers.names ?? [];
135:   const complete = dims.every((d) => answers[d.id]);
136:   return (
137:     <div className="panel">
138:       <div className="panel__head">
139:         <h2>CSF Tiers self-assessment</h2>
140:         <span className="spacer" />
141:         <a className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }} href={corpusFileUrl("nist-csf-2.0/core/NIST.CSWP.29.pdf", 29)} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
142:           NIST CSWP 29, Appendix B, Table 2 <ExternalLink size={11} />
143:         </a>
144:       </div>
145:       {existing && (
146:         <div className="grid grid--3" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
147:           {[
148:             ["Governance", existing.governanceTier],
149:             ["Management", existing.managementTier],
150:             ["Overall", existing.overallTier],
151:           ].map(([label, tier]) => (
152:             <div key={label as string} className="metric">
153:               <span className="eyebrow">{label as string}</span>
154:               <span className="metric__value" style={{ fontSize: 32 }}>
155:                 Tier {tier as number}
156:               </span>
157:               <span className="metric__sub">{names[(tier as number) - 1]}</span>
158:             </div>
159:           ))}
160:         </div>
161:       )}
162:       <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 12 }}>
163:         Choose the statement that best describes your organization today. The statements are NIST's notional illustration of the Tiers, quoted verbatim. A Tier is credited only when practices consistently meet it (floor of the mean), and the overall Tier is the lower of governance and management.
164:       </p>
165:       <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 14 }}>
166:         {dims.map((d) => (
167:           <fieldset key={d.id} style={{ border: 0, padding: 0, margin: 0 }}>
168:             <legend style={{ fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: 8 }}>
169:               {d.question} <span className="eyebrow" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>{d.area}</span>
170:             </legend>
171:             <div className="grid grid--4" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
172:               {d.statements.map((s, i) => {
173:                 const checked = answers[d.id] === i + 1;
174:                 return (
175:                   <label key={i} className="panel panel--raised" style={{ padding: 10, cursor: "pointer", borderColor: checked ? "var(--color-primary)" : undefined, background: checked ? "var(--color-primary-container)" : undefined, fontSize: 12.5, lineHeight: 1.45 }}>
176:                     <input type="radio" name={d.id} className="sr-only" checked={checked} onChange={() => {
177:                         setTouched(true);
178:                         setAnswers({ ...answers, [d.id]: i + 1 });
179:                       }} />
180:                     <div className="eyebrow" style={{ marginBottom: 4, color: checked ? "var(--color-on-primary-container)" : undefined }}>
181:                       Tier {i + 1} · {names[i]}
182:                     </div>
183:                     {s}
184:                   </label>
185:                 );
186:               })}
187:             </div>
188:           </fieldset>
189:         ))}
190:       </div>
191:       <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: "flex-end", marginTop: 16 }}>
192:         <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
193:           {Object.keys(answers).length}/{dims.length} answered
194:         </span>
195:         <button className="btn btn--primary" disabled={!complete || save.isPending} onClick={() => save.mutate(undefined, { onSuccess: () => toast("Tier assessment recorded in the audit trail") })}>
196:           Save assessment
197:         </button>
198:       </div>
199:     </div>
200:   );
201: }

203: export function ProfilePage() {
204:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
205:   const workspace = useWorkspace(ws);
206:   const graph = useGraph(FW);
207:   const state = useFrameworkState(workspace.data?.workspace.id, FW);
208:   const { rows, functions } = useMemo(() => {
209:     const nodes = graph.data?.nodes ?? [];
210:     const functions = nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === "function");
211:     const rows: Row[] = nodes
212:       .filter((n) => n.kind === "category")
213:       .map((cat) => {
214:         const units = nodes.filter((n) => n.parentId === cat.id).map((n) => state.data?.units[n.id]).filter((u) => u && u.applicable);
215:         const current = units.length ? units.reduce((s, u) => s + u!.current, 0) / units.length : 0;
216:         const target = units.length ? units.reduce((s, u) => s + u!.target, 0) / units.length : 0;
217:         return { node: cat, current, target, units: units.length, gaps: units.filter((u) => u!.target > u!.current).length };
218:       });
219:     return { rows, functions };
220:   }, [graph.data, state.data]);
221:   const overall = state.data?.overall;
222:   return (
223:     <div className="page">
224:       <header className="page__header">
225:         <div>
226:           <div className="eyebrow">NIST CSF 2.0</div>
227:           <h1>Organizational Profile & Tiers</h1>
228:           <p>Your Current Profile, Target Profile and the gap between them — the core CSF 2.0 workflow. Export uses NIST's official Organizational Profile template columns.</p>
229:         </div>
230:         <div className="page__actions">
231:           <a className="btn" href={exportUrl(ws, "csf-profile.csv")}>
232:             <Download size={14} /> Organizational Profile (CSV)
233:           </a>
234:           <a className="btn" href={exportUrl(ws, "readiness.md")}>
235:             <Download size={14} /> Readiness report
236:           </a>
237:           <Link className="btn btn--primary" to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${FW}`}>
238:             Open in 3D
239:           </Link>
240:         </div>
241:       </header>
242:       {overall && (
243:         <div className="panel" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
244:           <div className="row" style={{ gap: 24, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
245:             <div>
246:               <div className="eyebrow">Readiness</div>
247:               <div className="metric__value">{Math.round(overall.readiness * 100)}%</div>
248:             </div>
249:             <div>
250:               <div className="eyebrow">Mean level</div>
251:               <div className="metric__value" style={{ fontSize: 32 }}>
252:                 {overall.current.toFixed(1)} <small>→ {overall.target.toFixed(1)}</small>
253:               </div>
254:             </div>
255:             <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 280 }}>
256:               <StatusBar counts={overall.counts} height={10} />
257:               <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
258:                 <StatusLegend counts={overall.counts} />
259:               </div>
260:             </div>
261:           </div>
262:         </div>
263:       )}
264:       <div className="grid split" style={split(1.25, 1)}>
265:         <BulletChart rows={rows} functions={functions} />
266:         <TierAssessment />
267:       </div>
268:     </div>
269:   );
270: }

1: /** Reports, audit trail, trust center and the official corpus library. */

AICPA text is withheld from AI models unless your organization holds AICPA's permission.
