96: export function ReportsPage() {
97:   const canExport = useCan("workspace.export");
98:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
99:   const workspace = useWorkspace(ws);
100:   const audit = useAuditVerification(ws);
101:   const activity = useActivity(ws, 200);
102:   const enabled = workspace.data?.frameworks.map((f) => f.id) ?? [];
103:   const tc = workspace.data?.workspace.trustCenter;
104:   const [headline, setHeadline] = useState<string | null>(null);
105:   const [contact, setContact] = useState<string | null>(null);
106:   const saveTrust = useWsMutation(ws, (body: { enabled: boolean; headline?: string; contactEmail?: string }) => api.patch(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}`, { trustCenter: body }));
107:   const exports: { kind: string; title: string; description: string; icon: React.ReactNode; when?: boolean }[] = [
108:     { kind: "csf-profile.csv", title: "CSF 2.0 Organizational Profile", description: "Current and Target Profile using NIST's official template columns.", icon: <FileSpreadsheet size={18} />, when: enabled.includes("nist-csf-2.0") },
109:     { kind: "readiness.md", title: "Readiness report", description: "Readiness, evidence coverage and largest gaps for every enabled framework.", icon: <FileText size={18} /> },
110:     { kind: "action-plan.csv", title: "Action plan", description: "Tasks with dates, effort, checklist progress and their official basis.", icon: <FileSpreadsheet size={18} /> },
111:     { kind: "evidence-index.csv", title: "Evidence index", description: "Every evidence item with provenance, validity, reviewer and SHA-256.", icon: <FileSpreadsheet size={18} /> },
112:     { kind: "ai-rmf-profile.csv", title: "NIST AI RMF profile", description: "Current and target state per AI RMF outcome, with Playbook and Generative AI Profile actions.", icon: <FileSpreadsheet size={18} />, when: enabled.includes("nist-ai-rmf") },
113:     { kind: "soc2-pbc.csv", title: "SOC 2 PBC request list", description: "What an auditor will request per criterion and what is on file.", icon: <FileSpreadsheet size={18} />, when: enabled.includes("aicpa-tsc-2017") },
114:     { kind: "oscal-ssp.json", title: "OSCAL System Security Plan", description: "OSCAL 1.1.2 SSP with categorization and control implementation status.", icon: <FileJson size={18} />, when: enabled.includes("nist-sp-800-53-r5") },
115:     { kind: "oscal-poam.json", title: "OSCAL POA&M", description: "Plan of Action and Milestones for every requirement below target.", icon: <FileJson size={18} /> },
116:   ];
117:   return (
118:     <div className="page">
119:       <header className="page__header">
120:         <div>
121:           <div className="eyebrow">Reports</div>
122:           <h1>Reports, audit trail & trust</h1>
123:           <p>Readiness exports prepare you for an independent assessment. Visua never issues audit opinions, reports on controls or certifications.</p>
124:         </div>
125:       </header>
126:       <div className="grid grid--3" style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
127:         {!canExport && (
128:           <div className="panel muted" role="note" style={{ gridColumn: "1 / -1" }}>
129:             Exports are available to auditors, contributors and above. Ask an admin if you need a report.
130:           </div>
131:         )}
132:         {exports
133:           .filter((e) => e.when !== false && canExport)
134:           .map((e) => (
135:             <a key={e.kind} className="panel" href={exportUrl(ws, e.kind)} style={{ color: "inherit", textDecoration: "none" }}>
136:               <div className="row" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
137:                 <span style={{ color: "var(--color-primary)" }}>{e.icon}</span>
138:                 <strong style={{ flex: 1 }}>{e.title}</strong>
139:                 <Download size={15} className="muted" />
140:               </div>
141:               <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13, marginTop: 8 }}>
142:                 {e.description}
143:               </p>
144:             </a>
145:           ))}
146:       </div>
147:       <div className="grid split" style={split(1.4, 1)}>
148:         <div className="panel" style={{ padding: 0, overflow: "hidden" }}>
149:           <div className="panel__head" style={{ padding: "16px 16px 0" }}>
150:             <ShieldCheck size={16} style={{ color: audit.data?.valid ? "var(--color-status-verified)" : "var(--color-status-at-risk)" }} />
151:             <h2>Tamper-evident audit trail</h2>
152:             <span className="spacer" />
153:             {audit.data && (
154:               <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 11.5, color: audit.data.valid ? "var(--color-status-verified)" : "var(--color-status-at-risk)" }} title={audit.data.head}>
155:                 {audit.data.valid ? `✓ ${audit.data.events} events · head ${audit.data.head?.slice(0, 10)}…` : `✗ broken at #${audit.data.brokenAt}`}
156:               </span>
157:             )}
158:           </div>
159:           <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12.5, padding: "8px 16px 12px" }}>
160:             Each event stores the SHA-256 of the previous one. Editing, deleting or reordering any past event breaks the chain, and verification pinpoints where.
161:           </p>
162:           <div className="table-box" style={{ maxHeight: 520 }}>
163:             <table className="table table--audit">
164:               <thead>
165:                 <tr>
166:                   <th>#</th>
167:                   <th>When</th>
168:                   <th>Actor</th>
169:                   <th>Event</th>
170:                   <th>Hash</th>
171:                 </tr>
172:               </thead>
173:               <tbody>
174:                 {(activity.data ?? []).map((a) => (
175:                   <tr key={a.id}>
176:                     <td className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
177:                       {a.seq}
178:                     </td>
179:                     <td className="muted" style={{ whiteSpace: "nowrap", fontSize: 12 }}>
180:                       {relativeTime(a.at)}
181:                     </td>
182:                     <td style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: a.actor.startsWith("agent") ? "var(--color-tertiary)" : undefined }}>{truncate(a.actor, 28)}</td>
183:                     <td style={{ fontSize: 12.5 }}>{truncate(a.summary, 110)}</td>
184:                     <td className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 10.5 }} title={a.hash}>
185:                       {a.hash?.slice(0, 8)}
186:                     </td>
187:                   </tr>
188:                 ))}
189:               </tbody>
190:             </table>
191:           </div>
192:         </div>
193:         <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
194:           <div className="panel">
195:             <div className="panel__head">
196:               <Globe size={16} />
197:               <h2>Trust center</h2>
198:               <span className="spacer" />
199:               <label className="row" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 13 }}>
200:                 <input type="checkbox" checked={!!tc?.enabled} onChange={(e) => saveTrust.mutate({ enabled: e.target.checked, headline: tc?.headline, contactEmail: tc?.contactEmail })} />
201:                 Public
202:               </label>
203:             </div>
204:             <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 12 }}>
205:               Publishes only computed facts — readiness, evidence coverage, approved policies and live monitoring results. No free-text claims.
206:             </p>
207:             <p style={{ fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 12 }}>
208:               Readiness published for:{" "}
209:               {workspace.data?.frameworks.filter((f) => f.onTrustCenter).map((f) => f.shortName).join(", ") || "no framework"}.{" "}
210:               <Link to={`/w/${ws}/settings`}>Choose in Settings</Link>
211:             </p>
212:             <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
213:               <div className="field">
214:                 <label>Headline</label>
215:                 <input className="input" value={headline ?? tc?.headline ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setHeadline(e.target.value)} />
216:               </div>
217:               <div className="field">
218:                 <label>Security contact</label>
219:                 <input className="input" value={contact ?? tc?.contactEmail ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setContact(e.target.value)} />
220:               </div>
221:               <div className="row row--wrap">
222:                 {tc?.enabled && (
223:                   <Link className="btn" to={`/trust/${workspace.data?.workspace.slug}`} target="_blank">
224:                     View public page <ExternalLink size={13} />
225:                   </Link>
226:                 )}
227:                 <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
228:                 <button className="btn btn--primary" onClick={() => saveTrust.mutate({ enabled: !!tc?.enabled, headline: headline ?? tc?.headline, contactEmail: contact ?? tc?.contactEmail }, { onSuccess: () => toast("Trust center updated") })}>
229:                   Save
230:                 </button>
231:               </div>
232:             </div>
233:           </div>
234:           <Library />
235:         </div>
236:       </div>
237:     </div>
238:   );
239: }

FILE apps/web/src/pages/RmfPage.tsx SHA256 5293b16dd848fcabb71e034477e93783a025643ae203ea216ccf5b2848259078
1: /**
2:  * NIST RMF program: the seven-step lifecycle (SP 800-37r2), FIPS 199
3:  * categorization → SP 800-53B baseline, tailoring, authorization decision
4:  * and OSCAL exports.
5:  */
6: import { Download, Plus, Telescope, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
7: import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
8: import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
9: import { categorize, type ImpactLevel, type RmfSettings } from "@visua/core";
10: import { CodeTag, Empty, StatusBar, StatusChip, toast } from "../components/ui/index.tsx";
11: import { api, exportUrl } from "../lib/api.ts";
12: import { useCan } from "../lib/auth.ts";
13: import { shortDate } from "../lib/format.ts";
14: import { useFrameworkState, useGraph, useMeta, useWorkspace, useWsMutation } from "../lib/queries.ts";
15: import { CosaisPanel } from "../components/overlays/OverlayPanels.tsx";
16:
17: const LEVELS: ImpactLevel[] = ["low", "moderate", "high"];
18: const IMPACT_COLOR: Record<ImpactLevel, string> = { low: "var(--color-status-implemented)", moderate: "var(--color-status-in-progress)", high: "var(--color-status-at-risk)" };
19:
20: function Lifecycle({ wsId }: { wsId: string }) {
21:   const graph = useGraph("nist-rmf");
22:   const state = useFrameworkState(wsId, "nist-rmf");
23:   const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(null);
24:   const steps = (graph.data?.nodes ?? []).filter((n) => n.kind === "step");
25:   const firstIncomplete = steps.find((s) => (state.data?.groups[s.id]?.readiness ?? 0) < 1)?.id;
26:   const active = open ?? firstIncomplete ?? steps[0]?.id;
27:   const tasks = (graph.data?.nodes ?? []).filter((n) => n.parentId === active);
28:   return (
29:     <div className="panel">
30:       <div className="panel__head">
31:         <h2>RMF lifecycle · SP 800-37 Rev. 2</h2>
32:         <span className="spacer" />
33:         <Link to={`/w/${wsId}/observatory/nist-rmf`} className="btn btn--sm">
34:           <Telescope size={13} /> 3D
35:         </Link>
36:       </div>
37:       <div className="rmf-steps" role="tablist" aria-label="RMF steps">
38:         {steps.map((s, i) => {
39:           const g = state.data?.groups[s.id];
40:           const pct = Math.round((g?.readiness ?? 0) * 100);
41:           return (
42:             <button key={s.id} role="tab" aria-selected={active === s.id} className={`rmf-step ${active === s.id ? "is-active" : ""}`} onClick={() => setOpen(s.id)}>
43:               <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
44:                 {i + 1}
45:               </span>
46:               <strong>{s.title}</strong>
47:               <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
48:                 {pct}%
49:               </span>
50:               {g && <StatusBar counts={g.counts} height={4} />}
51:             </button>
52:           );
53:         })}
54:       </div>
55:       <div className="rmf-tasks">
56:         {tasks.map((t) => {
57:           const u = state.data?.units[t.id];
58:           return (
59:             <Link key={t.id} className="rmf-task" to={`/w/${wsId}/observatory/nist-rmf?select=${encodeURIComponent(t.id)}`} title={t.text}>
60:               <span className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-primary)", fontSize: 12 }}>
61:                 {t.code}
62:               </span>
63:               <span className="rmf-task__title">{t.title}</span>
64:               {u && <StatusChip status={u.status} />}
65:             </Link>
66:           );
67:         })}
68:       </div>
69:     </div>
70:   );
71: }

73: function Categorize({ ws, rmf }: { ws: string; rmf: RmfSettings }) {
74:   const meta = useMeta();
75:   const [systemName, setSystemName] = useState(rmf.systemName);
76:   const [types, setTypes] = useState<RmfSettings["informationTypes"]>(rmf.informationTypes);
77:   const [privacy, setPrivacy] = useState(!!rmf.privacyBaseline);
78:   useEffect(() => {
79:     setTypes(rmf.informationTypes);
80:     setSystemName(rmf.systemName);
81:     setPrivacy(!!rmf.privacyBaseline);
82:   }, [rmf]);
83:   const result = categorize(types);
84:   const apply = useWsMutation(ws, () => api.post(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/rmf/categorize`, { systemName, informationTypes: types, privacyBaseline: privacy }));
85:   const canDecide = useCan("work.approve");
86:   const set = (i: number, patch: Partial<RmfSettings["informationTypes"][number]>) => setTypes(types.map((t, ti) => (ti === i ? { ...t, ...patch } : t)));
87:   return (
88:     <div className="panel">
89:       <div className="panel__head">
90:         <h2>Categorize · FIPS 199</h2>
91:         <span className="spacer" />
92:         <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
93:           High-water mark per FIPS 200 selects the SP 800-53B baseline
94:         </span>
95:       </div>
96:       <div className="field" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
97:         <label>System name</label>
98:         <input className="input" value={systemName} onChange={(e) => setSystemName(e.target.value)} />
99:       </div>
100:       <table className="table table--stack">
101:         <thead>
102:           <tr>
103:             <th>Information type</th>
104:             <th>Confidentiality</th>
105:             <th>Integrity</th>
106:             <th>Availability</th>
107:             <th />
108:           </tr>
109:         </thead>
110:         <tbody>
111:           {types.map((t, i) => (
112:             <tr key={`${t.id}-${i}`}>
113:               <td data-label="Information type">
114:                 <input className="input" aria-label="Information type" value={t.name} onChange={(e) => set(i, { name: e.target.value, id: t.id || e.target.value.toLowerCase().replace(/\W+/g, "-") })} />
115:               </td>
116:               {(["confidentiality", "integrity", "availability"] as const).map((obj) => (
117:                 <td key={obj} data-label={obj[0]!.toUpperCase() + obj.slice(1)}>
118:                   <select className="select" aria-label={`${t.name}: ${obj}`} value={t[obj]} onChange={(e) => set(i, { [obj]: e.target.value as ImpactLevel })} style={{ color: IMPACT_COLOR[t[obj]] }}>
119:                     {LEVELS.map((l) => (
120:                       <option key={l} value={l}>
121:                         {l}
122:                       </option>
123:                     ))}
124:                   </select>
125:                 </td>
126:               ))}
127:               <td>
128:                 <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm btn--icon" aria-label="Remove" onClick={() => setTypes(types.filter((_, ti) => ti !== i))}>
129:                   <Trash2 size={13} />
130:                 </button>
131:               </td>
132:             </tr>
133:           ))}
134:         </tbody>
135:       </table>
136:       <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6, marginTop: 10 }}>
137:         <button className="btn btn--sm" onClick={() => setTypes([...types, { id: `type-${types.length + 1}`, name: "New information type", confidentiality: "low", integrity: "low", availability: "low" }])}>
138:           <Plus size={13} /> Add type
139:         </button>
140:         {(meta.data?.exampleInformationTypes ?? [])
141:           .filter((e) => !types.some((t) => t.id === e.id))
142:           .slice(0, 4)
143:           .map((e) => (
144:             <button key={e.id} className="chip" onClick={() => setTypes([...types, e])} title="Provisional impact levels — review for your context">
145:               + {e.name}
146:             </button>
147:           ))}
148:       </div>
149:       <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 16, gap: 16, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
150:         <div className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
151:           SC = {"{"}(confidentiality, <span style={{ color: IMPACT_COLOR[result.confidentiality] }}>{result.confidentiality}</span>), (integrity, <span style={{ color: IMPACT_COLOR[result.integrity] }}>{result.integrity}</span>), (availability,{" "}
152:           <span style={{ color: IMPACT_COLOR[result.availability] }}>{result.availability}</span>){"}"}
153:         </div>
154:         <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
155:         <label className="row" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 13 }}>
156:           <input type="checkbox" checked={privacy} onChange={(e) => setPrivacy(e.target.checked)} /> Include the PRIVACY baseline (PII processed)
157:         </label>
158:         <button className="btn btn--primary" disabled={!types.length || !canDecide} title={canDecide ? undefined : "Categorization is an approver decision"} onClick={() => apply.mutate(undefined, { onSuccess: () => toast(`Categorized ${result.overall.toUpperCase()} — baseline applied`) })}>
159:           Apply {result.overall.toUpperCase()} baseline
160:         </button>
161:       </div>
162:     </div>
163:   );
164: }

166: function Tailoring({ ws, rmf }: { ws: string; rmf: RmfSettings }) {
167:   const [code, setCode] = useState("");
168:   const [action, setAction] = useState<"add" | "remove">("remove");
169:   const [rationale, setRationale] = useState("");
170:   const tailor = useWsMutation(ws, (v: { nodeId: string; action: "add" | "remove" | "reset"; rationale: string }) => api.post(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/rmf/tailor`, v));
171:   const canDecide = useCan("work.approve");
172:   return (
173:     <div className="panel">
174:       <div className="panel__head">
175:         <h2>Select & tailor · SP 800-53B</h2>
176:       </div>
177:       <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
178:         {rmf.tailoring.some((t) => t.source) && (
179:           <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
180:             + {rmf.tailoring.filter((t) => t.source).length} control(s) added by an adopted AI overlay (see COSAiS below)
181:           </div>
182:         )}
183:         {rmf.tailoring.filter((t) => !t.source).map((t) => (
184:           <div key={t.nodeId} className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 8, fontSize: 13 }}>
185:             <CodeTag id={t.nodeId} />
186:             <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: t.action === "add" ? "var(--color-status-implemented)" : "var(--color-status-in-progress)" }}>
187:               {t.action === "add" ? "+ added" : "− removed"}
188:             </span>
189:             <span className="muted" style={{ flex: "1 1 160px", minWidth: 0 }}>
190:               {t.rationale}
191:             </span>
192:             {canDecide && (
193:               <button className="btn btn--quiet btn--sm" onClick={() => tailor.mutate({ nodeId: t.nodeId, action: "reset", rationale: "" })}>
194:                 Reset
195:               </button>
196:             )}
197:           </div>
198:         ))}
199:         {!rmf.tailoring.some((t) => !t.source) && <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>No tailoring decisions yet — the {rmf.baseline?.toUpperCase()} baseline applies as published.</div>}
200:       </div>
201:       <form
202:         className="row row--wrap"
203:         style={{ gap: 8, marginTop: 12 }}
204:         onSubmit={(e) => {
205:           e.preventDefault();
206:           tailor.mutate(
207:             { nodeId: `nist-sp-800-53-r5:${code.trim().toUpperCase()}`, action, rationale },
208:             { onSuccess: () => (setCode(""), setRationale(""), toast("Tailoring recorded")), onError: (err) => toast((err as Error).message, "error") },
209:           );
210:         }}
211:       >
212:         <input className="input mono" style={{ width: 120 }} placeholder="AC-2(4)" value={code} onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)} aria-label="Control" />
213:         <select className="select" style={{ width: 120 }} value={action} onChange={(e) => setAction(e.target.value as "add" | "remove")} aria-label="Action">
214:           <option value="remove">Remove</option>
215:           <option value="add">Add</option>
216:         </select>
217:         <input className="input" style={{ flex: "1 1 200px", minWidth: 0 }} placeholder="Rationale (required, visible to assessors)" value={rationale} onChange={(e) => setRationale(e.target.value)} />
218:         <button className="btn" disabled={!canDecide || !code.trim() || rationale.trim().length < 8} title={canDecide ? undefined : "Tailoring is an approver decision"}>
219:           Record
220:         </button>
221:       </form>
222:     </div>
223:   );
224: }

226: function Authorize({ ws, rmf }: { ws: string; rmf: RmfSettings }) {
227:   const auth = rmf.authorization ?? { decision: "pending" as const };
228:   const [decision, setDecision] = useState(auth.decision);
229:   const [ao, setAo] = useState(auth.authorizingOfficial ?? "");
230:   const [expires, setExpires] = useState(auth.expiresAt?.slice(0, 10) ?? "");
231:   const [rationale, setRationale] = useState(auth.rationale ?? "");
232:   const canDecide = useCan("work.approve");
233:   const save = useWsMutation(ws, () => api.post(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/rmf/authorize`, { decision, authorizingOfficial: ao || undefined, expiresAt: expires || undefined, rationale: rationale || undefined }));
234:   const labels: Record<string, string> = { pending: "Pending", ato: "Authorization to Operate (ATO)", iatt: "Interim Authorization to Test (IATT)", dato: "Denial of Authorization (DATO)" };
235:   return (
236:     <div className="panel">
237:       <div className="panel__head">
238:         <h2>Authorize · Task R-4</h2>
239:         <span className="spacer" />
240:         <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 12, color: auth.decision === "ato" ? "var(--color-status-implemented)" : auth.decision === "dato" ? "var(--color-status-at-risk)" : "var(--color-on-surface-muted)" }}>
241:           {labels[auth.decision]}
242:           {auth.decidedAt && auth.decision !== "pending" ? ` · ${shortDate(auth.decidedAt)}` : ""}
243:         </span>
244:       </div>
245:       <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 12 }}>
246:         Visua records the authorizing official's decision; it never makes it. Review the SSP, assessment results and POA&M before deciding.
247:       </p>
248:       <div className="grid grid--2" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
249:         <div className="field">
250:           <label>Decision</label>
251:           <select className="select" value={decision} onChange={(e) => setDecision(e.target.value as typeof decision)}>
252:             {Object.entries(labels).map(([k, v]) => (
253:               <option key={k} value={k}>
254:                 {v}
255:               </option>
256:             ))}
257:           </select>
258:         </div>
259:         <div className="field">
260:           <label>Authorizing official</label>
261:           <input className="input" value={ao} onChange={(e) => setAo(e.target.value)} />
262:         </div>
263:         <div className="field">
264:           <label>Authorization termination date</label>
265:           <input className="input" type="date" value={expires} onChange={(e) => setExpires(e.target.value)} />
266:         </div>
267:         <div className="field">
268:           <label>Rationale / terms and conditions</label>
269:           <input className="input" value={rationale} onChange={(e) => setRationale(e.target.value)} />
270:         </div>
271:       </div>
272:       <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: "flex-end", marginTop: 12 }}>
273:         <button className="btn btn--primary" disabled={!canDecide} title={canDecide ? undefined : "Only approvers record the authorizing official's decision"} onClick={() => save.mutate(undefined, { onSuccess: () => toast("Authorization decision recorded in the audit trail") })}>
274:           Record decision
275:         </button>
276:       </div>
277:     </div>
278:   );
279: }

281: export function RmfPage() {
282:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
283:   const { data } = useWorkspace(ws);
284:   const controls = useFrameworkState(data?.workspace.id, "nist-sp-800-53-r5");
285:   const graph = useGraph("nist-sp-800-53-r5");
286:   const enable = useWsMutation(ws, () => api.put(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/frameworks/nist-sp-800-53-r5`, { enabled: true }));
287:   const settings = data?.frameworks.find((f) => f.id === "nist-sp-800-53-r5")?.settings.rmf;
288:   const families = useMemo(() => (graph.data?.nodes ?? []).filter((n) => n.kind === "family"), [graph.data]);
289:   if (!data) return <div className="page muted">Loading…</div>;
290:   if (!settings) {
291:     return (
292:       <div className="page">
293:         <Empty title="NIST RMF is not enabled for this workspace">
294:           <p style={{ margin: "8px 0 12px" }}>Enable SP 800-53 Rev. 5 to run the Risk Management Framework: categorize your system, select and tailor a baseline, implement and assess controls, and record the authorization decision.</p>
295:           <button className="btn btn--primary" onClick={() => enable.mutate(undefined)}>
296:             Enable NIST RMF / SP 800-53
297:           </button>
298:         </Empty>
299:       </div>
300:     );
301:   }
302:   return (
303:     <div className="page">
304:       <header className="page__header">
305:         <div>
306:           <div className="eyebrow">NIST Risk Management Framework</div>
307:           <h1>{settings.systemName}</h1>
308:           <p>
309:             {settings.categorization ? `Categorized ${settings.categorization.overall.toUpperCase()} (C ${settings.categorization.confidentiality}, I ${settings.categorization.integrity}, A ${settings.categorization.availability})` : "Not yet categorized"} · {settings.baseline?.toUpperCase()} baseline
310:             {settings.privacyBaseline ? " + PRIVACY" : ""} · {controls.data?.overall.total ?? 0} controls in scope · {settings.tailoring.length} tailoring decision(s)
311:           </p>
312:         </div>
313:         <div className="page__actions">
314:           <a className="btn" href={exportUrl(ws, "oscal-ssp.json")}>
315:             <Download size={14} /> OSCAL SSP
316:           </a>
317:           <a className="btn" href={exportUrl(ws, "oscal-poam.json")}>
318:             <Download size={14} /> OSCAL POA&M
319:           </a>
320:           <Link className="btn btn--primary" to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/nist-sp-800-53-r5`}>
321:             <Telescope size={14} /> Controls in 3D
322:           </Link>
323:         </div>
324:       </header>
325:       <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
326:         <Lifecycle wsId={data.workspace.id} />
327:         <div className="grid grid--2" style={{ alignItems: "start" }}>
328:           <Categorize ws={ws} rmf={settings} />
329:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
330:             <Tailoring ws={ws} rmf={settings} />
331:             <Authorize ws={ws} rmf={settings} />
332:           </div>
333:         </div>
334:         <CosaisPanel ws={ws} />
335:         <div className="panel">
336:           <div className="panel__head">
337:             <h2>Implement & assess · control families</h2>
338:             <span className="spacer" />
339:             <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
340:               SP 800-53A objectives are in each control's inspector
341:             </span>
342:           </div>
343:           <div className="grid grid--4" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
344:             {families.map((f) => {
345:               const g = controls.data?.groups[f.id];
346:               if (!g || !g.total) return null;
347:               return (
348:                 <Link key={f.id} to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/nist-sp-800-53-r5?select=${encodeURIComponent(f.id)}`} className="panel panel--raised" style={{ color: "inherit", padding: 12 }}>
349:                   <div className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
350:                     <span className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-primary)" }}>
351:                       {f.code}
352:                     </span>
353:                     <span style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: 12.5, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>{f.title}</span>
354:                     <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
355:                       {Math.round(g.readiness * 100)}%
356:                     </span>
357:                   </div>
358:                   <div style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
359:                     <StatusBar counts={g.counts} height={6} />
360:                   </div>
361:                   <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11.5, marginTop: 6 }}>
362:                     {g.total} in scope · {g.gaps} gaps
363:                   </div>
364:                 </Link>
365:               );
366:             })}
367:           </div>
368:         </div>
369:       </div>
370:     </div>
371:   );
372: }

57: /** A switch; agent autonomy switches use the terracotta agent tone. */
58: function Toggle({ checked, onChange, label, tone = "primary" }: { checked: boolean; onChange: (v: boolean) => void; label: string; tone?: "primary" | "agent" }) {
59:   const on = tone === "agent" ? "var(--color-tertiary)" : "var(--color-primary)";
60:   const knob = tone === "agent" ? "var(--color-on-tertiary)" : "var(--color-on-primary)";
61:   return (
62:     <button role="switch" aria-checked={checked} aria-label={label} onClick={() => onChange(!checked)} style={{ width: 38, height: 22, borderRadius: 99, border: "1px solid var(--color-outline-strong)", background: checked ? on : "var(--color-surface-raised)", position: "relative", cursor: "pointer", flexShrink: 0 }}>
63:       <span style={{ position: "absolute", top: 2, left: checked ? 18 : 2, width: 16, height: 16, borderRadius: 99, background: checked ? knob : "var(--color-on-surface-muted)", transition: "left var(--dur-fast)" }} />
64:     </button>
65:   );
66: }

68: export function SettingsPage() {
69:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
70:   const navigate = useNavigate();
71:   const { data } = useWorkspace(ws);
72:   const meta = useMeta();
73:   const [profile, setProfile] = useState<OrganizationProfile | null>(null);
74:   const [name, setName] = useState("");
75:   useEffect(() => {
76:     if (data) {
77:       setProfile(data.workspace.profile);
78:       setName(data.workspace.name);
79:     }
80:   }, [data]);
81:   const save = useWsMutation(ws, (body: Record<string, unknown>) => api.patch(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}`, body));

1: /**
2:  * SOC 2 program: examination scope (Trust Services Categories, Type 1/Type 2,
3:  * observation window), readiness by criteria series, the DC 200 system
4:  * description checklist and the PBC request list.
5:  */
6: import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
7: import { Download, FileText, Telescope } from "lucide-react";
8: import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
9: import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
10: import type { Soc2Settings } from "@visua/core";
11: import { Empty, Segmented, StatusBar, toast } from "../components/ui/index.tsx";
12: import { api, exportUrl } from "../lib/api.ts";
13: import { shortDate } from "../lib/format.ts";
14: import { useFrameworkState, useGraph, useMeta, useWorkspace, useWsMutation } from "../lib/queries.ts";
15: import { split } from "../lib/media.ts";

17: const TSC = "aicpa-tsc-2017";
18: type Category = Soc2Settings["categories"][number];
19: const CATEGORIES: { id: Category; label: string; group: string; note: string }[] = [
20:   { id: "security", label: "Security", group: "CC", note: "Required — the Common Criteria apply to every SOC 2 examination." },
21:   { id: "availability", label: "Availability", group: "A", note: "Uptime, capacity, backup and recovery commitments." },
22:   { id: "processing-integrity", label: "Processing integrity", group: "PI", note: "Complete, valid, accurate, timely and authorized processing." },
23:   { id: "confidentiality", label: "Confidentiality", group: "C", note: "Information designated as confidential is protected." },
24:   { id: "privacy", label: "Privacy", group: "P", note: "Personal information is collected, used, retained, disclosed and disposed of per commitments." },
25: ];

27: interface DescriptionItem {
28:   id: string;
29:   title: string;
30:   /** Official DC 200 text — only when this installation holds a licensed copy. */
31:   text?: string;
32:   items?: { marker: string; text: string }[];
33:   page?: number;
34:   licensed: boolean;
35:   derived: { status: "drafted" | "needs-input" | "not-applicable"; facts: string[] };
36: }

38: function ObservationWindow({ start, end }: { start?: string; end?: string }) {
39:   if (!start || !end) return null;
40:   const s = new Date(start).getTime();
41:   const e = new Date(end).getTime();
42:   const now = Date.now();
43:   const total = Math.max(1, Math.round((e - s) / 86_400_000));
44:   const elapsed = Math.min(total, Math.max(0, Math.round((now - s) / 86_400_000)));
45:   const pct = (elapsed / total) * 100;
46:   const phase = now < s ? "Not started" : now > e ? "Window closed — ready for fieldwork" : `${elapsed} of ${total} days elapsed`;
47:   return (
48:     <div style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
49:       <div className="row" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 6 }}>
50:         <span className="mono muted">{shortDate(start)}</span>
51:         <span style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: "center" }}>{phase}</span>
52:         <span className="mono muted">{shortDate(end)}</span>
53:       </div>
54:       <div style={{ position: "relative", height: 8, borderRadius: 99, background: "var(--color-surface-raised)", border: "1px solid var(--color-outline)" }} role="img" aria-label={`Observation window: ${phase}`}>
55:         <div style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, width: `${pct}%`, borderRadius: 99, background: "var(--color-primary)", opacity: 0.8 }} />
56:       </div>
57:       <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginTop: 8 }}>
58:         A Type 2 report covers operating effectiveness over this period: evidence must show controls operated throughout it, not just on the day of the audit.
59:       </p>
60:     </div>
61:   );
62: }
63:
64: function Scope({ ws, settings }: { ws: string; settings: Soc2Settings }) {
65:   const [draft, setDraft] = useState(settings);
66:   useEffect(() => setDraft(settings), [settings]);
67:   const save = useWsMutation(ws, (soc2: Soc2Settings) => api.put(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/frameworks/${TSC}`, { soc2 }));
68:   const toggle = (c: Category) => {
69:     if (c === "security") return;
70:     setDraft({ ...draft, categories: draft.categories.includes(c) ? draft.categories.filter((x) => x !== c) : [...draft.categories, c] });
71:   };
72:   const dirty = JSON.stringify(draft) !== JSON.stringify(settings);
73:   return (
74:     <div className="panel">
75:       <div className="panel__head">
76:         <h2>Examination scope</h2>
77:         <span className="spacer" />
78:         <Segmented
79:           label="Report type"
80:           value={draft.reportType}
81:           onChange={(v) => setDraft({ ...draft, reportType: v as Soc2Settings["reportType"] })}
82:           options={[
83:             { id: "type1", label: "Type 1" },
84:             { id: "type2", label: "Type 2" },
85:           ]}
86:         />
87:       </div>
88:       <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
89:         {CATEGORIES.map((c) => {
90:           const on = c.id === "security" || draft.categories.includes(c.id);
91:           return (
92:             <label key={c.id} className="row" style={{ gap: 10, alignItems: "flex-start", cursor: c.id === "security" ? "default" : "pointer" }}>
93:               <input type="checkbox" checked={on} disabled={c.id === "security"} onChange={() => toggle(c.id)} style={{ marginTop: 3 }} />
94:               <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>
95:                 <span style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{c.label}</span> <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>{c.group}</span>
96:                 <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
97:                   {c.note}
98:                 </div>
99:               </span>
100:             </label>
101:           );
102:         })}
103:       </div>
104:       <div className="grid grid--3" style={{ gap: 10, marginTop: 14 }}>
105:         {draft.reportType === "type2" && (
106:           <>
107:             <div className="field">
108:               <label>Observation start</label>
109:               <input className="input" type="date" value={draft.observationStart ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, observationStart: e.target.value })} />
110:             </div>
111:             <div className="field">
112:               <label>Observation end</label>
113:               <input className="input" type="date" value={draft.observationEnd ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, observationEnd: e.target.value })} />
114:             </div>
115:           </>
116:         )}
117:         <div className="field">
118:           <label>Service auditor (CPA firm)</label>
119:           <input className="input" value={draft.auditFirm ?? ""} placeholder="Independent CPA firm" onChange={(e) => setDraft({ ...draft, auditFirm: e.target.value })} />
120:         </div>
121:       </div>
122:       {draft.reportType === "type2" && <ObservationWindow start={settings.observationStart} end={settings.observationEnd} />}
123:       <div className="row" style={{ justifyContent: "flex-end", marginTop: 12 }}>
124:         <button className="btn btn--primary" disabled={!dirty} onClick={() => save.mutate({ ...draft, categories: Array.from(new Set<Category>(["security", ...draft.categories])) }, { onSuccess: () => toast("SOC 2 scope saved — criteria re-scoped") })}>
125:           Save scope
126:         </button>
127:       </div>
128:     </div>
129:   );
130: }

132: function SystemDescription({ ws }: { ws: string }) {
133:   const { data } = useQuery({ queryKey: ["ws", ws, "soc2-description"], queryFn: () => api.get<{ source: { title: string; path?: string }; items: DescriptionItem[] }>(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/soc2/description`), retry: false });
134:   const licensed = data?.items.some((d) => d.licensed);
135:   if (!data) return null;
136:   const tone = { drafted: "var(--color-status-implemented)", "needs-input": "var(--color-status-in-progress)", "not-applicable": "var(--color-on-surface-muted)" } as const;
137:   const label = { drafted: "Drafted from workspace", "needs-input": "Needs your input", "not-applicable": "Not applicable" } as const;
138:   return (
139:     <div className="panel">
140:       <div className="panel__head">
141:         <FileText size={16} />
142:         <h2>System description · DC 200</h2>
143:         <span className="spacer" />
144:         <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
145:           Management's description must address each description criterion
146:         </span>
147:       </div>
148:       <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
149:         {data.items.map((d) => (
150:           <div key={d.id} className="row" style={{ alignItems: "flex-start", gap: 10 }}>
151:             <span className="code" style={{ flexShrink: 0, cursor: "default" }}>
152:               {d.id}
153:             </span>
154:             <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
155:               <div style={{ fontSize: 13.5, fontWeight: 500 }}>{d.title}</div>
156:               {d.text && (
157:                 <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }} title={d.page ? `DC 200, p. ${d.page}` : undefined}>
158:                   {d.text}
159:                   {d.items && d.items.length > 0 ? ` ${d.items.map((i) => `${i.marker} ${i.text}`).join(" · ")}` : ""}
160:                 </div>
161:               )}
162:               {d.derived.facts.length > 0 && (
163:                 <ul style={{ margin: "6px 0 0", paddingLeft: 18, fontSize: 12.5 }}>
164:                   {d.derived.facts.slice(0, 5).map((f, i) => (
165:                     <li key={i}>{f}</li>
166:                   ))}
167:                   {d.derived.facts.length > 5 && <li className="muted">+{d.derived.facts.length - 5} more</li>}
168:                 </ul>
169:               )}
170:             </div>
171:             <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 11, whiteSpace: "nowrap", color: tone[d.derived.status] }}>
172:               {label[d.derived.status]}
173:             </span>
174:           </div>
175:         ))}
176:       </div>
177:       <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginTop: 12 }}>
178:         Source: {data.source.title}
179:         {licensed ? " (© AICPA, local copy)" : " — titles are Visua's summaries; the official text is not bundled"}. Visua drafts only what it can derive from recorded facts; everything else is left for management to write.
180:       </p>
181:     </div>
182:   );
183: }

185: export function Soc2Page() {
186:   const { ws = "" } = useParams();
187:   const meta = useMeta();
188:   const { data } = useWorkspace(ws);
189:   const graph = useGraph(TSC);
190:   const state = useFrameworkState(data?.workspace.id, TSC);
191:   const enable = useWsMutation(ws, () => api.put(`/workspaces/${encodeURIComponent(ws)}/frameworks/${TSC}`, { enabled: true }));
192:   const loaded = meta.data?.frameworks.some((f) => f.id === TSC);
193:   const fw = data?.frameworks.find((f) => f.id === TSC);
194:   const nodes = graph.data?.nodes ?? [];
195:   const groups = useMemo(() => nodes.filter((n) => n.depth === 0).map((g) => ({ group: g, series: nodes.filter((n) => n.parentId === g.id) })), [nodes]);
196:
197:   if (!data || !meta.data) return <div className="page muted">Loading…</div>;
198:   if (!loaded) {
199:     return (
200:       <div className="page">
201:         <Empty title="The AICPA Trust Services Criteria are not ingested">
202:           <p style={{ margin: "8px 0 0" }}>
203:             Place the official criteria in <code className="mono">corpus/aicpa-soc2/</code> and run <code className="mono">pnpm ingest</code>.
204:           </p>
205:         </Empty>
206:       </div>
207:     );
208:   }
209:   if (!fw?.settings.soc2) {
210:     return (
211:       <div className="page">
212:         <Empty title="SOC 2 is not enabled for this workspace">
213:           <p style={{ margin: "8px 0 12px" }}>Prepare for a SOC 2 examination against the 2017 Trust Services Criteria (revised points of focus, 2022). Visua tracks readiness, evidence over the observation window and the auditor's request list.</p>
214:           <button className="btn btn--primary" onClick={() => enable.mutate(undefined)}>
215:             Enable SOC 2
216:           </button>
217:         </Empty>
218:       </div>
219:     );
220:   }
221:   const s = fw.settings.soc2;
222:   return (
223:     <div className="page">
224:       <header className="page__header">
225:         <div>
226:           <div className="eyebrow">SOC 2 · AICPA Trust Services Criteria (2017, points of focus rev. 2022)</div>
227:           <h1>
228:             {s.reportType === "type2" ? "Type 2" : "Type 1"} readiness · {Math.round(fw.readiness * 100)}%
229:           </h1>
230:           <p>
231:             {fw.total} in-scope criteria across {s.categories.length} categor{s.categories.length === 1 ? "y" : "ies"} · {fw.gaps} gaps · evidence coverage {Math.round(fw.evidenceCoverage * 100)}%{s.auditFirm ? ` · auditor ${s.auditFirm}` : ""}. Readiness is not an audit opinion — only an independent CPA firm issues a SOC 2 report.
232:           </p>
233:         </div>
234:         <div className="page__actions">
235:           <a className="btn" href={exportUrl(ws, "soc2-pbc.csv")}>
236:             <Download size={14} /> PBC request list
237:           </a>
238:           <Link className="btn btn--primary" to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${TSC}`}>
239:             <Telescope size={14} /> Criteria in 3D
240:           </Link>
241:         </div>
242:       </header>
243:       <div className="grid split" style={split(1, 1.25)}>
244:         <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
245:           <Scope ws={ws} settings={s} />
246:           <SystemDescription ws={ws} />
247:         </div>
248:         <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
249:           {groups.map(({ group, series }) => {
250:             const g = state.data?.groups[group.id];
251:             const inScope = !!g?.total;
252:             return (
253:               <div key={group.id} className="panel" style={{ opacity: inScope ? 1 : 0.55 }}>
254:                 <div className="panel__head">
255:                   <h2>{group.title}</h2>
256:                   <span className="spacer" />
257:                   {inScope ? (
258:                     <span className="mono" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
259:                       {Math.round((g?.readiness ?? 0) * 100)}% · {g?.gaps ?? 0} gaps
260:                     </span>
261:                   ) : (
262:                     <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
263:                       Not in scope
264:                     </span>
265:                   )}
266:                 </div>
267:                 {inScope && (
268:                   <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
269:                     {series.map((se) => {
270:                       const sg = state.data?.groups[se.id];
271:                       const criteria = nodes.filter((n) => n.parentId === se.id);
272:                       return (
273:                         <div key={se.id} className="series-row">
274:                           <Link to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${TSC}?select=${encodeURIComponent(se.id)}`} style={{ color: "inherit", minWidth: 0 }}>
275:                             <span className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-primary)", fontSize: 12.5 }}>{se.code}</span> <span style={{ fontSize: 12.5 }}>{se.title}</span>
276:                           </Link>
277:                           <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>{sg && <StatusBar counts={sg.counts} height={8} />}</div>
278:                           <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 11.5, textAlign: "right" }}>
279:                             {criteria.length} criteria
280:                           </span>
281:                         </div>
282:                       );
283:                     })}
284:                   </div>
285:                 )}
286:               </div>
287:             );
288:           })}
289:         </div>
290:       </div>
291:     </div>
292:   );
293: }

FILE apps/web/src/pages/ThreatsPage.tsx SHA256 287a17ed3cc9346b6c14e49ac5c339103cf2546c379e0fe87f2740a5eec80be1
1: /**
2:  * Threat views: MITRE ATLAS, the OWASP Top 10s for LLM and agentic applications,
3:  * and NIST AI 100-2, seen through the requirements a workspace implements.
4:  *
5:  * Threats are never assessed. Each one's coverage is derived from the requirements
6:  * its publishers link to it, and every link keeps its status: final, draft (NIST
7:  * drafts), unreviewed (OWASP's community crosswalk) or superseded.
8:  */
9: import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
10: import { Info, Search, Telescope } from "lucide-react";
11: import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
12: import { Link, useNavigate, useParams, useSearchParams } from "react-router-dom";
13: import { Inspector } from "../components/inspector/Inspector.tsx";
14: import { COVERAGE_LABEL, CoverageBar, CoverageChip, CoverageGlyph, CoverageLegend, coverageColor, LINK_STATUS_HELP, LinkStatusBadge, ThreatLinkFilter } from "../components/threats/Coverage.tsx";
15: import { Empty, FrameworkBadge, Segmented } from "../components/ui/index.tsx";
16: import { api } from "../lib/api.ts";
17: import { truncate } from "../lib/format.ts";
18: import { threatCatalogs } from "../lib/frameworks.ts";
19: import { keys } from "../lib/queries.ts";
20: import type { CoverageState, LinkStatus, ThreatCatalogState, ThreatCoverage, ThreatNode, ThreatsOverview } from "../lib/types.ts";
21: import { useUi } from "../state/ui.ts";

23: const enc = encodeURIComponent;

25: type Show = "all" | "linked" | "gaps";
26: const SHOW: { id: Show; label: string }[] = [
27:   { id: "all", label: "All" },
28:   { id: "linked", label: "With links" },
29:   { id: "gaps", label: "Open or partial" },
30: ];

32: const visible = (c: ThreatCoverage | undefined, show: Show) => {
33:   if (!c || show === "all") return true;
34:   if (show === "linked") return c.state !== "unmapped";
35:   return c.state === "open" || c.state === "partial";
36: };

38: function Cell({ node, coverage, selected, onSelect, subs, tabIndex, onFocus }: { node: ThreatNode; coverage?: ThreatCoverage; selected: boolean; onSelect: (id: string) => void; subs?: number; tabIndex?: number; onFocus?: () => void }) {
39:   const state: CoverageState = coverage?.state ?? "unmapped";
40:   return (
41:     <button
42:       type="button"
43:       data-key={node.id}
44:       tabIndex={tabIndex}
45:       onFocus={onFocus}
46:       className={`atlas-cell ${selected ? "is-selected" : ""}`}
47:       style={{ borderLeftColor: coverageColor(state) }}
48:       onClick={() => onSelect(node.id)}
49:       title={`${node.code} ${node.title} — ${COVERAGE_LABEL[state]}${coverage?.inScope ? ` (${coverage.met}/${coverage.inScope} linked requirements at target)` : ""}`}
50:       aria-pressed={selected}
51:     >
52:       <span className="row" style={{ gap: 5 }}>
53:         <span style={{ color: state === "unmapped" ? "var(--color-on-surface-muted)" : coverageColor(state), display: "inline-flex" }}>
54:           <CoverageGlyph state={state} size={11} />
55:         </span>
56:         <span className="mono atlas-cell__code">{node.label ?? node.code}</span>
57:         {subs ? <span className="mono muted atlas-cell__subs">+{subs}</span> : null}
58:       </span>
59:       <span className="atlas-cell__name">{node.title}</span>
60:     </button>
61:   );
62: }

64: /**
65:  * The ATLAS matrix: one group per tactic (its heading, then its techniques), laid out
66:  * as columns. It takes a single tab stop; arrow keys move within a tactic (up, down)
67:  * and across tactics (left, right), Home and End jump within a tactic, Enter opens.
68:  */
69: function AtlasMatrix({ data, selected, onSelect, show, query }: { data: ThreatCatalogState; selected: string | null; onSelect: (id: string) => void; show: Show; query: string }) {
70:   const { tactics, byTactic, subs } = useMemo(() => {
71:     const tactics = data.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === "tactic").sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
72:     const techniques = data.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === "technique");
73:     const subs = new Map<string, number>();
74:     for (const n of data.nodes) if (n.kind === "sub-technique" && n.parentId) subs.set(n.parentId, (subs.get(n.parentId) ?? 0) + 1);
75:     const byTactic = new Map(tactics.map((t) => [t.id, techniques.filter((n) => (n.tactics ?? []).includes(t.id)).sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title))]));
76:     return { tactics, byTactic, subs };
77:   }, [data.nodes]);
78:   const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
79:   const match = (n: ThreatNode) => !q || n.code.toLowerCase().includes(q) || n.title.toLowerCase().includes(q);
80:   const columns = tactics.map((t) => ({ tactic: t, cells: (byTactic.get(t.id) ?? []).filter((n) => match(n) && visible(data.coverage[n.id], show)) }));
81:   // Keys of the focusable items, column by column: the tactic heading, then its techniques.
82:   const keys = columns.map((c) => [c.tactic.id, ...c.cells.map((n) => n.id)]);
83:   const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
84:   const [active, setActive] = useState<string | null>(null);
85:   const has = (key: string | null) => !!key && keys.some((col) => col.includes(key));
86:   const current = has(active) ? active! : has(selected) ? selected! : (keys[0]?.[0] ?? null);
87:   const onKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
88:     if (!current) return;
89:     const c = keys.findIndex((col) => col.includes(current));
90:     const r = keys[c]!.indexOf(current);
91:     let next: string | undefined;
92:     if (e.key === "ArrowDown") next = keys[c]![Math.min(r + 1, keys[c]!.length - 1)];
93:     else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") next = keys[c]![Math.max(r - 1, 0)];
94:     else if (e.key === "ArrowRight" && c < keys.length - 1) next = keys[c + 1]![Math.min(r, keys[c + 1]!.length - 1)];
95:     else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" && c > 0) next = keys[c - 1]![Math.min(r, keys[c - 1]!.length - 1)];
96:     else if (e.key === "Home") next = keys[c]![0];
97:     else if (e.key === "End") next = keys[c]![keys[c]!.length - 1];
98:     else return;
99:     e.preventDefault();
100:     if (!next) return;
101:     setActive(next);
102:     root.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-key="${CSS.escape(next)}"]`)?.focus();
103:   };
104:   return (
105:     <div ref={root} className="atlas-matrix" role="group" aria-label="MITRE ATLAS matrix: tactics as columns, techniques colored by coverage" aria-describedby="atlas-keys" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
106:       <p id="atlas-keys" className="sr-only">
107:         Arrow keys move between techniques and tactics; Enter opens one.
108:       </p>
109:       {columns.map(({ tactic: t, cells }) => (
110:         <div key={t.id} className="atlas-col" role="group" aria-labelledby={`tactic-${t.code}`}>
111:           <button
112:             type="button"
113:             id={`tactic-${t.code}`}
114:             data-key={t.id}
115:             tabIndex={current === t.id ? 0 : -1}
116:             onFocus={() => setActive(t.id)}
117:             className={`atlas-col__head ${selected === t.id ? "is-selected" : ""}`}
118:             onClick={() => onSelect(t.id)}
119:             title={t.summary}
120:           >
121:             <span className="atlas-col__name">{t.title}</span>
122:             <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 10.5 }}>
123:               {t.code} · {(byTactic.get(t.id) ?? []).length}
124:             </span>
125:           </button>
126:           {cells.length ? (
127:             <ul className="atlas-col__list">
128:               {cells.map((n) => (
129:                 <li key={n.id}>
130:                   <Cell node={n} coverage={data.coverage[n.id]} selected={selected === n.id} onSelect={onSelect} subs={subs.get(n.id)} tabIndex={current === n.id ? 0 : -1} onFocus={() => setActive(n.id)} />
131:                 </li>
132:               ))}
133:             </ul>
134:           ) : (
135:             <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: "4px 6px" }}>
136:               —
137:             </span>
138:           )}
139:         </div>
140:       ))}
141:     </div>
142:   );
143: }

145: function AtlasMitigations({ data, selected, onSelect, query }: { data: ThreatCatalogState; selected: string | null; onSelect: (id: string) => void; query: string }) {
146:   const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
147:   const list = data.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === "mitigation" && (!q || n.code.toLowerCase().includes(q) || n.title.toLowerCase().includes(q)));
148:   return (
149:     <details className="panel">
150:       <summary className="eyebrow" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
151:         ATLAS mitigations ({list.length}) — linked to CSF 2.0 by NIST's draft Cyber AI Profile
152:       </summary>
153:       <div className="threat-grid" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
154:         {list.map((n) => (
155:           <Cell key={n.id} node={n} coverage={data.coverage[n.id]} selected={selected === n.id} onSelect={onSelect} />
156:         ))}
157:       </div>
158:     </details>
159:   );
160: }

162: function RiskCard({ node, coverage, selected, onSelect, nodes }: { node: ThreatNode; coverage?: ThreatCoverage; selected: boolean; onSelect: (id: string) => void; nodes: Map<string, ThreatNode> }) {
163:   const lineage = node.previousEdition ?? node.nextEdition;
164:   return (
165:     <button type="button" className={`threat-card ${selected ? "is-selected" : ""}`} onClick={() => onSelect(node.id)} aria-pressed={selected}>
166:       <span className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
167:         <span className="mono" style={{ color: "var(--color-primary)", fontWeight: 600 }}>
168:           {node.label ?? node.code}
169:         </span>
170:         <strong style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}>{node.title}</strong>
171:         {coverage && <CoverageChip coverage={coverage} />}
172:       </span>
173:       <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12.5, lineHeight: 1.5, textAlign: "left" }}>
174:         {node.summary}
175:       </span>
176:       <span className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 11.5 }}>
177:         {coverage?.frameworks.map((f) => (
178:           <FrameworkBadge key={f} frameworkId={f} />
179:         ))}
180:         {coverage?.best && <LinkStatusBadge status={coverage.best} />}
181:         <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
182:         {lineage && (
183:           <span className="muted mono" title={node.previousEdition ? "Same entry in the previous edition" : "Same entry in the current edition"}>
184:             {node.previousEdition ? "was" : "now"} {lineage.key}
185:             {nodes.get(lineage.nodeId) && nodes.get(lineage.nodeId)!.title !== node.title ? ` (${nodes.get(lineage.nodeId)!.title})` : ""}
186:           </span>
187:         )}
188:       </span>
189:     </button>
190:   );
191: }

193: function RiskList({ data, selected, onSelect, show, query }: { data: ThreatCatalogState; selected: string | null; onSelect: (id: string) => void; show: Show; query: string }) {
194:   const [edition, setEdition] = useState<"current" | "superseded">("current");
195:   const nodes = useMemo(() => new Map(data.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n])), [data.nodes]);
196:   const editions = data.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === "edition");
197:   const root = editions.find((e) => (e.status ?? "current") === edition) ?? editions[0];
198:   const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
199:   const risks = data.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === "risk" && n.parentId === root?.id && visible(data.coverage[n.id], show) && (!q || `${n.code} ${n.title} ${n.summary}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)));
200:   return (
201:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
202:       {editions.length > 1 && (
203:         <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
204:           <Segmented<"current" | "superseded">
205:             label="Edition"
206:             options={editions.map((e) => ({ id: (e.status ?? "current") as "current" | "superseded", label: `${e.label ?? e.code}${e.status === "superseded" ? " (superseded)" : ""}` }))}
207:             value={edition}
208:             onChange={setEdition}
209:           />
210:           {edition === "superseded" && (
211:             <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
212:               Kept because the Agentic Top 10 and NIST's Cyber AI Profile cite its identifiers. Coverage uses those links and the same entry in the current edition.
213:             </span>
214:           )}
215:         </div>
216:       )}
217:       <div className="threat-grid threat-grid--cards">
218:         {risks.map((n) => (
219:           <RiskCard key={n.id} node={n} coverage={data.coverage[n.id]} selected={selected === n.id} onSelect={onSelect} nodes={nodes} />
220:         ))}
221:       </div>
222:     </div>
223:   );
224: }

226: function AttackGroups({ data, selected, onSelect, show, query }: { data: ThreatCatalogState; selected: string | null; onSelect: (id: string) => void; show: Show; query: string }) {
227:   const objectives = data.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === "objective").sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
228:   const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
229:   return (
230:     <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
231:       {objectives.map((o) => {
232:         const attacks = data.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === "attack" && (n.objectives ?? []).includes(o.id) && visible(data.coverage[n.id], show) && (!q || `${n.code} ${n.title}`.toLowerCase().includes(q)));
233:         return (
234:           <section key={o.id} className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
235:             <h3 className="row" style={{ gap: 8, margin: 0, fontSize: 15 }}>
236:               {o.title}
237:               <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
238:                 {o.code} · {(o.taxonomies ?? []).join(" + ")}
239:               </span>
240:             </h3>
241:             <div className="threat-grid">
242:               {attacks.map((n) => (
243:                 <Cell key={n.id} node={n} coverage={data.coverage[n.id]} selected={selected === n.id} onSelect={onSelect} />
244:               ))}
245:               {!attacks.length && <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>No attack matches.</span>}
246:             </div>
247:           </section>
248:         );
249:       })}
250:     </div>
251:   );
252: }

254: const STATUS_ORDER: LinkStatus[] = ["final", "draft", "unreviewed", "superseded"];
255:
256: function Sources({ overview }: { overview: ThreatsOverview }) {
257:   return (
258:     <details className="panel">
259:       <summary className="eyebrow" style={{ cursor: "pointer" }}>
260:         Where the links come from ({overview.sources.reduce((n, s) => n + s.links, 0).toLocaleString()} links, {overview.sources.length} sets)
261:       </summary>

269:                 <LinkStatusBadge status={status} />
270:                 <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
271:                   {LINK_STATUS_HELP[status]}
272:                 </span>
273:               </div>
274:               {sets.map((s) => (
275:                 <div key={s.id} className="row" style={{ gap: 8, fontSize: 12.5, paddingLeft: 8 }}>
276:                   <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{s.authority}</span>
277:                   <span className="muted">
278:                     {s.source.shortName} → {s.target.shortName}
279:                   </span>
280:                   <span className="mono" style={{ width: 48, textAlign: "right" }}>
281:                     {s.links}
282:                   </span>
283:                 </div>
284:               ))}
285:             </div>
286:           );
287:         })}
288:         <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, margin: 0 }}>
289:           No publisher maps ATLAS directly to CSF 2.0, SP 800-53 or the AI RMF, or the OWASP Top 10s to CSF 2.0 or SP 800-53, in a final document. Visua counts a requirement toward a threat when it is linked to the threat, to an ATLAS mitigation of it, or to the same OWASP entry in the other edition.
290:         </p>
291:       </div>
292:     </details>
293:   );
294: }
