296: export function ThreatsPage() {
297:   const { ws = "", catalog } = useParams();
298:   const navigate = useNavigate();
299:   const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams();
300:   const min = useUi((s) => s.threatMin);
301:   const catalogs = threatCatalogs().map((c) => c.id);
302:   const active = catalog && catalogs.includes(catalog) ? catalog : (catalogs[0] ?? "");
303:   const [show, setShow] = useState<Show>("all");
304:   const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
305:   const overview = useQuery({ queryKey: [...keys.workspace(ws), "threats", min], queryFn: () => api.get<ThreatsOverview>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws)}/threats?min=${min}`), enabled: !!ws, placeholderData: keepPreviousData });
306:   const state = useQuery({
307:     queryKey: [...keys.workspace(ws), "threats", active, min],
308:     queryFn: () => api.get<ThreatCatalogState>(`/workspaces/${enc(ws)}/threats/${active}?min=${min}`),
309:     enabled: !!ws,
310:     placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
311:   });
312:   const selected = params.get("select");
313:   const select = (id: string | null) => {
314:     const next = new URLSearchParams(params);
315:     if (id) next.set("select", id);
316:     else next.delete("select");
317:     setParams(next, { replace: true });
318:   };
319:   if (overview.isError) return <div className="page muted">{(overview.error as Error).message}</div>;
320:   const data = overview.data;
321:   if (!data) return <div className="page muted">Loading threat catalogs…</div>;
322:   if (!data.catalogs.length) return <div className="page"><Empty title="No threat catalogs ingested">Run `pnpm ingest` with the corpus in corpus/ai-threats.</Empty></div>;
323:   const current = data.catalogs.find((c) => c.id === active) ?? data.catalogs[0]!;
324:   const view = state.data?.catalog.id === current.id ? state.data : undefined;
325:   return (
326:     <div className={`threats ${selected ? "has-inspector" : ""}`}>
327:       <div className="threats__main">
328:         <div className="page">
329:           <header className="page__header">
330:             <div>
331:               <div className="eyebrow">Threat views · AI systems</div>
332:               <h1>AI threats, seen through your requirements</h1>
333:               <p>
334:                 MITRE ATLAS, the OWASP Top 10s for LLM and agentic applications, and NIST AI 100-2. Threats are not assessed: each one's coverage comes from the requirements its publishers link to it, in the
335:                 frameworks you follow, and every link shows whether it is final, a draft or unreviewed.
336:               </p>
337:             </div>
338:             <div className="page__actions">
339:               <Link className="btn btn--primary" to={`/w/${ws}/observatory/${current.id}`}>
340:                 <Telescope size={14} aria-hidden /> {current.shortName} in 3D
341:               </Link>
342:               <Link className="btn" to={`/w/${ws}/crosswalk`}>
343:                 Threat ring in the Nexus
344:               </Link>
345:             </div>
346:           </header>
347:           <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 16 }}>
348:             <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 12 }}>
349:               <span className="eyebrow">Links counted</span>
350:               <ThreatLinkFilter />
351:               <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
352:               <CoverageLegend />
353:             </div>
354:             <div className="grid grid--4" role="tablist" aria-label="Threat catalogs">
355:               {data.catalogs.map((c) => (
356:                 <button
357:                   key={c.id}
358:                   type="button"
359:                   role="tab"
360:                   aria-selected={c.id === current.id}
361:                   className={`panel threat-catalog ${c.id === current.id ? "is-selected" : ""}`}
362:                   onClick={() => navigate(`/w/${ws}/threats/${c.id}`)}
363:                 >
364:                   <span className="row" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
365:                     <FrameworkBadge frameworkId={c.id} />
366:                     <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
367:                       {c.version}
368:                     </span>
369:                   </span>
370:                   <strong style={{ fontSize: 15, textAlign: "left" }}>{c.shortName}</strong>
371:                   <CoverageBar byState={c.byState} />
372:                   <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, textAlign: "left" }}>
373:                     {c.units} {c.unitLabelPlural} · {c.byState.covered} covered · {c.byState.partial + c.byState.open} with gaps · {c.byState.unmapped} without links
374:                   </span>
375:                 </button>
376:               ))}
377:             </div>
378:             <section className="stack" style={{ gap: 12 }} aria-labelledby="catalog-title">
379:               <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 10 }}>
380:                 <h2 id="catalog-title" className="section-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
381:                   {current.name}
382:                 </h2>
383:                 <span className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
384:                   {current.publisher} · {current.published}
385:                 </span>
386:                 <span style={{ flex: 1 }} />
387:                 <div className="row" style={{ gap: 6 }}>
388:                   <Search size={14} className="muted" aria-hidden />
389:                   <input className="input" style={{ height: 30, minHeight: 30, width: 220 }} placeholder={`Find a ${current.unitLabel}`} value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} aria-label={`Find a ${current.unitLabel}`} />
390:                 </div>
391:                 <Segmented<Show> label="Show" options={SHOW} value={show} onChange={setShow} />
392:               </div>
393:               <p className="muted" style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 13 }}>
394:                 {current.description}
395:               </p>
396:               {current.linkedFrameworks.length > 0 && (
397:                 <div className="row row--wrap" style={{ gap: 6, fontSize: 12 }}>
398:                   <span className="muted">Linked to</span>
399:                   {current.linkedFrameworks.map((f) => (
400:                     <span key={f.id} className="row" style={{ gap: 4 }} title={f.enabled ? "Followed in this workspace" : "Not followed in this workspace: its links count as out of scope"}>
401:                       <FrameworkBadge frameworkId={f.id} />
402:                       <span className="muted">
403:                         {f.threats} {current.unitLabelPlural}
404:                         {f.enabled ? "" : " · not followed"}
405:                       </span>
406:                     </span>
407:                   ))}
408:                 </div>
409:               )}
410:               {current.byState.unmapped === current.units && (
411:                 <div className="callout" role="note">
412:                   <Info size={14} /> No {current.unitLabel} in this catalog has a link at the chosen status.
413:                   {min !== "unreviewed" ? " Include unreviewed links to see OWASP's community crosswalk." : ""}
414:                 </div>
415:               )}
416:               {!view ? (
417:                 <div className="muted">Loading {current.shortName}…</div>
418:               ) : current.id === "mitre-atlas" ? (
419:                 <>
420:                   <AtlasMatrix data={view} selected={selected} onSelect={select} show={show} query={query} />
421:                   <AtlasMitigations data={view} selected={selected} onSelect={select} query={query} />
422:                 </>
423:               ) : current.id === "nist-ai-100-2" ? (
424:                 <AttackGroups data={view} selected={selected} onSelect={select} show={show} query={query} />
425:               ) : (
426:                 <RiskList data={view} selected={selected} onSelect={select} show={show} query={query} />
427:               )}
428:             </section>
429:             {current.weakest.length > 0 && (
430:               <section className="panel stack" style={{ gap: 8 }} aria-labelledby="weakest">
431:                 <h2 id="weakest" className="eyebrow" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
432:                   Least covered {current.unitLabelPlural} with links in your frameworks
433:                 </h2>
434:                 {current.weakest.map((w) => (
435:                   <button key={w.id} type="button" className="xw-group" onClick={() => select(w.id)}>
436:                     <span className="mono" style={{ width: 110 }}>
437:                       {w.code}
438:                     </span>
439:                     <span style={{ flex: 1, overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap", textAlign: "left" }}>{truncate(w.title, 80)}</span>
440:                     <CoverageChip coverage={w.coverage} />
441:                   </button>
442:                 ))}
443:               </section>
444:             )}
445:             <Sources overview={data} />
446:             {current.contentNotice && (
447:               <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 11.5, fontStyle: "italic", margin: 0 }}>
448:                 {current.contentNotice}
449:               </p>
450:             )}
451:           </div>
452:         </div>
453:       </div>
454:       {selected && <Inspector nodeId={selected} onClose={() => select(null)} />}
455:     </div>
456:   );
457: }

FILE apps/web/src/pages/TrustPage.tsx SHA256 9f053b5b4734e5e8f748d6565dc9f6435c8075f0b9be0a706e291979184a92d0
1: /** Public trust center: only computed, evidence-backed facts — no free-text claims. */
2: import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
3: import { CheckCircle2, CircleAlert, FileText, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
4: import { useParams } from "react-router-dom";
5: import { api } from "../lib/api.ts";
6: import { relativeTime } from "../lib/format.ts";
7:
8: interface TrustData {
9:   name: string;
10:   headline: string;
11:   contactEmail?: string;
12:   frameworks: { id: string; name: string; readiness: number; evidenceCoverage: number }[];
13:   policies: { title: string; version: number }[];
14:   monitoring: { title: string; outcome: string; observedAt: string }[];
15:   updatedAt: string;
16: }
17:
18: export function TrustPage() {
19:   const { slug = "" } = useParams();
20:   const { data, error } = useQuery({ queryKey: ["trust", slug], queryFn: () => api.get<TrustData>(`/trust/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}`) });
21:   if (error) return <div className="page muted">This trust center is not public.</div>;
22:   if (!data) return <div className="page muted">Loading…</div>;
23:   return (
24:     <div style={{ height: "100%", overflow: "auto" }}>
25:       <div style={{ maxWidth: 980, margin: "0 auto", padding: "56px 24px" }}>
26:         <div className="eyebrow">Trust center · powered by Visua</div>
27:         <h1 style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-display-lg-family)", fontSize: 38, fontWeight: 600, marginTop: 8 }}>{data.headline}</h1>
28:         <p className="muted" style={{ marginTop: 8, maxWidth: 720 }}>
29:           Every figure on this page is computed from {data.name}'s live compliance workspace: implementation levels, accepted evidence with provenance, approved policies and automated monitoring. Readiness is not an audit opinion or a certification.
30:         </p>
31:         <div className="grid grid--3" style={{ marginTop: 28 }}>
32:           {data.frameworks.map((f) => (
33:             <div key={f.id} className="panel">
34:               <div className="eyebrow">{f.name}</div>
35:               <div className="metric__value" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
36:                 {f.readiness}
37:                 <small>% ready</small>
38:               </div>
39:               <div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 13, marginTop: 6 }}>
40:                 Evidence coverage {f.evidenceCoverage}%
41:               </div>
42:             </div>
43:           ))}
44:         </div>
45:         <div className="grid grid--2" style={{ marginTop: 20, alignItems: "start" }}>
46:           <div className="panel">
47:             <div className="panel__head">
48:               <ShieldCheck size={16} />
49:               <h2>Continuous monitoring</h2>
50:             </div>
51:             <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
52:               {data.monitoring.map((m) => (
53:                 <div key={m.title} className="row" style={{ gap: 8, fontSize: 13 }}>
54:                   {m.outcome === "pass" ? <CheckCircle2 size={15} style={{ color: "var(--color-status-implemented)" }} /> : <CircleAlert size={15} style={{ color: "var(--color-status-in-progress)" }} />}
55:                   <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{m.title}</span>
56:                   <span className="muted mono" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
57:                     {m.outcome} · {relativeTime(m.observedAt)}
58:                   </span>
59:                 </div>
60:               ))}
61:               {!data.monitoring.length && <div className="muted">No automated checks published yet.</div>}
62:             </div>
63:           </div>
64:           <div className="panel">
65:             <div className="panel__head">
66:               <FileText size={16} />
67:               <h2>Approved policies</h2>
68:             </div>
69:             <div className="stack" style={{ gap: 8 }}>
70:               {data.policies.map((p) => (
71:                 <div key={p.title} className="row" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
72:                   <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>{p.title}</span>
73:                   <span className="mono muted" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
74:                     v{p.version}
75:                   </span>
76:                 </div>
77:               ))}
78:               {!data.policies.length && <div className="muted">No approved policies published yet.</div>}
79:             </div>
80:           </div>
81:         </div>
82:         <p className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 12, marginTop: 24 }}>
83:           Last updated {relativeTime(data.updatedAt)}.{data.contactEmail ? ` Security contact: ${data.contactEmail}.` : ""}
84:         </p>
85:       </div>
86:     </div>
87:   );
88: }

FILE apps/web/src/scene/FrameworkScene.tsx SHA256 6e0927d2a13ca52a6e5a02aa8a2166e6eed2b4f625e9ab6e2af8586573f715ca
1: /**
2:  * The framework space: every object encodes data (DESIGN.md › Spatial System).
3:  * Units of work are instanced hex prisms (height = current level) topped with
4:  * translucent "gap glass" up to the target level; groups are beacons; tasks
5:  * occupy satellite slots; evidence docks as crystals; agents travel as comets.
6:  */
7: import { Line } from "@react-three/drei";
8: import { useFrame, useThree, type ThreeEvent } from "@react-three/fiber";
9: import { memo, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
10: import {
11:   BufferGeometry,
12:   Color,
13:   CylinderGeometry,
14:   Float32BufferAttribute,
15:   IcosahedronGeometry,
16:   InstancedMesh,
17:   Object3D,
18:   OctahedronGeometry,
19:   QuadraticBezierCurve3,
20:   TetrahedronGeometry,
21:   Vector3,
22:   type Group,
23:   type Mesh,
24: } from "three";
25: import type { FrameworkStateBundle } from "../lib/types.ts";
26: import { useAgentActivity } from "../state/agentActivity.ts";
27: import type { Lens } from "../state/ui.ts";
28: import { TOKENS, unitColor } from "./colors.ts";
29: import { SpatialGround } from "./SpatialGround.tsx";
30: import { hexRimGeometry } from "./spatialGeometry.ts";
31: import type { Layout, Vec3 } from "./layout.ts";
32: import { ScreenLabels, type ScreenLabel } from "./ScreenLabels.tsx";
33:
34:
35: export interface SceneProps {
36:   layout: Layout;
37:   state: FrameworkStateBundle | undefined;
38:   lens: Lens;
39:   selectedId: string | null;
40:   hoveredId: string | null;
41:   focusIds: string[];
42:   reducedMotion: boolean;
43:   onHover: (id: string | null, clientX?: number, clientY?: number) => void;
44:   onSelect: (id: string | null) => void;
45: }
46:
47: const tmp = new Object3D();
48: const tmpColor = new Color();
49: const rimGeometry = hexRimGeometry();
50: const targetRimGeometry = hexRimGeometry(0.8);
51: const beaconGeometry = new CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 32, 1).translate(0, 0.5, 0);
52: const hexGeometry = new CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 6, 1);
53: hexGeometry.translate(0, 0.5, 0);
54:
55: export function heightFor(level: number, view: Layout["view"]) {
56:   return view === "terrain" ? 0.3 + level * 0.9 : 0.22 + level * 0.46;
57: }
58:
59: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
60:
61: function UnitField({ layout, state, lens, onHover, onSelect, reducedMotion }: SceneProps) {
62:   const mesh = useRef<InstancedMesh>(null);
63:   const glass = useRef<InstancedMesh>(null);
64:   const targets = useRef<InstancedMesh>(null);
65:   const crowns = useRef<InstancedMesh>(null);
66:   const ids = layout.units;
67:   const count = ids.length;
68:   const shown = useRef<Float32Array>(new Float32Array(count));
69:   const goal = useRef<Float32Array>(new Float32Array(count));
70:   const tops = useRef<Float32Array>(new Float32Array(count));
71:   // Units out of scope (not applicable, or no link for a threat) shrink to small dots so the ones that count stand out.
72:   const widths = useRef<Float32Array>(new Float32Array(count).fill(1));
73:   const animating = useRef(true);
74:   const invalidate = useThree((s) => s.invalidate);
75:
76:   // Targets for heights whenever state changes.
77:   useLayoutEffect(() => {
78:     const g = new Float32Array(count);
79:     const t = new Float32Array(count);
80:     const w = new Float32Array(count);
81:     ids.forEach((id, i) => {
82:       const u = state?.units[id];
83:       const out = !!u && !u.applicable;
84:       g[i] = out ? 0.08 : heightFor(u ? u.current : 0, layout.view);
85:       t[i] = u && u.applicable ? heightFor(Math.max(u.current, u.target), layout.view) : g[i]!;
86:       w[i] = out ? 0.42 : 1;
87:     });
88:     goal.current = g;
89:     tops.current = t;
90:     widths.current = w;
91:     if (shown.current.length !== count) shown.current = new Float32Array(g);
92:     if (reducedMotion) shown.current = new Float32Array(g);
93:     animating.current = true;
94:     invalidate();
95:   }, [ids, state, count, layout.view, reducedMotion, invalidate]);
96:
97:   // The layout can change with the same number of units; always rewrite transforms.
98:   useLayoutEffect(() => { animating.current = true; invalidate(); }, [layout, invalidate]);
99:
100:   // Colors per lens.
101:   useLayoutEffect(() => {
102:     const m = mesh.current;
103:     if (!m) return;
104:     ids.forEach((id, i) => {
105:       unitColor(lens, state?.units[id], tmpColor);
106:       m.setColorAt(i, tmpColor);
107:       crowns.current?.setColorAt(i, tmpColor.lerp(TOKENS.onSurface, 0.22));
108:     });
109:     if (m.instanceColor) m.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
110:     if (crowns.current?.instanceColor) crowns.current.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
111:     invalidate();
112:   }, [ids, state, lens, invalidate]);
113:
114:   useFrame((_, dt) => {
115:     const m = mesh.current;
116:     const gl = glass.current;
117:     if (!m || !gl || !animating.current) return;
118:     let moving = false;
119:     const k = Math.min(dt, 1 / 30) * 6;
120:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
121:       const cur = shown.current[i] ?? 0;
122:       const tgt = goal.current[i] ?? 0;
123:       const next = Math.abs(tgt - cur) < 0.002 ? tgt : cur + (tgt - cur) * k;
124:       if (next !== tgt) moving = true;
125:       shown.current[i] = next;
126:       const p = layout.positions.get(ids[i]!)!;
127:       const r = layout.cell * (layout.view === "terrain" ? 0.9 : 1) * (widths.current[i] ?? 1);
128:       tmp.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
129:       tmp.position.set(p[0], 0, p[2]);
130:       tmp.scale.set(r, next, r);
131:       tmp.updateMatrix();
132:       m.setMatrixAt(i, tmp.matrix);
133:       const top = tops.current[i] ?? next;
134:       const gapH = Math.max(0, top - next);
135:       tmp.position.set(p[0], next, p[2]);
136:       tmp.scale.set(gapH > 0.002 ? r * 0.98 : 0, gapH, gapH > 0.002 ? r * 0.98 : 0);
137:       tmp.updateMatrix();
138:       gl.setMatrixAt(i, tmp.matrix);
139:       tmp.position.set(p[0], top + 0.008, p[2]);
140:       tmp.scale.setScalar(top > (goal.current[i] ?? 0) + 0.002 ? r * 0.98 : 0);
141:       tmp.updateMatrix();
142:       targets.current?.setMatrixAt(i, tmp.matrix);
143:       tmp.position.y = next + 0.006;
144:       tmp.scale.setScalar(r);
145:       tmp.updateMatrix();
146:       crowns.current?.setMatrixAt(i, tmp.matrix);
147:     }
148:     m.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
149:     gl.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
150:     if (targets.current) targets.current.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
151:     if (crowns.current) crowns.current.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
152:     // Raycasting also uses this sphere during layout/height transitions.
153:     m.computeBoundingSphere();
154:     animating.current = moving;
155:     if (moving) invalidate();
156:   });
157:
158:   const handleMove = (e: ThreeEvent<PointerEvent>) => {
159:     e.stopPropagation();
160:     if (e.instanceId === undefined) return;
161:     onHover(ids[e.instanceId] ?? null, e.nativeEvent.clientX, e.nativeEvent.clientY);
162:     document.body.style.cursor = "pointer";
163:   };
164:   const handleOut = () => {
165:     onHover(null);
166:     document.body.style.cursor = "";
167:   };
168:   const handleClick = (e: ThreeEvent<MouseEvent>) => {
169:     e.stopPropagation();
170:     if (e.instanceId !== undefined) onSelect(ids[e.instanceId] ?? null);
171:   };
172:
173:   return (
174:     <group>
175:       <instancedMesh ref={mesh} args={[hexGeometry, undefined, count]} onPointerMove={handleMove} onPointerOut={handleOut} onClick={handleClick} frustumCulled={false}>
176:         <meshStandardMaterial roughness={0.62} metalness={0.08} flatShading />
177:       </instancedMesh>
178:       <instancedMesh ref={glass} renderOrder={1} args={[hexGeometry, undefined, count]} raycast={() => null} frustumCulled={false}>
179:         <meshStandardMaterial color={TOKENS.primary} transparent opacity={0.12} roughness={0.7} metalness={0} depthWrite={false} />
180:       </instancedMesh>
181:       <instancedMesh ref={targets} renderOrder={2} args={[targetRimGeometry, undefined, count]} raycast={() => null} frustumCulled={false}>
182:         <meshBasicMaterial color={TOKENS.primary} transparent opacity={0.55} depthWrite={false} />
183:       </instancedMesh>
184:       <instancedMesh ref={crowns} args={[rimGeometry, undefined, count]} raycast={() => null} frustumCulled={false}>
185:         <meshBasicMaterial polygonOffset polygonOffsetFactor={-1} polygonOffsetUnits={-4} />
186:       </instancedMesh>
187:     </group>
188:   );
189: }
190:
191: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
192:
193: function Beacons({ layout, state, onSelect, onHover }: SceneProps) {
194:   const invalidate = useThree((s) => s.invalidate);
195:   const hubs = layout.hubs;
196:   const mids = layout.mids.filter((id) => layout.positions.has(id) && layout.view === "constellation");
197:   const hubMesh = useRef<InstancedMesh>(null);
198:   const midMesh = useRef<InstancedMesh>(null);
199:   useLayoutEffect(() => {
200:     const place = (mesh: InstancedMesh | null, list: string[], radius: number, height: number) => {
201:       if (!mesh) return;
202:       list.forEach((id, i) => {
203:         const p = layout.positions.get(id) ?? [0, 0, 0];
204:         tmp.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
205:         tmp.position.set(p[0], 0, p[2]);
206:         tmp.scale.set(radius, height, radius);
207:         tmp.updateMatrix();
208:         mesh.setMatrixAt(i, tmp.matrix);
209:         const g = state?.groups[id];
210:         tmpColor.copy(g ? TOKENS.status[g.status] : TOKENS.status["not-started"]);
211:         mesh.setColorAt(i, tmpColor);
212:       });
213:       mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
214:       if (mesh.instanceColor) mesh.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
215:       mesh.computeBoundingSphere();
216:     };
217:     place(hubMesh.current, hubs, layout.view === "terrain" ? 0.9 : 1.15, 0.5);
218:     place(midMesh.current, mids, 0.5, 0.28);
219:     invalidate();
220:   }, [layout, state, hubs, mids, invalidate]);
221:
222:   const click = (list: string[]) => (e: ThreeEvent<MouseEvent>) => {
223:     e.stopPropagation();
224:     if (e.instanceId !== undefined) onSelect(list[e.instanceId] ?? null);
225:   };
226:   const move = (list: string[]) => (e: ThreeEvent<PointerEvent>) => {
227:     e.stopPropagation();
228:     if (e.instanceId !== undefined) onHover(list[e.instanceId] ?? null, e.nativeEvent.clientX, e.nativeEvent.clientY);
229:     document.body.style.cursor = "pointer";
230:   };
231:   const out = () => {
232:     onHover(null);
233:     document.body.style.cursor = "";
234:   };
235:   return (
236:     <group>
237:       {hubs.length > 0 && (
238:         <instancedMesh key={`h${hubs.length}`} ref={hubMesh} args={[beaconGeometry, undefined, hubs.length]} onClick={click(hubs)} onPointerMove={move(hubs)} onPointerOut={out}>
239:           <meshStandardMaterial roughness={0.68} metalness={0.06} />
240:         </instancedMesh>
241:       )}
242:       {mids.length > 0 && (
243:         <instancedMesh key={`m${mids.length}`} ref={midMesh} args={[beaconGeometry, undefined, mids.length]} onClick={click(mids)} onPointerMove={move(mids)} onPointerOut={out}>
244:           <meshStandardMaterial roughness={0.7} metalness={0.05} />
245:         </instancedMesh>
246:       )}
247:     </group>
248:   );
249: }
250:
251: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
252:
253: function Links({ layout }: { layout: Layout }) {
254:   const geometry = useMemo(() => {
255:     const pts: number[] = [];
256:     for (const [a, b] of layout.links) {
257:       const pa = layout.positions.get(a);
258:       const pb = layout.positions.get(b);
259:       if (!pa || !pb) continue;
260:       pts.push(pa[0], 0.05, pa[2], pb[0], 0.05, pb[2]);
261:     }
262:     // Rays from the core to each top-level group.
263:     for (const h of layout.hubs) {
264:       const p = layout.positions.get(h)!;
265:       pts.push(0, 0.05, 0, p[0], 0.05, p[2]);
266:     }
267:     const g = new BufferGeometry();
268:     g.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(pts, 3));
269:     return g;
270:   }, [layout]);
271:   useEffect(() => () => geometry.dispose(), [geometry]);
272:   if (layout.view === "terrain") return null;
273:   return (
274:     <lineSegments geometry={geometry} raycast={() => null}>
275:       <lineBasicMaterial color={TOKENS.outlineStrong} transparent opacity={0.78} />
276:     </lineSegments>
277:   );
278: }
279:
280: function Rings({ layout }: { layout: Layout }) {
281:   const rings = useMemo(() => {
282:     if (layout.view === "terrain") return [layout.sectors[0]?.radius ?? 10];
283:     const radii = new Set<number>();
284:     for (const id of [...layout.hubs, ...layout.mids.slice(0, 1)]) {
285:       const p = layout.positions.get(id);
286:       if (p) radii.add(Math.round(Math.hypot(p[0], p[2]) * 10) / 10);
287:     }
288:     return [...radii].filter((r) => r > 0);
289:   }, [layout]);
290:   return (
291:     <group rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 0.01, 0]}>
292:       {rings.map((r) => (
293:         <mesh key={r} raycast={() => null}>
294:           <ringGeometry args={[r - 0.03, r + 0.03, 192]} />
295:           <meshBasicMaterial color={TOKENS.grid} transparent opacity={0.95} />
296:         </mesh>
297:       ))}
298:     </group>
299:   );
300: }
301:
302: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
303:
304: function Core({ active, reducedMotion }: { active: boolean; reducedMotion: boolean }) {
305:   const invalidate = useThree((s) => s.invalidate);
306:   // Motion preferences can change while active without changing any Three props.
307:   useLayoutEffect(() => invalidate(), [active, reducedMotion, invalidate]);
308:   const ref = useRef<Mesh>(null);
309:   const geometry = useMemo(() => new IcosahedronGeometry(1.4, 0), []);
310:   useFrame(({ clock, invalidate }, dt) => {
311:     if (!ref.current) return;
312:     if (active && !reducedMotion) invalidate();
313:     ref.current.rotation.y += active && !reducedMotion ? Math.min(dt, 0.1) * 0.6 : 0;
314:     const mat = ref.current.material as unknown as { emissiveIntensity: number };
315:     mat.emissiveIntensity = active ? (reducedMotion ? 0.18 : 0.18 + Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * 3) * 0.06) : 0.04;
316:   });
317:   return (
318:     <group>
319:       <mesh ref={ref} geometry={geometry} position={[0, 1.6, 0]} raycast={() => null}>
320:         <meshStandardMaterial color={TOKENS.primary} emissive={active ? TOKENS.tertiary : TOKENS.primary} emissiveIntensity={0.04} roughness={0.58} metalness={0.12} flatShading />
321:       </mesh>
322:       <mesh visible={active} position={[0, 0.04, 0]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} raycast={() => null}>
323:         <ringGeometry args={[1.8, 2.05, 64]} />
324:         <meshBasicMaterial color={TOKENS.tertiary} toneMapped={false} />
325:       </mesh>
326:     </group>
327:   );
328: }
329:
330: /** Selection halo + highlighted ancestry path. */
331: function Selection({ layout, selectedId, state }: SceneProps) {
332:   // Keep points stable until selection changes to avoid rebuilding the line material.
333:   const path = useMemo(() => {
334:     const out: Vec3[] = [];
335:     let cur = selectedId ? layout.byId.get(selectedId) : undefined;
336:     while (cur) {
337:       const q = layout.positions.get(cur.id);
338:       if (q) out.push([q[0], 0.08, q[2]]);
339:       cur = cur.parentId ? layout.byId.get(cur.parentId) : undefined;
340:     }
341:     out.push([0, 0.08, 0]);
342:     return out;
343:   }, [layout, selectedId]);
344:   if (!selectedId) return null;
345:   const p = layout.positions.get(selectedId);
346:   if (!p) return null;
347:   const node = layout.byId.get(selectedId);
348:   const u = state?.units[selectedId];
349:   const h = node?.assessable ? heightFor(Math.max(u?.current ?? 0, u?.target ?? 0), layout.view) : 0.6;
350:   const r = node?.assessable ? layout.cell * 1.6 : layout.view === "terrain" ? 1.6 : 1.9;
351:   return (
352:     <group>
353:       <mesh position={[p[0], 0.04, p[2]]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} raycast={() => null}>
354:         <ringGeometry args={[r * 0.82, r, 6, 1, Math.PI / 6]} />
355:         <meshBasicMaterial color={TOKENS.primary} toneMapped={false} />
356:       </mesh>
357:       <mesh position={[p[0], h + 0.05, p[2]]} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} raycast={() => null}>
358:         <ringGeometry args={[r * 0.55, r * 0.62, 6, 1, Math.PI / 6]} />
359:         <meshBasicMaterial color={TOKENS.primary} toneMapped={false} transparent opacity={0.7} />
360:       </mesh>
361:       {layout.view === "constellation" && path.length > 1 && <Line points={path} color={TOKENS.primary} lineWidth={2.2} />}
362:     </group>
363:   );
364: }
365:
366: /** Open tasks occupy fixed satellite slots; only active agent work moves. */
367: function Satellites({ layout, state }: SceneProps) {
368:   const invalidate = useThree((s) => s.invalidate);
369:   const ref = useRef<InstancedMesh>(null);
370:   const slots = useMemo(() => {
371:     const out: { p: Vec3; k: number; n: number; h: number }[] = [];
372:     for (const id of layout.units) {
373:       const u = state?.units[id];
374:       if (!u || !u.openTasks) continue;
375:       const p = layout.positions.get(id)!;
376:       const n = Math.min(3, u.openTasks);
377:       for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) out.push({ p, k, n, h: heightFor(Math.max(u.current, u.target), layout.view) });
378:     }
379:     return out;
380:   }, [layout, state]);
381:   const geometry = useMemo(() => new OctahedronGeometry(0.13, 0), []);
382:   useLayoutEffect(() => {
383:     const m = ref.current;
384:     if (!m) return;
385:     slots.forEach((s, i) => {
386:       const a = (s.k / s.n) * Math.PI * 2;
387:       const rr = layout.cell * 1.55;
388:       tmp.position.set(s.p[0] + Math.cos(a) * rr, s.h + 0.25, s.p[2] + Math.sin(a) * rr);
389:       tmp.rotation.set(0, a, 0);
390:       tmp.scale.setScalar(1);
391:       tmp.updateMatrix();
392:       m.setMatrixAt(i, tmp.matrix);
393:     });
394:     m.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
395:     invalidate();
396:   }, [slots, layout, invalidate]);
397:   if (!slots.length) return null;
398:   return (
399:     <instancedMesh key={slots.length} ref={ref} args={[geometry, undefined, slots.length]} raycast={() => null} frustumCulled={false}>
400:       <meshStandardMaterial color={TOKENS.onSurface} roughness={0.65} />
401:     </instancedMesh>
402:   );
403: }
404:
405: /** Evidence crystals docked on units with accepted evidence. */
406: function Crystals({ layout, state }: SceneProps) {
407:   const invalidate = useThree((s) => s.invalidate);
408:   const ref = useRef<InstancedMesh>(null);
409:   const items = useMemo(() => layout.units.filter((id) => (state?.units[id]?.evidence ?? 0) > 0), [layout, state]);
410:   const geometry = useMemo(() => new TetrahedronGeometry(0.17, 0), []);
411:   useLayoutEffect(() => {
412:     const m = ref.current;
413:     if (!m) return;
414:     items.forEach((id, i) => {
415:       const p = layout.positions.get(id)!;
416:       const u = state!.units[id]!;
417:       tmp.position.set(p[0], heightFor(Math.max(u.current, u.target), layout.view) + 0.28, p[2]);
418:       tmp.rotation.set(0.6, 0.8, 0);
419:       tmp.scale.setScalar(1);
420:       tmp.updateMatrix();
421:       m.setMatrixAt(i, tmp.matrix);
422:       tmpColor.copy(u.status === "at-risk" ? TOKENS.status["at-risk"] : TOKENS.status.verified);
423:       m.setColorAt(i, tmpColor);
424:     });
425:     m.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
426:     if (m.instanceColor) m.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
427:     invalidate();
428:   }, [items, layout, state, invalidate]);
429:   if (!items.length) return null;
430:   return (
431:     <instancedMesh key={items.length} ref={ref} args={[geometry, undefined, items.length]} raycast={() => null} frustumCulled={false}>
432:       <meshStandardMaterial roughness={0.6} metalness={0.04} />
433:     </instancedMesh>
434:   );
435: }
436:
437: /** Warm comets travelling from the core to nodes an agent is working on. */
438: function AgentComets({ layout, reducedMotion }: { layout: Layout; reducedMotion: boolean }) {
439:   const hot = useAgentActivity((s) => s.hot);
440:   const targets = useMemo(() => Object.keys(hot).filter((id) => layout.positions.has(id)).slice(0, 24), [hot, layout]);
441:   return <Comets layout={layout} targets={targets} reducedMotion={reducedMotion} />;
442: }
443:
444: function Comets({ layout, targets, reducedMotion }: { layout: Layout; targets: string[]; reducedMotion: boolean }) {
445:   const curves = useMemo(
446:     () =>
447:       targets.map((id) => {
448:         const p = layout.positions.get(id)!;
449:         const end = new Vector3(p[0], 0.9, p[2]);
450:         const mid = new Vector3(p[0] * 0.5, 4 + Math.hypot(p[0], p[2]) * 0.18, p[2] * 0.5);
451:         return new QuadraticBezierCurve3(new Vector3(0, 1.6, 0), mid, end);
452:       }),
453:     [targets, layout],
454:   );
455:   const invalidate = useThree((s) => s.invalidate);
456:   useLayoutEffect(() => invalidate(), [curves, reducedMotion, invalidate]);
457:   const trails = useMemo(() => curves.map((c) => c.getPoints(32)), [curves]);
458:   const heads = useRef<(Mesh | null)[]>([]);
459:   useFrame(({ clock, invalidate }) => {
460:     if (curves.length && !reducedMotion) invalidate();
461:     curves.forEach((curve, i) => {
462:       const m = heads.current[i];
463:       if (!m) return;
464:       const t = reducedMotion ? 1 : (clock.elapsedTime * 0.45 + i * 0.13) % 1;
465:       m.position.copy(curve.getPoint(t));
466:       m.scale.setScalar(reducedMotion ? 1 : 0.7 + Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.6);
467:     });
468:   });
469:   if (!curves.length) return null;
470:   return (
471:     <group>
472:       {curves.map((curve, i) => (
473:         <group key={targets[i]}>
474:           <Line points={trails[i]!} color={TOKENS.tertiary} lineWidth={1.5} transparent opacity={0.62} />
475:           <mesh ref={(el) => (heads.current[i] = el)} raycast={() => null}>
476:             <sphereGeometry args={[0.22, 12, 12]} />
477:             <meshBasicMaterial color={TOKENS.tertiary} toneMapped={false} />
478:           </mesh>
479:           <mesh position={curve.getPoint(1)} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} raycast={() => null}>
480:             <ringGeometry args={[layout.cell * 1.2, layout.cell * 1.45, 6, 1, Math.PI / 6]} />
481:             <meshBasicMaterial color={TOKENS.tertiary} toneMapped={false} transparent opacity={0.8} />
482:           </mesh>
483:         </group>
484:       ))}
485:     </group>
486:   );
487: }
488:
489: const pct = (x: number) => `${Math.round(x * 100)}%`;
490:
491: /**
492:  * Titles and codes, placed in screen space (ScreenLabels): sector titles outside the
493:  * ring; codes for the selection, hover, agent focus, the selected group's members and
494:  * the mid-level groups when there are few. Higher priority wins where labels collide.
495:  */
496: function SceneLabels({ layout, state, selectedId, hoveredId, focusIds, onSelect }: SceneProps) {
497:   const labels = useMemo<ScreenLabel[]>(() => {
498:     const out: ScreenLabel[] = [];
499:     const selected = selectedId ? layout.byId.get(selectedId) : undefined;
500:     let root = selected;
501:     while (root?.parentId) root = layout.byId.get(root.parentId);
502:     for (const s of layout.sectors) {
503:       const g = state?.groups[s.id];
504:       const mid = (s.start + s.end) / 2;
505:       const position: Vec3 = layout.view === "constellation" ? [Math.cos(mid) * (s.radius + 1), 0.3, Math.sin(mid) * (s.radius + 1)] : s.labelPos;
506:       const titled = !!s.title && s.title.toUpperCase() !== s.code.toUpperCase();
507:       const sub = g ? (state?.threat ? `${pct(g.readiness)} covered · ${g.total} with links` : `${pct(g.readiness)} ready · ${g.gaps} gaps`) : undefined;
508:       const priority = root ? (root.id === s.id ? 700 : 300) : 500;
509:       const sector = { variant: "sector" as const, position, outwardFrom: [0, 0, 0] as Vec3, group: `sector:${s.id}`, active: selectedId === s.id, onClick: () => onSelect(s.id) };
510:       out.push({ ...sector, id: `sector:${s.id}`, code: titled ? s.code : undefined, title: titled ? s.title : s.code, sub, priority });
511:       // Where its title does not fit (twenty SP 800-53 families), a sector keeps its code, with its read-out if there is room.
512:       if (titled) {
513:         out.push({ ...sector, id: `sector:${s.id}:code`, title: s.code, sub, priority: priority - 12 });
514:         if (sub) out.push({ ...sector, id: `sector:${s.id}:bare`, title: s.code, priority: priority - 14 });
515:       }
516:     }
517:     const focus = new Set(focusIds);
518:     const members = new Set<string>();
519:     const group = selected ? (selected.assessable && selected.parentId ? selected.parentId : selected.id) : undefined;
520:     if (group) {
521:       const walk = (id: string) => {
522:         for (const k of layout.children.get(id) ?? []) {
523:           members.add(k.id);
524:           if (members.size < 90) walk(k.id);
525:         }
526:       };
527:       walk(group);
528:     }
529:     const ids = new Set<string>([selectedId, hoveredId, ...focusIds, ...members].filter((id): id is string => !!id && layout.positions.has(id)));
530:     if (layout.view === "constellation" && layout.mids.length <= 40) for (const id of layout.mids) ids.add(id);
531:     for (const id of ids) {
532:       const node = layout.byId.get(id);
533:       const p = layout.positions.get(id)!;
534:       const u = state?.units[id];
535:       const emphasized = id === selectedId || id === hoveredId;
536:       const y = node?.assessable ? heightFor(Math.max(u?.current ?? 0, u?.target ?? 0), layout.view) + 0.3 : 0.9;
537:       out.push({
538:         id: `code:${id}`,
539:         variant: emphasized ? "selected" : "code",
540:         position: [p[0], y, p[2]],
541:         title: (node?.meta?.["label"] as string | undefined) ?? node?.code ?? "",
542:         // Groups with units in scope (a law that applies) outrank the rest when space is short.
543:         priority: id === selectedId ? 1000 : id === hoveredId ? 900 : focus.has(id) ? 450 : members.has(id) ? 350 : state?.groups[id]?.total ? 260 : 200,
544:         active: id === selectedId,
545:       });
546:     }
547:     return out;
548:   }, [layout, state, selectedId, hoveredId, focusIds, onSelect]);
549:   return <ScreenLabels labels={labels} />;
550: }
551:
552: /**
553:  * Compiles, as soon as the scene is up, the shader programs that only a selection and agent
554:  * activity use: the selection halo and path, and agent comets. Compiled on first use, they
555:  * stalled the frame that answered the first click by 60 to 100 ms. The real components are
556:  * drawn for a couple of frames, for one unit, shrunk inside the opaque core where the depth
557:  * test hides them, so they compile through the same tone-mapping pipeline
558:  * as the real ones. Then they are hidden, not removed, and never re-rendered by a selection:
559:  * disposing their materials would let three.js delete the programs again. They are drawn
560:  * again when the layout changes. (`renderer.compileAsync` does not reliably warm
561:  * the same program variants as the real components.)
562:  */
563: const ShaderWarmup = memo(function ShaderWarmup({ layout }: { layout: Layout }) {
564:   const group = useRef<Group>(null);
565:   const frames = useRef(0);
566:   const invalidate = useThree((s) => s.invalidate);
567:   const unit = layout.units[0];
568:   const targets = useMemo(() => (unit ? [unit] : []), [unit]);
569:   // Shown again for each layout, drawn however far they are from the camera's view.
570:   useLayoutEffect(() => {
571:     frames.current = 0;
572:     if (!group.current) return;
573:     group.current.visible = true;
574:     group.current.traverse((o) => (o.frustumCulled = false));
575:     invalidate();
576:   }, [layout, invalidate]);
577:   useFrame(({ invalidate }) => {
578:     if (!group.current?.visible) return;
579:     if (++frames.current > 2) group.current.visible = false;
580:     else invalidate();
581:   });
582:   if (!unit) return null;
583:   const noop = () => undefined;
584:   return (
585:     <group ref={group} position={[0, 1.6, 0]} scale={0.001}>
586:       <Selection layout={layout} state={undefined} selectedId={unit} lens="status" hoveredId={null} focusIds={[]} reducedMotion onHover={noop} onSelect={noop} />
587:       <Comets layout={layout} targets={targets} reducedMotion />
588:     </group>
589:   );
590: });
591:
592: export function FrameworkScene(props: SceneProps & { agentActive: boolean }) {
593:   return (
594:     <group>
595:       <SpatialGround {...props} />
596:       <Rings layout={props.layout} />
597:       <Links layout={props.layout} />
598:       <Core active={props.agentActive} reducedMotion={props.reducedMotion} />
599:       <Beacons {...props} />
600:       <UnitField {...props} />
601:       <Satellites {...props} />
602:       <Crystals {...props} />
603:       <Selection {...props} />
604:       {props.agentActive && <AgentComets layout={props.layout} reducedMotion={props.reducedMotion} />}
605:       <ShaderWarmup layout={props.layout} />
606:       <SceneLabels {...props} />
607:     </group>
608:   );
609: }

1: /**
2:  * The Crosswalk Nexus: every framework on one ring, its requirement groups as
3:  * pillars, and authoritative mappings as bundled arcs rising between them.
4:  * Pillar height = number of units (log), pillar color = group status, arc
5:  * width = number of unit-level mappings, arc color = source → target framework.
6:  */
7: import { CameraControls } from "@react-three/drei";
8: import { Canvas, useThree, type ThreeEvent } from "@react-three/fiber";
9: import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef } from "react";
10: import { Color, CubicBezierCurve3, CylinderGeometry, FogExp2, Float32BufferAttribute, InstancedBufferAttribute, InstancedMesh, Object3D, RingGeometry, Vector3, type PerspectiveCamera } from "three";
11: import { LineMaterial } from "three/examples/jsm/lines/LineMaterial.js";
12: import { LineSegments2 } from "three/examples/jsm/lines/LineSegments2.js";
13: import { LineSegmentsGeometry } from "three/examples/jsm/lines/LineSegmentsGeometry.js";
14: import { designSystem } from "@visua/design";
15: import type { FrameworkFamily, Status } from "@visua/core";
16: import { allFrameworks, frameworkMeta } from "../lib/frameworks.ts";
17: import type { LinkStatus, ThreatRing } from "../lib/types.ts";
18: import { DemandCameraControls } from "./demandRendering.ts";
19: import { arcTriangles, positionGeometry } from "./spatialGeometry.ts";
20: import { TOKENS } from "./colors.ts";
21: import { fitRing, titleSize, useSafeArea } from "./framing.ts";
22: import type { Vec3 } from "./layout.ts";
23: import { usePrefersReducedMotion } from "./Observatory.tsx";
24: import { hudRects, ScreenLabels, type ScreenLabel } from "./ScreenLabels.tsx";
25:
26: export interface NexusGroup {
27:   id: string;
28:   code: string;
29:   title: string;
30:   units: number;
31:   readiness: number | null;
32:   status: Status | null;
33: }
34: export interface NexusFramework {
35:   id: string;
36:   shortName: string;
37:   family: FrameworkFamily;
38:   enabled: boolean;
39:   groups: NexusGroup[];
40: }
41: export interface NexusBundle {
42:   a: string;
43:   b: string;
44:   count: number;
45:   setId: string;
46: }
47: export interface NexusData {
48:   frameworks: NexusFramework[];
49:   sets: { id: string; title: string; authority: string; source: string; target: string; count: number; documentId?: string; documentTitle?: string }[];
50:   bundles: NexusBundle[];
51:   /** Inner ring: threat catalogs bundled onto the requirement groups their publishers link them to. */
52:   threats?: ThreatRing;
