163:     description: "Distance to full coverage (level 4 on the coverage scale).",
164:     legend: LENS_INFO.gap.legend.map((l) => (l.label === "At target" ? { ...l, label: "Fully covered" } : l.label === "Out of scope" ? { ...l, label: "No link in your frameworks" } : l)),
165:   },
166: };

FILE apps/web/src/scene/demandRendering.ts SHA256 3990de51755d606499740c240f3ffa21e89e6bb92f5cfa5a08327840f418d074
1: import { CameraControlsImpl } from "@react-three/drei";
2:
3: /** A demand frame can follow minutes of idle time; flights must still ease in. */
4: export class DemandCameraControls extends CameraControlsImpl {
5:   private moving = false;
6:
7:   override update(delta: number): boolean {
8:     // Only the first frame after sleep includes idle time. Capping every frame
9:     // makes camera flights take many seconds on a slow GPU.
10:     const updated = super.update(this.moving ? delta : Math.min(delta, 1 / 30));
11:     this.moving = updated;
12:     return updated;
13:   }
14: }
15:
16: /**
17:  * Wake a sleeping scene when its DOM layout changes. Label transforms are written
18:  * by the scene itself, so observing them would create an endless render loop.
19:  */
20: export function observeSceneLayout(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, changed: () => void): () => void {
21:   const root = canvas.closest("[data-stage-root]") ?? canvas.closest("[data-stage]") ?? canvas.parentElement;
22:   if (!root) return () => undefined;
23:   let frame = 0;
24:   let live = true;
25:   const transitions = new Map<EventTarget, Set<string>>();
26:   const flush = () => {
27:     frame = 0;
28:     if (!live) return;
29:     changed();
30:     for (const target of transitions.keys()) if (!root.contains(target as Node)) transitions.delete(target);
31:     if (transitions.size) schedule();
32:   };
33:   const schedule = () => {
34:     if (live && !frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(flush);
35:   };
36:   const resize = new ResizeObserver(schedule);
37:   const observed = new Set<Element>();
38:   const refresh = () => {
39:     const next = new Set<Element>([root, canvas, ...root.querySelectorAll("[data-hud]")]);
40:     for (const el of observed) if (!next.has(el)) { resize.unobserve(el); observed.delete(el); }
41:     for (const el of next) if (!observed.has(el)) { resize.observe(el); observed.add(el); }
42:   };
43:   // Descendant content is covered by the panel's ResizeObserver. Only panels,
44:   // the canvas and their ancestors can move those rectangles via transforms.
45:   const boundary = (el: Element) => !el.closest(".scene-labels") &&
46:     (el === canvas || el.matches("[data-hud]") || el.contains(canvas) || !!el.querySelector("[data-hud]"));
47:   const mutations = new MutationObserver((records) => {
48:     if (!records.some((record) => {
49:       if (record.type === "characterData") return false;
50:       const el = record.target as Element;
51:       if (el.closest(".scene-labels")) return false;
52:       if (record.type === "childList") {
53:         // A removed panel is no longer discoverable through its parent.
54:         if ([...record.addedNodes, ...record.removedNodes].some((node) => node.nodeType === 1 && boundary(node as Element))) return true;
55:         if (el.closest("[data-hud]")) return false;
56:       }
57:       return boundary(el);
58:     })) return;
59:     refresh();
60:     schedule();
61:   });
62:   refresh();
63:   mutations.observe(root, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class", "style", "hidden", "data-hud", "data-full", "open"] });
64:   // ResizeObserver covers size transitions, but transforms move panels without resizing.
65:   const transition = (event: Event) => {
66:     const e = event as TransitionEvent;
67:     const target = e.target as Element | null;
68:     if (!target || !boundary(target)) return;
69:     if (!/^(transform|translate|scale|width|height|top|right|bottom|left|margin.*|padding.*|flex-basis|grid-template-.*)$/.test(e.propertyName)) return;
70:     if (e.type === "transitionrun") {
71:       const properties = transitions.get(target) ?? new Set<string>();
72:       properties.add(e.propertyName);
73:       transitions.set(target, properties);
74:     } else {
75:       const properties = transitions.get(target);
76:       properties?.delete(e.propertyName);
77:       if (!properties?.size) transitions.delete(target);
78:     }
79:     schedule();
80:   };
81:   root.addEventListener("transitionrun", transition);
82:   root.addEventListener("transitionend", transition);
83:   root.addEventListener("transitioncancel", transition);
84:   root.addEventListener("scroll", schedule, true);
85:   window.addEventListener("resize", schedule);
86:   schedule();
87:   return () => {
88:     live = false;
89:     cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
90:     resize.disconnect();
91:     mutations.disconnect();
92:     root.removeEventListener("transitionrun", transition);
93:     root.removeEventListener("transitionend", transition);
94:     root.removeEventListener("transitioncancel", transition);
95:     root.removeEventListener("scroll", schedule, true);
96:     window.removeEventListener("resize", schedule);
97:   };
98: }

FILE apps/web/src/scene/framing.ts SHA256 7c9c3fae607bfc7350070c42627a1fe4ec5decd6e3379c8ffe0439d2935584a0
1: /**
2:  * Framing a ring-shaped scene around the HUD (Observatory and Crosswalk Nexus).
3:  *
4:  * - `useSafeArea` tracks the part of the canvas no HUD band covers and offsets the
5:  *   camera's projection so whatever the camera looks at appears in its middle: the
6:  *   scene re-frames when the inspector opens or a bottom sheet covers the canvas.
7:  * - `fitRing` finds the home view: seen from a fixed direction, as close as it can be
8:  *   while the ring and its titles stay inside the canvas and clear of every panel.
9:  */
10: import { useThree } from "@react-three/fiber";
11: import { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
12: import { Vector3, type PerspectiveCamera } from "three";
13: import { observeSceneLayout } from "./demandRendering.ts";
14: import { outwardRect, rectsOverlap, safeRect, type Rect } from "./ScreenLabels.tsx";
15:
16: export interface RingTitle {
17:   /** World anchor of the title (its label sits outside the ring from here). */
18:   anchor: Vector3;
19:   /** Estimated size on screen, in pixels. */
20:   w: number;
21:   h: number;
22: }
23:
24: /** Size of a title as ScreenLabels draws it: an optional code line, the label-caps title (~9.6px a character), a read-out line. */
25: export function titleSize(title: string, opts: { code?: boolean; sub?: number; swatch?: boolean } = {}) {
26:   return { w: Math.max(title.length * 9.6 + (opts.swatch ? 14 : 0), opts.sub ?? 150) + 8, h: (opts.code ? 14 : 0) + 17 + 14 };
27: }
28:
29: export function useSafeArea(): Rect | null {
30:   const camera = useThree((s) => s.camera) as PerspectiveCamera;
31:   const gl = useThree((s) => s.gl);
32:   const size = useThree((s) => s.size);
33:   const [safe, setSafe] = useState<Rect | null>(null);
34:   const last = useRef<Rect | null>(null);
35:   const invalidate = useThree((s) => s.invalidate);
36:   useLayoutEffect(() => observeSceneLayout(gl.domElement, () => {
37:     const r = safeRect(gl.domElement, size.width, size.height);
38:     const p = last.current;
39:     if (!p || Math.abs(p.x - r.x) > 2 || Math.abs(p.y - r.y) > 2 || Math.abs(p.w - r.w) > 2 || Math.abs(p.h - r.h) > 2) {
40:       last.current = r;
41:       setSafe(r);
42:     }
43:   }), [gl, size.width, size.height]);
44:   useLayoutEffect(() => {
45:     if (!safe) return;
46:     const { width: W, height: H } = size;
47:     camera.setViewOffset(W, H, W / 2 - (safe.x + safe.w / 2), H / 2 - (safe.y + safe.h / 2), W, H);
48:     camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
49:     invalidate();
50:   }, [safe, size, camera, invalidate]);
51:   return safe;
52: }
53:
54: export function fitRing({
55:   camera,
56:   width,
57:   height,
58:   safe,
59:   panels,
60:   radius: R,
61:   top,
62:   titles,
63:   dir: direction,
64:   center = 0.08,
65: }: {
66:   camera: PerspectiveCamera;
67:   width: number;
68:   height: number;
69:   safe: Rect;
70:   panels: Rect[];
71:   radius: number;
72:   top: number;
73:   titles: RingTitle[];
74:   dir: Vector3;
75:   /** Where along z the camera first looks, as a share of the radius (then adjusted to center the ring). */
76:   center?: number;
77: }) {
78:   const cam = camera.clone();
79:   const dir = direction.clone().normalize();
80:   const ring: Vector3[] = [];
81:   for (let i = 0; i < 72; i++) {
82:     const a = (i / 72) * Math.PI * 2;
83:     ring.push(new Vector3(Math.cos(a) * R, 0, Math.sin(a) * R), new Vector3(Math.cos(a) * R, top, Math.sin(a) * R));
84:   }
85:   const blocked = panels.map((b) => ({ x: b.x - 6, y: b.y - 6, w: b.w + 12, h: b.h + 12 }));
86:   const inside = (r: Rect) => r.x >= 8 && r.y >= 8 && r.x + r.w <= width - 8 && r.y + r.h <= height - 8;
87:   const v = new Vector3();
88:   const target = new Vector3();
89:   const toScreen = (p: Vector3) => {
90:     v.copy(p).project(cam);
91:     return [((v.x + 1) / 2) * width, ((1 - v.y) / 2) * height] as const;
92:   };
93:   const place = (d: number, tz: number) => {
94:     target.set(0, 0, tz);
95:     cam.position.copy(target).addScaledVector(dir, d);
96:     cam.lookAt(target);
97:     cam.updateMatrixWorld();
98:   };
99:   // "all": ring and titles clear of the panels; "titles": ring and titles inside the canvas;
100:   // "ring": the ring alone clear of the panels (a phone has no room for titles at the sides).
101:   type Mode = "all" | "titles" | "ring";
102:   const fits = (d: number, tz: number, mode: Mode) => {
103:     place(d, tz);
104:     const avoid = mode !== "titles";
105:     for (const p of ring) {
106:       const [x, y] = toScreen(p);
107:       const dot = { x, y, w: 0, h: 0 };
108:       if (!inside(dot) || (avoid && blocked.some((b) => rectsOverlap(dot, b, 0)))) return false;
109:     }
110:     if (mode === "ring") return true;
111:     const [ox, oy] = toScreen(target);
112:     for (const t of titles) {
113:       const [px, py] = toScreen(t.anchor);
114:       const r = outwardRect(px, py, ox, oy, t.w, t.h);
115:       if (!inside(r) || (avoid && blocked.some((b) => rectsOverlap(r, b, 0)))) return false;
116:     }
117:     return true;
118:   };
119:   const verticalCenter = (d: number, tz: number) => {
120:     place(d, tz);
121:     let minY = Infinity;
122:     let maxY = -Infinity;
123:     for (const p of ring) {
124:       const [, y] = toScreen(p);
125:       minY = Math.min(minY, y);
126:       maxY = Math.max(maxY, y);
127:     }
128:     return (minY + maxY) / 2;
129:   };
130:   const search = (tz: number, mode: Mode) => {
131:     let lo = R * 0.4;
132:     let hi = R * 14;
133:     if (!fits(hi, tz, mode)) return null;
134:     for (let k = 0; k < 26; k++) {
135:       const mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
136:       if (fits(mid, tz, mode)) hi = mid;
137:       else lo = mid;
138:     }
139:     return hi;
140:   };
141:   const closest = (tz: number) => search(tz, "all") ?? search(tz, "titles") ?? search(tz, "ring");
142:   let tz = R * center;
143:   let d = R * 2.1;
144:   for (let iter = 0; iter < 4; iter++) {
145:     d = closest(tz) ?? R * 2.4;
146:     // Perspective draws the near side larger: slide the target until the ring sits in the middle of the free area.
147:     const cy = verticalCenter(d, tz);
148:     const off = cy - (safe.y + safe.h / 2);
149:     if (Math.abs(off) < 2) break;
150:     const slope = (verticalCenter(d, tz + R * 0.05) - cy) / (R * 0.05);
151:     if (!Number.isFinite(slope) || Math.abs(slope) < 1e-6) break;
152:     tz -= off / slope;
153:   }
154:   // A corner panel can hold the ring back on one side only: nudging it off-center may let it grow.
155:   let best = { d, tz };
156:   for (let k = -5; k <= 5; k++) {
157:     if (k === 0) continue;
158:     const t = tz + k * R * 0.06;
159:     const dk = closest(t);
160:     if (dk !== null && dk < best.d * 0.97) best = { d: dk, tz: t };
161:   }
162:   target.set(0, 0, best.tz);
163:   return { position: target.clone().addScaledVector(dir, best.d), target: target.clone(), distance: best.d };
164: }

FILE apps/web/src/scene/layout.ts SHA256 f120d87660089253017f7a84811c27feb9dfce5b7e78995192eae274a67c2554
1: /**
2:  * Spatial layouts for any framework graph (DESIGN.md › Spatial System).
3:  *
4:  * - Constellation: radial hierarchy on the XZ plane. Top-level groups get
5:  *   angular sectors proportional to their size; units of work sit on outer
6:  *   rings; SP 800-53 enhancements form radial stalks beyond their control.
7:  * - Terrain: each top-level group is a honeycomb "district" of hex cells, one
8:  *   cell per unit of work; districts ring the framework core.
9:  *
10:  * Y is reserved for measured values (current / target level), never decoration.
11:  */
12: import type { LeanNode } from "../lib/types.ts";
13:
14: export type Vec3 = [number, number, number];
15: export type ViewMode = "constellation" | "terrain";
16:
17: export interface Sector {
18:   id: string;
19:   code: string;
20:   title: string;
21:   start: number;
22:   end: number;
23:   radius: number;
24:   labelPos: Vec3;
25: }
26:
27: export interface Layout {
28:   view: ViewMode;
29:   positions: Map<string, Vec3>;
30:   /** Hex radius for unit cells in this layout. */
31:   cell: number;
32:   units: string[];
33:   hubs: string[];
34:   mids: string[];
35:   links: [string, string][];
36:   sectors: Sector[];
37:   radius: number;
38:   byId: Map<string, LeanNode>;
39:   children: Map<string | null, LeanNode[]>;
40: }
41:
42: function index(nodes: LeanNode[]) {
43:   const byId = new Map(nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]));
44:   const children = new Map<string | null, LeanNode[]>();
45:   for (const n of nodes) {
46:     const list = children.get(n.parentId) ?? [];
47:     list.push(n);
48:     children.set(n.parentId, list);
49:   }
50:   for (const list of children.values()) list.sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
51:   return { byId, children };
52: }
53:
54: function weightOf(id: string, children: Map<string | null, LeanNode[]>, byId: Map<string, LeanNode>, memo: Map<string, number>): number {
55:   const cached = memo.get(id);
56:   if (cached !== undefined) return cached;
57:   const kids = children.get(id) ?? [];
58:   const self = byId.get(id)?.assessable ? 1 : 0;
59:   const w = Math.max(1, self + kids.reduce((s, k) => s + weightOf(k.id, children, byId, memo), 0));
60:   memo.set(id, w);
61:   return w;
62: }
63:
64: const polar = (r: number, a: number, y = 0): Vec3 => [Math.cos(a) * r, y, Math.sin(a) * r];
65:
66: /**
67:  * The scene draws units of work and the groups that hold them. Nodes with no unit
68:  * below them (MITRE ATLAS's mitigations, a law with no tracked obligation) stay in
69:  * the outline and the inspector but take no place in space: `positions` has only
70:  * what is drawn, while `byId` and `children` keep every node for navigation.
71:  */
72: export function computeLayout(nodes: LeanNode[], view: ViewMode): Layout {
73:   const { children } = index(nodes);
74:   const holds = new Map<string, boolean>();
75:   const hasUnit = (n: LeanNode): boolean => {
76:     const known = holds.get(n.id);
77:     if (known !== undefined) return known;
78:     const v = n.assessable || (children.get(n.id) ?? []).some(hasUnit);
79:     holds.set(n.id, v);
80:     return v;
81:   };
82:   const drawn = nodes.filter(hasUnit);
83:   const layout = view === "terrain" ? terrain(drawn) : constellation(drawn);
84:   const all = index(nodes);
85:   return { ...layout, byId: all.byId, children: all.children };
86: }
87:
88: function constellation(nodes: LeanNode[]): Layout {
89:   const { byId, children } = index(nodes);
90:   const memo = new Map<string, number>();
91:   const roots = children.get(null) ?? [];
92:   const positions = new Map<string, Vec3>();
93:   const units: string[] = [];
94:   const hubs: string[] = [];
95:   const mids: string[] = [];
96:   const links: [string, string][] = [];
97:   const sectors: Sector[] = [];
98:
99:   // Ring radii grow with density so nodes never overlap.
100:   const byDepth = new Map<number, number>();
101:   for (const n of nodes) {
102:     const parent = n.parentId ? byId.get(n.parentId) : undefined;
103:     const stalk = parent?.assessable && n.assessable;
104:     if (!stalk) byDepth.set(n.depth, (byDepth.get(n.depth) ?? 0) + 1);
105:   }
106:   const spacing = 1.15;
107:   const usable = 2 * Math.PI * 0.86;
108:   const radii: number[] = [];
109:   let r = 0;
110:   for (let d = 0; d <= 4; d++) {
111:     const count = byDepth.get(d) ?? 0;
112:     const min = d === 0 ? Math.max(6.5, (count * 3.2) / usable) : r + 7;
113:     r = Math.max(min, (count * spacing) / usable);
114:     radii.push(r);
115:   }
116:
117:   // A ring of labeled groups (up to 40, e.g. the state laws between jurisdictions and
118:   // obligations) moves out toward the units so the group codes have room to be read.
119:   const labeledMids = nodes.filter((n) => n.depth === 1 && !n.assessable).length;
120:   if (labeledMids > 0 && labeledMids <= 40 && radii[2] !== undefined && byDepth.get(2)) radii[1] = Math.max(radii[1]!, Math.min(radii[2] * 0.58, radii[2] - 7));
121:
122:   const totalWeight = roots.reduce((s, n) => s + weightOf(n.id, children, byId, memo), 0);
123:   const gap = roots.length > 1 ? 0.14 * Math.PI * 2 * (1 / roots.length) * 0.35 : 0;
124:   const available = Math.PI * 2 - gap * roots.length;
125:   let angle = -Math.PI / 2 + gap / 2;
126:   let outer = radii[0]!;
127:
128:   const place = (node: LeanNode, a0: number, a1: number) => {
129:     const mid = (a0 + a1) / 2;
130:     const r0 = radii[node.depth] ?? radii[radii.length - 1]!;
131:     positions.set(node.id, polar(r0, mid));
132:     outer = Math.max(outer, r0);
133:     if (node.depth === 0) hubs.push(node.id);
134:     else if (node.assessable) units.push(node.id);
135:     else mids.push(node.id);
136:     if (node.parentId) links.push([node.parentId, node.id]);
137:     const kids = children.get(node.id) ?? [];
138:     if (!kids.length) return;
139:     if (node.assessable) {
140:       // Stalk: enhancements continue radially outward, zig-zagging slightly.
141:       kids.forEach((k, i) => {
142:         const rr = r0 + 1.25 * (i + 1);
143:         const wobble = ((i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * 0.32) / Math.max(rr, 1);
144:         positions.set(k.id, polar(rr, mid + wobble));
145:         outer = Math.max(outer, rr);
146:         units.push(k.id);
147:         links.push([i === 0 ? node.id : kids[i - 1]!.id, k.id]);
148:         for (const g of children.get(k.id) ?? []) place(g, mid, mid);
149:       });
150:       return;
151:     }
152:     const w = kids.reduce((s, k) => s + weightOf(k.id, children, byId, memo), 0);
153:     let a = a0;
154:     for (const k of kids) {
155:       const span = ((a1 - a0) * weightOf(k.id, children, byId, memo)) / w;
156:       place(k, a, a + span);
157:       a += span;
158:     }
159:   };
160:
161:   for (const root of roots) {
162:     const span = (available * weightOf(root.id, children, byId, memo)) / totalWeight;
163:     place(root, angle, angle + span);
164:     sectors.push({ id: root.id, code: root.code, title: root.title, start: angle, end: angle + span, radius: 0, labelPos: [0, 0, 0] });
165:     angle += span + gap;
166:   }
167:   const sectorRadius = outer + 3.2;
168:   for (const s of sectors) {
169:     s.radius = sectorRadius;
170:     s.labelPos = polar(sectorRadius + 3.4, (s.start + s.end) / 2, 0.2);
171:   }
172:   return { view: "constellation", positions, cell: 0.46, units, hubs, mids, links, sectors, radius: sectorRadius + 6, byId, children };
173: }
174:
175: /** Axial hex coordinates of a spiral fill (center first, then rings). */
176: function hexSpiral(count: number): [number, number][] {
177:   const out: [number, number][] = [[0, 0]];
178:   const dirs: [number, number][] = [
179:     [1, 0],
180:     [1, -1],
181:     [0, -1],
182:     [-1, 0],
183:     [-1, 1],
184:     [0, 1],
185:   ];
186:   for (let ring = 1; out.length < count; ring++) {
187:     let q = -ring;
188:     let r = ring;
189:     for (const [dq, dr] of dirs) {
190:       for (let s = 0; s < ring && out.length < count; s++) {
191:         out.push([q, r]);
192:         q += dq;
193:         r += dr;
194:       }
195:     }
196:   }
197:   return out.slice(0, count);
198: }
199:
200: function terrain(nodes: LeanNode[]): Layout {
201:   const { byId, children } = index(nodes);
202:   const roots = children.get(null) ?? [];
203:   const positions = new Map<string, Vec3>();
204:   const units: string[] = [];
205:   const hubs: string[] = [];
206:   const mids: string[] = [];
207:   const links: [string, string][] = [];
208:   const sectors: Sector[] = [];
209:   const cell = 0.82;
210:   const w = Math.sqrt(3) * cell;
211:
212:   const collect = (id: string): LeanNode[] => {
213:     const out: LeanNode[] = [];
214:     const walk = (pid: string) => {
215:       for (const k of children.get(pid) ?? []) {
216:         if (k.assessable) out.push(k);
217:         else mids.push(k.id);
218:         walk(k.id);
219:       }
220:     };
221:     walk(id);
222:     return out;
223:   };
224:
225:   const districts = roots.map((root) => {
226:     const cells = collect(root.id);
227:     const spiral = hexSpiral(Math.max(1, cells.length));
228:     const radius = cell * 1.9 * Math.sqrt(Math.max(1, cells.length)) * 0.62 + cell * 1.6;
229:     return { root, cells, spiral, radius };
230:   });
231:   const circumference = districts.reduce((s, d) => s + d.radius * 2 + 3, 0);
232:   const ringRadius = Math.max(9, circumference / (2 * Math.PI));
233:   let angle = -Math.PI / 2;
234:   for (const d of districts) {
235:     const span = ((d.radius * 2 + 3) / circumference) * Math.PI * 2;
236:     const mid = angle + span / 2;
237:     const center = polar(ringRadius + d.radius * 0.35, mid);
238:     hubs.push(d.root.id);
239:     positions.set(d.root.id, [center[0] * 0.42, 0, center[2] * 0.42]);
240:     d.cells.forEach((c, i) => {
241:       const [q, r] = d.spiral[i]!;
242:       const x = center[0] + w * (q + r / 2);
243:       const z = center[2] + cell * 1.5 * r;
244:       positions.set(c.id, [x, 0, z]);
245:       units.push(c.id);
246:     });
247:     // Mid-level groups (categories/controls) sit at the centroid of their cells for navigation.
248:     for (const mid of children.get(d.root.id) ?? []) {
249:       if (mid.assessable) continue;
250:       const pts = (function gather(id: string): Vec3[] {
251:         return (children.get(id) ?? []).flatMap((k) => (k.assessable ? [positions.get(k.id)!] : gather(k.id)));
252:       })(mid.id).filter(Boolean);
253:       if (!pts.length) continue;
254:       const cx = pts.reduce((s, p) => s + p[0], 0) / pts.length;
255:       const cz = pts.reduce((s, p) => s + p[2], 0) / pts.length;
256:       positions.set(mid.id, [cx, 0, cz]);
257:     }
258:     sectors.push({ id: d.root.id, code: d.root.code, title: d.root.title, start: angle, end: angle + span, radius: ringRadius, labelPos: polar(ringRadius + d.radius * 0.35 + d.radius + 2.2, mid, 0.2) });
259:     angle += span;
260:   }
261:   for (const id of mids) if (!positions.has(id)) positions.set(id, [0, 0, 0]);
262:   return { view: "terrain", positions, cell, units, hubs, mids, links, sectors, radius: ringRadius + Math.max(...districts.map((d) => d.radius)) + 3, byId, children };
263: }

FILE apps/web/src/scene/spatialGeometry.ts SHA256 cbf3ecef507c1437c96dd8a181a0cdc25336404bfbf31fa7511f5a2a910b1d2a
1: /** Ground geometry stays on XZ: surface offsets prevent z-fighting, never encode data. */
2: import { BufferGeometry, Float32BufferAttribute } from "three";
3: import type { Layout, Vec3 } from "./layout.ts";
4:
5: export type Point2 = [number, number];
6:
7: /** Counter-clockwise convex hull in XZ, including the footprint of every cell. */
8: export function convexHull(points: Point2[]): Point2[] {
9:   const sorted = [...new Map(points.map((p) => [`${p[0]},${p[1]}`, p])).values()].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]);
10:   if (sorted.length < 3) return sorted;
11:   const cross = (a: Point2, b: Point2, c: Point2) => (b[0] - a[0]) * (c[1] - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (c[0] - a[0]);
12:   const half = (list: Point2[]) => {
13:     const out: Point2[] = [];
14:     for (const p of list) {
15:       while (out.length > 1 && cross(out.at(-2)!, out.at(-1)!, p) <= 0) out.pop();
16:       out.push(p);
17:     }
18:     return out;
19:   };
20:   return [...half(sorted).slice(0, -1), ...half([...sorted].reverse()).slice(0, -1)];
21: }
22:
23: export function rootOf(layout: Layout, id: string | null): string | undefined {
24:   let node = id ? layout.byId.get(id) : undefined;
25:   while (node?.parentId) node = layout.byId.get(node.parentId);
26:   return node?.id;
27: }
28:
29: export function districtHulls(layout: Layout): Map<string, Point2[]> {
30:   const points = new Map<string, Point2[]>();
31:   for (const id of layout.units) {
32:     const root = rootOf(layout, id);
33:     const p = layout.positions.get(id);
34:     if (!root || !p) continue;
35:     const list = points.get(root) ?? [];
36:     for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
37:       const a = i * Math.PI / 3;
38:       list.push([p[0] + Math.sin(a) * layout.cell * 1.3, p[2] + Math.cos(a) * layout.cell * 1.3]);
39:     }
40:     points.set(root, list);
41:   }
42:   return new Map([...points].map(([id, pts]) => [id, convexHull(pts)]));
43: }
44:
45: /** Explicit upward winding for a triangle fan on XZ. */
46: export function hullTriangles(hull: Point2[], y: number): number[] {
47:   const out: number[] = [];
48:   for (let i = 1; i + 1 < hull.length; i++) {
49:     for (const p of [hull[0]!, hull[i + 1]!, hull[i]!]) out.push(p[0], y, p[1]);
50:   }
51:   return out;
52: }
53:
54: /** An annular strip, with subdivision proportional to its angular span. */
55: export function arcTriangles(inner: number, outer: number, start: number, end: number, y: number): number[] {
56:   if (end <= start || outer <= inner) return [];
57:   const out: number[] = [];
58:   const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((end - start) * 40));
59:   const p = (r: number, a: number): Vec3 => [Math.cos(a) * r, y, Math.sin(a) * r];
60:   for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
61:     const a = start + (end - start) * i / steps;
62:     const b = start + (end - start) * (i + 1) / steps;
63:     for (const v of [p(inner, a), p(inner, b), p(outer, a), p(outer, a), p(inner, b), p(outer, b)]) out.push(...v);
64:   }
65:   return out;
66: }
67:
68: export function positionGeometry(positions: number[]): BufferGeometry {
69:   const geometry = new BufferGeometry();
70:   geometry.setAttribute("position", new Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
71:   return geometry;
72: }
73:
74: /** A flat six-sided rim aligned with Three's CylinderGeometry, for instancing. */
75: export function hexRimGeometry(inner = 0.9): BufferGeometry {
76:   const out: number[] = [];
77:   for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
78:     const a = i * Math.PI / 3;
79:     const b = (i + 1) * Math.PI / 3;
80:     const p = (r: number, angle: number) => [Math.sin(angle) * r, 0, Math.cos(angle) * r];
81:     for (const v of [p(inner, a), p(1, a), p(inner, b), p(1, a), p(1, b), p(inner, b)]) out.push(...v);
82:   }
83:   return positionGeometry(out);
84: }

FILE apps/web/src/state/agentActivity.ts SHA256 977a64de9d3066b6b9465702c48648508b448c5e94bed1e36127fe16c476c94f
1: /** Live agent activity from SSE: drives terracotta comets in the scene and the activity ticker. */
2: import { create } from "zustand";
3: import type { AgentStep } from "@visua/core";
4:
5: export interface LiveStep {
6:   runId: string;
7:   agent: string;
8:   step: AgentStep;
9:   receivedAt: number;
10: }
11:
12: interface AgentActivityState {
13:   steps: LiveStep[];
14:   running: Record<string, { agent: string; status: string }>;
15:   /** Node ids touched in the last few seconds → pulse + comet targets. */
16:   hot: Record<string, number>;
17:   pushStep: (runId: string, agent: string, step: AgentStep) => void;
18:   setRunStatus: (runId: string, agent: string, status: string) => void;
19: }
20:
21: export const useAgentActivity = create<AgentActivityState>((set) => ({
22:   steps: [],
23:   running: {},
24:   hot: {},
25:   pushStep: (runId, agent, step) =>
26:     set((s) => {
27:       const now = Date.now();
28:       const hot = { ...s.hot };
29:       for (const id of step.nodeIds ?? []) hot[id] = now;
30:       for (const [id, t] of Object.entries(hot)) if (now - t > 12_000) delete hot[id];
31:       return { steps: [...s.steps.slice(-80), { runId, agent, step, receivedAt: now }], hot };
32:     }),
33:   setRunStatus: (runId, agent, status) =>
34:     set((s) => {
35:       const running = { ...s.running };
36:       if (status === "running" || status === "queued") running[runId] = { agent, status };
37:       else delete running[runId];
38:       return { running };
39:     }),
40: }));

FILE apps/web/src/state/ui.ts SHA256 fe3c9c573bc5eefe957d978f4125990ba1f7e3675aea483b21237c702526330e
1: /** Client UI state: selection, lens, view mode, panels. */
2: import { create } from "zustand";
3: import type { MinStatus } from "../lib/types.ts";
4:
5: export type Lens = "status" | "gap" | "evidence" | "priority" | "crosswalk" | "overlay";
6: export type ViewMode = "constellation" | "terrain";
7:
8: interface UiState {
9:   selectedId: string | null;
10:   hoveredId: string | null;
11:   /** Node ids an agent or search asked the camera to frame. */
12:   focusIds: string[];
13:   focusSeq: number;
14:   lens: Lens;
15:   view: ViewMode;
16:   outlineOpen: boolean;
17:   /** The Observatory legend: open where there is room for it. */
18:   legendOpen: boolean;
19:   inspectorOpen: boolean;
20:   paletteOpen: boolean;
21:   paletteQuery: string;
22:   /** Below 1024px the nav rail folds into the top bar (DESIGN.md › Layout) and opens as a menu. */
23:   navOpen: boolean;
24:   /** Weakest link status counted in threat views (Threats page, threat Observatory, Nexus ring). */
25:   threatMin: MinStatus;
26:   select: (id: string | null) => void;
27:   hover: (id: string | null) => void;
28:   focus: (ids: string[], lens?: Lens) => void;
29:   setLens: (lens: Lens) => void;
30:   cycleLens: () => void;
31:   setView: (view: ViewMode) => void;
32:   toggleOutline: () => void;
33:   toggleLegend: () => void;
34:   setInspector: (open: boolean) => void;
35:   openPalette: (query?: string) => void;
36:   closePalette: () => void;
37:   setNav: (open: boolean) => void;
38:   setThreatMin: (min: MinStatus) => void;
39: }
40:
41: export const LENSES: Lens[] = ["status", "gap", "evidence", "priority", "crosswalk", "overlay"];
42:
43: export const useUi = create<UiState>((set, get) => ({
44:   selectedId: null,
45:   hoveredId: null,
46:   focusIds: [],
47:   focusSeq: 0,
48:   lens: "status",
49:   view: "constellation",
50:   // Below 1024px the outline is an overlay: it starts closed so the scene is visible.
51:   outlineOpen: typeof window === "undefined" || window.innerWidth > 1024,
52:   legendOpen: typeof window === "undefined" || (window.innerWidth >= 1280 && window.innerHeight >= 960),
53:   inspectorOpen: true,
54:   paletteOpen: false,
55:   paletteQuery: "",
56:   navOpen: false,
57:   threatMin: "unreviewed",
58:   select: (id) => set({ selectedId: id, inspectorOpen: id ? true : get().inspectorOpen }),
59:   hover: (id) => set({ hoveredId: id }),
60:   focus: (ids, lens) => set((s) => ({ focusIds: ids, focusSeq: s.focusSeq + 1, lens: lens ?? s.lens, selectedId: ids.length === 1 ? ids[0]! : s.selectedId })),
61:   setLens: (lens) => set({ lens }),
62:   cycleLens: () => set((s) => ({ lens: LENSES[(LENSES.indexOf(s.lens) + 1) % LENSES.length]! })),
63:   setView: (view) => set({ view }),
64:   toggleOutline: () => set((s) => ({ outlineOpen: !s.outlineOpen })),
65:   toggleLegend: () => set((s) => ({ legendOpen: !s.legendOpen })),
66:   setInspector: (open) => set({ inspectorOpen: open }),
67:   openPalette: (query = "") => set({ paletteOpen: true, paletteQuery: query }),
68:   closePalette: () => set({ paletteOpen: false }),

70:   setThreatMin: (threatMin) => set({ threatMin }),
71: }));

13: :root {

1117: }
1118:
1119: .progress {

1131:
1132: .table {

1135:   border-spacing: 0;
1136: }
1137: .table th {
1138:   background: var(--table-header-bg);

1171:
1172: /* Phones: tables keep their essential columns and wrap long values; secondary columns hide. */
1173: @media (max-width: 640px) {
1174:   .table th,
1175:   .table td {
1176:     padding-left: var(--space-sm);
1177:     padding-right: var(--space-sm);
1178:   }
1179:   .table td {
1180:     overflow-wrap: anywhere;
1181:   }
1182:   .table--members :is(th, td):is(:nth-child(3), :nth-child(4)),
1183:   .table--tokens :is(th, td):is(:nth-child(3), :nth-child(4)),
1184:   .table--sso :is(th, td):nth-child(3),
1185:   .table--systems :is(th, td):is(:nth-child(2), :nth-child(4)),
1186:   .table--gai :is(th, td):is(:nth-child(2), :nth-child(3), :nth-child(5)),
1187:   .table--evidence :is(th, td):is(:nth-child(2), :nth-child(3)),
1188:   .table--cosais :is(th, td):nth-child(2),
1189:   .table--obligations :is(th, td):is(:nth-child(3), :nth-child(4)) {
1190:     display: none;
1191:   }
1192:   /* An editable table becomes one card per row, each cell labeled. */
1193:   .table--stack thead {
1194:     display: none;
1195:   }
1196:   .table--stack,
1197:   .table--stack tbody {
1198:     display: block;
1199:   }
1200:   .table--stack tr {
1201:     display: grid;
1202:     grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) auto;
1203:     align-items: end;
1204:     gap: var(--space-sm);
1205:     padding: var(--space-md) 0;
1206:     border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-outline);
1207:   }
1208:   .table--stack td {
1209:     display: block;
1210:     height: auto;
1211:     padding: 0;
1212:     border: 0;
1213:     background: transparent;
1214:   }
1215:   .table--stack tr:hover td {
1216:     background: transparent;
1217:   }
1218:   .table--stack td:first-child {
1219:     grid-column: 1 / -1;
1220:   }
1221:   /* SSO connections: the connection, its domains, then status and remove. */
1222:   .table--sso.table--stack tr {
1223:     grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
1224:   }
1225:   .table--sso.table--stack td:nth-child(2) {
1226:     grid-column: 1 / -1;
1227:   }
1228:   .table--stack td[data-label]::before {
1229:     content: attr(data-label);
1230:     display: block;
1231:     margin-bottom: 4px;
1232:     color: var(--color-on-surface-muted);
1233:     font-family: var(--font-label-caps-family);
1234:     font-size: var(--font-label-caps-size);
1235:     font-weight: var(--font-label-caps-weight);
1236:     letter-spacing: var(--font-label-caps-letter-spacing);
1237:     text-transform: uppercase;
1238:   }
1239:   .table--stack .select {
1240:     width: 100%;
1241:     padding-left: 6px;
1242:     padding-right: 2px;
1243:     font-size: 13px;
1244:   }
1245: }
1246:
1247: /* A table in a scroll box follows the box's width, not the window's: in a narrow pane
1248:    (Reports beside the trust center at 1024px, any phone) secondary columns hide rather
1249:    than scroll sideways. */
1250: .table-box {
1251:   container-type: inline-size;
1252:   overflow: auto;
1253: }
1254: @container (max-width: 600px) {
1255:   .table--audit :is(th, td):nth-child(5) {
1256:     display: none;
1257:   }
1258: }
1259: @container (max-width: 460px) {
1260:   .table--audit :is(th, td):nth-child(1),
1261:   .table--docs :is(th, td):is(:nth-child(2), :nth-child(3)) {
1262:     display: none;
1263:   }
1264: }
1265:
1266: .empty {
1267:   padding: var(--space-2xl);
1268:   text-align: center;
1269:   color: var(--color-on-surface-muted);
1270:   border: 1px dashed var(--color-outline-strong);
1271:   border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
1272: }
1273:
1274: /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ tabs */
1275:
1276: .tabs {
1277:   display: flex;
1278:   flex-wrap: wrap;
1279:   gap: 0 var(--space-xs);
1280:   border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-outline);
1281:   margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
1282: }
1283: .inspector .tabs button {
1284:   padding: 0 10px;
1285: }
1286: .tabs button {
1287:   height: 34px;
1288:   padding: 0 var(--space-md);
1289:   border: 0;
1290:   border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
1291:   background: transparent;
1292:   color: var(--color-on-surface-muted);
1293:   font-family: var(--font-label-lg-family);
1294:   font-size: var(--font-label-lg-size);
1295:   font-weight: 500;
1296:   cursor: pointer;
1297:   white-space: nowrap;
1298: }
1299: .tabs button[aria-selected="true"] {
1300:   color: var(--color-on-surface);
1301:   border-bottom-color: var(--color-primary);
1302: }
1303: .tabs button .count {
1304:   margin-left: 6px;
1305:   color: var(--color-on-surface-muted);
1306:   font-family: var(--font-code-sm-family);
1307:   font-size: 11px;
1308: }
1309:
1310: /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ overlays */
1311:
1312: .overlay {
1313:   position: fixed;
1314:   inset: 0;
1315:   background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-on-surface) 32%, transparent);
1316:   display: grid;
1317:   place-items: start center;
1318:   padding-top: 12vh;
1319:   z-index: 100;
1320:   animation: fade var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out);
1321: }
1322: .dialog {
1323:   width: min(var(--dialog-width), calc(100vw - 32px));
1324:   max-height: 76vh;
1325:   overflow: auto;
1326:   background: var(--dialog-bg);
1327:   color: var(--dialog-fg);
1328:   border: 1px solid var(--color-outline-strong);
1329:   border-radius: var(--dialog-radius);
1330:   padding: var(--dialog-padding);
1331:   box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay);
1332: }
1333: .dialog--wide {
1334:   width: min(880px, calc(100vw - 32px));
1335: }
1336: .palette {
1337:   width: min(var(--command-palette-width), calc(100vw - 32px));
1338:   background: var(--command-palette-bg);
1339:   color: var(--command-palette-fg);
1340:   border: 1px solid var(--color-outline-strong);
1341:   border-radius: var(--command-palette-radius);
1342:   box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay);
1343:   overflow: hidden;
1344: }
1345: .palette__input {
1346:   width: 100%;
1347:   height: 56px;
1348:   border: 0;
1349:   border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-outline);
1350:   background: transparent;
1351:   color: var(--color-on-surface);
1352:   padding: 0 var(--space-xl);
1353:   font-family: var(--font-body-lg-family);
1354:   font-size: var(--font-body-lg-size);
1355:   outline: none;
1356: }
1357: .palette__list {
1358:   max-height: 52vh;
1359:   overflow: auto;
1360:   padding: var(--space-sm);
1361: }
1362: .palette__group {
1363:   padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-md) var(--space-xs);
1364: }
1365: .palette__item {
1366:   display: flex;
1367:   align-items: center;
1368:   gap: var(--space-md);
1369:   width: 100%;
1370:   min-height: 40px;
1371:   padding: 6px var(--space-md);
1372:   border: 0;
1373:   border-radius: var(--radius-md);
1374:   background: transparent;
1375:   color: var(--color-on-surface);
1376:   text-align: left;
1377:   font: inherit;
1378:   cursor: pointer;
1379: }
1380: .palette__item[aria-selected="true"] {
1381:   background: var(--color-surface-bright);
1382: }
1383: .palette__item .muted {
1384:   overflow: hidden;
1385:   text-overflow: ellipsis;
1386:   white-space: nowrap;
1387: }
1388:
1389: .toasts {
1390:   position: fixed;
1391:   bottom: var(--space-xl);
1392:   right: var(--space-xl);
1393:   display: flex;
1394:   flex-direction: column;
1395:   gap: var(--space-sm);
1396:   z-index: 200;
1397: }
1398: .toast {
1399:   background: var(--toast-bg);
1400:   color: var(--toast-fg);
1401:   border: 1px solid var(--color-outline-strong);
1402:   border-radius: var(--toast-radius);
1403:   padding: var(--toast-padding);
1404:   font-size: var(--font-body-sm-size);
1405:   box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay);
1406:   max-width: 380px;
1407:   display: flex;
1408:   gap: var(--space-sm);
1409:   align-items: flex-start;
1410:   animation: rise var(--dur-base) var(--ease-out);
1411: }
1412: .toast--error {
1413:   background: var(--toast-error-bg);
1414:   color: var(--toast-error-fg);
1415: }
1416: .toast--agent {
1417:   border-color: var(--color-tertiary);
1418: }
1419:
1420: .tooltip {
1421:   position: fixed;
1422:   pointer-events: none;
1423:   background: var(--tooltip-bg);
1424:   color: var(--tooltip-fg);
1425:   border: 1px solid var(--color-outline-strong);
1426:   border-radius: var(--tooltip-radius);
1427:   padding: var(--tooltip-padding);
1428:   font-size: var(--font-body-sm-size);
1429:   max-width: 340px;
1430:   z-index: 50;
1431:   box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay);
1432: }
1433:
1434: /* The Crosswalk Nexus below 1024px: the scene, then its details, as one scrolling page. */
1435: @media (max-width: 1024px) {
1436:   .observatory.nexus {
1437:     display: block;
1438:     overflow-y: auto;
1439:   }
1440:   .observatory.nexus .observatory__canvas {
1441:     height: min(68vh, 640px);
1442:   }
1443:   .observatory.nexus .inspector {
1444:     position: static;
1445:     height: auto;
1446:     border-top: 1px solid var(--color-outline);
1447:   }
1448: }
1449: /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ agents */
1450:
1451: .agent-step {
1452:   background: var(--agent-step-bg);
1453:   color: var(--agent-step-fg);
1454:   border-radius: var(--agent-step-radius);
1455:   padding: var(--agent-step-padding);
1456:   font-size: var(--font-body-sm-size);
1457: }
1458: .agent-step--tool {
1459:   background: var(--agent-step-tool-bg);
1460:   color: var(--agent-step-tool-fg);
1461:   font-family: var(--font-code-sm-family);
1462:   font-size: var(--font-code-sm-size);
1463: }
1464: .citation {
1465:   background: var(--citation-bg);
1466:   color: var(--citation-fg);
1467:   border-left: 2px solid var(--color-secondary);
1468:   border-radius: var(--citation-radius);
1469:   padding: var(--citation-padding);
1470:   font-size: var(--font-body-sm-size);
1471: }
1472: .citation cite {
1473:   display: block;
1474:   margin-top: 4px;
1475:   font-style: normal;
1476:   color: var(--color-on-surface-muted);
1477:   font-size: 12px;
1478: }
1479:
1480: .markdown {
1481:   line-height: 1.6;
1482: }
1483: .markdown h1,
1484: .markdown h2,
1485: .markdown h3 {
1486:   font-family: var(--font-headline-md-family);
1487:   margin: 1.1em 0 0.4em;
1488: }
1489: .markdown h1 {
1490:   font-size: 22px;
1491: }
1492: .markdown h2 {
1493:   font-size: 18px;
1494: }
1495: .markdown h3 {
1496:   font-size: 15px;
1497: }
1498: .markdown p,
1499: .markdown ul,
1500: .markdown ol,
1501: .markdown table,
1502: .markdown blockquote {
1503:   margin: 0 0 0.8em;
1504: }
1505: .markdown ul,
1506: .markdown ol {
1507:   padding-left: 1.3em;
1508: }
1509: .markdown table {
1510:   border-collapse: collapse;
1511:   font-size: 13px;
1512: }
1513: .markdown td,
1514: .markdown th {
1515:   border: 1px solid var(--color-outline);
1516:   padding: 4px 8px;
1517:   text-align: left;
1518: }
1519: .markdown blockquote {
1520:   border-left: 2px solid var(--color-secondary);
1521:   padding-left: var(--space-md);
1522:   color: var(--color-on-surface-muted);
1523: }
1524: .markdown code {
1525:   font-family: var(--font-code-sm-family);
1526:   background: var(--color-surface-raised);
1527:   padding: 0 4px;
1528:   border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
1529: }
1530:
1531: @keyframes fade {
1532:   from {
1533:     opacity: 0;
1534:   }
1535: }
1536: @keyframes rise {
1537:   from {
1538:     opacity: 0;
1539:     transform: translateY(8px);
1540:   }
1541: }
1542: @keyframes pulse {
1543:   50% {
1544:     opacity: 0.45;
1545:   }
1546: }
1547: .pulse {
1548:   animation: pulse 1.4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
1549: }
1550:
1551: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
1552:   *,
1553:   *::before,
1554:   *::after {
1555:     animation-duration: 1ms !important;
1556:     transition-duration: 1ms !important;
1557:   }
1558: }
1559:
1560: /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ observatory */
1561:
1562: .observatory {
1563:   position: relative;
1564:   display: grid;
1565:   grid-template-columns: 1fr;
1566:   height: 100%;
1567:   min-height: 0;
1568: }
1569: .observatory.has-outline {
1570:   grid-template-columns: 300px 1fr;
1571: }
1572: .observatory.has-inspector {
1573:   grid-template-columns: 1fr var(--inspector-width);
1574: }
1575: .observatory.has-outline.has-inspector {
1576:   grid-template-columns: 300px 1fr var(--inspector-width);
1577: }
1578: .observatory__canvas {
1579:   position: relative;
1580:   min-width: 0;
1581:   min-height: 0;
1582:   background: var(--scene-space-bg);
1583:   /* The HUD adapts to the stage's own width, which the outline and inspector change. */
1584:   container-type: inline-size;
1585:   container-name: stage;
1586: }
1587:
1588: /* Observatory HUD: a top bar whose two groups wrap rather than overlap, and a foot. */
1589: .hud-bar,
1590: .hud-foot {
1591:   position: absolute;
1592:   left: var(--space-lg);
1593:   right: var(--space-lg);
1594:   z-index: 5;
1595:   display: flex;
1596:   flex-wrap: wrap;
1597:   gap: var(--space-sm);
1598:   pointer-events: none;
1599: }
1600: .hud-bar {
1601:   top: var(--space-lg);
1602:   align-items: flex-start;
1603: }
1604: .hud-foot {
1605:   bottom: var(--space-lg);
1606:   align-items: flex-end;
1607: }
1608: .hud-bar > *,
1609: .hud-foot > * {
1610:   pointer-events: auto;
1611:   min-width: 0;
1612:   max-width: 100%;
1613: }
1614: .hud-bar__group--end,
1615: .hud-foot .hud-stats {
1616:   margin-left: auto;
1617: }
1618: .hud-bar .hud-select {
1619:   display: none;
1620:   width: auto;
1621:   min-height: 30px;
1622:   height: 30px;
1623:   padding: 0 8px;
1624:   font-size: 13px;
1625: }
1626: .hud-legend__toggle {
1627:   display: flex;
1628:   align-items: center;
1629:   gap: 8px;
1630:   padding: 0;
1631:   border: 0;
1632:   background: transparent;
1633:   color: inherit;
1634:   font: inherit;
1635:   cursor: pointer;
1636: }
1637: .hud-stats__value {
1638:   font-size: 30px;
1639: }
1640: .hud-stats__bar {
1641:   width: 260px;
1642:   max-width: 100%;
1643:   margin-top: 10px;
1644: }
1645: .hud-stats__keys {
1646:   font-size: 11px;
1647:   margin-top: 6px;
1648: }
1649: /* The framework switcher becomes a select first (it is the wider group), then the lenses. */
1650: @container stage (max-width: 1180px) {
1651:   .hud-bar .hud-chips--frameworks {
1652:     display: none;
1653:   }
1654:   .hud-bar .hud-select--frameworks {
1655:     display: inline-block;
1656:   }
1657: }
1658: @container stage (max-width: 820px) {
1659:   .hud-bar .hud-chips {
1660:     display: none;
1661:   }
1662:   .hud-bar .hud-select {
1663:     display: inline-block;
1664:   }
1665:   .hud-stats .hud-stats__keys {
1666:     display: none;
1667:   }
1668:   .hud-stats .hud-stats__bar {
1669:     width: 180px;
1670:   }
1671:   .hud-stats .hud-stats__value {
1672:     font-size: 24px;
1673:   }
1674: }
1675: @container stage (max-width: 520px) {
1676:   .hud-bar > .hud,
1677:   .hud-foot > .hud {
1678:     padding: 8px 10px;
1679:   }
1680:   .hud-bar nav[aria-label="Breadcrumb"],
1681:   .hud-stats .hud-stats__bar {
1682:     display: none;
1683:   }
1684: }
1685: .observatory__canvas canvas {
1686:   display: block;
1687: }
1688:
1689: /* Screen-space labels over the 3D scenes (scene/ScreenLabels.tsx): code-sm and label-caps, 11–13px. */
1690: .scene-labels {
1691:   position: absolute;
1692:   inset: 0;
1693:   overflow: hidden;
1694:   pointer-events: none;
1695:   z-index: 2;
1696: }
1697: .scene-label {
1698:   position: absolute;
1699:   top: 0;
1700:   left: 0;
1701:   display: flex;
1702:   flex-direction: column;
1703:   align-items: center;
1704:   gap: 1px;
1705:   white-space: nowrap;
1706:   color: var(--color-on-surface-muted);
1707:   font-family: var(--font-code-sm-family);
1708:   font-size: var(--font-code-sm-size);
1709:   font-weight: var(--font-code-sm-weight);
1710:   line-height: 1.25;
1711:   text-shadow:
1712:     0 1px 0 var(--color-neutral),
1713:     1px 0 0 var(--color-neutral),
1714:     -1px 0 0 var(--color-neutral),
1715:     0 -1px 0 var(--color-neutral);
1716:   /* Shown, hidden and moved on the compositor (ScreenLabels.tsx: showLabel, hideLabel). */
1717:   will-change: transform, opacity;
1718: }
1719: .scene-label[data-side="right"] {
1720:   align-items: flex-start;
1721: }
1722: .scene-label[data-side="left"] {
1723:   align-items: flex-end;
1724: }
1725: .scene-label.is-clickable {
1726:   pointer-events: auto;
1727:   cursor: pointer;
1728: }
1729: .scene-label.is-dim {
1730:   opacity: 0.5;
1731: }
1732: .scene-label__title {
1733:   display: inline-flex;
1734:   align-items: center;
1735: }
1736: .scene-label__swatch {
1737:   width: 8px;
1738:   height: 8px;
1739:   border-radius: 2px;
1740:   margin-right: 6px;
1741:   flex: none;
1742: }
1743: .scene-label--sector .scene-label__title {
1744:   color: var(--color-on-surface);
1745:   font-family: var(--font-label-caps-family);
1746:   font-size: 13px;
1747:   font-weight: var(--font-label-caps-weight);
1748:   letter-spacing: var(--font-label-caps-letter-spacing);
1749:   text-transform: uppercase;
1750: }
1751: .scene-label--selected {
1752:   color: var(--color-on-primary-container);
1753:   font-size: 13px;
1754:   padding: 4px 8px;
1755:   border: 1px solid var(--color-primary);
1756:   border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
1757:   background: var(--color-primary-container);
1758:   text-shadow: none;
1759: }
1760: .scene-label.is-active .scene-label__title {
1761:   color: var(--color-primary);
1762: }
1763: .scene-label.is-clickable:hover .scene-label__title {
1764:   color: var(--color-primary);
1765: }
1766:
1767: .hud--tl,
1768: .hud--tr,
1769: .hud--bl,
1770: .hud--br {
1771:   position: absolute;
1772:   z-index: 5;
1773: }
1774: .hud--tl {
1775:   top: var(--space-lg);
1776:   left: var(--space-lg);
1777:   max-width: 55%;
1778: }
1779: .hud--tr {
1780:   top: var(--space-lg);
1781:   right: var(--space-lg);
1782:   max-width: 44%;
1783: }
1784: .hud--bl {
1785:   bottom: var(--space-lg);
1786:   left: var(--space-lg);
1787: }
1788: .hud--br {
1789:   bottom: var(--space-lg);
1790:   right: var(--space-lg);
1791: }
1792: /* On a narrow stage the Nexus panel takes the full width, so its chips wrap in rows. */
1793: @container stage (max-width: 600px) {
1794:   .hud--tl {
1795:     max-width: none;
1796:     right: var(--space-lg);
1797:   }
1798: }
1799:
1800: .outline {
1801:   background: var(--color-surface);
1802:   border-right: 1px solid var(--color-outline);
1803:   display: flex;
1804:   flex-direction: column;
1805:   min-height: 0;
1806: }
1807: /* Phones: the outline is the view, the 3D scene one tap away. */
1808: .observatory.is-outline-view .outline {
1809:   position: static;
1810:   width: auto;
1811:   border-right: 0;
1812:   box-shadow: none;
1813: }
1814: .outline__head {
1815:   padding: var(--space-md);
1816:   border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-outline);
1817: }
1818: .outline__scroll {
1819:   overflow: auto;
1820:   flex: 1;
1821:   padding: var(--space-xs) 0 var(--space-xl);
1822: }
1823: .outline__list {
1824:   list-style: none;
1825:   margin: 0;
1826:   padding: 0;
1827: }
1828: .outline__row {
1829:   display: flex;
1830:   align-items: center;
1831:   gap: 6px;
1832:   min-height: 28px;
1833:   padding-right: var(--space-sm);
1834:   cursor: pointer;
1835:   font-size: 12.5px;
1836:   border-left: 2px solid transparent;
1837: }
1838: .outline__row:hover {
1839:   background: var(--color-surface-raised);
1840: }
1841: .outline__row.is-selected {
1842:   background: var(--color-primary-container);
1843:   border-left-color: var(--color-primary);
1844: }
1845: .outline__toggle {
1846:   width: 18px;
1847:   height: 18px;
1848:   display: grid;
1849:   place-items: center;
1850:   border: 0;
1851:   background: transparent;
1852:   color: var(--color-on-surface-muted);
1853:   cursor: pointer;
1854:   padding: 0;
1855: }
1856: .outline__code {
1857:   color: var(--color-primary);
1858:   font-size: 11.5px;
1859:   white-space: nowrap;
1860: }
1861: .outline__text {
1862:   flex: 1;
1863:   min-width: 0;
1864:   overflow: hidden;
1865:   text-overflow: ellipsis;
1866:   white-space: nowrap;
1867:   color: var(--color-on-surface-muted);
1868: }
1869:
1870: .inspector {
1871:   background: var(--inspector-bg);
1872:   color: var(--inspector-fg);
1873:   border-left: 1px solid var(--color-outline);
1874:   display: flex;
1875:   flex-direction: column;
1876:   min-height: 0;
1877:   min-width: 0;
1878: }
1879: .inspector__head {
1880:   padding: var(--inspector-padding) var(--inspector-padding) var(--space-sm);
1881: }
1882: .inspector__grabber {
1883:   display: none;
1884:   flex: none;
1885:   width: 56px;
1886:   height: 18px;
1887:   margin: 6px auto -8px;
1888:   padding: 0;
1889:   border: 0;
1890:   background: transparent;
1891:   cursor: pointer;
1892: }
1893: .inspector__grabber::before {
1894:   content: "";
1895:   display: block;
1896:   width: 40px;
1897:   height: 4px;
1898:   margin: 0 auto;
1899:   border-radius: var(--radius-full);
1900:   background: var(--color-outline-strong);
1901: }
1902: .threat-pub {
1903:   border-top: 1px solid var(--color-outline);
1904:   padding-top: var(--space-sm);
1905: }
1906: .threat-pub > summary {

1908:   list-style-position: outside;
1909: }
1910: .inspector__title {
1911:   font-family: var(--font-headline-md-family);
1912:   font-size: var(--font-headline-md-size);
1913:   font-weight: var(--font-headline-md-weight);
1914:   margin-top: 6px;
1915: }
1916: .inspector .tabs {
1917:   padding: 0 var(--inspector-padding);
1918:   margin-bottom: 0;
1919: }
1920: .inspector__body {
1921:   flex: 1;
1922:   overflow: auto;
1923:   padding: var(--space-lg) var(--inspector-padding) var(--space-xl);
1924: }
1925: .inspector__foot {
1926:   border-top: 1px solid var(--color-outline);
1927:   padding: var(--space-md) var(--inspector-padding);
1928:   background: var(--color-surface);
1929: }
1930:
1931: @media (max-width: 1024px) {
1932:   .observatory.has-outline {
1933:     grid-template-columns: 1fr;
1934:   }
1935:   /* The outline opens over the scene instead of beside it. */
1936:   .observatory.has-outline .outline {
1937:     position: absolute;
1938:     top: 0;
1939:     left: 0;
1940:     bottom: 0;
1941:     width: min(320px, 86%);
1942:     z-index: 20;
1943:     box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay);
1944:   }
1945:   .observatory.has-inspector,
1946:   .observatory.has-outline.has-inspector {
1947:     grid-template-columns: 1fr;
1948:   }
1949:   /* The inspector becomes a bottom sheet: half the height, or nearly all of it from its handle. */
1950:   .inspector {
1951:     position: absolute;
1952:     left: 0;
1953:     right: 0;
1954:     bottom: 0;
1955:     height: 55%;
1956:     z-index: 30;
1957:     border-left: 0;
1958:     border-top: 1px solid var(--color-outline-strong);
1959:     border-radius: var(--radius-xl) var(--radius-xl) 0 0;
1960:     box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay);
1961:     transition: height var(--dur-slow) var(--ease-out);
1962:   }
1963:   .inspector[data-full] {
1964:     height: calc(100% - var(--space-md));
1965:   }
1966:   .inspector__grabber {
1967:     display: block;
1968:   }
1969: }
1970:
1971: /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ agents */

1989: .runrow.is-selected {

1994: .flight {

1997:   padding: 0 0 0 4px;

2005:   bottom: 6px;

2025:   z-index: 1;

2027: .flight__dot--proposal,

2119: /* ------------------------------------------------------------------ bullet chart */

2121: .bullet__row {

2137: /* Phones: the category name takes its own line; the bullet and its numbers share the next. */
2138: @media (max-width: 640px) {

2154:   .bullet__row--head {

2156:   }
2157:   .bullet__row--head > :nth-child(1) {
2158:     display: none;
2159:   }
2160:   .bullet__group {
2161:     padding: 12px var(--space-md) 4px;
2162:   }
2163: }
2164:

2169:   align-items: center;

2172: @media (max-width: 640px) {

2177:   }
2178:   .series-row > :nth-child(1) {
2179:     grid-area: label;
2180:   }
2181:   .series-row > :nth-child(2) {
2182:     grid-area: bar;
2183:   }
2184:   .series-row > :nth-child(3) {
2185:     grid-area: count;
2186:   }
2187: }

7:
8: describe("demand camera flights", () => {
9:   it("does not consume idle time as animation time when a flight starts", () => {
10:     vi.stubGlobal("DOMRect", class { x = 0; y = 0; width = 0; height = 0; });

14:     void controls.setLookAt(0, 0, 10, 0, 0, 0, false);

20:     expect(camera.position.x).toBeLessThan(5);

23:     expect(camera.position.z).toBeCloseTo(10, 2);

43: /** Minimal DOM tree: exercise real observer scheduling without WebGL. */
44: class ElementStub {
45:   nodeType = 1;
46:   children: ElementStub[] = [];
47:   parent: ElementStub | null = null;
48:   listeners = new Map<string, EventListener>();
49:   readonly kind: string;
50:   constructor(kind: string) { this.kind = kind; }
51:   append(child: ElementStub) { child.parent = this; this.children.push(child); return child; }
52:   remove() { if (this.parent) this.parent.children = this.parent.children.filter((child) => child !== this); this.parent = null; }
53:   matches(selector: string): boolean { return selector === `[data-${this.kind}]` || (this.kind === "labels" && selector === ".scene-labels"); }
54:   closest(selector: string): ElementStub | null { return this.matches(selector) ? this : this.parent?.closest(selector) ?? null; }
55:   contains(node: ElementStub): boolean { return this === node || this.children.some((child) => child.contains(node)); }
56:   querySelectorAll(selector: string): ElementStub[] { return this.children.flatMap((child) => [...(child.matches(selector) ? [child] : []), ...child.querySelectorAll(selector)]); }
57:   querySelector(selector: string) { return this.querySelectorAll(selector)[0] ?? null; }
58:   addEventListener(name: string, listener: EventListener) { this.listeners.set(name, listener); }
59:   removeEventListener(name: string) { this.listeners.delete(name); }
60: }
61:
62: function environment() {
63:   const root = new ElementStub("stage-root");
64:   const canvas = root.append(new ElementStub("canvas"));
65:   let mutations!: MutationCallback;
66:   let resized!: ResizeObserverCallback;
67:   const observed = new Set<object>();
68:   const disconnect = vi.fn();
69:   vi.stubGlobal("MutationObserver", class {
70:     constructor(callback: MutationCallback) { mutations = callback; }
71:     observe() {}
72:     disconnect = disconnect;
73:   });
74:   vi.stubGlobal("ResizeObserver", class {
75:     constructor(callback: ResizeObserverCallback) { resized = callback; }
76:     observe(target: object) { observed.add(target); }
77:     unobserve(target: object) { observed.delete(target); }
78:     disconnect = disconnect;
79:   });
80:   const frames = new Map<number, FrameRequestCallback>();
81:   let id = 0;
82:   vi.stubGlobal("requestAnimationFrame", (callback: FrameRequestCallback) => { frames.set(++id, callback); return id; });
83:   vi.stubGlobal("cancelAnimationFrame", (key: number) => frames.delete(key));
84:   vi.stubGlobal("window", { addEventListener: vi.fn(), removeEventListener: vi.fn() });
85:   const mutate = (target: ElementStub, type = "attributes", addedNodes: ElementStub[] = [], removedNodes: ElementStub[] = []) => mutations([
86:     { target, type, addedNodes, removedNodes } as unknown as MutationRecord,
87:   ], {} as MutationObserver);
88:   const transition = (target: ElementStub, type: string, propertyName = "transform") => root.listeners.get(type)!({ type, target, propertyName } as unknown as Event);
89:   const tick = () => {
90:     const pending = [...frames.values()];
91:     frames.clear();
92:     pending.forEach((callback) => callback(0));
93:   };
94:   return { root, canvas: canvas as unknown as HTMLCanvasElement, observed, frames, tick, mutate, transition, disconnect, resize: () => resized([], {} as ResizeObserver) };
95: }
96:
97: describe("scene layout wakeups", () => {
98:   it("wakes for new HUD panels and resizes but ignores its own label writes", () => {
99:     const env = environment();
100:     const changed = vi.fn();
101:     const stop = observeSceneLayout(env.canvas, changed);
102:     env.tick();
103:     expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
104:     const label = env.root.append(new ElementStub("labels")).append(new ElementStub("label"));
105:     env.mutate(label);
106:     env.tick();
107:     expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
108:     const holder = env.root.append(new ElementStub("holder"));
109:     const panel = holder.append(new ElementStub("hud"));
110:     env.mutate(holder, "childList", [panel]);
111:     env.resize();
112:     expect(env.observed.has(panel)).toBe(true);
113:     expect(env.frames.size).toBe(1);
114:     env.tick();
115:     expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
116:     panel.remove();
117:     env.mutate(holder, "childList", [], [panel]);
118:     expect(env.observed.has(panel)).toBe(false);
119:     stop();
120:     env.tick();
121:     expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
122:     expect(env.disconnect).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
123:     expect(env.root.listeners.size).toBe(0);
124:   });
125:
126:   it("follows moving HUD transforms, then sleeps after completion or panel removal", () => {
127:     const env = environment();
128:     const changed = vi.fn();
129:     const panel = env.root.append(new ElementStub("hud"));
130:     const stop = observeSceneLayout(env.canvas, changed);
131:     env.tick();
132:     env.transition(panel, "transitionrun");
133:     env.tick();
134:     expect(env.frames.size).toBe(1);
135:     env.transition(panel, "transitionend");
136:     env.tick();
137:     expect(env.frames.size).toBe(0);
138:     env.transition(panel, "transitionrun");
139:     panel.remove();
140:     env.tick();
141:     expect(env.frames.size).toBe(0);
142:     stop();
143:   });
144:
145:   it("ignores child hover transforms and text updates, but wakes when content resizes its panel", () => {
146:     const env = environment();
147:     const panel = env.root.append(new ElementStub("hud"));
148:     const child = panel.append(new ElementStub("button"));
149:     const changed = vi.fn();
150:     const stop = observeSceneLayout(env.canvas, changed);
151:     env.tick();
152:     env.mutate(child);
153:     env.mutate(child, "characterData");
154:     env.mutate(panel, "childList", [child]);
155:     env.transition(child, "transitionrun");
156:     env.transition(child, "transitionrun", "padding");
157:     env.transition(child, "transitionrun", "margin-left");
158:     env.tick();
159:     expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
160:     expect(env.frames.size).toBe(0);
161:     env.resize();
162:     env.tick();
163:     expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
164:     env.transition(env.root, "transitionrun");
165:     env.tick();
166:     expect(changed).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
167:     expect(env.frames.size).toBe(1);
168:     env.transition(env.root, "transitioncancel");
169:     env.tick();
170:     expect(env.frames.size).toBe(0);
171:     stop();
172:   });
173: });

FILE apps/web/test/nexus-geometry.test.ts SHA256 aef0eea14a464304f615f2096358603623b3d0869d5754905343af837b3f1482
1: import { Vector3 } from "three";
2: import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
3: import { arcDistances, arcsFor, LINK_DASH, nexusLayout, overviewBundles, type NexusFramework } from "../src/scene/Nexus.tsx";
4: const frameworks: NexusFramework[] = [
5:   { id: "nist-csf-2.0", shortName: "CSF", family: "csf", enabled: true, groups: [{ id: "a", code: "A", title: "A", units: 20, readiness: 0.5, status: "in-progress" }] },
6:   { id: "nist-rmf", shortName: "RMF", family: "rmf", enabled: true, groups: [{ id: "b", code: "B", title: "B", units: 10, readiness: 0, status: "not-started" }] },
7: ];
8: describe("Nexus relationship geometry", () => {
9:   it("keeps mapping endpoints at their groups while routing finite bundled curves", () => {
10:     const layout = nexusLayout(frameworks);
11:     const arcs = arcsFor(layout, [{ a: "a", b: "b", count: 8, setId: "official" }]);
12:     expect(arcs).toHaveLength(1);
13:     for (const [id, point] of [["a", arcs[0]!.points[0]!], ["b", arcs[0]!.points.at(-1)!]] as const) {
14:       const pos = layout.positions.get(id)!.pos;
15:       expect(point.x).toBeCloseTo(pos[0] * 0.955);
16:       expect(point.z).toBeCloseTo(pos[2] * 0.955);
17:       expect(point.y).toBeCloseTo(0.3);
18:     }
19:     expect(arcs[0]!.points.every(p => p.toArray().every(Number.isFinite))).toBe(true);
20:     expect(arcsFor(layout, [{ a: "missing", b: "b", count: 1, setId: "official" }])).toEqual([]);
21:   });
22:   it("preserves mapping counts and publication sets when aggregating the overview", () => {
23:     const layout = nexusLayout(frameworks);
24:     const grouped = overviewBundles(layout, [
25:       { a: "a", b: "b", count: 4, setId: "official" },
26:       { a: "b", b: "a", count: 6, setId: "official" },
27:       { a: "a", b: "b", count: 3, setId: "threat:draft" },
28:       { a: "a", b: "b", count: 2, setId: "threat:final" },
29:       { a: "missing", b: "b", count: 100, setId: "official" },
30:     ]);
31:     expect(grouped).toHaveLength(3);
32:     expect(grouped.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.count, 0)).toBe(15);
33:     expect(grouped.find(b => b.setId === "official")?.count).toBe(10);
34:     expect(grouped.every(b => b.a === "nist-csf-2.0" && b.b === "nist-rmf")).toBe(true);
35:   });
36:   it("separates parallel publication sets without moving their endpoints", () => {
37:     const arcs = arcsFor(nexusLayout(frameworks), [
38:       { a: "a", b: "b", count: 2, setId: "threat:final" },
39:       { a: "a", b: "b", count: 2, setId: "threat:draft" },
40:     ]);
41:     expect(arcs[0]!.points[0]!.equals(arcs[1]!.points[0]!)).toBe(true);
42:     expect(arcs[0]!.points.at(-1)!.equals(arcs[1]!.points.at(-1)!)).toBe(true);
43:     expect(arcs[0]!.points[20]!.distanceTo(arcs[1]!.points[20]!)).toBeGreaterThan(0.5);
44:   });
45:   it("restarts dash distance for every relationship instead of inheriting the preceding arc", () => {
46:     const distances = arcDistances([
47:       { points: [new Vector3(0, 0, 0), new Vector3(3, 4, 0), new Vector3(6, 8, 0)] },
48:       { points: [new Vector3(10, 0, 0), new Vector3(10, 0, 2)] },
49:     ]);
50:     expect(distances).toEqual({ starts: [0, 5, 0], ends: [5, 10, 2] });
51:   });
52:   it("keeps published, draft, unreviewed and superseded patterns distinct", () => {
53:     expect(LINK_DASH.final).toBeNull();
54:     expect(new Set(Object.values(LINK_DASH).map(v => JSON.stringify(v))).size).toBe(4);
55:   });
56: });

FILE apps/web/test/screen-labels.test.ts SHA256 8aef402ab65a1a2f16fc1e7a511853f8947738ebfb3b6a124e06b73023975cb1
1: import { PerspectiveCamera, Vector3 } from "three";
2: import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
3: import { hideLabel, showLabel, viewState } from "../src/scene/ScreenLabels.tsx";
4:
5: const W = 1076;
6: const H = 848;
7:
8: /** Where a world point lands on screen for a camera. */
9: function screen(camera: PerspectiveCamera, point: Vector3): [number, number] {
10:   const p = point.clone().project(camera);
11:   return [((p.x + 1) / 2) * W, ((1 - p.y) / 2) * H];
12: }
13:
14: /** A camera that has been rendered at the Observatory's starting pose. */
15: function rendered(): PerspectiveCamera {
16:   const camera = new PerspectiveCamera(45, W / H, 0.1, 4000);
17:   camera.position.set(0, 40, 60);
18:   camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
19:   camera.updateMatrixWorld();
20:   return camera;
21: }
22:
23: describe("screen labels follow the camera of the frame being drawn", () => {
24:   // camera-controls moves the camera in its frame callback (position and lookAt) and
25:   // leaves the world matrix to the renderer, which updates it after the labels are placed.
26:   const moveLikeCameraControls = (camera: PerspectiveCamera) => {
27:     camera.position.set(0, 52, 55);
28:     camera.lookAt(0, 0, 4);
29:   };
30:
31:   it("places labels where the moved camera shows their anchors", () => {
32:     const camera = rendered();
33:     viewState(camera, W, H);
34:     moveLikeCameraControls(camera);
35:     viewState(camera, W, H);
36:     const fresh = new PerspectiveCamera(45, W / H, 0.1, 4000);
37:     fresh.position.set(0, 52, 55);
38:     fresh.lookAt(0, 0, 4);
39:     fresh.updateMatrixWorld();
40:     const anchor = new Vector3(-30, 0.9, 12);
41:     const [x, y] = screen(camera, anchor);
42:     const [fx, fy] = screen(fresh, anchor);
43:     expect(x).toBeCloseTo(fx, 3);
44:     expect(y).toBeCloseTo(fy, 3);
45:   });
46: });
47:
48: describe("showing and hiding a label needs no repaint", () => {
49:   // Positions are compositor properties (transform); visibility is a paint property. When
50:   // raster falls behind (a busy machine, SwiftShader), Chromium composites new positions
51:   // over old raster: labels just shown stay blank and labels just hidden stay drawn where
52:   // they were. Showing and hiding must be compositor changes too.
53:   const label = () => ({ style: {} as Record<string, string>, dataset: {} as Record<string, string> });
54:
55:   it("shows a label by opacity and transform, never visibility", () => {
56:     const el = label();
57:     showLabel(el as unknown as HTMLElement, 120.4, 80.6);
58:     // No inline opacity left: the stylesheet's (1, or 0.5 for a dimmed label) applies.
59:     expect(el.style).toEqual({ transform: "translate3d(120px, 81px, 0)", opacity: "", pointerEvents: "" });
60:     expect(el.dataset["shown"]).toBe("true");
61:   });
62:
63:   it("hides a label by opacity and keeps it from taking clicks", () => {
64:     const el = label();
65:     showLabel(el as unknown as HTMLElement, 10, 10);
66:     hideLabel(el as unknown as HTMLElement);
67:     expect(el.style["opacity"]).toBe("0");
68:     expect(el.style["pointerEvents"]).toBe("none");
69:     expect(el.style["visibility"]).toBeUndefined();
70:     expect(el.dataset["shown"]).toBe("false");
71:   });
72: });

FILE apps/web/test/spatial-geometry.test.ts SHA256 d1c00c114589155ca9b9f938e255f8576a8f99a8fb113f32aafa1b88fe7dfac3
1: import { CylinderGeometry, Vector3 } from "three";
2: import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
3: import type { LeanNode } from "../src/lib/types.ts";
4: import { computeLayout } from "../src/scene/layout.ts";
5: import { arcTriangles, convexHull, districtHulls, hexRimGeometry, hullTriangles, rootOf } from "../src/scene/spatialGeometry.ts";
6:
7: function expectUpward(positions: number[]) {
8:   for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i += 9) {
9:     const a = new Vector3().fromArray(positions, i);
10:     const b = new Vector3().fromArray(positions, i + 3);
11:     const c = new Vector3().fromArray(positions, i + 6);
12:     expect(b.sub(a).cross(c.sub(a)).y).toBeGreaterThan(0);
13:   }
14: }
15:
16: const node = (id: string, parentId: string | null, depth: number, assessable: boolean): LeanNode => ({ id, parentId, depth, assessable, code: id, title: id, text: "", order: 0, kind: assessable ? "subcategory" : "function" });
17:
18: describe("cartographic ground geometry", () => {
19:   it("keeps annular strips facing the above-ground camera across wraparound angles", () => {
20:     for (const [start, end] of [[-Math.PI / 2, Math.PI * 1.5], [5.8, 6.6], [0, 0.0001]]) {
21:       const pts = arcTriangles(5, 9, start!, end!, -0.05);
22:       expectUpward(pts);
23:       for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i += 3) {
24:         expect(Math.hypot(pts[i]!, pts[i + 2]!)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5 - 1e-9);
25:         expect(Math.hypot(pts[i]!, pts[i + 2]!)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(9 + 1e-9);
26:         expect(pts[i + 1]).toBe(-0.05);
27:       }
28:     }
29:     expect(arcTriangles(5, 9, 1, 1, 0)).toEqual([]);
30:   });
31:
32:   it("handles duplicate/collinear points and produces upward district surfaces", () => {
33:     const hull = convexHull([[0, 0], [2, 0], [1, 0], [2, 2], [0, 2], [1, 1], [0, 0]]);
34:     expect(hull).toHaveLength(4);
35:     expectUpward(hullTriangles(hull, -0.05));
36:     expect(convexHull([])).toEqual([]);
37:     expect(hullTriangles(convexHull([[0, 0], [1, 0]]), 0)).toEqual([]);
38:   });
39:
40:   it("encloses every terrain cell in its own root district, including deep descendants", () => {
41:     const nodes = [node("a", null, 0, false), node("b", null, 0, false), node("group", "a", 1, false)];
42:     for (let i = 0; i < 180; i++) nodes.push(node(`u${i}`, i % 2 ? "group" : "b", i % 2 ? 2 : 1, true));
43:     const layout = computeLayout(nodes, "terrain");
44:     const hulls = districtHulls(layout);
45:     expect(hulls.size).toBe(2);
46:     expect(rootOf(layout, "u1")).toBe("a");
47:     expect(rootOf(layout, "missing")).toBeUndefined();
48:     for (const id of layout.units) {
49:       const hull = hulls.get(rootOf(layout, id)!)!;
50:       const p = layout.positions.get(id)!;
51:       for (let vertex = 0; vertex < 6; vertex++) {
52:         const angle = vertex * Math.PI / 3;
53:         const x = p[0] + Math.sin(angle) * layout.cell;
54:         const z = p[2] + Math.cos(angle) * layout.cell;
55:         for (let i = 0; i < hull.length; i++) {
56:           const a = hull[i]!;
57:           const b = hull[(i + 1) % hull.length]!;
58:           expect((b[0] - a[0]) * (z - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (x - a[0])).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(-1e-8);
59:         }
60:       }
61:     }
62:   });
63:
64:   it("aligns target rims with the hex prism corners, with upward winding", () => {
65:     const rim = hexRimGeometry();
66:     const prism = new CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 6);
67:     const points = rim.getAttribute("position");
68:     expectUpward(Array.from(points.array));
69:     const corners = prism.getAttribute("position");
70:     for (let i = 0; i < points.count; i++) {
71:       const x = points.getX(i), z = points.getZ(i);
72:       if (Math.hypot(x, z) < 0.95) continue;
73:       expect(Array.from({ length: corners.count }, (_, j) => Math.hypot(x - corners.getX(j), z - corners.getZ(j))).some((d) => d < 1e-6)).toBe(true);
74:     }
75:     rim.dispose();
76:     prism.dispose();
77:   });
78: });
