539: test("3D scenes: labels stay inside the canvas, clear of the HUD and of each other", async ({ page }) => {
540:   // Ten scenes, each measured only once its camera has landed: at SwiftShader's frame rate that
541:   // takes about a minute on an idle arm64 Mac, and several on a busy one (four frames can take
542:   // 5 to 13 seconds under heavy load).
543:   test.setTimeout(600_000);
544:   await signIn(page);
545:   const meta = (await (await page.request.get("/api/meta")).json()) as { frameworks: { id: string }[] };
546:   const scenes = [...["nist-csf-2.0", "nist-sp-800-53-r5", "mitre-atlas", "us-state-ai-laws"].filter((id) => meta.frameworks.some((f) => f.id === id)).map((id) => `/observatory/${id}`), "/crosswalk"];
547:   for (const [width, height] of [
548:     [1440, 900],
549:     [1024, 768],
550:   ] as const) {
551:     await page.setViewportSize({ width, height });
552:     for (const fw of scenes) {
553:       await page.goto(`${WS}${fw}`);
554:       await expect(page.locator(".observatory__canvas canvas")).toBeVisible();
555:       await expect(page.locator('.scene-label--sector[data-shown="true"]').first()).toBeVisible();
556:       // Measure once the camera has landed. Labels are placed again on every frame the camera moves,
557:       // so the layout is sampled a few rendered frames apart, not a fixed time apart: a software
558:       // renderer can stall for a second on its first frames (SwiftShader on arm64 does), and a
559:       // stalled scene looks as still as a settled one.
560:       const layout = () =>
561:         page.evaluate(async () => {
562:           for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) await new Promise(requestAnimationFrame);
563:           return [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".scene-label")]
564:             .filter((l) => l.dataset["shown"] === "true")
565:             .map((l) => {
566:               const r = l.getBoundingClientRect();
567:               return `${l.textContent}@${Math.round(r.left)},${Math.round(r.top)}`;
568:             })
569:             .join("|");
570:         });
571:       // Bounded in samples (at least 400 ms and four rendered frames apart), not seconds: under
572:       // heavy load four frames can take 5 to 13 seconds, and the test's own time limit is the backstop.
573:       let previous = "";
574:       let still = 0;
575:       for (let sample = 0; sample < 12 && still < 2; sample++) {
576:         if (sample) await page.waitForTimeout(400);
577:         const now = await layout();
578:         still = now === previous ? still + 1 : 0;
579:         previous = now;
580:       }
581:       expect(still, `${fw} at ${width}x${height}: labels settle`).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
582:       const report = await page.evaluate(() => {
583:         const canvas = document.querySelector(".observatory__canvas canvas")!.getBoundingClientRect();
584:         const panels = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-hud]")].map((e) => e.getBoundingClientRect());
585:         const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".scene-label")].filter((l) => l.dataset["shown"] === "true").map((l) => ({ text: l.textContent ?? "", r: l.getBoundingClientRect(), sector: l.classList.contains("scene-label--sector") }));
586:         const hit = (a: DOMRect, b: DOMRect) => a.left < b.right && b.left < a.right && a.top < b.bottom && b.top < a.bottom;
587:         const problems: string[] = [];
588:         labels.forEach((l, i) => {
589:           if (l.r.left < canvas.left || l.r.right > canvas.right || l.r.top < canvas.top || l.r.bottom > canvas.bottom) problems.push(`outside the canvas: ${l.text}`);
590:           if (panels.some((p) => hit(l.r, p))) problems.push(`under a panel: ${l.text}`);
591:           for (const other of labels.slice(i + 1)) if (hit(l.r, other.r)) problems.push(`overlaps: ${l.text} / ${other.text}`);
592:         });
593:         return { problems, sectors: labels.filter((l) => l.sector).length };
594:       });
595:       expect(report.problems, `${fw} at ${width}x${height}`).toEqual([]);
596:       // Twenty SP 800-53 families: where a family's title does not fit, its code does.
597:       expect(report.sectors, `${fw} at ${width}x${height}: sectors labeled`).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(fw.endsWith("800-53-r5") ? 12 : 4);
598:     }
599:   }
600: });
